title: Content writer Intern
description:
**We’re Hiring: Content Writer Intern**

**Company:**
ORGITS Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**Job Location:**
Connaught Place (CP), New Delhi

**Work Mode:**
Full-time, On-site

**Qualification:**
Graduate (mandatory)

**Monthly Stipend:**
₹14,000–₹20,000, depending on skills and writing quality

**Apply at:**
hr@orgits.in

**About the Role**

**ORGITS is looking for a talented, research-oriented Content Writer Intern with excellent English writing skills and the ability to produce well-researched, informative, and professional content on business, finance, taxation, regulatory developments, and compliance.**

**The candidate must be a graduate and willing to work full-time from our office in Connaught Place, New Delhi.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research and write high-quality articles on business, finance, taxation, and regulatory compliance.
* Analyse recent regulatory developments and explain their practical implications for businesses and industries.
* Create well-structured, factually accurate, and reader-friendly content.
* Verify information using credible and authoritative sources.
* Maintain high standards of grammar, originality, readability, and professional presentation.
* Contribute to website blogs, business articles, and other content requirements.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Must be a graduate from a recognised university.
* Excellent written English and grammar.
* Strong research, analytical, and content structuring skills.
* Ability to understand complex business and regulatory topics and explain them clearly.
* Familiarity with finance, taxation, compliance, or regulatory developments is an advantage.
* Must be comfortable working full-time, on-site, at our Connaught Place office in New Delhi.
* Fresh graduates and candidates with relevant writing experience are welcome to apply.

**Mandatory Writing Assignment**

**Candidates must complete and submit articles on both**
of the following topics as part of the selection process.

**Topic 1: Recent IRDAI Regulatory Reforms**

**Title:**
Recent IRDAI Regulatory Reforms: Impact on Insurance Companies and the Indian Insurance Industry

The article should discuss recent regulatory reforms introduced by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), their objectives, and their practical impact on insurance companies, policyholders, and the Indian insurance industry.

**Topic 2: Recent EPF Regulatory Changes**

**Title:**
Recent Changes in EPF Regulations: Practical Impact on Employers, Payroll Cost and Compliance

The article should examine recent changes in Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) regulations and explain their practical implications for employers, payroll costs, employee benefits, and statutory compliance.

**Assignment Submission Guidelines**

* Submit both articles in
  **Microsoft Word (.docx) format**
  .
* Conduct thorough research using credible and authoritative sources.
* Focus on recent developments and verify the accuracy of regulatory information.
* Include relevant examples, practical implications, and clear explanations.
* Use appropriate headings, subheadings, and a conclusion.
* Include references or source links for factual and regulatory claims.
* Ensure the content is original, plagiarism-free, and professionally written.

**There is recommended limit of 800-1200 word limit. Candidates should focus on the quality of research, depth of analysis, clarity, and overall writing quality.**

**How to Apply**

**Email the following documents to hr@orgits.in**
:

1. Your updated CV or resume.
2. Completed assignment covering both topics.
3. Both articles must be submitted in Microsoft Word (.docx) format.

**Email Subject:**
Application for Content Writer Intern – [Your Name]

Please ensure that your CV and both assignment articles are attached to the email.

Applications without the completed assignment may not be considered.

**Stipend and Selection Process**

**The monthly stipend will range from ₹14,000 to ₹20,000**
, depending on the candidate’s skills, research ability, analytical thinking, writing quality, and overall performance during the selection process.

Candidates will be evaluated on:

* Research quality and factual accuracy.
* Grammar, vocabulary, and writing style.
* Ability to explain complex subjects clearly.
* Analytical depth and practical understanding.
* Article structure, originality, and professional presentation.

**The final stipend will be determined by the quality of the submitted assignment and the candidate’s overall skill set.**

**Ready to Apply?**

**If you are a graduate with a passion for research and writing, enjoy analysing business and regulatory developments, and are ready to work on-site at our Connaught Place office in New Delhi, we would love to hear from you.**

* **Send your CV and completed writing assignment to hr@orgits.in.**

title: Tendering Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
operates in a dynamic, project-driven environment that requires careful planning, documentation, and coordination with multiple stakeholders. The organization focuses on delivering competitive, compliant proposals and tenders for a variety of contracts and clients. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their work, maintain high professional standards, and contribute to process improvement. The work culture values reliability, attention to detail, and clear communication across functions to support successful bids and long-term partnerships.

**Role Description**
The Tendering Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end tendering process GEM, EProcure, CPWD & Other State Tender portal, including identifying opportunities, analyzing tender requirements, preparing documentation, and submitting proposals within stipulated timelines. Day-to-day tasks include coordinating with internal teams for technical and commercial inputs, compiling cost estimates, ensuring compliance with client and regulatory requirements, and maintaining tender records. The Tendering Specialist will draft and refine proposals, respond to clarifications, support negotiations, and track outcomes to improve future submissions. The role also involves monitoring relevant procurement portals, maintaining a calendar of bids, and contributing to standard templates and best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Tender Management skills Guide to client GEM Bid Creation, Guide to client GEM L1 Link , including end-to-end bid coordination and documentation control.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret tender documents, evaluate risks, and prepare cost and compliance analyses.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with internal stakeholders and interact professionally with clients and vendors.
* Candidates should possess Proposal Writing skills to develop clear, compelling, and well-structured technical and commercial submissions.
* Relevant experience in PBG,EMD preparation & Return Process
* Proficiency with office productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, presentation software) and online tender portals.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple deadlines, and high attention to detail.
* Capacity to work ethically, follow compliance standards, and maintain accurate records of bids and supporting documents.

title: PRODUCTION SPECIALIST L1
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of the role is to provide effective technical support to the process and actively resolve client issues directly or through timely escalation to meet process SLAs.

͏
**Do**

* **Support process by managing transactions as per required quality standards**
  + Fielding all incoming help requests from clients via telephone and/or emails in a courteous manner
  + Document all pertinent end user identification information, including name, department, contact information and nature of problem or issue
  + Update own availability in the RAVE system to ensure productivity of the process
  + Record, track, and document all queries received, problem-solving steps taken and total successful and unsuccessful resolutions
  + Follow standard processes and procedures to resolve all client queries
  + Resolve client queries as per the SLA s defined in the contract
  + Access and maintain internal knowledge bases, resources and frequently asked questions to aid in and provide effective problem resolution to clients
  + Identify and learn appropriate product details to facilitate better client interaction and troubleshooting
  + Document and analyze call logs to spot most occurring trends to prevent future problems
  + Maintain and update self-help documents for customers to speed up resolution time
  + Identify red flags and escalate serious client issues to Team leader in cases of untimely resolution
  + Ensure all product information and disclosures are given to clients before and after the call/email requests
  + Avoids legal challenges by complying with service agreements

͏

* **Deliver excellent customer service through effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of client queries**
  + Provide product support and resolution to clients by performing a question diagnosis while guiding users through step-by-step solutions
  + Assist clients with navigating around product menus and facilitate better understanding of product features
  + Troubleshoot all client queries in a user-friendly, courteous and professional manner
  + Maintain logs and records of all customer queries as per the standard procedures and guidelines
  + Accurately process and record all incoming call and email using the designated tracking software
  + Offer alternative solutions to clients (where appropriate) with the objective of retaining customers and clients business
  + Organize ideas and effectively communicate oral messages appropriate to listeners and situations
  + Follow up and make scheduled call backs to customers to record feedback and ensure compliance to contract /SLAs

͏

* **Build capability to ensure operational excellence and maintain superior customer service levels of the existing account/client**
  + Undertake product trainings to stay current with product features, changes and updates
  + Enroll in product specific and any other trainings per client requirements/recommendations
  + Partner with team leaders to brainstorm and identify training themes and learning issues to better serve the client
  + Update job knowledge by participating in self learning opportunities and maintaining personal networks

͏
**Deliver**

.

Experience: 1-3 Years
  
.

title: Senior Associate - Organizational Change Management
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Senior Associate - Organizational Change Management, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their organizational structures and processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will focus on aligning organizational structures with strategic goals, driving long-term success for our clients. As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems, mentor junior team members, and maintain professional standards. You will build meaningful client relationships and develop a deeper understanding of the business context, navigating complex situations to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will deliver tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth. You will collaborate with subject matter experts to deliver training needs analysis, curriculum design, and blended training solutions, using industry-standard tools to create engaging learning assets. Your ability to adapt to changing priorities and work across time zones will validate seamless project execution and client satisfaction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Designing and implementing learning solutions to support client transformation initiatives
* Collaborating with Subject Matter Experts to conduct Training Needs Analysis and develop curriculum
* Utilizing instructional design frameworks such as ADDIE and SAM to create engaging learning experiences
* Developing role-based learning plans and blended training solutions tailored to client needs
* Leveraging industry-standard authoring tools like Articulate Storyline and Adobe Captivate to create multimedia learning assets
* Publishing and managing content on Learning Management Systems, confirming accessibility standards are met
* Evaluating learning program effectiveness using Kirkpatrick Levels 1-3 and refining based on feedback
* Supporting engagement delivery through phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation
* Facilitating workshops and presentations using various collaboration tools
* Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members to enhance their development
* Staying informed on the latest trends in learning and development to contribute to internal initiatives
* Developing and presenting innovative ideas and solutions to clients and stakeholders
* Building and maintaining client relationships to support organizational change management efforts
* Analyzing business operations and ERP solutions to align learning strategies with organizational goals

What You Must Have
  
  

* 4-8 years of prior relevant experience in consulting
* Master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education (M.Ed.), Communications, HR, Organizational Development or Psychology.
* Certification in Instructional Design or Learning Experience Design (e.g., ATD/CPTD, Articulate, or an equivalent recognized ID credential) is required, while PROSCI or other Change Management certifications are preferred and considered an added advantage.
* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
* Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity.
* Demonstrating proficiency in AI tools for workforce solutions
* Utilizing analytical thinking to assess training effectiveness
* Collaborating with engagement managers to address client needs
* Exhibiting ability to work independently and in teams
* Supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring juniors
* Leveraging AI-human collaboration for enhanced productivity

title: Technical Sales Engineer
company: CSD Process Control and Automation Pvt Ltd
description:
**Company Description**
CSD Process Control and Automation Pvt Ltd is a technology-focused organization specializing in process control, automation solutions, and related engineering services. The company works with industrial clients to design, implement, and support automation systems that improve efficiency, reliability, and safety in operations. Its teams collaborate closely with customers to provide technically sound solutions tailored to specific process requirements and industry standards. CSD values practical innovation, strong engineering fundamentals, and long-term client relationships, offering opportunities for team members to contribute directly to impactful projects. The organization encourages continuous learning and professional development in a fast-evolving automation and industrial controls environment.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Technical Sales Engineer role based in Kolkata. The Technical Sales Engineer will engage with existing and prospective clients to understand their process control and automation needs, prepare technical proposals and quotations, and present solution offerings. Daily activities include conducting site visits, performing basic technical evaluations, coordinating product demonstrations, and supporting customers with pre- and post-sales technical queries. The role involves close collaboration with the engineering and operations teams to ensure accurate solution design, project handover, and timely delivery. The Technical Sales Engineer will also maintain sales pipelines, support negotiations, contribute to sales targets, and provide regular reporting on market trends, customer feedback, and competitive activities.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Technical Sales and Sales skills to identify opportunities, build client relationships, and support revenue growth.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills to translate technical requirements into solutions and assist customers throughout the sales cycle.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication, presentation abilities, and customer-facing interaction.
* Relevant educational background such as a diploma or degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics, or related engineering fields.
* Understanding of industrial automation, PLCs, SCADA, process instruments, and control systems is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site with clients, manage multiple accounts, and travel within the region as required.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with the ability to work both independently and in cross-functional teams.

**Job Title:** SEO Executive / Digital Marketing Executive

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated SEO Executive with hands-on experience in SEO and Google Ads campaigns. The candidate will be responsible for improving organic search rankings, managing paid advertising campaigns, increasing website traffic, and generating quality leads.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform keyword research for SEO and PPC campaigns
* Optimize website content, meta tags, landing pages, and URLs
* Execute on-page, off-page, and technical SEO activities
* Create and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, Remarketing)
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize CPC, CTR, and conversions
* Conduct competitor analysis and traffic analysis
* Track website performance using:
* Google Analytics
* Google Search Console
* Generate SEO and PPC performance reports
* Coordinate with content writers and developers for optimization
* Stay updated with SEO trends and Google algorithm updates

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of SEO (On-page, Off-page, Technical SEO)
* Experience managing Google and Meta Ads campaigns
* Knowledge of keyword planning and bid strategies
* Familiarity with tools like: SEMRush, UberSuggests, Google Ads, etc.
* Basic understanding of HTML, WordPress, and landing page optimization
* Good analytical and communication skills

**Qualifications**

* Certification in SEO or Google Ads preferred
* 1–3 years of experience in SEO/PPC/Digital Marketing

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Ability to handle both organic and paid marketing strategies
* Data-driven mindset with reporting skills
* Experience in lead generation campaigns is a plus

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Customer Support Executive
description:
# Job Description: Customer Support Executive

About Us :

Futuristic Climate Controls Pvt. Ltd. (www.futuristicclimatecontrols.in) is a premier distributor and stockist of industrial process instrumentation, sensors, and HVAC control systems based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Since 2008, we have partnered with global industry leaders like Honeywell, Wika, Baumer to supply high-precision transmitters, Switches gauges, and automation controls to industrial clients nationwide.

---

Position Title: Customer Support Executive

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Experience Required 1 – 10 Years

Industry Preference: Industrial Instrumentation / Process Automation / HVAC Controls

### Job Overview

We are looking for a customer-focused Customer Support Executive to manage post-sales technical support from our Ahmedabad office. The ideal candidate will have prior experience supporting clients in the industrial instrumentation and automation sector, handling queries regarding Pressure, Temperature, Flow, Level, and HVAC Transmitters, Switches, and Gauges. You will be responsible for providing prompt solutions, maintaining high client satisfaction, and resolving order or product issues efficiently.

### Key Responsibilities

\* Technical Assistance: Handle incoming client calls, emails, and online inquiries regarding product installation, Wiring, Integration with other instruments or any other query post sales.

\* Issue & Complaint Resolution: Address client grievances, coordinate replacement/repair requests or returns according to company policies, and ensure minimal downtime for the customer.

\* Feedback & Relationship Maintenance: Collect customer feedback, follow up after delivery to ensure product performance, and maintain long-term positive client relationships.

\* Record Keeping: Update and maintain customer interaction logs, feedback reports, and complaint resolution histories

### Qualifications & Key Skills

\* Domain Knowledge: 1 to 10 years of experience in customer support or client coordination, preferably within industrial instrumentation, sensors, or HVAC equipment.

\* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, Hindi, and Gujarati.

\* Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical and conflict-resolution skills to resolve customer issues calmly and quickly.

\* Tools & Software: Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel) and Tally Prime/ERP9

Please share your CV to rajesh.garg@futuristicclimatecontrols.in

title: Founder's Associate
description:
**About TAFCO**

TAFCO is India’s first Integrated Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) Solutions company focused on assessing, managing, and improving indoor air quality across residential, commercial, and industrial environments. TAFCO is positioned beyond selling individual products and provides end-to-end IAQ solutions, combining monitoring, data analysis, solution deployment, and ongoing performance management to deliver healthier indoor environments in residential, commercial, and industrial setups. Recently, we have received funding under the SISFS (GoI) scheme and are a DPIIT-recognized & incubated startup at GUSEC, Ahmedabad.

**Who this is for**

* Someone who wants to grow into a leadership role in the startup/cleantech space, or build their own company one day
* Genuinely curious about air quality, cleantech, and building a category-defining brand in India
* Highly organized — able to take a messy, undefined problem and run with it alone once the goal is clear
* Comfortable owning numbers (budgets, MIS) as much as people (hiring, vendors, coordination)

**You will**

* Work closely with the founder (almost shadow) to move high-priority operational and financial workstreams forward independently
* Own MIS reporting, budgets, and day-to-day financial admin
* Scout and coordinate hiring — sourcing candidates, running interview logistics, closing loops
* Coordinate vendors, compliance, and administrative operations
* Take on special projects that don't yet have an owner
* Take up client discovery calls and formulate actions for onboarding regional partners
* Prepare curated investment decks for angels and VCs

**You are**

* An engineer (any stream) with 0-3 years of experience working in a startup (hardware preferably)
* Enthusiastic about learning new things and never shy of approaching a problem to find a solution
* A person who enjoys keeping multiple tabs open at all times and multitasking to sort things, however, finds calm in the chaos
* Someone who understands the problem of air pollution and is ready to create an impact

*This is not a remote job and the selected candidate needs to work from our Ahmedabad office or travel with the Founder. We have a 6-day working week.*

**Salary range : 3.5 ~ 4LPA (Incentives + potential ESOPs in future)**

Please write to us at careers@tafco.in once you have applied here by introducing yourself briefly and focusing more on your pitch for this role.

title: Operation Intern
description:
**About Shipturtle**

Shipturtle is transforming eCommerce through collaborative, tech-driven solutions for online retailers. We enable brands to build custom vertical marketplaces, manage brand collaborations, and streamline multi-seller operations through seamless integrations with leading eCommerce platforms such as Shopify, WooCommerce, and Magento.

As a rapidly growing SaaS company serving global customers, we are looking for enthusiastic and driven individuals to join our Operations team and contribute to delivering an exceptional customer experience.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented, and customer-focused Operations Executive Intern to support day-to-day customer operations and platform support activities. This role offers hands-on exposure to SaaS operations, customer experience management, client onboarding, and cross-functional collaboration within a fast-paced startup environment.

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication skills, strong problem-solving abilities, and a passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer queries via email, chat, and virtual meetings.
* Assist customers with platform-related questions and provide timely, effective resolutions.
* Support customer onboarding and help users successfully navigate and adopt the platform.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to ensure prompt resolution of customer concerns.
* Monitor customer tickets, follow up on open issues, and ensure timely closure.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and operational activities.
* Identify recurring customer concerns and share actionable feedback with internal teams.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Support various operational tasks and projects as required by the business.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Freshers or candidates with up to 1 year of experience are welcome to apply.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English are mandatory.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
* Customer-centric mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
* High attention to detail and strong organizational abilities.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment.

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
Arvind Advanced Materials (AAML) is the technology-led advanced materials platform of Arvind Limited, part of the Lalbhai Group and one of India's most established textile and materials businesses. We engineer fibre into finished performance for industries where the material decides the outcome: protective fabrics for people who work in hazardous environments, lightweight composites for infrastructure and mobility, and filtration media that help industry run cleaner.

Integrated from fibre to certified finished product, AAML works across three businesses:

* **Human Protection:**
  flame-retardant and protective fabrics and garments for industrial, utility and defence users.
* **Composites:**
  pultruded profiles, prepregs and composite pressure vessels for infrastructure, energy and mobility.
* **Industrials:**
  filtration media, belting and coated fabrics for demanding industrial processes.

With manufacturing in India, the United States and Egypt, and customers in more than 50 countries, AAML is investing in new technologies, global partnerships and international growth. Building a modern, brand- and demand-led marketing function is central to that next chapter.

About the role

We are building AAML’s marketing function and seeking a hands-on B2B marketer to strengthen our digital presence and create clear, compelling content and sales collateral. As the first dedicated marketing hire, you will work closely with the Chief Strategy & Marketing Officer, corporate communications, business and technical teams, and external agencies engaged for specialist support. This is a chance to shape how an ambitious, technology-led materials business presents itself to customers in India and around the world.

Your primary focus will be digital strategy, content and collateral. You will personally develop messaging and write and edit core content, while briefing and managing specialist design, website and video production. The role also includes marketing support for 2–3 exhibitions annually.

Key responsibilities

Digital strategy and execution

* Develop a prioritised digital marketing plan aligned with business goals, target customers and available budgets. Recommend the right mix of website content, SEO, LinkedIn, email and paid campaigns.
* Manage the content calendar and day-to-day digital activity; work with agencies on website improvements and specialist campaign execution.
* Track engagement, enquiries and lead sources; use findings to improve content, channel choices and spend.

Content and sales collateral

* Work with sales and technical teams to understand products, applications and customer needs, translating these into clear, credible messages and customer benefits.
* Write and edit website copy, brochures, pitch decks, case studies, sample-book content, social posts and video scripts. Tailor materials to priority audiences and markets.
* Brief and review design, photography and video work; ensure the business teams validate technical claims before publication.
* Maintain an organised library of current, approved collateral and incorporate feedback from sales teams.

Collaboration and delivery

* Manage agency briefs, timelines, quality and agreed budgets for assigned projects. Coordinate internal inputs and approvals to keep work moving.
* Keep AAML’s messaging and visual identity consistent across all materials, working with the CSMO and corporate communications; contribute content for PR and leadership communications.
* Coordinate marketing for 2–3 exhibitions annually, including event messaging, collateral, pre-event promotion, display and booth briefs, and lead capture. Work with vendors on production and logistics and with sales on post-event follow-up.
* Agree priorities across the three businesses with the CSMO; maintain a simple marketing dashboard; and coordinate lead hand-off with sales and the CRM team.

What you bring

* 8–12 years of marketing experience, with a strong record in B2B marketing and evidence of personal contribution to digital activity and content creation.
* Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn technical information into relevant customer-facing communication.
* Practical digital marketing judgement: selecting channels, planning campaigns, interpreting performance and working effectively with specialists.
* Experience briefing and managing agencies or freelancers, with strong creative judgement and attention to detail.
* Strong project and stakeholder management skills; comfortable working independently and delivering alongside senior leaders, sales and technical teams.
* A portfolio demonstrating your own contribution to B2B content, collateral and digital campaigns.

Preferred

title: MID SEO Executive
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Mid SEO Executive with 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Search Engine Optimization. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of on-page, technical, and off-page SEO, with the ability to independently execute SEO initiatives that improve organic visibility, website performance, search rankings, and AI traffic. The role requires close collaboration with content, design, and development teams to implement SEO best practices and contribute to the organization's overall digital growth.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Conduct comprehensive keyword research to identify high-potential opportunities for improving organic visibility, traffic, and conversions.
* Perform in-depth competitor analysis to identify content gaps, backlink opportunities, and strategies to outperform competitors.
* Plan, execute, and optimize on-page SEO across landing pages, blogs, feature pages, and other website content.
* Prepare detailed SEO briefs for the content team, ensuring alignment with search intent, keyword strategy, and business objectives.
* Review content before publication to ensure SEO best practices, readability, internal linking, metadata, schema recommendations, and overall optimization are implemented.
* Publish and manage website content using WordPress while maintaining proper formatting, URL structure, media optimization, and SEO settings.
* Conduct regular technical SEO audits to identify crawl issues, indexing problems, Core Web Vitals concerns, duplicate content, broken links, redirect issues, structured data errors, and other technical improvements.
* Coordinate with developers to implement technical SEO recommendations and validate successful deployment.
* Execute and support link-building activities, including outreach, guest posting, digital PR opportunities, citation management, and backlink quality analysis.
* Monitor backlink profiles, identify toxic links when required, and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
* Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and other SEO performance metrics using Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and SEO platforms.
* Prepare weekly and monthly SEO reports with actionable insights, performance analysis, and recommendations.
* Analyze search trends and algorithm updates to identify opportunities and minimize potential ranking risks.
* Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or cannibalized pages and recommend optimization strategies.
* Collaborate closely with content writers, designers, developers, and other stakeholders to execute SEO initiatives efficiently.
* Assist in planning and executing content strategies that align with business goals and search demand.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Search Engine Optimization.
* Strong understanding of on-page, technical, and off-page SEO.
* Experience working with WordPress or similar Content Management Systems.
* Proficiency in Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and Screaming Frog.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS.
* Ability to analyze SEO data and convert findings into actionable recommendations.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working on SaaS or B2B websites.
* Understanding of structured data and schema markup.
* Exposure to AI Search, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
* Experience with SEO content optimization tools.
* Ability to manage multiple SEO initiatives while meeting deadlines.

Pay: ₹9,800.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

title: Deputy Manager - Education Loan
description:
**Location Name:**
Thrissur New
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Acquire and convert eligible Education Loan customers through compliant counselling, disciplined funnel management, complete documentation, coordinated fulfilment and active ownership of portfolio quality.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Generate and manage leads from direct, referral, consultant, institution and partner channels.
* Counsel students and co-applicants on course, country, institution, funding requirement, repayment construct and documentation.
* Capture complete application data, customer consent and source attribution in approved systems.
* Collect and validate admission, academic, KYC, income, banking and collateral documents before login.
* Coordinate with Credit, Operations, Verification and partners to resolve queries and progress files within agreed service levels.
* Track the lead-to-login, login-to-sanction and sanction-to-disbursement funnel and record lost reasons and corrective actions.
* Communicate sanction terms, conditions and pending requirements accurately to customers.
* Maintain compliant selling, customer confidentiality, audit trails and approved communication standards.
* Support portfolio quality through appropriate sourcing, fraud vigilance and early issue escalation.
* Support portfolio quality and X-bucket management through pre-due and pre-bounce customer engagement, timely repayment reminders, follow-up on assigned overdue cases and escalation to the Sales Manager and Collections team.
* Execute assigned activities directly and maintain accurate system records.
* Escalate customer, documentation, fraud or repayment concerns promptly.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**
Decision rights
  
  

* Make day-to-day sales and customer-management decisions within approved policy, process, pricing and delegated authority.
* Prioritise and allocate customer follow-ups, including portfolio-quality and X-bucket actions, within the assigned scope.
* Escalate policy deviations, material customer impact, fraud indicators, persistent overdue cases and unresolved dependencies.
* Commercial, hiring and budget authorities are to be defined in the approved delegation matrix.

Key interactions
  
  
Internal Sales, Product, Credit/Underwriting, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Compliance, Finance, Technology, HR and COE.
  
  
External Students, co-applicants, universities, education consultants, DSAs, referral partners and other approved service providers.
  
  
**Major Challenges**

* Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
* Managing incomplete or inconsistent customer, academic and financial information.
* Driving timely customer engagement for pre-due, pre-bounce and overdue cases while following approved conduct standards.
* Coordinating Sales, Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations to address X-bucket and early-delinquency issues.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Graduate. Relevant customer-facing, lending or financial-services experience preferred.
  
  
Critical skills and knowledge
  
  

* Education Loan customer counselling
* Sales execution and relationship management
* Portfolio-quality and X-bucket management awareness
* Customer repayment engagement and early-delinquency follow-up
* Understanding of academic, income and KYC documents
* CRM/LOS usage and MIS discipline
* Communication, negotiation and customer orientation
* Compliance, fraud and customer-conduct awareness
* Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
* High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality

title: Account Executive - SME & Mid-Market
description:
SME & Mid-Market Account Executive

Location: HSR Layout, Bengaluru

Budget: 8 LPA Fixed

Role: Individual Contributor

About Qoruz

Qoruz is an enterprise-grade creator marketing and intelligence platform that helps brands and agencies discover creators, build relationships, manage campaigns, and make better marketing decisions using data.

We are building the technology layer for the creator economy, helping marketing teams move from fragmented, manual influencer marketing processes to a more intelligent and data-driven approach.

The Role

We are looking for a driven Account Executive to win new business with mid-size brands and agencies.

You will own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to product demos, proposals, negotiation and closure. You’ll run a high number of opportunities at once and close deals in weeks, not quarters.

This is a consultative, new-business role built for pace. You will work closely with Brand Managers at mid-size brands, and with Heads of Operations and Brand Managers at mid-size agencies, to show how Qoruz helps them run creator campaigns more efficiently, deliver better results and measure what’s working.

What You’ll Do

Build and manage a healthy pipeline across mid-size brands and agencies.

Prospect actively through outbound, referrals, events and inbound leads.

Build strong relationships with Brand Managers at brands and with Heads of Operations and Brand Managers at agencies.

Understand how brand teams plan and run creator campaigns, and how agencies deliver them across multiple clients.

Run sharp discovery calls and tailored product demos that connect Qoruz to each buyer’s day-to-day challenges.

For brands, position Qoruz around better creator selection, campaign performance and measurable ROI.

For agencies, position Qoruz around operational efficiency, faster execution, scalability across clients and stronger reporting.

Own the complete sales cycle from first conversation to signed contract.

Handle pricing discussions and negotiations, and help your champions build the case internally with their leadership.

Maintain strong pipeline discipline, accurate forecasting and clean CRM hygiene.

Share customer and market feedback with Product and Marketing to sharpen our positioning.

Work closely with Customer Success to ensure smooth onboarding and set accounts up for expansion.

What We’re Looking For

1-2 years of B2B sales experience, ideally selling SaaS, marketing technology or digital solutions.

Experience in AdTech, MarTech, marketing SaaS, influencer technology, social intelligence or marketing analytics is a strong plus.

Experience selling to mid-size brands and/or digital, social or influencer marketing agencies.

Proven ability to manage the full sales cycle independently, from prospecting to closure.

Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding monthly or quarterly targets.

Comfort managing a high-velocity pipeline with shorter sales cycles.

Strong discovery, demo, negotiation and communication skills.

A self-starter mindset with the ability to generate your own pipeline rather than relying only on inbound.

You’ll Have an Edge If You Have

Sold directly to Brand Managers, Marketing Managers or agency operations leaders.

An existing network across mid-size brands or digital and influencer marketing agencies.

An understanding of how agencies operate, including client servicing, campaign delivery and reporting workflows.

Experience with monthly, quarterly or annual SaaS subscriptions and upsell motions.

A solid understanding of social media, influencer marketing or the creator economy.

Why Qoruz

Creator marketing is becoming a core part of how brands reach and engage their audiences. As brand teams and agencies run more creator campaigns, they need better tools, data and workflows to manage them without adding headcount.

Qoruz sits at the intersection of technology, marketing, data and the creator economy. If you enjoy fast-paced selling, running lots of conversations at once, closing deals quickly and helping brands and agencies work smarter, we’d love to speak with you.

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Strategic Technical Partnership**: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* **Joint Solution Development:** Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* **Customer Deal Support:** Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* **Partner Ecosystem & Events**: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* **Product Feedback:** Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Inventory Procurement Executive
description:
**About Valeo Health**  
Valeo Health is a DHA-licensed digital and home healthcare platform operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Qatar, with 250,000+ managed members.

We deliver healthcare where our clients actually are — at home, at work, in the gym, or by teleconsultation. Our services span at-home lab and blood testing, doctor-on-call across multiple specialties, professional nursing and post-operative care, IV and peptide therapies, chronic disease management, telehealth, and data-driven weight management and longevity programmes built on our proprietary Valeo Longevity Score. Our clinical outcomes are independently verified: 52% member engagement against a 6% industry average, measurable HbA1c reduction in diabetic populations, and demonstrable reduction in avoidable hospitalisation.

ISO 27001 / HIPAA / GDPR compliant. Recognised by Healthcare 2.0, Deloitte and Future 100, and backed by Global Ventures, Dubai Future District Fund, GFC, Shorooq and 500 Global.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
We are looking for a detail-oriented and commercially savvy Inventory Procurement Executive to join our growing Supply Chain team. This role is central to ensuring that Kuwa's product catalogue remains consistently stocked, competitively priced, and aligned with demand trends. You will manage end-to-end procurement of supplements, vitamins, skincare, and beauty products — coordinating closely with suppliers, warehouse teams, and the e-commerce operations function. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, consumer-health environment and brings a sharp analytical mindset paired with strong negotiation skills.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Procurement**  
- Negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times, and minimum order quantities to optimise cost and availability.  
- Monitor real-time stock levels across all product categories and initiate replenishment orders proactively.  
- Maintain optimum inventory levels by balancing carrying costs against service-level targets and demand forecasts.  
**-** Conduct regular stock audits and reconcile physical counts against system records; investigate and resolve variances.

**Supplier Relationship Management**  
- Build and sustain strong, productive relationships with domestic and international suppliers and distributors.  
- Track supplier performance against agreed KPIs (fill rate, on-time delivery, quality) and lead periodic reviews.  
- Resolve supply disputes, short shipments, quality non-conformances, and documentation discrepancies in a timely manner.  
- Coordinate with the quality team to manage product certifications, shelf-life requirements, and recall procedures.  
- Maintain accurate procurement records, COAs, MSDS, and supplier documentation for audit readiness.

**Cost & Budget Management**  
- Track procurement spend against budget and identify opportunities for savings through strategic sourcing or consolidation.  
- Prepare regular reports on purchase orders, landed costs, inventory turnover, and supplier lead times.  
**-** Support financial reconciliation by coordinating closely with the Finance team on invoice approvals and GRN matching.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**  
- Liaise with the warehouse and fulfilment team to coordinate inbound shipments, receiving schedules, and storage allocation.  
- Work with the product and marketing teams to support new product introduction (NPI) timelines.  
- Partner with the Valeo health team on shared product lines to align procurement strategies across both brands.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**  
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Pharmacy, Nutrition Science, or a related field.  
- 2–4 years of experience in procurement, inventory management, or supply chain within FMCG, healthcare, nutraceuticals, or e-commerce.  
- Proven track record of supplier negotiation and cost reduction in a product-based business.  
- Experience working with ERP or inventory management systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Odoo, Shopify- integrated tools).  
- Solid understanding of GCC import regulations and customs procedures for health and wellness products.  
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for demand modelling, PO tracking, and stock analysis.  
- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks for food supplements and cosmetics in the UAE/GCC is a strong plus.  
- Prior experience in a D2C or e-commerce supply chain environment is highly desirable.

**SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret sales data, inventory reports, and market trends to drive procurement decisions.
* Negotiation: Confident negotiator who can secure favourable commercial terms without compromising supplier relationships.
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous with documentation, compliance records, and data accuracy.
* Communication: Clear communicator with internal stakeholders, international suppliers, and logistics partners.
* Problem Solving: Proactive in identifying supply risks and resolving operational issues under time pressure.
* Adaptability: Comfortable operating in a high-growth, rapidly evolving e-commerce environment.
* Time Management: Skilled at prioritising across multiple categories and concurrent purchase orders.
* Integrity: Maintains ethical sourcing standards in line with Kuwa's commitment to quality and sustainability

title: Client Partner Manager
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.  
  
**Description**  
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Bangalore team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.  
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.  
Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
Experience in gaming app category preferred.  
Experience managing a sales team preferred  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.  
Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.

title: Deal Manager
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 16, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1751026

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Discipline**

Pursuits & Commercial Excellence

  

**Role Type**

Deal Manager - Assistant Director

  

**The opportunity**

The Deal Manager - Assistant Director partners with Engagement Teams to support regional strategic, high-value pursuits. They engage early and at multiple stages during the pursuit process and are responsible for developing a tailored communications strategy to articulate a compelling ‘Why EY’ proposition in all pursuit collateral. The Deal Manager - Assistant Director is responsible for the tactical management of all pursuit work-streams including the facilitation of pursuit readiness sessions, touchpoint campaign, draft value proposition, proposal development and orals preparation. The Deal Manager - Assistant Director provides support, advice and expertise to in all the stages of Bid Management Process, involving in pre-RFP, RFP response and post-RFP phase

  

Deal Manager - Assistant Directors are expected to

* Manage execution of pursuit process, including critical path, timeline, and interdependencies
* Assess competitive situation and help develop differentiated win strategy focused on client priorities while protecting EY’s interests
* Develop power map and tactics to navigate client buying process
* Provide ‘glue’ to focus and guide extended pursuit team through structured sales approach and proposal development
* Collaborate with extended pursuit team define, package and articulate compelling client offer across scope, solution, price, and terms
* Plan storyline/key messages and prepare extended team for orals.

  

Additionally, the Deal Manager - Assistant Director is required to identify, develop and implement innovative approaches to pursuit management and drive adoption of these across the Region.

  

Your key responsibilities

**Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management**

* Partner with Engagement Teams to provide a full-service pursuit management model for Regional strategic, high-end opportunities
* Leads by example and advocates for gold standard pursuit practices
* In collaboration with other pursuit team members (e.g., Deal Leader, Engagement Partner, Client Partner), develops client-centric win themes that underpin the entire deal strategy. Ensures the win themes are reflected consistently throughout all client communications and deliverables.
* Suggests creative ideas that enhance our win strategy or ability to differentiate
* Manage and leads the development of opportunity value propositions
* Develop strategic messaging and lead conceptualization of all client-facing pursuit collateral
* Ensures all pursuit deliverables (e.g., meeting documents, proposals, presentations) are developed on schedule submitted on time and with the highest quality
* Ultimately responsible for quality control of all client-facing materials during the pursuit
* Ensures deal infrastructure is established & maintained, including TEAMS site, calendar, action tracker, team roster, notebook, etc. with support from the Deal Coordinator as needed.
* Develops and maintains the pursuit plan/action tracker and calendar, making certain that all pursuit activities are assigned ownership, tracked and executed according to schedule.
* Plan storyline/key messages and prepare extended team for orals
* Supports team strategic and/or operational initiatives to develop new or enhance existing best practices, tools, or enablers.
* Act as the central point of contact in managing the end-to-end process: evaluating requirements, organizing meetings, preparing meeting notes, finalizing timelines and accountabilities as per deadlines
* Serve as a facilitator/key contributor in pursuit strategy sessions, manages output and drives actions
* Shares lessons learned, best practices and innovation from pursuits and other experiences with teammates, the broader BD community, and the global firm as appropriate.
* Act as the knowledge steward for the pursuit
* Builds collaborative relationships with pursuit teams & senior client stakeholders,
* Lead post pursuit analysis and review; makes recommendations for process improvement
* Maintain relationships with other Deal Activation teams and key interdependency groups across the organization Participate in relevant internal and external networks
* Facilitate internal deal governance process

  

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* Champion CoE best-practice pursuit management tools and processes
* Solution-oriented and makes sound decisions quickly, given tight timeframes
* Demonstrate versatility in a constantly evolving environment with a wide variety of social styles
* Influence / challenge the account team to optimize the chances of winning

  

**Supervision Responsibilities:**

* Work with considerable autonomy while often managing the work of others
* Provide coaching and mentoring to others; may serve as a Counsellor to other Deal Coordinators in P&CE.
* Support the onboarding and training of new hires in P&CE.
* Develop and coach Deal Coordinators, Client Executives and Client Servers, through teaming on pursuits and facilitated training
* Oversee the work of the pursuit support team, including third-party resources (e.g. Deal Coordinator, external translation services, etc.)

  

Skills and attributes for success

* Critical thinking, organized, detail – oriented with strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines
* Good understanding of Business Development and Pursuit Management
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines which are essential for a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and listening)
* Strong inter-personal skills
* Ability to analyze data and derive conclusions
* Excellent critical and strategic thinking
* Excellent project management and negotiation skills
* Self-motivated, resourceful & ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ability to influence without authority, lead and coach others
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree (advanced degree preferred)
* MBA (Marketing/International Business)

  

**Experience:**

* 12-15 years in Business Development of which minimum 5 years should be in Bid Management/Pre-Sales/Pursuit Management in professional services organizations
* Minimum 5 years’ experience working with large Global organization preferably in a professional services firm
* Must have communications and proposal writing experience
* Experience in managing end to end managed services deals
* Experience working in a cross-border, multi-cultural environment

  

**Certification Requirements:**

* Expected to remain current on EY training and curriculum (e.g. Account Management Framework (AMF), Badges, etc.)
* APMP and or PMP Certification would be added advantage

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* As the job involves responding to clients' needs and varying time zones, long/flexible hours are regularly required
* Moderate travel - including occasional international travel - will be required

  

**Technologies and Tools**

Excellent MS office skills, specifically PowerPoint are required

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sales Manager
description:
YesProperty is seeking an experienced and target-driven Sales Manager to lead and drive real estate sales operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing a team of sales professionals, achieving revenue targets, developing sales strategies, and ensuring exceptional customer experience throughout the sales cycle.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead, motivate, and manage a team of sales executives to achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Develop and implement effective sales strategies to maximize revenue and market penetration.
* Generate, qualify, and convert leads into successful property sales.
* Monitor sales performance, pipeline management, and conversion metrics.
* Conduct regular team reviews, coaching sessions, and performance evaluations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, channel partners, and key stakeholders.
* Handle high-value customer interactions and negotiations to close deals successfully.
* Coordinate with marketing, CRM, legal, and operations teams for seamless sales execution.
* Ensure timely follow-up on inquiries, site visits, bookings, and documentation.
* Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences to identify growth opportunities.
* Prepare and present sales reports, forecasts, and MIS updates to management.
* Maintain high standards of customer satisfaction and post-sales support.

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* 2-7 years of experience in real estate sales, with at least 2 years in a team-handling role.
* Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
* Strong leadership, team management, and mentoring skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation abilities.
* Experience in residential, commercial, plotted development, or luxury property sales.
* Proficiency in CRM tools and MS Office applications.
* Strong understanding of the Bengaluru real estate market is preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience managing a team of 5–10 sales professionals.
* Established network of channel partners, brokers, and investors.
* Ability to drive sales performance in a fast-paced environment.

* Half yearly appraisals
* International exposure in sales

description:
**Job Description: Quality Control cum Compliance Executive**

**Company:** Indepesca Overseas Pvt. Ltd.

**Department:** Quality Control & Compliance  
**Experience:** Minimum 5 Years in the Seafood/Fisheries Industry  
**Salary:** Up to ₹50,000 per month  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM  
**Notice Period:** Immediate Joiner / Maximum 15 Days

**Job Summary**

Indepesca Overseas Pvt. Ltd., under its brand **Bigsams**, is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented **Quality Control cum Compliance Executive** for its Bangalore operations. The candidate must have a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in the seafood or fisheries industry, with hands-on expertise in quality assurance, seafood product inspection, food safety standards, hygiene management, and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should be capable of ensuring that seafood products meet the company's quality standards, food safety requirements, and applicable statutory and regulatory guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities (KRA)**

**1. Quality Control & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct quality inspections of fresh, chilled, and frozen seafood products.
* Check product quality, freshness, colour, odour, texture, temperature, packaging, labelling, and storage conditions.
* Monitor product handling, processing, packing, transportation, and cold-chain management.
* Ensure compliance with approved product specifications and quality standards.
* Identify quality deviations, prepare reports, and recommend corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Monitor product shelf life, expiry dates, batch details, and traceability records.

**2. Food Safety & Hygiene**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations and food safety requirements.
* Monitor hygiene and sanitation practices at storage facilities, processing units, and handling locations.
* Conduct routine hygiene inspections and maintain inspection records.
* Ensure proper temperature control throughout storage, handling, and transportation.
* Identify potential contamination risks and implement preventive measures.

**3. Compliance & Documentation**

* Maintain quality inspection reports, product acceptance/rejection records, temperature logs, and other QC documentation.
* Ensure that relevant licences, registrations, certificates, and compliance records are valid and updated.
* Support internal audits, supplier audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Maintain supplier documentation, product specifications, traceability records, and non-conformance reports.
* Ensure adherence to applicable food safety, quality, and operational compliance requirements.

**4. Supplier & Vendor Quality Management**

* Inspect incoming seafood products and verify compliance with purchase specifications.
* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors regarding quality issues, rejections, and corrective actions.
* Evaluate supplier performance based on product quality, hygiene, consistency, and compliance.
* Investigate customer complaints related to product quality and implement corrective measures.

**5. Reporting & Coordination**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly quality reports for management.
* Coordinate with procurement, warehouse, operations, logistics, and sales teams to resolve quality-related issues.
* Conduct staff awareness sessions on seafood handling, hygiene, food safety, and quality procedures.
* Ensure timely escalation of critical quality and compliance issues to management.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Minimum **5 years of relevant experience in the seafood/fisheries industry** is mandatory.
* Candidates from seafood processing, frozen seafood, fish trading, seafood distribution, or fisheries operations will be preferred.
* Qualification in Fisheries Science, Food Technology, Microbiology, Food Science, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Practical knowledge of seafood quality parameters, cold-chain management, food safety, and hygiene standards.
* Knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, and relevant food safety systems.
* Good documentation, reporting, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to conduct inspections, identify quality risks, and implement corrective actions.
* Candidates who can join immediately or within 15 days will be preferred.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** Up to ₹50,000 per month, depending on experience, qualifications, and suitability.
* Opportunity to work with Bigsams, a seafood business brand of Indepesca Overseas Pvt. Ltd.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates with relevant seafood industry experience may share their updated CV on firoz.premani@bigsams.in along with the following details:

* Total work experience
* Relevant experience in the seafood/fisheries industry
* Current CTC and expected CTC
* Current location
* Notice period / Earliest joining date

**Important:** Candidates without relevant seafood/fisheries industry experience will not be considered.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

* Align and partner with Product Management to help drive appropriate product enhancements and changes to technology roadmap
* Aid in driving stability and innovation within the client’s current and future state and create solutions based on client requirements and available product offerings

  

**We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That’s why we’ve outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it’s important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer sciences

* Understanding of (and experience with) public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and hybrid solutions preferred
* Demonstrated ability to understand and leverage Artificial Intelligence, applying AI-driven strategies and tools to modernize legacy systems and enhance data migration efforts.

* Well versed in the hosting technology landscape including compute, storage, backup, network, security, DR, DevOps and IT governance
