**Department:** Dispatch & Logistics  
**Job Title:** Dispatch Executive

Job Summary

The Dispatch Executive will be responsible for managing the timely and accurate dispatch of finished wet wipes products to customers, distributors, and business partners. The role involves coordinating with the production, quality control, warehouse, sales, and logistics teams to ensure proper order processing, packaging verification, documentation, inventory accuracy, and on-time delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* **Dispatch Planning & Execution**
* Plan and execute daily dispatches according to customer orders and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate with the warehouse and production departments to ensure product availability.
* Ensure timely loading and dispatch of wet wipes cartons, cases, and pallets.
* Verify product names, variants, quantities, batch numbers, and expiry dates before dispatch.
* **Documentation & Record Keeping**
* Prepare delivery challans, invoices, e-way bills, packing lists, and other applicable dispatch documents.
* Maintain dispatch registers, vehicle details, transporter records, and proof of delivery (POD).
* Update dispatch entries in ERP software, Excel, or other inventory management systems.
* Maintain accurate records of dispatched goods and pending orders.
* **Quality & Packaging Verification**
* Ensure finished goods are properly packed, sealed, labelled, and ready for transportation.
* Check that wet wipes packs and cartons are not damaged, leaking, or improperly sealed.
* Verify batch details, manufacturing dates, expiry dates, and labelling requirements.
* Coordinate with the Quality Control (QC) team regarding product release and dispatch clearance.
* **Inventory & Warehouse Coordination**
* Maintain accurate finished goods stock records.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO principles, as applicable, for inventory movement.
* Coordinate with the warehouse team for picking, packing, staging, and loading.
* Report stock shortages, damaged products, and dispatch discrepancies to the concerned department.
* **Transport & Logistics Coordination**
* Arrange vehicles and coordinate with transporters, drivers, and courier partners.
* Ensure proper loading, stacking, and handling to prevent damage during transit.
* Track shipments and communicate delivery status to the sales or customer service team.
* Follow up on delayed deliveries, returned goods, and pending proof of delivery.
* **Reporting & Compliance**
* Prepare daily dispatch reports and pending-order reports.
* Ensure compliance with company dispatch procedures and applicable documentation requirements.
* Report dispatch errors, shortages, damages, and customer complaints to the reporting manager.
* Maintain cleanliness, safety, and proper handling practices in the dispatch area.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate or 12th pass; a diploma in logistics, supply chain, or warehouse management is preferred.
* 1–2 years of experience in dispatch, warehouse operations, or logistics, preferably in FMCG or manufacturing.
* Experience in finished goods dispatch and inventory management will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of GST invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans, and transport documentation.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and ERP/inventory management software.

Required Skills

* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Good attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple dispatches and meet delivery deadlines.
* Knowledge of FIFO/FEFO and stock reconciliation.
* Problem-solving skills and a responsible approach to documentation.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* On-time dispatch and delivery performance.
* Accuracy of dispatched quantities and documentation.
* Number of dispatch errors, shortages, and damages.
* Inventory record accuracy.
* Timely submission of dispatch reports and proof of delivery.
* Compliance with packaging and quality release requirements.

title: Partnerships & Activations Lead
description:
**Job Title: Partnerships & Activations Lead**

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, work from office, with local travel

**Preferred Experience:**
3–5 years in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, brand activations or business development

**About Sevora**

Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery in eligible locations. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a relationship-driven professional to build partnerships and deliver community activations that generate qualified leads, shopping appointments and sales.

You will develop a network across Kolkata’s residential communities, clubs, private social groups and complementary businesses. Working closely with Sales and the Personal Shopper, you will own partner acquisition, activation planning, execution, lead quality and cost efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partnerships & Community Development**

* Build relationships with community hosts, residential associations, premium clubs, women’s groups and event organisers.
* Establish referral partnerships with salons, beauty studios, wedding planners, makeup artists and complementary lifestyle businesses.
* Develop partnership proposals and negotiate participation fees, promotional support, collaboration terms and referral arrangements.
* Maintain an active partner pipeline and monthly activation calendar.
* Develop productive partnerships into recurring shopping events and referral opportunities.

**2. Lead Generation & Appointment Booking**

* Deliver monthly targets for qualified customer leads and shopping appointments.
* Generate enquiries through kitty parties, private gatherings, residential communities, clubs, curated exhibitions, professional networks and referrals.
* Prepare channel plans with target audiences, activities, budgets and expected outcomes.
* Capture shopping preferences, budget, occasion, buying timeline and location to support lead qualification.
* Develop customer and community-host referral programmes with approved incentives and clear tracking.

**3. Activations & Event Execution**

* Plan and execute private shopping sessions, styling events, collection previews, pop-ups and community activations.
* Evaluate opportunities based on audience fit, purchase intent, participation costs and sales potential.
* Own event logistics, including permissions, venue arrangements, setup, displays, staffing coordination and partner communication.
* Coordinate invitations, lookbooks, QR codes, registration forms and promotional materials with Marketing and Creative teams.
* Coordinate assortment, stock availability, product movement and reconciliation with Merchandising and Operations.
* Work with Sales and the Personal Shopper to deliver shopping assistance and introduce eligible customers to Try at Home.
* Manage approved budgets and maintain records of expenses and partner commitments.

**4. Lead Handover & Sales Coordination**

* Capture accurate customer details and permission for follow-up.
* Record lead source, preferences, interest level and next action in the CRM.
* Hand over leads promptly to Sales with clear ownership and follow-up expectations.
* Review appointment attendance, follow-up progress, purchases and reasons for lost sales.
* Coordinate post-event follow-ups with Sales and retention campaigns with CRM.
* Use customer and sales feedback to improve future activations.

**5. Performance & Reporting**

* Report weekly on partner outreach, confirmed activities, qualified leads, appointments, costs and attributable sales.
* Track performance by partner, event and referral source using CRM tags, QR links or referral codes.
* Monitor cost per qualified lead, cost per purchasing customer and sales after cancellations and returns.
* Assess activation profitability with Finance using product margins and relevant costs.
* Recommend which partnerships and activities to expand, improve or discontinue.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Relevant experience in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, activations or business development.
* Strong networking, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills.
* Experience generating customer leads and delivering measurable commercial outcomes.
* Ability to manage activities independently, from outreach and planning to execution and reporting.
* Understanding of budgets, lead qualification, conversion and customer acquisition costs.
* Clear communication in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, presentations, WhatsApp Business and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled evening or weekend events.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in fashion, premium retail, beauty, hospitality or lifestyle services. Existing relationships with Kolkata communities, clubs, residential associations and relevant businesses will be an advantage.

title: Textile Operations Lead (Production, Merchandising & Quality)
description:
Job Overview

Anuprerna Artisan Alliance is seeking an experienced, proactive **Textile Production & Merchandising Manager** to lead end-to-end textile operations, quality assurance, and artisan cluster management.

In this pivotal operational role, you will bridge client requirements and on-ground production. You will be responsible for translating design and client orders into structured production plans, managing Time & Action (T&A) calendars, overseeing raw material procurement and dyeing/weaving processes, enforcing strict quality standards, and directly leading field supervisors and artisan teams.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical knowledge of yarns, natural fibers, weave structures, and finishing, paired with hands-on commercial merchandising acumen and the leadership ability to ensure on-time, defect-free delivery.

Key Responsibilities. Production Planning & Cluster Execution

* Develop, monitor, and execute comprehensive Time & Action (T&A) production calendars across all running orders to ensure 100% on-time delivery.
* Plan loom capacities, manage yarn consumption matrices, and allocate production runs across internal units, weaver clusters, and external dyeing facilities.
* Track work-in-progress (WIP) from raw yarn procurement, warping, and dyeing through weaving, washing, finishing, and packing.
* Proactively identify production bottlenecks, material shortages, or weather-dependent delays, implementing rapid corrective actions.

2. Textile Merchandising & Costing

* Coordinate order specifications, approvals, and buyer requirements from initial sampling through bulk dispatch.
* Prepare accurate Bill of Materials (BOM), cost breakdowns, fabric yields, and consumption estimates for custom developments and commercial collections.
* Manage sampling cycles, lab dips, strike-offs, and counter-samples, obtaining formal sign-offs before bulk production rollout.
* Serve as the technical link between internal management/sales and field execution teams.

3. Quality Assurance & Technical Control (QA/QC)

* Establish and implement standardized inspection protocols across raw materials (yarn count, strength, twist), in-line weaving, and final fabric finishing.
* Supervise physical testing parameters including GSM, dimensional stability (shrinkage), colorfastness, rub fastness, and weaving defect tolerances (utilizing 4-Point System or relevant international standards).
* Audit dyeing units (natural and azo-free certified processes) to ensure batch-to-batch shade consistency and lot integrity.
* Conduct root-cause analysis on defects and implement preventive measures to systematically drive down rejections.

4. Team Leadership & Artisan Management

* Direct and mentor on-site supervisors, quality checkers, logistics staff, and weaver cluster coordinators.
* Foster fair, professional, and productive relationships with artisan networks, weavers, and dyeing partners.
* Maintain clean production ERP records, inventory audits, and regular status reports for executive management.

Candidate Profile & Eligibility Criteria

* **Education:** Degree or Diploma in Textile Technology, Textile Engineering, Textile Design, or Apparel Production (e.g., GCETT, NIFT, or recognized textile institutes).
* **Experience:** 4 to 8+ years of hands-on experience in textile production, merchandising, or quality assurance within textile mills, handloom/powerloom clusters, export houses, or sustainable textile enterprises.
* **Technical Mastery:** In-depth knowledge of fiber classifications, yarn counts, weave constructions (plain, twill, dobby, jacquard), GSM analysis, dyeing mechanics, and post-loom finishing treatments.
* **Process Knowledge:** Familiarity with handloom, artisanal textile techniques, natural fibers (silk, linen, cotton), and eco-conscious or sustainable finishing standards is strongly preferred.
* **Operational Skills:** High proficiency in creating and managing T&A schedules, fabric costing, and inventory tracking using MS Excel / Google Sheets or textile ERP tools.
* **Languages & Leadership:** Strong cross-functional leadership skills. Ability to communicate effectively with artisans and local weavers in Bengali, along with professional working proficiency in English or Hindi for reporting.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

We provide game development, art, co-development, and custom software services to studios, publishers and enterprises worldwide. We need a senior marketing leader who can turn marketing into a predictable, measurable pipeline engine for a long-cycle, high-ticket services business.

You will own the full marketing mandate: positioning, demand generation, content, SEO and AI-search visibility, paid media, ABM, events and marketing operations. title: Legal Executive
description:
Job Purpose

To handle day-to-day legal matters, statutory and regulatory compliance coordination, contract documentation, legal notices, litigation tracking, and liaison with external advocates and government authorities to protect the company's legal and commercial interests.

2. Key Responsibilities

3. Detailed Roles and Responsibilities

A. Contract Drafting and Legal Documentation

- Draft, review, and vet commercial agreements, vendor agreements, purchase agreements, service contracts, NDAs, and confidentiality agreements.

- Review lease deeds, business agreements, undertakings, indemnities, and other legal documents.

- Prepare legal notices, replies, declarations, affidavits, and official correspondence.

- Maintain an organized record of executed agreements, renewals, expiry dates, and amendments.

B. Legal Compliance and Regulatory Matters

- Monitor applicable laws, rules, and regulatory updates affecting company operations.

- Coordinate with HR, Finance, Purchase, Sales, and Factory Management on legal requirements.

- Track factory licences, registrations, permits, renewals, and statutory documentation in coordination with the responsible departments and consultants.

- Coordinate with relevant government departments for inspections, notices, submissions, and approvals.

- Support labour-law and industrial compliance matters, including employment documentation and contractor-related legal records.

C. Litigation and Legal Case Management

- Coordinate with external advocates for civil, commercial, labour, and other legal matters.

- Maintain a tracker of ongoing cases, hearing dates, deadlines, notices, and pending actions.

- Prepare case summaries and compile supporting documents for advocates.

- Follow up on court proceedings, legal notices, disputes, and recovery matters.

D. HR and Employee-Related Legal Matters

- Draft and review appointment letters, employment agreements, confidentiality clauses, NDAs, and disciplinary notices.

- Assist HR in handling employee misconduct, resignation-related disputes, confidentiality breaches, and protection of company information.

- Review company policies, HR notices, and internal procedures from a legal perspective.

- Support the company in addressing employment disputes and employee grievances.

E. Corporate and Commercial Support

- Assist with company documentation, authorisations, declarations, and board-related documents in coordination with the Company Secretary or external consultant, where applicable.

- Review customer and supplier agreements to identify legal and commercial risks.

- Support recovery of outstanding payments and preparation of formal demand notices.

- Help protect company assets, confidential information, intellectual property, and commercial interests.

F. Documentation and Reporting

- Maintain a centralised legal database of agreements, notices, licences, cases, and compliance records.

- Prepare monthly MIS reports on pending legal matters, renewals, risks, and deadlines.

- Ensure confidentiality and secure storage of sensitive legal documents.

- Coordinate with management and departments to close pending legal actions within defined timelines.

These responsibilities reflect the core requirements commonly seen in corporate legal roles in Ahmedabad, including contract management, regulatory coordination, litigation tracking, and legal documentation.

3. Educational Qualification and Experience

- LL.B. from a recognised university; LL.M. is an added advantage.

- 2–5 years of relevant experience in a corporate legal department, manufacturing company, or law firm.

- Practical knowledge of Indian contract law, commercial law, employment-related legal matters, and applicable regulatory requirements.

- Experience in drafting and reviewing legal notices, agreements, and formal correspondence.

- Familiarity with Gujarat government departments and local regulatory procedures.

- Gujarati, Hindi, and English communication skills preferred.

- Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, email, and legal documentation systems.

4. Key Skills Required

- Strong legal drafting and interpretation.

- Contract review and risk identification.

- Negotiation and problem-solving.

- Communication and coordination with advocates and government authorities.

- Confidentiality and professional ethics.

- Time management, follow-up, and documentation accuracy.

title: Area Manager - Cardiac Surgery
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Kerala and Mangalore. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.
  
  
The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
* Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
* Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
* Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
* Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
* Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
* Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
* Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
* Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
* Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
* Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**
The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers.

title: Account Coordinator-Senior Associate
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Competency**
Client Excellence – Account Excellence
  
  
**Role Type**
Senior Account Coordinator
  
  
**The opportunity**
Senior Associate at C&I team supports the Account Manager and the Account Leadership team; Global Client serving Partner, Global Client Executive to develop and manage relevant activities on designated Priority accounts. The Senior Account Coordinator will be expected to provide high quality and insightful support to account teams on Go-to-market activities. The Senior Account Coordinator will build network across the account leadership and within GDS to develop account knowledge to benefit the regional/global Account team and our relationship and business with the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Account Management**

* Own account reporting and ensure relevant stakeholders receive and understand reported data
* In liaison with the Client Service Partner and Director, own the account planning process and ensure regular reviews against planned milestones and targets.
* Understand the strategic communication and stakeholder engagement requirements to progress the account plan agenda, and work with global teams to respond and deploy
* Provide relevant knowledge to Account teams – focus on dissemination of business analysis and research, competitive intelligence and relevant firm thought leadership
* To liaise and work with onshore account teams and internal business services groups to scope new support requirements, build processes for the execution of account management tasks, and ensure effective transition of work to the remote GDS support platform
* Client Relationship Development
* Contribute to complex account and business development needs, including global account planning, go-to-market research and strategy, pursuit or sales support, pitch development, among others
* Work with BMC point of contact to plan and execute marketing initiatives that directly drive revenue
* Accelerate strategy execution, particularly around prioritized Regions and strategic solutions.
* Understand market trends, what is on our clients' agenda and how these translate into revenue generating opportunities. Monitor solution revenue to understand success, opportunities, underperformance
* Communication
* Coordinate with global network of regional account team meetings. Send updated account and sector content and information.
* Develop and maintain relationships with service lines, Accounts, Market Segments, Emerging Markets and subsectors to serve as a two-way conduit for connection and communication
* Responsible for working to develop high impact relationships and embedding ABD support into the processes of the accounts
* Responsible for project management, quality control, review of deliverables, and for embedding the principles of exceptional client service of being connected, responsive and insightful in our support to the account teams and ABD stakeholders
* Facilitation of knowledge sharing

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Succinct and structured oral and written communications skills with proven ability to explain complex concepts in a crisp, clear, concise, and graphic-rich style, using appropriate analytics and visualization tools.
* Experience in Account Management and preparing sales and pipeline reporting, as well as providing insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients
* Experience in Microsoft tools like excel and PPT

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Any Graduate
* 4-8 years' experience in Account management and data reporting and analysis
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Demonstrated strong written and oral communication skills
* Ability to use both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis methodologies, including financial analysis skills, to synthesize information, review data inputs and provide analytic insights

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Account Management and data reporting skills
* Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc
* Credible experience working in a fast-moving, client-driven environment

**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
* Experience using Procurement portals (i.e., SAP Fieldglass or Ariba)

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* A professional with strong interpersonal skills - confidence, maturity & ability to build strong client relationships

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality

title: Branch Manager- Cochi
description:
**Job Purpose**
To manage the affairs of the respective branch & increase the business by penetrating deeper in the branch geography, ensuring successful operations & formulating plans for better client servicing through that branch to generate Business revenue & brokerage. The product portfolio includes broking products & services and other investment products like mutual funds, life insurance, health insurance.
  
  
**Job Context & Major Challenges**
Aditya Birla Money Ltd. (ABML) is primarily a Broking Company, deals in Equity, Commodity & Currency. Workforce of ~800 spread across ~40 locations with customer base of in excess of 3 lacs. Commodity operations are managed through its 100% subsidiary Aditya Birla Commodities Broking limited.
  
  
ABML is one of the leading securities trading companies in the country. ABML operates in a fragmented equity broking business and has a daily turnover of close to 3,000 Crores with a market share of 1%. ABM works in a highly regulated environment with a host of regulators like SEBI, RBI, AMFI, FMC, IRDA etc. regulating its day to day operations.
  
  
In addition to the regulator ABML is also subject to close monitoring and inspection through various agencies like NSE / BSE / NCDX / MCX / NSDL / CDSL etc. ABML also operates in a highly competitive market mainly in fragmented industry with ABML competition from major National Broking houses like ICICI Securities, HDFC Securities, Angel Broking, MOFSL etc. and a range of local Broking outfits.
  
  
ABM also operates in a highly competitive market mainly in fragmented industry with ABML competition from major National Broking houses like Kotak securities, Zerodha, Edelweiss, MOFSL etc. and a range of local Broking outfits.
  
  
**The Branch Manager Is Responsible For**

* Increasing the client base, revenue and market share in the branch.
* Increase the Pool & Base of UHNI, Large Self Trader clients and corporate customers, with the Team and Personal Network.
* Ensuring Dealer Productivity is as per the defined standards
* Manage relationships across the set of HNI clients and Corporate investors
* Cross Sell ABC’s Products & Investment Products to attain clients’ needs and desired Profitability from Cross Sell segment.

**The Major Challenges For This Profile Include**

* Acquiring new Large trader clients (direct) amidst competitive offerings
* Ensuring effective management and retention of customers.
* Regulator Challenges as regulator is going strict on funding, margins
* Effective operational & cost management through Branch Administration
* Maintaining multi product focus and equally driving the Cross-Sell Products to the existing and new clients.
* Ensuring Risk Compliance - Ensuring risk free and compliant business and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.
* Operational Challenges - Day to day coordination with RMS, Activation Team, Surveillance, day to day approvals W.R.T. to limits, commercials and various other departments for smooth functioning of branch.
* Staff Management - Recruitment of individual and teams and keeping the employees engaged thereby putting a control over attrition.

The critical skill sets required to meet these challenges are excellent implementation skills, strong business and analytical skills, strong product knowledge, superior communication skills, integration and controlling skills, people management skills, a strong local network and high target and customer service orientation.
  
  
**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)**
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
KRA1 Achieve the revenue growth & profitability to upscale the branch
  
  

* To drive the sales targets for the branch and build teams as per company’s annual target and over all objectives.
* To focus on Revenue & Profitability with achievement of target and Yield management.
* To maximize branch profits by achieving targeted fee income & effective cost management.
* Acquiring new Large trader clients (direct) and increase the “Digital Client” Base.
* To achieve the respective Branch gross revenue through offline and online platform
* To plan and execute various local level initiatives to ensure business momentum and direction.
* To engage in new and innovative business planning activities locally to increase client acquisition and Branch profitability.
* To monitor individual and team performance and take steps to improve productivity and correct deviations if any.

KRA2 Manage Online Transition & Dealer Productivity to ensure client profitability
  
  

* To transition existing & new clients to Mobile/Web/Exe platform so as to optimize dealer bandwidth.
* To increase the dealer’s productivity by acquiring & servicing Large Traders and building a temp funding through HNI/ Large Traders.

KRA3 To ensure Cross Sell of ABC Products
  
  

* To ensure multi product targets are attained at the branch.
* To regularly attend trainings and learn about the alternate products offered and ensure all branch employees attend training & are aware of alternate products.
* To increase business through cross-selling initiatives & innovative product mixes.
* To use alternate products to activate inactive customers.

KRA4 To effectively manage day to day branch administration and operations for smooth functioning of the branch
  
  

* To monitor and foster all daily operations of the branch
* To handle a team of Dealers/Relationship managers and Customer Service executives and motivate them in target achievements.
* To ensure security of the physical assets of the branch.
* To oversee and ensure adherence to the Risk compliance and statutory compliance policies.

KRA5 To ensure customer management & engagement
  
  

* To plan and execute local area programs and referrals programs
* To disseminate research based advisory services to clients based on recommendations given by In-house Research team.
* To focus on retention of customers, higher revenue generation and referral activities.
* To continuously scan the local market penetration & competitive offerings & report on emerging trends for different product lines.
* To ensure proper implementation and usage of Lead management system (LMS) & IMS at the branch in coordination with HO team.
* To ensure client records are up to date in terms of financial details & contact ability and run data analytics on them on periodic basis
* To ensure speedy resolution of client queries and grievances to maximize satisfaction levels.

KRA6 To ensure effective risk management & policy adherence
  
  

* To ensure adequate compliance to KYC norms, processes & documentation for client profiling.
* To ensure adherence of all regulatory compliances & critical policies set by HO.

KRA7 Team Building, Engagement & Development
  
  

* To build a Sales Driven proactive team and enhance their capabilities by regularly imparting relevant knowledge and skills required for the Equity Advisors to achieve their goals efficiently.
* Meeting the Competition Teams and doing Competition Talent Mapping.
* Engaging the teams and keeping them engaged and motivated and ensuring that there is minimum attrition in the branches.
* To ensure that requisite product & behavioral trainings are imparted.

description:
Blue Tech Marine Services PVT LTD, a part of Bluebird Group, is currently seeking a diligent and detail-oriented **Accounts Executive** to join our Finance and Accounts team in Kochi. The role will cover day-to-day accounting operations, ERP coordination, cash and bank transactions, reconciliations, receivables, and maintenance of accurate financial records through to account finalisation.

**Educational Qualification:** Commerce graduate preferred; working knowledge of ERP software required

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Ø ERP coordination and system support: Coordinate with ERP service providers to report issues, follow up on resolutions, support system configuration or process improvements, and help ensure the ERP system meets the company’s accounting and reporting requirements.

Ø Accounting entries and ledger maintenance: Record and review day-to-day financial transactions, maintain general ledger and subsidiary ledgers, and ensure entries are supported by appropriate documentation and posted to the correct accounts and periods.

Ø Invoicing and billing support: Prepare, verify, record, and track customer and supplier invoices, as applicable; check supporting documents and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve billing discrepancies.

Ø Accounts receivable and collections: Monitor outstanding receivables, follow up on overdue payments with customers and internal teams, update collection status, and escalate long-pending or disputed items to the appropriate supervisor.

Ø Petty cash management: Maintain petty cash records, verify bills and vouchers, record approved expenses, monitor balances, and ensure timely submission and replenishment requests in line with company procedures.

Ø Bank and account reconciliations: Prepare regular bank reconciliations and reconcile relevant ledger balances, investigate unmatched entries or discrepancies, and follow up for timely resolution.

Ø Payments and expense processing: Assist with payment preparation, expense verification, employee claims, supplier balances, and other routine accounting activities, ensuring appropriate approvals and supporting documents are available before processing.

Ø Cash and bank transaction tracking: Maintain accurate records of receipts, payments, deposits, and transfers; verify entries against bank statements and supporting records.

Ø Month-end and year-end support: Assist with closing activities, schedules, balance confirmations, reconciliations, and preparation of records required for account finalisation, audit, and statutory or management reporting.

Ø Financial data accuracy: Enter and update financial information in the ERP and related records promptly, maintain organised documentation, and protect the confidentiality and integrity of financial data.

Ø Reports and analysis: Prepare periodic reports on receivables, payables, expenses, cash and bank balances, reconciliations, and other financial information required by management.

Ø Internal coordination: Liaise with Finance and Accounts colleagues, operations, sales, procurement, and other departments to obtain documents, clarify transactions, and resolve accounting-related queries.

Ø Compliance and controls: Follow company accounting procedures, approval workflows, record-retention practices, and applicable financial control requirements; promptly highlight unusual transactions or discrepancies.

Ø Additional duties: Undertake other accounting and finance-related responsibilities reasonably assigned by the reporting manager, according to business requirements.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

Ø Minimum 2 years of experience working with ERP applications.

Ø Good understanding of accounting principles, bookkeeping, ledger maintenance, and reconciliation practices.

Ø Working knowledge of MS Excel, including the ability to maintain schedules and prepare reports.

Ø Practical understanding of petty cash, bank reconciliation, invoicing, and receivables is an advantage.

Ø Strong numerical accuracy, analytical thinking, organisation, and attention to detail.

Ø Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.

Ø Ability to manage deadlines, maintain confidentiality, and coordinate effectively with internal teams and external service providers.

title: Business Development Manager- Aerospace & Defense

Scimplify is a science-first manufacturing company for Advanced Materials: from specialty chemicals to the emerging building blocks of next-generation energy applications, life sciences, and crop sciences.

We scale process development and manufacturing as one continuous system, supported by world-class R&D infrastructure and executed across a global network of 500+ manufacturing partners and thousands of scientists and technical partners. You will build Scimplify's Aerospace & Defence business from the ground up. The first focus is long-term supply of raw materials for land defence vehicle programmes, followed by aerospace, space and other defence platforms.

You will own the full cycle: mapping the market, winning OEMs, Tier-1 and Tier-2 suppliers and public sector undertakings as customers, running government bids, and closing long-term agreements with sound margins. * Map the Indian A&D market: land defence vehicle programmes, aerospace, space, and the OEMs, Tier-1 and Tier-2 suppliers and PSUs behind them.

**Key account management**

* Manage key accounts end to end, including order book, forecasts and renewals.

**Technical and cross-functional coordination**

* Translate customer specifications into material requirements for R&D, sourcing and manufacturing teams.

**Market building**

**Experience and education**

* A track record of closing long-term supply agreements
* Experience selling raw materials, metals, alloys, composites, chemicals or engineered materials is a strong advantage.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
Location: Pune/Delhi/Bangalore

Job Type: Full-time | Employment: Permanent

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic, clinically focused and result-oriented Area Sales Manager – Vascular to drive sales and develop strong customer relationships across Vascular Surgery, Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgery (CVTS), liver transplant, and Interventional Radiology (IR). The ideal candidate will have experience engaging with surgeons, interventional radiologists, hospital teams and procurement stakeholders, with the ability to support clinical procedures and achieve territory growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Clinical & Surgeon Engagement**

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with Vascular Surgeons, CVTS surgeons, liver transplant teams, and Interventional Radiologists.

• Provide product-related clinical and procedural support during surgeries, interventions, and OT procedures, within the scope of training and company protocols.

• Support product evaluations, demonstrations, trials, and adoption by healthcare professionals.

• Conduct product presentations, clinical discussions, workshops, and in-service training for surgeons and hospital teams.

• Help healthcare professionals understand product features, usage, and procedural workflows; coordinate with internal teams to address product-related queries.

**2. Sales & Business Development**

• Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for the assigned territory.

• Identify new business opportunities and convert leads into sustainable sales across vascular, CVTS, liver transplant, and IR specialties.

• Promote the company’s relevant medical devices and consumables in line with approved product information and commercial strategy.

• Build relationships with key hospitals, surgeons, cath labs, operating theatres, procurement teams, and biomedical departments.

• Coordinate product trials, quotations, negotiations, tenders, and commercial approvals to support business closure.

**3. Territory & Account Management**

• Develop and execute territory business plans to increase product penetration and revenue.

• Maintain regular follow-ups on customer requirements, quotations, negotiations, and pending orders.

• Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, customer visit reports, forecasts, and territory performance updates.

• Build long-term relationships with key accounts and ensure responsive customer support.

**4. Market Intelligence & Strategy**

• Monitor market trends, competitor activity, product developments, and customer requirements in the relevant specialties.

• Identify new hospitals, surgeons, procedures, and accounts with potential for business growth.

• Share market feedback and recommend initiatives to improve product adoption, account coverage, and sales performance.

**Preferred Product / Specialty Exposure**

• Vascular surgery and vascular intervention products

• Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgery (CVTS)

• Liver transplant surgery and related surgical/interventional requirements

• Interventional Radiology (IR), including relevant consumables and devices

• Hospital-based medical devices, operating theatres, cath labs, or interventional procedure areas

**Qualifications & Skills**

• Bachelor’s degree in Science, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field preferred.

• 2–3 years of experience in medical device sales or healthcare business development; experience in the listed specialties will be an advantage.

• Good understanding of hospital procurement processes and clinical environments.

• Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to engage confidently with surgeons, interventional radiologists, and other healthcare professionals.

• Self-motivated, target-oriented, organised, and able to work independently.

• Willingness to travel regularly within the assigned territory.

**Industry**

* Medical Devices, Medical Equipment & Healthcare

title: Solutions Architect, ISV
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- AWS India - Karnataka

* Any Data Center related certification(CCIE, CCNP VCP, etc.) with a strong drive for continuous learning.
* Inspiring leader who can showcase the value, Cisco solutions and services bring to Customer business and ensure adoption.
* Ability to develop high-level migration and delivery strategies, driving decisions and seeing it through execution effectively and in an efficient manner.

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Technical Partnership: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* Joint Solution Development: Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* Customer Deal Support: Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* Partner Ecosystem & Events: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* Product Feedback: Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Technical Service - Agronomy, Plant Biosolutions - India
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis Plant Biosolutions, we believe biology can help transform agriculture and create a more sustainable future. We are looking for an experienced agronomy professional to help accelerate the adoption of biological solutions across India by connecting science, farmers, partners, and commercial teams.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service – Agronomy, Plant Biosolutions - South Asia, you will be a trusted technical and agronomy expert for Novonesis Plant Biosolutions in India. You will drive the adoption and growth of biological solutions in sugarcane through strategic engagement with sugar mills, distributors, and commercial teams.
  
  
You will provide technical leadership, validate product performance, develop agronomic value propositions, and help successfully commercialize Novonesis Biosolutions across key sugarcane-growing regions in India.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Partner closely with sugar mills in Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Karnataka to accelerate adoption and commercialization of Novonesis Biosolutions in sugarcane.
* Build strong relationships with sugar mill management, agronomy teams, and their extension networks, while supporting commercial teams in communicating Novonesis' technical value proposition and product differentiation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert in sugarcane agronomy and biological solutions, developing agronomic recommendations, application protocols, and best practices for Novonesis products.
* Establish and manage demonstration programs, field days, customer trials, and a robust pipeline of demonstrations supporting current and future business opportunities.
* Develop technical evidence and content, including comparative field data, cost calculators, case studies, customer testimonials, success stories, and agronomic recommendations.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting and deliver technical training to sugar mill agronomy and commercial teams and distributors.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Agronomy, Soil Science, Plant Nutrition, Crop Science, Agricultural Microbiology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in agronomy, technical services, or market development with sugar mills or within the agri-inputs, crop nutrition, crop protection, or agri-biologicals industry.
* Strong agronomic expertise in sugarcane production systems and crop management practices.
* Demonstrated experience conducting field trials, demonstration programs, technical evaluations, and data interpretation.
* Experience working directly with farmers, distributors, institutional customers, or large sugar mill groups.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English and Hindi.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* A customer-centric approach and passion for agriculture.
* A self-driven, entrepreneurial approach and ability to work independently.
* Strong collaboration and cross-functional working skills.
* A strong execution mindset, curiosity, and forward-thinking approach.
* Business acumen and the ability to translate agronomic science into customer and commercial value.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to bring your sugarcane agronomy expertise together with biological solutions and work across science, agriculture, customer partnerships, and commercial teams. The role offers broad engagement with sugar mills, distributors, farmers, and internal teams while contributing to the growth of Plant Biosolutions in India.
  
  
Working conditions
  
  
This is a hybrid role based in NCR, New Delhi or Bangalore, with travel of up to 60% within India.
  
  
Application deadline
  
  
End of October.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

+ Monetize the value of EY’s differentiated solution, mitigating commercial risks: Design and execute innovative pricing and commercial models (e.g., outcome-based, risk-reward, consumption-based) incorporating behavioral economics techniques to accelerate client value while safeguarding EY’s margin and risk exposure.
+ Oversee, execute and validate financial modelling and commercial structuring: Use applications such as Microsoft Excel and EY’s pricing and analytics tools to create financial structures and model forecasted economics based on accounting standards and internal guidelines, ensuring alignment with EY’s profitability and risk frameworks.
+ Shape pursuit, integrating solution intelligence and EY gold standards: Collaborate with solution architects to test the solution design for alignment with expected value, client's willingness to pay, and internal ROI expectations. Validate solution estimates against typical market approaches to identify sources of differentiated value and/or optimize them for competitiveness.
+ Refine the pricing strategy aligned with the differentiated value of our solution: Develop detailed price-to-win assessments to refine price positioning strategy leveraging market benchmarks, macro and micro economic indicators, knowledge of client pain points and objectives, and competitor intelligence.
+ Synthesize sales, price and solution insights into actionable intelligence: Collaborate with competitive intelligence, analytics, and other internal teams to perform research and refine the pursuit’s pricing strategy, positioning and offer design to help build compelling proposals.
+ Showcase pursuit experience to build intelligence and optimize win odds: Bring forward relevant insights and ideas from pursuit experience, knowledge of service lines and sectors, research and network connections on a consistent basis.
+ Active contributor to negotiations and client communications: Lead development of client-facing financial and commercial documents, assist in high-stakes negotiations, and articulate deal constructs and value propositions to engagement partners and pursuit leaders to support securing of strategic agreements and strengthen client relationships.
+ Drive commercial transformation through training and facilitation: Contribute to thought leadership activities for development of pricing and commercial acumen within the organization. Develop collateral, assets and white papers for spreading commercial knowledge outside of the function.
+ Adept at team building: Mentor and coach team members to enhance performance.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**




+ Experience with a broad spectrum of pricing and commercial strategies applicable to professional services with a holistic view on value-based pricing, client’s willingness to pay and competitive landscape to determine pricing power.
+ Collaborate effectively across a matrix organization displaying pursuit and relationship management skills to deliver a high-quality work product while navigating conflicting interests.
+ Executive-level communication and negotiation skills to influence senior stakeholders and articulate differentiated value propositions.
+ Possess natural coaching skills, ease team discussions, speak in large group settings, handle difficult conversations and objections, influence without authority and write persuasively.
+ Execute with a high degree of independence and autonomy.
+ Ability to demonstrate innovation and creativity.
+ Strong data driven or statistical and problem-solving skills.
+ Be a transformative leader, both as an individual and as a counsellor.
+ Ability to prioritize strategic decisions under ambiguity and high-stakes timelines.

**Qualifications for the role:**




+ Graduate in relevant field(s) like finance, accounting, statistics, engineering or a related field along with equivalent practical experience.
+ MBA and / or certifications covering financial knowledge (CFA, CMA, CPA) would carry significant advantages.
+ At least 6 years of relevant experience in professional services, preferably in functions like pricing and commercials, Price-to-Win, strategy consulting, financial planning & analysis, SaaS/cloud commercialization etc.
+ Advanced excel knowledge with expert proficiency in financial modelling, accounting, budgeting and associated metrics.
+ English language fluency (oral and written).
+ Experience in solution architecture or design is highly desirable and will be an added advantage.

**Additional notes:**




+ Must be flexible with working hours according to the needs of the geography being supported.
+ May be needed to travel on occasions.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.
* Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions.
* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
  
  
As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams.
