title: Senior Technical Consultant: Salesforce(Automotive Experience)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Executive Summary & Organizational Context**
Within Salesforce Professional Services, the Senior Technical Consultant — Automotive Cloud role occupies a vital strategic position at the bleeding edge of AI CRM and automotive industry digital transformation. As automotive enterprises navigate sweeping market disruptions—from electric vehicle transitions and direct-to-consumer sales models to connected vehicle telemetry and autonomous fleets—this role serves as the bridge between pioneering platform capabilities and real-world enterprise execution.
  
  
Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.
  
  

* Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes. Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
* Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies.

**Core Automotive Domain Implementation**
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:
  
  

* Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
* Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
* Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
* Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
* Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.

**AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing**

* Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
* Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.

**Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship**

* Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
* Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
* Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.

Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.
  
  

* Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
* Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
* Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
* Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
* Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
* Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
* Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct engagement experience on Salesforce Automotive Cloud implementations, with deep operational mastery of the Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, or Fleet Management modules.
* Hands-on experience with connected vehicle platforms, IoT edge device integrations, or real-time telematics data ingestion into the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to build real-time, unified customer and vehicle data profiles that power personalized experiences.
* Practical exposure to cutting-edge Agentforce implementations within automotive contexts, such as AI-driven service advisors, dealer-facing conversational chatbots, and predictive maintenance agents.
* Direct experience consulting with OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, or dealership groups at enterprise scale.
* Existing Salesforce Industry Cloud accreditations or certifications in Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or adjacent vertical solutions.

While these baseline and preferred qualifications establish a candidate's operational readiness, long-term success in the practice requires continuous technical credentialing and structured platform upskilling.
  
  

* Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning Maintaining technical mastery within the rapidly evolving Agentforce ecosystem requires an unyielding commitment to continuous learning and formal platform credentialing. Salesforce Professional Services invests heavily in continuous talent development to ensure consultants remain ahead of platform innovation curves.

**Target Certification Requirements**
Candidates are expected to formally achieve the following five Salesforce certifications within their first 3 months in the role:
  
  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect

*Note: Holding any of the above Salesforce credentials prior to onboarding is considered highly beneficial and serves as a primary key differentiator during the candidate evaluation and selection process.*
Beyond technical certifications and architectural expertise, sustained consulting excellence in high-stakes enterprise environments depends on core leadership behaviors and alignment with corporate values.
  
  

* Leadership Qualities & Core Values To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Senior Technical Consultant must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust. Core Leadership Pillars
* PASSION: Demonstrates an unyielding commitment to Customer Success. The consultant exhibits deep personal investment in seeing automotive clients succeed, transforming complex technology implementations into tangible market wins and measurable business outcomes for OEM stakeholders and dealer networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Maintains a continuous learning mindset. The consultant approaches every complex enterprise engagement, client interaction, and architectural challenge with humbleness, curiosity, and openness—actively dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in automotive technology and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives amidst high levels of uncertainty and rapid industry transformation. Recognizing that structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption are permanent constants in the automotive sector, the consultant remains poised, agile, and decisive when navigating ambiguous project environments.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Manager, Account Management
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Account Management
  
  
Mastercard is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented professional to join the Financial Institutions (FI) team. This individual contributor role will be responsible for managing and growing strategic relationships with Banks and Financial Institutions while identifying new business opportunities that drive revenue growth and expand Mastercard's presence within the banking ecosystem.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted partner to customers, developing deep stakeholder relationships, uncovering opportunities for collaboration, and delivering innovative payment solutions that create mutual value. The role requires a combination of relationship management, business development, strategic thinking, and commercial execution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own and manage relationships with a portfolio of Banks and Financial Institutions, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to strengthen existing client relationships, increase customer engagement, and drive sustainable business growth.
* Identify opportunities within existing customer portfolios to expand Mastercard's products, services, and solutions, generating incremental revenue and increasing market share.
* Proactively scout for and secure new business opportunities with existing and prospective banking partners to achieve business development objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers, including CXOs, Business Heads, Product Heads, Payments Heads, Cards Leaders, and Digital Banking stakeholders.
* Work closely with customers to understand their strategic priorities and align Mastercard solutions to support their growth ambitions.
* Lead customer engagements and business discussions to identify opportunities across card issuance, digital payments, acceptance, commercial solutions, value-added services, and emerging payment technologies.
* Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new and existing Mastercard products and solutions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Franchise, Customer Solutions, Consulting, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver customer-centric solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Analyse customer portfolios, market trends, competitive dynamics, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities and formulate winning strategies.

title: Business Processes Principal Consultant - CIS
description:
**We help the world run better**
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. **Business Process Principal Consultant — Customer Industry Solutions (CIS)**

* Build the Industry AI portfolio: Turn customer learnings into industry-specific AI assets and accelerators — with documented financial and operational value, reusable across SAP globally.

**What You Bring**

* Deep industry expertise: 6+ years in Manufacturing, Energy & Natural Resources, Consumer Products, or Professional Industries — with operational-level knowledge of where processes break and where transformation creates real value.
* AI use case expertise: Hands-on experience defining Agentic AI solutions with a clear focus on data readiness, process fit, and measurable outcomes.

* Business acumen and value orientation: Ability to translate AI opportunities into quantified business cases — with realistic KPIs, ROI timelines, and a clear understanding of how value is created and measured in the businesses you serve.

You will join SAP's Customer Industry Solutions (CIS) team — a global group of industry experts at the intersection of deep domain knowledge and cutting-edge AI engineering. * Experience in operating environments in retail, hospitality, restaurant or other industries to understand and identify labor challenges that Legion solves

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
  
  
Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously.
  
  
Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.
  
  
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. title: Managed Services Senior Solution Architect - Bengaluru,India
description:
**About Diversified**
Diversified is a global leader in audio visual and media innovation, recognized for designing and building the world’s most experiential environments. Our award-winning team specializes in delivering solutions for the most complex, large-scale and immersive installations. Serving a global clientele that includes major media organizations and retailers, sports and live performance venues, corporate enterprises, and government agencies, Diversified partners with clients to create spaces that bring people together and keep them coming back.
  
  
**What To Expect**
At Diversified, we're on a mission to create a world without boundaries, where technology enables all people to connect and experience the moments that matter, wherever they choose to be. With clients spanning the globe and an exciting pipeline of projects across industries, Diversified offers more than just a job. We offer a career path with the flexibility to grow personally and professionally, wherever your ambitions take you.
  
  
As a Diversified associate, you'll dive headfirst into big, complex, and rewarding projects that push the boundaries of what's possible. Plus, you'll enjoy a flexible work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and a culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.
  
  
**IF YOU CAN DREAM IT, YOU CAN DO IT AT DIVERSIFIED.**
**Job Summary**
Diversified is seeking a commercially driven and technically credible Managed Services Senior Solution Architect to lead the design and continuous improvement of service solutions. This is a senior, presales-focused service architecture role responsible for supporting complex, multi-element, service-led opportunities from early discovery through solution design, commercial modelling, contractual definition, and executive presentation.
  
  
The role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Operations, with accountability for ensuring that solutions are:
  
  

* Technically robust
* Commercially sound
* Contractually clear
* Operationally deliverable

In parallel, the role contributes to the development of scalable, repeatable service offerings, supporting long-term service & revenue growth, and portfolio evolution.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Solution Architecture & Design
* Lead structured discovery engagements to understand business objectives, operational requirements, and service outcomes
* Define end-to-end service solutions including scope, SLAs, governance models, and transition frameworks
* Architect complex, multi-element managed services, support agreements, and staffing models
* Drive the use of standardized, repeatable service components to ensure scalability, consistency, and margin efficiency
* Ensure all solutions align with established service offerings, delivery models, operational capabilities, and support frameworks
* Define clear acceptance criteria to support seamless transition into service delivery
* Produce high-quality, executive-level proposals and detailed solution documentation
* Commercial & Contractual Responsibility
* Develop and validate service cost models in alignment with defined pricing frameworks and margin expectations
* Responsible for financial accuracy of solutions, ensuring compliance with margin thresholds and commercial governance standards, adjusting pricing based on risk, delivery complexity, contractual exposure, and operational considerations
* Clearly define and document all assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, and constraints to protect delivery integrity
* Own and assure the quality of Statements of Work (SOW), ensuring contractual clarity across scope, SLAs, deliverables, and obligations
* Support contract review and redlining activities, ensuring alignment between solution design, commercial position, and contractual commitments
* Complex Deal & RFPs
* Lead the service strategy for complex, service-led opportunities in partnership with Account Executives
* Provide subject matter expertise for service workstreams within RFI/RFP responses
* Coordinate cross-functional inputs from Sales, Operations, Delivery, and Pre-Sales teams
* Participate in client workshops, presentations, and executive-level solution discussions
* Support commercial negotiations relating to service scope, SLAs, and delivery commitments
* Participate in formal deal governance processes, ensuring solution quality, compliance, and risk mitigation prior to client commitment
* Delivery Readiness & Assurance
* Ensure all solutions meet internal delivery standards, frameworks, and operational acceptance criteria
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, and constraints, and define appropriate mitigation strategies
* Validate solution delivery capability across global and regional delivery models
* Support structured handover into delivery teams, ensuring clarity and continuity
* Use feedback from delivery teams and clients to continuously improve solution design, standards, and assumptions
* Service Development
* Identify gaps and opportunities within our services portfolio
* Partner with services offering team, sales and service leadership to develop scalable, repeatable service offerings aligned to market demand
* Collaborate with OEMs and technology partners to shape lifecycle, consulting, and XaaS-based services
* Sales Enablement & Growth
* Support and guide Account Executives in qualifying service-led opportunities using clear qualification criteria
* Work with Service and Sales leadership to improve service attachment rates across project and technology sales
* Contribute to the development of service scoping tools, pricing frameworks, and proposal templates in collaboration with the services offering team
* Prioritise engagement on high-value, complex, and strategic opportunities

**Required Skills/Qualifications**

* 5+ years’ experience within AV, Unified Communications, or technology services environments
* Proven experience architecting managed services and lifecycle support solutions
* Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise Account Executives on complex presales engagements
* Experience designing SLA frameworks, governance models, and service transition approaches
* Strong experience in commercial modelling, pricing structures, and margin management
* Experience contributing to or leading service workstreams within complex RFP/RFI responses
* Proven experience with Unified Communications environments and enterprise collaboration ecosystems

**Technical & Commercial Capability**

* Strong understanding of managed services operating models (onsite, remote, hybrid)
* Ability to solution scalable, repeatable service solutions aligned to commercial and operational objectives
* Sound commercial judgement with clear understanding of cost drivers, margin protection, and contractual risk
* Ability to structure multi-element service solutions including support, staffing, consulting, and lifecycle services

**Preferred Skills/Qualifications**

* Experience developing new service catalogues or go-to-market service offerings
* Exposure to multi-site or global enterprise service models
* Knowledge of ITIL or recognized service management best practices
* Experience working with subscription-based or XaaS commercial structures
* Experience collaborating with OEMs and technology vendors to shape service propositions

**Core Competencies**

* Advanced discovery and consultative solution design capability
* Strong executive-level communication and presentation skills
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decision-making
* Structured and analytical approach to complex service challenges
* High attention to detail across documentation, pricing, and contractual scope
* Ability to balance client outcomes with operational scalability and risk
* Strong cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Operations, and Delivery

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**
To learn more about becoming part of the Diversified team, visit us at https://onediversified.com/careers/careers-at-diversified or email us at careers@onediversified.com.
  
  
Diversified is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All aspects of employment will be based on job requirements, individual qualifications, merit, performance, and business need.
  
  
We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
  
  
We believe in fair and equitable hiring practices and strive to create an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Industry Solution Architect –**
**Media & Entertainment**
**Experience Range:12–18 years**
**Function: Business Development | Complex Solutioning | Media industry Transformation**
**Overview**
EY seeks accomplished professionals for the role of
**Industry Solution Architect - Media & Entertainment.**
This role is designed for strategic leader who brings deep media sector expertise and can architect large-scale business and technology transformation solutions for media clients globally. The ideal candidate will combine industry knowledge with consulting, solutioning, and commercial acumen to help clients navigate audience fragmentation, digital disruption, content monetization challenges, evolving advertising models, and AI-led transformation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Media Industry Solution Leadership: Lead the design of end-to-end transformation solutions for media clients, shaping strategic pursuits and delivering measurable business value across content, audience, and revenue ecosystems
* Media Domain Expertise & Advisory: Serve as a trusted media SME, advising clients on streaming, content monetization, advertising, audience engagement, rights management, and emerging industry trends.
* Media Transformation & Innovation: Architect AI-enabled, data-driven transformation programs that modernize content supply chains, digital platforms, operating models, and revenue growth strategies.
* Value Proposition & Executive Storytelling: Develop compelling business cases and executive narratives that translate complex media transformation initiatives into clear commercial outcomes.
* Financial Modeling & Commercial Strategy: Design commercial, pricing, and value realization frameworks that support profitable growth, operational efficiency, and sustainable client impact.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with account teams, sector leaders, alliance partners, and client executives to co-create scalable solutions and drive successful transformation outcomes.

**Domain Skills And Knowledge Attributes**

* Proven experience in Media & Entertainment consulting, business transformation, strategy, or solution architecture with strong commercial acumen and business development capabilities.
* Deep understanding of media industry business models, economics, and value chains across content creation, broadcasting, streaming, advertising, publishing, sports, and entertainment ecosystems.
* Strong expertise in OTT and streaming platforms, AdTech, audience measurement, content operations, customer engagement, subscription businesses, and digital platform models.
* Ability to apply AI, analytics, personalization, and automation to drive business outcomes such as audience growth, content discovery, advertising yield optimization, subscriber retention, and operational efficiency.
* Strong understanding of content rights and licensing, DTC strategies, media distribution models, platform ecosystems, and emerging industry trends.
* Ability to translate industry challenges into scalable consulting and technology-led solutions.
* Working knowledge of media industry regulations, content governance, intellectual property rights, privacy requirements, advertising standards, and risk considerations.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.

**Qualifications**

* MBA or advanced degree.
* 12-18 years of experience within Media & Entertainment, Media Consulting, Digital Media Platforms, Broadcasting, Streaming Services, AdTech, or related industries.
* Demonstrated experience leading transformation initiatives, solution architecture, or strategic consulting engagements within the media ecosystem.
* Strong industry network and credibility as a Media Subject Matter Expert (SME)

This position calls for strategic visionaries, effective collaborators, and domain specialists who will shape the future of TMT through innovative, enterprise-scale solutions for marquee clients, delivering lasting value for EY and its partners.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Deal Support Specialist - Supervising Associate
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 16, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1745289

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Deal Support Specialist - Supervising Associate**

  

**The opportunity**:

  

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) consists of various service delivery centers from which Client Service and Enablement Services teams operate to deliver strategic support to EY member firms. GDS spans all geographies, practices, services lines, sectors and competencies within EY to deliver integrated services that result in efficient and world-class solutions. The position in discussion is with the P&CE in EY GDS Clients and Industries Function. The GDS P&CE serves as an extension to the onshore Deals team who are involved in the direct Bid Management Processes. The P&CE supports the onshore teams on a number of opportunities, adding more value during the Deal process or the bid management cycle.

  

The Deal Support Specialist - Supervising Associate provides support in the different phases of the Deal process. This role will support the Pursuit Strategist/Leader in all the stages of the Bid Management Process, involving in pre-RFP, RFP response and post-RFP phase. The range of activities include project management, research, review and analytical support for the onshore Deal team throughout the bid management cycle. This role will support in executing globally consistent strategy.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

  

**Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management:**

* Gather information through secondary research (both internal and external sources) and generate top-notch deliverables such as company profiles, competitor insights, trend analysis, and other valuable assets to support pre and proposal development phases.
* Prepare and drive project management plan throughout the deal cycle by acting as a point of contact in managing the end-to-end process including but not limited to organizing meetings, preparing meeting notes, finalizing timelines and accountabilities as per deadlines.
* Owns the preparation of kick-off documents, CV collation for team book, orals preparation and credentials pack. Support in the development of draft proposal sections based on deal requirement.
* Liaise with the broader team in development of client collaterals such as storyboards, placemats, proposals and internal presentations
* Establish and maintain clear and transparent communication and build strong stakeholders’ relationships by exhibiting professional etiquettes and adhering to agreed timelines and quality benchmarks
* Manage a repository of Regional, Market Segment or Service Line client-facing collateral as appropriate
* Exhibit innovative thinking and flexible approach while managing complex and out-of-scope requests
* Own and maintain repository of client presentations, RFQ responses, marketing collateral, etc.

  

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* Critical thinking, organized, detail – oriented with strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines
* Demonstrates excellent customer service skills including telephone, MS Teams and e-mail support

  

**Supervision Responsibilities:**

  

* This role will have supervisory responsibilities and direct reports
* Will be responsible for leading a region, stakeholder management and governance
* Act as a counselor for Pursuit Coordinators (Senior Associate and Associate Ranks)
* Quality review of deliverables

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* Prior experience in Deals/pre-sales/bid management and project management
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and listening)
* Good business acumen and understanding of business development, Deal/ project management and coordination skills
* Expert in computer skills like Microsoft suite and Internet-based research
* Experience with SharePoint is desirable
* Able to build collaborative relationships with a variety of stakeholders

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

  

**Education:**

* University/bachelor’s degree required
* Master’s in business administration

  

**Experience:**

* 6 Yrs to 11 Yrs
* Minimum 3 years’ experience working with large Global organization preferably in a professional services firm
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
* Excellent written and oral communication skills in English is essential as the role requires direct communication with international team members
* Well versed in using MS Office

  

**Certification Requirements:**

* Expected to remain current on EY training and curriculum (e.g. Account Management Framework (AMF), Badges, etc.)
* APMP and or PMP Certification would be added advantage

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* As the job involves responding to clients' needs and varying time zones, long/flexible hours are regularly required
* Moderate travel – for attending leadership meetings/trainings

  

**Technologies and Tools**

  

* Excellent MS office skills, specifically PowerPoint are required

  

**What we offer**

  

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

  

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**Job description**
-------------------

**Role Type -** Deal Manager - Assistant Director

  

**The opportunity**

The Deal Manager - Assistant Director partners with Engagement Teams to support regional strategic, high-value pursuits. They engage early and at multiple stages during the pursuit process and are responsible for developing a tailored communications strategy to articulate a compelling ‘Why EY’ proposition in all pursuit collateral. The Deal Manager - Assistant Director is responsible for the tactical management of all pursuit work-streams including the facilitation of pursuit readiness sessions, touchpoint campaign, draft value proposition, proposal development and orals preparation. The Deal Manager - Assistant Director provides support, advice and expertise to in all the stages of Bid Management Process, involving in pre-RFP, RFP response and post-RFP phase

  

Deal Manager - Assistant Directors are expected to

* Manage execution of pursuit process, including critical path, timeline, and interdependencies
* Assess competitive situation and help develop differentiated win strategy focused on client priorities while protecting EY’s interests
* Develop power map and tactics to navigate client buying process
* Provide ‘glue’ to focus and guide extended pursuit team through structured sales approach and proposal development
* Collaborate with extended pursuit team define, package and articulate compelling client offer across scope, solution, price, and terms
* Plan storyline/key messages and prepare extended team for orals.

Additionally, the Deal Manager - Assistant Director is required to identify, develop and implement innovative approaches to pursuit management and drive adoption of these across the Region.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management**

* Partner with Engagement Teams to provide a full-service pursuit management model for Regional strategic, high-end opportunities
* Leads by example and advocates for gold standard pursuit practices
* In collaboration with other pursuit team members (e.g., Deal Leader, Engagement Partner, Client Partner), develops client-centric win themes that underpin the entire deal strategy. Ensures the win themes are reflected consistently throughout all client communications and deliverables.
* Suggests creative ideas that enhance our win strategy or ability to differentiate
* Manage and leads the development of opportunity value propositions
* Develop strategic messaging and lead conceptualization of all client-facing pursuit collateral
* Ensures all pursuit deliverables (e.g., meeting documents, proposals, presentations) are developed on schedule submitted on time and with the highest quality
* Ultimately responsible for quality control of all client-facing materials during the pursuit
* Ensures deal infrastructure is established & maintained, including TEAMS site, calendar, action tracker, team roster, notebook, etc. with support from the Deal Coordinator as needed.
* Develops and maintains the pursuit plan/action tracker and calendar, making certain that all pursuit activities are assigned ownership, tracked and executed according to schedule.
* Plan storyline/key messages and prepare extended team for orals
* Supports team strategic and/or operational initiatives to develop new or enhance existing best practices, tools, or enablers.
* Act as the central point of contact in managing the end-to-end process: evaluating requirements, organizing meetings, preparing meeting notes, finalizing timelines and accountabilities as per deadlines
* Serve as a facilitator/key contributor in pursuit strategy sessions, manages output and drives actions
* Shares lessons learned, best practices and innovation from pursuits and other experiences with teammates, the broader BD community, and the global firm as appropriate.
* Act as the knowledge steward for the pursuit
* Builds collaborative relationships with pursuit teams & senior client stakeholders,
* Lead post pursuit analysis and review; makes recommendations for process improvement
* Maintain relationships with other Deal Activation teams and key interdependency groups across the organization Participate in relevant internal and external networks
* Facilitate internal deal governance process

  

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* Champion CoE best-practice pursuit management tools and processes
* Solution-oriented and makes sound decisions quickly, given tight timeframes
* Demonstrate versatility in a constantly evolving environment with a wide variety of social styles
* Influence / challenge the account team to optimize the chances of winning

  

**Supervision Responsibilities:**

* Work with considerable autonomy while often managing the work of others
* Provide coaching and mentoring to others; may serve as a Counsellor to other Deal Coordinators in P&CE.
* Support the onboarding and training of new hires in P&CE.
* Develop and coach Deal Coordinators, Client Executives and Client Servers, through teaming on pursuits and facilitated training
* Oversee the work of the pursuit support team, including third-party resources (e.g. Deal Coordinator, external translation services, etc.)

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Critical thinking, organized, detail – oriented with strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines
* Good understanding of Business Development and Pursuit Management
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines which are essential for a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and listening)
* Strong inter-personal skills
* Ability to analyze data and derive conclusions
* Excellent critical and strategic thinking
* Excellent project management and negotiation skills
* Self-motivated, resourceful & ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ability to influence without authority, lead and coach others
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree (advanced degree preferred)
* MBA (Marketing/International Business)

  

**Experience:**

* 12-15 years in Business Development of which minimum 5 years should be in Bid Management/Pre-Sales/Pursuit Management in professional services organizations
* Minimum 5 years’ experience working with large Global organization preferably in a professional services firm
* Must have communications and proposal writing experience
* Experience in managing end to end managed services deals
* Experience working in a cross-border, multi-cultural environment

  

**Certification Requirements:**

* Expected to remain current on EY training and curriculum (e.g. Account Management Framework (AMF), Badges, etc.)
* APMP and or PMP Certification would be added advantage

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* As the job involves responding to clients' needs and varying time zones, long/flexible hours are regularly required
* Moderate travel - including occasional international travel - will be required

  

**Technologies and Tools**

* Excellent MS office skills, specifically PowerPoint are required

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**Job Description**

Inviting Applications for Senior Principal Consultant - Data Architect, Data Engineering!

  

A Data Architect who can design and implement data modernization solutions in the cloud is responsible for developing and implementing data architecture strategies for organizations transitioning their data systems to the cloud. They collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions. The Data Solution Architect works closely with data engineers, data scientists, and other IT professionals to design and deliver robust data platforms and architectures. Responsibilities: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into data architecture strategies and solutions. Design and develop scalable, secure, and high-performing data architectures in the cloud, leveraging cloud technologies and services. Modernize legacy data systems and migrate them to cloud-based architectures, ensuring smooth transition and minimal disruption. Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and other IT professionals to design and implement data pipelines, data transformation processes, and data integration solutions. Ensure data governance principles and best practices are implemented, including data quality controls, data privacy, and compliance. Optimize data platforms for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency, monitoring and troubleshooting any issues that may arise. Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in cloud technologies and data architecture, continuously enhancing knowledge and skills. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of learning and growth. Act as a subject matter expert in data architecture and cloud technologies, providing recommendations and insights to stakeholders and senior management Lead RFP responses by working with the Sales, Vertical and competency teams. Groom the team members in the pre-sales area.

  

Data Architecture: In-depth knowledge and experience in designing and implementing scalable, secure, and high-performing data Lakehouse architectures in the cloud using Databricks. Cloud Technologies: Proficiency in cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including their data services like AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or Google BigQuery. Data Modernization: Expertise in modernizing legacy data systems and transitioning them to cloud-based architectures using industry best practices. Data Integration: Strong understanding of data integration techniques, including ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, data pipelines, and data streaming using Python , Kafka for streams , Pyspark , DBT , and ETL services provided by cloud providers and SQL/PLSQL Database Technologies: Familiarity with various database technologies, both relational and non-relational, such as SQL databases, NoSQL databases, data lakes, and data warehouses. Should have strong hands-on knowledge in Data Modelling techniques using ERWIN Data Governance: Knowledge of data governance principles and practices, including data quality, data lineage, data privacy, and compliance. Data Security: Understanding of data security principles, including encryption, access controls, and data masking techniques. Programming and Scripting: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala, and experience with scripting languages like SQL or Shell scripting. Communication and Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with stakeholders, business users, and technical teams. Pre-Sales : Ability to lead/Coordinate the medium to large scale RFPs and construct the end to end big-data, analytics technical solutions and articulate the same using Power point or word document. Participate the client presentations and present the solutions prepared. Databricks Certification: At least one Databricks certification (Associate or Professional) is mandatory for this role. Preferred Qualifications Hybrid cloud domain exposure including end to end data architecture experience.

Bachelors - Business Analytics, Bachelors - Computer Science, Bachelors - Statistics, Masters - Data Science

**Certifications**

Certified Data Management Professional - RiversandRiversand, Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark 3.0 - Databricks AcademyDatabricks Academy, Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark - Databricks AcademyDatabricks Academy, Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate - MicrosoftMicrosoft, Oracle Database 12c Certified Implementation Specialist - OracleOracle

title: Junior ERP Sales Consultant
description:
Join a growing ERP consulting team where you'll close real deals with real businesses, not just chase quotas. Highshine IT Solutions is looking for an experienced ERP Sales Consultant who can own the full sales cycle and build lasting client relationships.

**About Us**

Highshine IT Solutions is a leading provider of ERP services, helping businesses run more efficiently and achieve excellence with tailored ERP solutions designed to meet each client's unique needs.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven ERP Sales Consultant to join our growing team. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of ERP ecosystems, a proven track record in B2B sales, and the ability to manage the complete sales cycle while building meaningful client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**

* *Customer Engagement:*
  Engage with potential and existing clients to understand their business challenges and position the right ERP solutions accordingly.
* *Needs Analysis:*
  Conduct in-depth analysis of client requirements and business processes to recommend suitable ERP modules and solutions.
* *Proposal Development:*

* *Sales Execution:*
  Own the end-to-end sales process from prospecting to deal closure, consistently meeting and exceeding sales targets.
* *Relationship Management:*

* *Collaboration:*

* *Market Intelligence:*

* Strong understanding of business processes and the ability to translate client needs into effective ERP solutions.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Self-motivated, target-driven, and capable of managing multiple accounts independently.
* Proficiency in CRM software and sales tools (e.g., Odoo, Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot).
* Willingness to work on-site in Chennai and travel to client locations as required.

₹6 - 7 LPA (based on experience).

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Comprehensive onboarding and continuous learning programs.
* Exposure to diverse industries and complex business environments.
* A collaborative and growth-focused work culture.

description:
**Business Information**
The
**Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC)**
is a competence center with around 3600+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy’s units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
  
  
**Mission Statement**
Service Sales & Tendering Team Manager is responsible for leading the Service Sales and Tendering team to deliver high-quality, timely and competitive offers for service business opportunities. The role includes managing team operations, resource allocation, competence development, stakeholder collaboration and people development. This position drives standardization, best-practice sharing, continuous improvement and team capability development while supporting business growth, customer satisfaction and operational excellence across global and local service sales requirements.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership and People Development**

* Lead, coach and mentor the Service Sales and Tendering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular performance and development discussions, define individual goals, identify competency gaps and support career growth.
* Build team capability through structured onboarding, training, knowledge sharing and development of behavioral and functional competencies.
* Drive recruitment, onboarding and resource readiness to support business expansion and future scope growth.
* Promote diversity, inclusion, positive team dynamics and a healthy work environment.

**Service Sales and Tendering Operations**

* Manage end-to-end service sales and tendering activities, ensuring alignment with customer requirements, timelines, quality standards and business expectations.
* Oversee RFQ review, scope clarification, technical-commercial alignment, offer preparation, risk assessment, bid submission and post-offer support.
* Provide guidance on tendering process flow, commercial governance, risk identification and quality of offer submissions.
* Support scope addition, team scaling and long-term capability building to match evolving business needs.

**Stakeholder and Business Collaboration**

* Collaborate with global stakeholders, sales units, factories, HUBs, customers and cross-functional teams to understand requirements, provide updates and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Maintain regular engagement with business counterparts to align priorities, review performance and address operational challenges.

**Performance Management and Operational Excellence**

* Drive and monitor key performance indicators such as On-Time Delivery, Hit rate, efficiency, utilization, NPS/customer satisfaction and quality of deliverables.
* Ensure effective workload planning, prioritization of critical cases and visibility of long-pending offers or execution gaps.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, process standardization, best-practice deployment and quality management system adherence.
* Develop and maintain a roadmap for team growth, productivity improvement, competency development and future technology/tool adoption.

**Administrative And Financial Responsibilities**

* Manage team administration, including resource planning, leave planning, onboarding support, infrastructure coordination and HR-related operational support.
* Support business-related financial coordination such as offer submission tracking, purchase order follow-up, invoicing coordination and payment collection follow-up where applicable.
* Ensure accurate reporting, timely updates and effective governance of team deliverables and business support activities.

**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
* Electrical Engineering or power/energy sector background will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Sales, Tendering, Front-End Sales, EPC or related functions.
* Prior experience in managing teams, working with global stakeholders and supporting multi-location or global business environments will be preferred.
* Experience in HV switchgear, Transformer, substations or service business.

**Functional Skills**

* Strong knowledge of service sales, tendering process flow, commercial review, risk assessment and offer management.
* Ability to manage sales processes, stakeholder requirements, timelines, quality standards and business priorities.
* Working knowledge of CRM/Salesforce and Power BI will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, organizational and risk management skills.

**Leadership And Behavioral Skills**

* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management and team-building abilities.
* Strong interpersonal skills to manage team dynamics, resolve conflicts and maintain a positive work environment.
* Strategic thinking with a proactive approach to business growth, scalability and capability development.

* Support portfolio quality through appropriate sourcing, fraud vigilance and early issue escalation.

* Escalate customer, documentation, fraud or repayment concerns promptly.

Decision rights
  
  

* Make day-to-day sales and customer-management decisions within approved policy, process, pricing and delegated authority.
* Prioritise and allocate customer follow-ups, including portfolio-quality and X-bucket actions, within the assigned scope.
* Escalate policy deviations, material customer impact, fraud indicators, persistent overdue cases and unresolved dependencies.

Internal Sales, Product, Credit/Underwriting, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Compliance, Finance, Technology, HR and COE.

* Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
* Managing incomplete or inconsistent customer, academic and financial information.
* Driving timely customer engagement for pre-due, pre-bounce and overdue cases while following approved conduct standards.
* Coordinating Sales, Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations to address X-bucket and early-delinquency issues.

Graduate. Relevant customer-facing, lending or financial-services experience preferred.
  
  
Critical skills and knowledge
  
  

* Education Loan customer counselling
* Sales execution and relationship management
* Portfolio-quality and X-bucket management awareness
* Customer repayment engagement and early-delinquency follow-up
* Understanding of academic, income and KYC documents
* CRM/LOS usage and MIS discipline
* Communication, negotiation and customer orientation
* Compliance, fraud and customer-conduct awareness
* Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
* High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality

title: Solutions Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Senior Analyst - Commercial Pharma Analytics
description:
Job Title: Senior Analyst - Commercial Pharma Analytics
  
  
GCL: D1
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn complex healthcare data into decisions that accelerate impact for patients and brands? In this hands-on role based in Chennai or Bangalore, you will partner directly with oncology brand leaders to build strategy and execution across Marketing, Sales, Clinical Affairs, Market Access, and Forecasting. You will use advanced analytics to focus our resources, sharpen go-to-market choices, and improve patient and HCP outcomes.
  
  
As a proactive internal consultant, you will build rigorous analytics that impact growth opportunities and audience segmentation. You will also support outreach, identify HCP and patient opportunities, measure return on investment, simulate markets, and analyze patient journeys. How would you build test-and-learn experiments that drive confident decisions and measurable commercial results?
  
  
**Accountabilities**
Strategic Brand Partnership: Serve as a trusted analytics partner to assigned Brand teams, translating ambiguous business questions into clear analytical approaches aligned to commercial objectives and patient impact.
  
  
Commercial Analytics and Insight Generation: Deliver opportunity assessments, segmentation and targeting, healthcare provider and patient analytics, marketing mix and return on investment analysis, market simulation, and patient flow modeling that inform strategic and tactical decisions.
  
  
Advanced Analytics and Data Science: Build production-ready analytics in Python and SQL (and PySpark where relevant). Apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, time series, regression and econometrics, Bayesian methods, and appropriate machine learning to solve high-value problems.
  
  
Engage with large, longitudinal healthcare datasets. These cover insurance records, electronic medical and health records, prescriptions, and patient-level sources (e.g., IQVIA). Ensure the assumptions are strong and outputs reproducible.
  
  
Data Platforms and Automation: Leverage Databricks and modern data environments to create scalable, reusable analytical assets. Champion guidelines in coding, version control, documentation, and efficiency, including AI-assisted development and automation.
  
  
Collaboration and Influence: Work with cross-functional team members across Marketing, Medical, Market Access, Sales, Forecasting, and US Sales Force Operations. Manage multiple priorities and deliver clear recommendations through concise storytelling and business framing.
  
  
Executive Communication and Knowledge Sharing: Synthesize complex analyses into compelling insights for senior leadership via decks, dashboards, and executive updates. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and analytical excellence.
  
  
**Education**
Essential Skills/Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative field such as:
* Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Operations Research or related field
* Advanced degree (Master’s / MBA / PhD) or equivalent experience is preferred.

**Experience**

* 7–11 years of relevant experience in Pharmaceutical / Biotech / Healthcare analytics.
* Strong experience working with secondary healthcare data (claims, EMR/EHR, patient‑level datasets).
* Demonstrated experience delivering commercial analytics with business impact.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong hands‑on experience with: Python, R, SQL (PySpark preferred) Databricks or analytics platforms
* Data visualization experience with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, QlikView (or similar).
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills for executive communication.
* Expertise in statistical analysis, modelling, and data mining.
* Experience with IQVIA or similar syndicated data sources.

**Essential Proficiencies**

* Strong analytical capability.
* Ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Excellent communication and skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast‑paced environment.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience in Oncology analytics or strong understanding of patient pathways and treatment landscapes.
* Exposure to machine learning, optimization, and simulation techniques.
* Experience with Big Data / Spark‑based environments.
* Proven ability to lead analytics initiatives and influence senior commercial collaborators.
* Strong strategic insight with the ability to link analytics to brand and business strategy.

When we bring together unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold ideas fueled by the power to encourage life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Join a global, fast-growing organization where diverse experts come together to solve complex problems that matter. You will harness brand new analytics, modern data platforms, and automation to power better decisions and real patient impact. We champion curiosity and decisive action, valuing kindness alongside ambition, and we back you with smart tools, deep mentorship, and a connected network that opens new paths. Here you can shape how we work, influence enterprise-wide decisions, and see your ideas move quickly from insight to outcome.

Step into a role where your analytics will guide bold brand decisions and improve patients’ lives—seize this opportunity to build, influence, and grow with us today.

* CRM/LOS usage and MIS discipline

description:
Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow.
