Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
Peloton is seeking an experienced Anaplan Solution Architect to play a key role in delivering connected planning solutions and supporting the growth of our Anaplan practice. This is a hands-on, client-facing role focused on designing, building, and optimizing scalable Anaplan models across Finance (FP&A), Supply Chain (S&OP), and Sales planning domains. As an Anaplan Architect, you will serve as a subject matter expert, guiding clients through transformation initiatives while ensuring best practices in model design, data integration, and overall solution architecture.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
Solution Architecture & Design
  
- Serve as the architectural SME for large-scale, connected Anaplan planning solutions
  
  
- Translate complex business problems, legacy tools, and spreadsheets into scalable, multi-dimensional Anaplan models
  
  
- Define solution architecture, data flows, and model design standards aligned with Anaplan best practices
  
  
- Develop implementation roadmaps and high-level solution strategies
  
  
Requirements & Delivery Execution
  
- Gather and analyze business requirements across Finance, Supply Chain, and/or Sales planning functions
  
  
- Design, build, and optimize Anaplan models to support planning, forecasting, and reporting needs
  
  
- Enhance and extend existing models to support new functionality and evolving business requirements
  
  
- Lead or support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment, and post-go-live stabilization
  
  
Data Integration & Modeling
  
- Design and support data integration solutions (inbound and outbound) between Anaplan and source systems
  
  
- Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and performance across models and integrations
  
  
- Apply strong financial and operational modeling principles to support decision-making
  
  
Project & Team Leadership
  
- Lead project workstreams and manage team members to deliver high-quality solutions on time and within scope
  
  
- Mentor and develop team members, providing guidance on Anaplan modeling and best practices
  
  
- Contribute to knowledge sharing and capability development within the Anaplan practice
  
  
Practice Development & Sales Support
  
- Support business development efforts, including solutioning, estimating, and proposal development
  
  
- Participate in client presentations, demos, and statements of work (SOW) creation
  
  
- Contribute to the development of methodologies, accelerators, and intellectual property
  
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience:
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  
  
- 3+ years of experience as an Anaplan Solution Architect
  
  
- 5+ years of experience delivering end-to-end Anaplan implementations
  
  
- Strong expertise in Anaplan model building and architecture
  
  
- Experience in one or more functional areas:
  
- Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
  
  
- Sales Planning
  
  
- Supply Chain Planning (S&OP)
  
  
  
- Demonstrated experience with full implementation lifecycle (requirements, design, build, test, deploy), preferably using Agile methodologies
  
  
- Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling skills
  
  
- Strong understanding of data integration concepts and tools
  
  
- Ability to decompose complex business, financial, and technical concepts into scalable solutions
  
  
- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and lead team members effectively
  
  
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  
  
- Passion for business analytics, modeling, and planning
  
  
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  
  
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
  
  
- Eagerness to mentor and develop staff
  
  
- Alignment with Peloton values: Amplify Ideas, Can-Do Attitude, Teamwork, Integrity, Own Your Voice, and Next-Level Service
  
- Willingness to travel as required
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
- Anaplan certifications (e.g., Certified Model Builder, Solution Architect, Master Anaplanner)
  
- Experience integrating Anaplan with ERP systems (e.g., Oracle, SAP) or data platforms
  
- Experience with enterprise planning transformations across Finance and/or Supply Chain
  
- Experience contributing to pre-sales, proposals, and practice development initiatives
  
  
Compensation:
  
Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including

• Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
  
• Annual Health Wallet
  
• Group Medical Insurance
  
• Group Term Accident & Life Insurance

Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Senior Technical Consultant: Salesforce(Automotive Experience)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Executive Summary & Organizational Context**
Within Salesforce Professional Services, the Senior Technical Consultant — Automotive Cloud role occupies a vital strategic position at the bleeding edge of AI CRM and automotive industry digital transformation. As automotive enterprises navigate sweeping market disruptions—from electric vehicle transitions and direct-to-consumer sales models to connected vehicle telemetry and autonomous fleets—this role serves as the bridge between pioneering platform capabilities and real-world enterprise execution.
  
  
Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.
  
  

* Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes. Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
* Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies.

**Core Automotive Domain Implementation**
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:
  
  

* Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
* Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
* Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
* Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
* Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.

**AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing**

* Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
* Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.

**Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship**

* Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
* Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
* Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.

Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.
  
  

* Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
* Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
* Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
* Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
* Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
* Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
* Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct engagement experience on Salesforce Automotive Cloud implementations, with deep operational mastery of the Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, or Fleet Management modules.
* Hands-on experience with connected vehicle platforms, IoT edge device integrations, or real-time telematics data ingestion into the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to build real-time, unified customer and vehicle data profiles that power personalized experiences.
* Practical exposure to cutting-edge Agentforce implementations within automotive contexts, such as AI-driven service advisors, dealer-facing conversational chatbots, and predictive maintenance agents.
* Direct experience consulting with OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, or dealership groups at enterprise scale.
* Existing Salesforce Industry Cloud accreditations or certifications in Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or adjacent vertical solutions.

While these baseline and preferred qualifications establish a candidate's operational readiness, long-term success in the practice requires continuous technical credentialing and structured platform upskilling.
  
  

* Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning Maintaining technical mastery within the rapidly evolving Agentforce ecosystem requires an unyielding commitment to continuous learning and formal platform credentialing. Salesforce Professional Services invests heavily in continuous talent development to ensure consultants remain ahead of platform innovation curves.

**Target Certification Requirements**
Candidates are expected to formally achieve the following five Salesforce certifications within their first 3 months in the role:
  
  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect

*Note: Holding any of the above Salesforce credentials prior to onboarding is considered highly beneficial and serves as a primary key differentiator during the candidate evaluation and selection process.*
Beyond technical certifications and architectural expertise, sustained consulting excellence in high-stakes enterprise environments depends on core leadership behaviors and alignment with corporate values.
  
  

* Leadership Qualities & Core Values To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Senior Technical Consultant must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust. Core Leadership Pillars
* PASSION: Demonstrates an unyielding commitment to Customer Success. The consultant exhibits deep personal investment in seeing automotive clients succeed, transforming complex technology implementations into tangible market wins and measurable business outcomes for OEM stakeholders and dealer networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Maintains a continuous learning mindset. The consultant approaches every complex enterprise engagement, client interaction, and architectural challenge with humbleness, curiosity, and openness—actively dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in automotive technology and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives amidst high levels of uncertainty and rapid industry transformation. Recognizing that structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption are permanent constants in the automotive sector, the consultant remains poised, agile, and decisive when navigating ambiguous project environments.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The company is a growing organization seeking to strengthen its presence in the events and hospitality market in Hyderabad. It focuses on delivering well-organized, memorable events for a variety of clients, including corporate groups and private parties. Team members collaborate across functions to provide high-quality service, efficient operations, and strong client relationships. The work environment encourages initiative, professional development, and accountability. Joining the team offers the opportunity to shape event experiences and contribute to business growth.
  
**Role Description**
The Event Sales Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for driving event revenue and managing client relationships. Day-to-day tasks include prospecting and qualifying leads, conducting client meetings, preparing proposals, and negotiating contracts for corporate and private events. The role involves coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth event planning and execution, maintaining accurate sales forecasts, and tracking performance against targets. The Event Sales Manager will also develop sales strategies for key market segments, represent the company at networking events, and provide post-event follow-up to foster repeat and referral business. Consistent collaboration, attention to detail, and a focus on client satisfaction are core to this position.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Event Planning and Event Management skills to oversee end-to-end event coordination.
* Candidates should possess effective Sales skills to generate leads, convert opportunities, and meet revenue targets.
* Candidates should possess clear and professional Communication skills for client interactions and internal collaboration.
* Candidates should possess experience managing Private Events, including social gatherings, celebrations, and bespoke functions.
* Candidates should have proven ability to work on-site in a fast-paced environment, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Candidates should have experience using CRM or sales management tools, and proficiency with common office software.
* Candidates should ideally have prior experience in events, hospitality, or related industries; a bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality management, or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates should demonstrate a client-focused mindset, negotiation abilities, and flexibility to work evenings or weekends as needed for events.

title: Manager - Business Development
description:
**Job Title:**
Business Manager / Business Head – Implen Nanophotometers Business
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad / Delhi
  
  
**Company:**
Inkarp Instruments Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
**Experience Required:**
8–10 Years
  
  
**Department:**
Sales
  
  
**Job Summary**
Inkarp Instruments Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Business Manager / Business Head exclusively for the Implen Nanophotometers business**
to drive business growth, market expansion, and commercial performance in India. The ideal candidate should possess strong experience in scientific and analytical instrumentation, strategic business development, distributor network management, revenue planning, and commercial operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement business plans and market-entry strategies to expand the Implen Nanophotometers business across India.
* Identify new business opportunities, target markets, and potential customer segments to drive business growth.
* Build, develop, and manage a strong distribution network and channel partner ecosystem across the country.
* Establish annual sales targets, revenue forecasts, profitability goals, and business growth objectives.
* Develop and execute effective sales and business development strategies to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
* Manage pricing strategies, profit margins, commercial negotiations, and overall business economics.
* Drive customer acquisition and develop strategic relationships with pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, research institutions, universities, and other relevant industries.
* Plan and execute marketing initiatives, product promotions, seminars, exhibitions, conferences, and customer engagement programs.
* Coordinate with Implen and internal stakeholders to align business strategies, product positioning, sales targets, and market-development initiatives.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer requirements, and emerging opportunities within the scientific and analytical instrumentation industry.
* Identify and develop key accounts, strategic partnerships, and new distribution opportunities to increase market penetration.
* Track sales performance, business profitability, distributor productivity, and pipeline development against established targets.
* Prepare regular business reports, sales forecasts, market assessments, and performance reviews for management.
* Take complete ownership of the commercial performance, strategic direction, and long-term growth of the Implen Nanophotometers business.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong strategic business planning and business development skills.
* Good understanding of scientific and analytical instrumentation and laboratory solutions.
* Proven ability to develop market-entry strategies and expand business operations.
* Strong distributor network development and channel management capabilities.
* Excellent commercial acumen, including pricing, margin management, revenue forecasting, and profitability planning.
* Strong customer acquisition, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to identify new markets, develop strategic accounts, and generate sustainable business growth.
* Excellent communication, presentation, leadership, and decision-making skills.
* Strong analytical thinking, market assessment, and business performance management abilities.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business objectives.
* Willingness to travel across India for business development, customer meetings, and distributor management.

**Preferred Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, Physics, Instrumentation, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* An MBA in Marketing, Sales, or Business Management will be an added advantage.
* 8–10 years of relevant experience in sales, business development, product management, or business leadership within the scientific and analytical instrumentation industry.
* Experience in analytical instruments, laboratory equipment, spectroscopy, UV-Vis spectrophotometry, or related technologies will be preferred.
* Proven experience in managing distributor networks, channel partnerships, and market expansion initiatives.
* Experience in developing business strategies, managing revenue targets, and improving business profitability.
* Candidates with prior experience managing a product portfolio, business unit, or distribution-led business will be preferred.
* Experience handling pharmaceutical, biotechnology, research, academic, industrial, and government customers will be an added advantage.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Best in the industry.
* Career growth opportunities with the opportunity to lead and expand a dedicated business vertical.
* Opportunity to represent and develop the market for Implen Nanophotometers, a specialized scientific instrumentation product line.
* Performance-based incentives, subject to company policy.
* Travel reimbursement, mobile and data allowance, mediclaim cover, and applicable statutory benefits.

**To Apply:**
Please send your CV to
**recruit@inkarp.co.in**
.

title: Business Development Manager - Interior Designers & Architects
description:
**Candidates from Luxury background may only apply**

**Organization Description:**
Jaipur Rugs is a social enterprise that connects rural craftsmanship with global markets through its luxurious handmade carpets. It is a family-run business that offers an exclusive range of hand-knotted and hand-woven rugs made using 2500 years old traditional art forms. The founder, Mr. Nand Kishore Chaudhary created a unique business model, which provides livelihood to the artisans at their doorstep. This changed the standard practice of involving middlemen to work with artisanal communities. The company currently has a network of over 40,000 artisans spread across 600 rural Indian villages in five states of India. It has an end-to-end business model, right from sourcing of wool to exporting a finished handmade rug.

The modern and eclectic collection of rugs, made using the finest wool and silk, has won numerous global awards and is currently exported to more than 45 countries with the US sales arm, Jaipur Living, Inc. located in Georgia, Atlanta.

**Job Description:**
The specific responsibilities of the position holder will

description:
**Experience:**

2–5 years |

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**tech-oriented business operator**

to work closely with the Founder’s Office across
**strategy, product, GTM, growth, fundraising, and business operations**

.

The ideal candidate comes from a
**technology/product/engineering background**

but has developed a strong understanding of
**business, GTM, growth, and commercial decision-making**

.

This is not a role for someone who simply executes tasks. We are looking for someone who can
**think independently, challenge assumptions, form a point of view, and turn ambiguous problems into actionable solutions.**

**What You'll Do**

* Work with leadership on
  **strategy, business planning, and high-priority initiatives**

  .
* Conduct
  **market, competitor, customer, and industry research**

  and develop clear recommendations.
* Build
  **GTM strategies, market-entry plans, pricing analyses, and business cases**

  .
* Support
  **fundraising**

  through investor decks, market sizing, business narratives, and strategic theses.
* Create
  **strategy decks, investor presentations, pitch decks, and leadership presentations**

  .
* Work closely with Product and Technology to translate
  **technical capabilities into business and customer value**

  .
* Support
  **product positioning, launches, growth, SEO, content, and digital marketing initiatives**

  .
* Analyse
  **revenue, pipeline, CAC, LTV, retention, conversion, and growth metrics**

  .
* Build prototypes, dashboards, workflows, and internal tools using
  **AI-assisted development / vibe coding**

  where useful.
* Identify
  **partnerships, strategic opportunities, and new business avenues**

  .
* Build processes and SOPs where the business needs structure.

**What We're Looking For**

* **2–5 years of experience**

  , preferably from a
  **technology, product, engineering, analytics, or technical consulting background**

  .
* Strong understanding of
  **business, GTM, growth, and product thinking**

  .
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Ability to work with
  **data, technology, and business problems simultaneously**

  .
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Comfortable creating
  **decks, business cases, market analyses, and strategic recommendations**

  .
* Working knowledge of
  **SEO, digital marketing, SaaS metrics, and growth**

  .
* Comfortable experimenting with
  **AI tools and vibe coding**

  .

**More Important Than Any Tool**

We are
**not hiring someone because they know Claude, ChatGPT, or vibe coding.**

These are tools that anyone can learn.

What matters is whether you can
**use your judgement**

:

* Can you identify the right problem?
* Can you ask the right questions?
* Can you distinguish a good idea from a bad one?
* Can you look at data and form a point of view?
* Can you understand both the
  **technology and the business impact**

  ?
* Can you challenge the founder when you disagree?
* Can you take an ambiguous problem and figure out what needs to happen next?

**We are looking for someone who uses AI to amplify their thinking — not someone who uses AI instead of thinking.**

title: Solutions Architect, ISV
description: DescriptionAWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.Key job responsibilitiesThis role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).A day in the lifeThe Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.About The TeamISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.Basic Qualifications Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecturePreferred Qualifications Knowledge of AWS services Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences 4+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technologyOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Account Manager, HPOP & MA India
description:
**Job Description – Account Manager, HP Organic Peroxides & Metal Alkyls (India)**
At
**Nouryon**
, our global team takes positive action every day to reach higher goals collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society's needs today and in the future.
  
  
We are looking for an
**Account Manager, HP Organic Peroxides & Metal Alkyls (India)**
who can drive profitable sales growth, strengthen strategic customer relationships, identify new business opportunities, and expand Nouryon's market presence across the Polymer Specialties business in the Indian Subcontinent. This position will focus on Organic Peroxides and Metal Alkyls applications within Polyolefins, PVC, Styrenics, Recycling, Pharma, and other allied industries.
  
**In your future role as Account Manager, you will:**

* Drive sales and business development activities for Organic Peroxides and Metal Alkyls across the Indian Subcontinent.
* Support the achievement and growth of Net Sales in line with agreed budgets and strategic objectives.
* Develop new business opportunities and expand Nouryon's presence in Polyolefins, PVC, Styrenics, Recycling, Pharma, and related market segments.
* Build, maintain, and grow long-term relationships with key accounts through a structured Key Account Management approach.
* Lead commercial discussions including pricing, contract negotiations, claims management, and customer agreements.
* Develop and execute customer-specific value propositions to strengthen market position and customer loyalty.
* Monitor market trends, competitive activities, emerging sectors, and new plant capacities to identify growth opportunities.
* Conduct customer visits, maintain CRM records, and ensure timely reporting of business activities and opportunities.
* Provide technical, application, and Health, Safety & Environment support to customers in collaboration with internal teams.
* Work closely with Supply Chain, Integrated Business Planning, Operations, Technical Service, Regulatory, and Business Management teams to ensure product availability and on-time delivery.
* Prepare annual budgets, demand forecasts, and quarterly business plans for assigned accounts.
* Analyze profitability drivers including product mix, contribution margins, and distribution costs to improve business performance.
* Leverage Artificial Intelligence tools to improve sales productivity, forecasting accuracy, market intelligence gathering, and reporting.
* Prepare business reports, market analyses, and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
* Ensure compliance with Nouryon policies, competition laws, corporate directives, and the Nouryon Code of Conduct.
* Represent Nouryon through engagement with industry associations, regulatory authorities, and professional organizations where required.

**Great if you have**

* Strong understanding of Polymer Specialties applications, particularly Organic Peroxides and Metal Alkyls.
* Knowledge of Polyolefins, PVC, Styrenics, Recycling, Pharma, and related industries.
* Experience in Key Account Management, business development, and commercial negotiations.
* Exposure to new product development processes and technical customer support.
* Strong analytical capabilities to interpret market trends and business intelligence.
* Experience working in a matrix and international business environment.
* Ability to leverage CRM systems, forecasting tools, and Artificial Intelligence technologies to drive business outcomes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills.

**We believe you are...**

* Customer-focused and commercially driven.
* Results-oriented with a proactive growth mindset.
* Strong in relationship building and stakeholder management.
* Analytical and capable of translating market insights into business opportunities.
* Self-motivated, energetic, and enthusiastic.
* A collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal and cross-cultural skills.
* Comfortable working independently while managing multiple priorities.

**We believe you bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Polymer Science, or related technical discipline.
* Minimum 5-10 years of experience in the polymer industry with a techno-commercial background.
* Experience within PVC, Polyolefins, Styrenics, Recycling, or similar specialty chemical industries.
* Understanding of Organic Peroxides and Metal Alkyls applications and their end-use markets.
* Experience interacting with customers at mid to senior management levels.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, cross-functional, and international environment.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India (approximately 50%).

**We offer you**
At Nouryon, we not only offer an exciting role and great colleagues, but also benefits in addition to your salary.
  
  
Are you passionate about innovation, sustainability, customer success, and collaboration? Do you want to grow together with a company that is forward-looking and continuously improving how it works? At Nouryon, we support your personal growth through challenging positions, broad market exposure, and comprehensive learning and development opportunities in a dynamic, international, and diverse working environment.
  
**Good to know**
This is a permanent full-time position based in
**Mumbai, India**
, supporting the
**Polymer Specialties - Organic Peroxides & Metal Alkyls business**
across the Indian Subcontinent. The role reports to the
**Account Manager, HP Organic Peroxides & Metal Alkyls (ISB)**
and requires regular domestic travel to support customers, key accounts, and business development activities.
  
  
Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit:
**nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/**
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Saraswati Global Rugs is an Indian rug atelier rooted in generations of weaving expertise and a commitment to material integrity. The company works across hand knotted, hand tufted, and flat weave techniques to create rugs that balance cultural heritage with contemporary architectural requirements. Each rug is developed through careful material selection, iterative sampling, and close collaboration with artisan communities. Saraswati Global Rugs partners with architects, interior designers, and private clients to translate spatial concepts into tactile surfaces that quietly support and define interiors. The brand’s rugs are conceived as enduring foundational layers, designed to age gracefully and remain relevant over time.

**Role Description**
The Business Development Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai. This role is responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities with architects, interior designers, and private clients, as well as nurturing existing relationships to drive sustained sales growth. Daily tasks include prospecting and lead generation, conducting client meetings and presentations, preparing proposals and quotations, and managing the sales pipeline from initial contact to closing. The Business Development Manager collaborates closely with design and production teams to align client requirements with feasible product solutions, monitors market trends and competitor activity, and contributes to pricing, positioning, and go-to-market strategies. The role also involves attending industry events, maintaining accurate sales reporting, and supporting brand visibility through targeted outreach and networking.

* Strong relationship-building and client management capabilities, ideally with
  **architects, interior designers, or luxury/home décor customers.**
* Solid communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, including the ability to translate design and technical details into clear value propositions.
* Ability to conduct market research, analyze trends, and develop strategic plans to expand market presence and achieve sales targets.
* Comfort working closely with cross-functional teams such as design, production, and logistics to ensure timely and accurate order fulfillment.
* High level of self-organization, time management, and accountability, with the ability to work independently on-site in Mumbai.
* Prior experience in textiles, rugs, interior products, or premium/luxury goods is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Design Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Proficiency with CRM tools and basic office software (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations) to manage pipeline and reporting.

title: Clinical Sales Specialist– Novocastra, Mumbai
description:
**Bring more to life.**
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next-generation, life-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact.
  
  
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
  
  
The
***Clinical Sales Specialist– Novocastra***
is responsible for driving commercial growth, expanding market presence, and strengthening customer partnerships across the assigned territory. This role will focus on building a strong sales funnel, increasing market share, and leading strategic engagements with key accounts and stakeholders.
  
  
This position reports to the
**Strategic Growth Manager, India**
and is part of the
**Sales/Commercial organization**
located in
**Mumbai**
and will be fully remote.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Own and achieve assigned Novocastra sales targets and business objectives by developing and executing territory growth plans, identifying and converting sales opportunities, and increasing market penetration and revenue.
* Build and maintain a robust sales funnel, ensure accurate opportunity tracking through CRM systems, and conduct competitive analysis and market-intelligence activities to identify growth opportunities and support strategic business decisions.
* Provide technical expertise, application support, troubleshooting, product optimization, and customer training related to Novocastra antibodies and Leica Biosystems consumables across the IVD and RUO portfolios during pre-sales and post-sales activities.
* Lead Proof of Principle activities, including product evaluations, sampling programs, demonstrations, and customer validations, in collaboration with regional sales teams and channel partners.
* Build trusted relationships with pathologists, laboratory managers, researchers, procurement teams, and key opinion leaders; collaborate with Sales, Marketing, channel partners, and regional and global application teams to conduct workshops, scientific meetings, seminars, exhibitions, demonstrations, and customer-education programs; and submit monthly activity and business-outcome reports.

**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pathology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum three years of relevant experience in Histopathology, Immunohistochemistry, Pathology Applications, Clinical Diagnostics, Diagnostic Sales, or a related field.
* Demonstrated knowledge of pathology workflows, antibody-based assays, immunohistochemistry, and related diagnostic applications.
* Experience providing customer-facing technical or application support, including troubleshooting, product demonstrations, customer training, or scientific consultation.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and CRM tools, along with professional proficiency in English and relevant local language(s).

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements**

* Ability and willingness to travel 60–80% within the assigned region and other geographies as business needs require, including regular customer visits, demonstrations, training sessions, conferences, and field-based commercial activities.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Pathology laboratories, cancer diagnostics, immunohistochemistry reagents, or companion diagnostics.
* A customer-facing application specialist, product specialist, clinical sales specialist, or technical sales role within the diagnostics industry.
* Distributor or channel-partner management and territory development.

**Success In This Role Will Be Measured By**

* Achievement of assigned Novocastra sales targets and territory business objectives.
* Growth in the qualified opportunity pipeline, conversion rate, territory revenue, market penetration, and market share.
* Successful and timely execution of Proof of Principle activities, product evaluations, demonstrations, and customer validations.
* Customer satisfaction, retention, and adoption and utilization of Novocastra products.
* Effective collaboration with Sales, Marketing, regional and global application teams, and channel partners.

Leica Biosystems, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.
  
  
Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
  
  
For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Finishing Engineer
description:
**Pay:** ₹50,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

**Job Description – Finishing Engineer**

Location: Mumbai, Santacruz

Department: Projects / Construction

Industry: Real Estate – High-Rise Residential Development

Experience: 10 -12 Years in Finishing

working for Luxurious Residential projects

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Objective

We are looking for an experienced Finishing Engineer to manage and execute finishing works for premium high-rise residential projects in Mumbai.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring superior workmanship, adherence to drawings and specifications, timely completion, coordination between multiple agencies, systematic snagging and possession-ready delivery of apartments and common areas.

The role requires strong on-site execution capabilities and a keen eye for finishing quality and detailing.

Key Responsibilities

1. Finishing Works Execution

\* Plan, supervise and execute all internal and external finishing activities.

\* Manage works including:

\* Blockwork and internal plaster

\* Waterproofing

\* Screeding and flooring

\* Marble, granite and tile works

\* Gypsum/plaster and false ceilings

\* Internal and external painting

\* Doors, frames and hardware

\* Aluminium/windows and glazing

\* Railings and metal works

\* Sanitary and CP fittings

\* Kitchen and utility finishes

\* Carpentry and joinery

\* Façade finishing interfaces

\* Common areas, lift lobbies and staircases

\* Entrance lobby and other premium finishes

\* External development and landscape interfaces

2. Quality Control

\* Ensure finishing works are executed strictly as per approved drawings, specifications, material approvals and established quality standards.

\* Inspect workmanship at every stage instead of identifying defects only at completion.

\* Check line, level, plumb, alignment, joints, slopes, surface finish, shade variations and overall aesthetics.

\* Ensure proper protection of completed finishes to prevent damage by subsequent agencies.

\* Establish and maintain benchmark/mock-up standards before commencement of repetitive finishing works.

\* Identify defective workmanship and ensure timely rectification.

3. MEP & Services Coordination

\* Coordinate finishing works with electrical, plumbing, fire-fighting, HVAC, ELV and other service contractors.

\* Ensure all concealed services are inspected and approved before closing walls, ceilings, shafts or flooring.

\* Prevent rework arising from improper coordination between civil, finishing and MEP agencies.

4. Planning & Contractor Management

\* Prepare floor-wise and activity-wise finishing schedules in line with the overall project programme.

\* Monitor daily and weekly progress against targets.

\* Coordinate multiple contractors and vendors to maintain proper work sequence.

\* Assess manpower and material requirements in advance to avoid delays.

\* Conduct regular site coordination meetings and follow up on pending activities.

\* Verify contractor work quantities and assist in certification of bills where required.

5. Drawings & Technical Coordination

\* Study and implement architectural, interior, structural and MEP drawings.

\* Identify drawing discrepancies and constructability issues before execution.

\* Coordinate with architects, consultants and the project team for RFIs and technical clarifications.

\* Ensure only the latest approved drawings are being followed at site.

6. Snagging & Possession Readiness

\* Conduct systematic apartment-wise, floor-wise and common-area snagging.

\* Maintain snag lists with clear responsibility and closure timelines.

\* Carry out pre-handover inspections before units are offered for customer inspection.

\* Coordinate with CRM/Post-Sales teams for customer inspections and possession.

\* Ensure customer snags are attended to promptly and closed to the required quality standard.

\* Ensure flats are thoroughly checked, cleaned, functional and possession-ready before handover.

7. Material Management

\* Check incoming finishing materials for approved make, specification, shade and quality.

\* Monitor material consumption and minimise wastage.

\* Ensure appropriate storage and protection of high-value finishing materials.

\* Coordinate material requirements and delivery schedules with Procurement.

8. Documentation & Reporting

Maintain proper records of:

\* Daily progress

\* Quality inspections

\* Material approvals

\* Mock-up approvals

\* RFIs and drawing revisions

\* Snagging and closure status

\* Contractor performance

\* Floor-wise completion status

Provide regular progress and quality reports to the Project Manager/Management.

Candidate Profile

\* B.E./B.Tech Civil or Diploma in Civil Engineering

\* 10 + years of relevant experience, preferably with reputed developers or contractors executing high-rise residential projects in Mumbai.

\* Strong hands-on experience in premium residential finishing works.

\* Should have independently handled finishing of multiple floors/apartments through final possession.

\* Good understanding of architectural drawings, finishing details and MEP interfaces.

\* Strong knowledge of finishing materials, installation methodology and quality standards.

\* Ability to manage multiple contractors and large site teams.

\* Strong problem-solving and coordination abilities.

\* Extremely detail-oriented with a strong eye for workmanship, alignment, aesthetics and final presentation.

Preferred Experience

Preference will be given to candidates who have:

\* Worked on premium/luxury high-rise residential buildings

\* Managed finishing from bare shell through possession

\* Experience with sample/mock-up flats

\* Managed apartment and common-area snagging

\* Coordinated directly with architects and interior designers

\* Experience in customer handover and possession

\* Delivered projects with high-quality marble, stone, façade, lobby and interior finishes

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will primarily be measured on:

\* Finishing quality and workmanship

\* Floor-wise completion against schedule

\* Number of snags at internal inspection

\* Customer snags at possession

\* Snag closure turnaround time

\* Rework and material wastage

\* Contractor productivity

\* Protection of completed works

\* Readiness of apartments for possession

\* Quality of common areas and final project presentation

Key Requirements:

\* Strong experience in high-rise residential finishing

\* Expertise in flooring, marble/tiles, painting, gypsum, doors/windows, sanitary fittings & common-area finishes

\* Strong Civil–MEP coordination

\* Contractor & floor-wise execution management

\* Excellent eye for quality and detailing

\* Experience in snagging, possession readiness & customer handover

\* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Civil Engineering

Candidates who have independently handled finishing from civil completion to possession will be preferred.

Benefits:

· Paid sick time

· Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

· How many years experience you have in Finishing?

· Where do you stay?

· What is your notice period?

· What is your current Salary?

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You are a DDR/LPDDR Controller System Architecture Specialist who can work directly with customer architects to close real system-level memory subsystem design decisions.
  
  
You are comfortable discussing SoC integration, memory subsystem architecture, controller configuration, performance optimization, power management, validation, and interoperability topics. You can help customers evaluate technical trade-offs and guide them toward practical architecture decisions.
  
  
This is a customer-facing technical role. You will help customers integrate DDR/LPDDR controller IP into complex SoCs, identify key requirements or gaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable input for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Own the technical architecture engagement for DDR/LPDDR controller IP with strategic customers, from early platform requirements through architecture closure and initial deployment readiness.
* Work with customer architects and engineering teams to define suitable DDR/LPDDR memory subsystem configurations for advanced SoC platforms.
* Analyze system-level trade-offs related to memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and scalability.
* Translate customer platform requirements and integration constraints into clear feedback for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
* Support technical closure of design wins by providing architecture guidance, configuration recommendations and competitive positioning.
* Develop reusable technical material, application notes, and customer-facing guidance based on real engagement experience.
* Train FAEs and customer teams on DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem integration, performance tuning, validation expectations, and deployment best practices.

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Improve the quality of DDR/LPDDR design wins by ensuring customer memory architectures are technically sound before commitment.
* Strengthen Synopsys DDR/LPDDR roadmap by feeding real customer memory subsystem requirements into product planning and R&D execution.
* Reduce customer integration risk by identifying architecture, performance, power, validation, and bring-up issues early.
* Help establish Synopsys as a trusted technical partner for next-generation AI, HPC, mobile, automotive, networking, and edge computing platforms.

What You’ll Need
  
  

* Bachelors and/or Masters Degree in Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
* 5+ years of experience in DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem design, SoC integration, silicon validation, systems engineering, applications engineering, or customer-facing technical leadership.
* Solid understanding of DDR and/or LPDDR controller IP, including memory architecture concepts, controller configuration, scheduling, quality of service, power management, training, validation, or system integration.
* Good system-level understanding of SoC integration and ability to reason through memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and software/firmware trade-offs.
* Experience engaging directly with customer architects, design teams, validation teams, and technical decision-makers.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical recommendations, product feedback, and closure plans.
* Strong technical communication skills, including clear written analysis, structured trade-off explanation, and ability to align customer, sales, product, and engineering teams.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Linux, firmware bring-up, or software-driven debug of DDR/LPDDR subsystems.
* Familiarity with advanced SoC architectures used in AI, HPC, automotive, mobile, networking, or compute platforms.
* Experience with memory performance analysis, traffic modeling, quality-of-service management, memory hierarchy optimization, or system-level benchmarking.
* Knowledge of advanced topics such as DDR5, LPDDR5X, LPDDR6, memory training algorithms, RAS features, chiplet-based memory architectures, or AI memory bandwidth optimization.

The Team You’ll be a Part Of
  
  
You will be part of our IP high-performance computing applications engineering team, a group of dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology and innovation. The team focuses on helping customers integrate more capabilities into SoCs faster, working collaboratively across geographic and organizational boundaries to drive revenue growth and accelerate business closure.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
Inclusion and Diversity
  
  
Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:

You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.

Utilize Relevant AI Tools Across All Tasks And Deliverable Creation, Including The Creation Of Agents And Other Tools To Help Facilitate
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.

The company is known for innovative offerings, including India’s first over-the-counter health and home insurance policies. With more than 200 offices across 173 cities in 22 states, it provides a strong on-ground presence, wide distribution channels, and 24x7 customer service support. Reliance General Insurance was the first insurer in India to receive ISO 9001:2000 certification across all functions, processes, products, and locations. Its e-commerce platform enables customers to buy policies easily via the website or telephone/mobile, reflecting a strong commitment to digital convenience and customer experience.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Insurance Agent role based in Kolkata. The Insurance Agent will identify prospective clients, explain general insurance products, and recommend suitable coverage options tailored to customer needs. Daily responsibilities include generating leads, conducting consultations, preparing quotations, and assisting customers with policy issuance, renewals, endorsements, and claims support. The role involves maintaining accurate records of client interactions, complying with regulatory and company policies, and collaborating with internal teams and distribution partners to achieve sales targets. The Insurance Agent is expected to provide high-quality customer service, build long-term relationships, and contribute to overall business growth in the Kolkata region.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Insurance Sales and Insurance to effectively promote and explain general insurance products.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Insurance Brokerage and related industry practices to manage policy placement and client advisory services.
* Candidates should possess a good understanding of Finance to interpret premium structures, coverage terms, and basic risk assessment.
* Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service skills to handle queries, resolve issues, and maintain long-term client relationships.
* Relevant experience in general insurance or financial services, preferably in sales or client-facing roles.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Ability to work with targets, manage time effectively, and maintain detailed documentation and reports.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in any discipline; professional insurance certifications are an advantage.

title: Manager Purchase
description:
Position Summary
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Management & Strategic Sourcing
* Lead end-to-end category management and strategic procurement for capital equipment (Greenfield & Rebuild projects), MRO, and spare parts categories.
* Own the complete equipment build cycle: source individual parts, sub-assemblies, and heavy components from a global and domestic supplier base, coordinate inbound logistics, and support in-house assembly and trial runs.
* Prepare component-level budgets for new products, conduct comprehensive market and industry research to inform category strategies, and collaborate with business area stakeholders for project estimation and cost modelling.
* Establish and maintain framework agreements, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), price benchmarking tools, and should-cost models for diverse equipment and spare parts.
* Supplier Development, De-risking & Cost Optimization
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic suppliers; assess and enhance existing supplier capacities across Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QDC) parameters.
* Drive cost-saving initiatives through competitive tendering, strategic bundling, group purchasing volumes, and alternative supplier development (e.g., building robust local/national models to mitigate foreign supply chain dependencies).
* Perform sub-assembly level risk assessments before ordering, develop secondary/alternative sources to de-risks supply chains, and maintain production continuity.
* Act as the primary commercial point of contact for key partners, managing supplier performance evaluations and sharing insights transparently across internal engineering, production, and quality teams.
* Cross-functional Collaboration & Quality Compliance
* Partner closely with design, production, and quality assurance teams during assembly and trial phases to resolve part deviations, manage supplier claims, and ensure strict technical conformity.
* Ensure full compliance with corporate sourcing policies, internal approval workflows, ISO standards, and corporate procurement audits.
* Drive internal restructuring initiatives to optimize procurement performance, fostering clear accountability across specialized purchase, sourcing, and supply chain verticals.
* Digital Transformation & Systems Excellence
* Leverage advanced procurement tools—specifically SAP HANA (MM & SH modules) and JAGGAER (RFX, Auctions, SRM, Supplier Evaluation, and Spend Analytics)—to drive process transparency and data integrity.
* Manage vendor onboarding onto digital platforms, facilitating EDI-based data exchange, order confirmation, and digital offer submissions.
* Train cross-functional teams (Purchase, Quality, and Shipping) and external suppliers on digital procurement modules to enhance department-wide response efficiency and reporting accuracy.
