title: Partnerships & Activations Lead
description:
**Job Title: Partnerships & Activations Lead**

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, work from office, with local travel

**Preferred Experience:**
3–5 years in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, brand activations or business development

**About Sevora**

Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery in eligible locations. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a relationship-driven professional to build partnerships and deliver community activations that generate qualified leads, shopping appointments and sales.

You will develop a network across Kolkata’s residential communities, clubs, private social groups and complementary businesses. Working closely with Sales and the Personal Shopper, you will own partner acquisition, activation planning, execution, lead quality and cost efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partnerships & Community Development**

* Build relationships with community hosts, residential associations, premium clubs, women’s groups and event organisers.
* Establish referral partnerships with salons, beauty studios, wedding planners, makeup artists and complementary lifestyle businesses.
* Develop partnership proposals and negotiate participation fees, promotional support, collaboration terms and referral arrangements.
* Maintain an active partner pipeline and monthly activation calendar.
* Develop productive partnerships into recurring shopping events and referral opportunities.

**2. Lead Generation & Appointment Booking**

* Deliver monthly targets for qualified customer leads and shopping appointments.
* Generate enquiries through kitty parties, private gatherings, residential communities, clubs, curated exhibitions, professional networks and referrals.
* Prepare channel plans with target audiences, activities, budgets and expected outcomes.
* Capture shopping preferences, budget, occasion, buying timeline and location to support lead qualification.
* Develop customer and community-host referral programmes with approved incentives and clear tracking.

**3. Activations & Event Execution**

* Plan and execute private shopping sessions, styling events, collection previews, pop-ups and community activations.
* Evaluate opportunities based on audience fit, purchase intent, participation costs and sales potential.
* Own event logistics, including permissions, venue arrangements, setup, displays, staffing coordination and partner communication.
* Coordinate invitations, lookbooks, QR codes, registration forms and promotional materials with Marketing and Creative teams.
* Coordinate assortment, stock availability, product movement and reconciliation with Merchandising and Operations.
* Work with Sales and the Personal Shopper to deliver shopping assistance and introduce eligible customers to Try at Home.
* Manage approved budgets and maintain records of expenses and partner commitments.

**4. Lead Handover & Sales Coordination**

* Capture accurate customer details and permission for follow-up.
* Record lead source, preferences, interest level and next action in the CRM.
* Hand over leads promptly to Sales with clear ownership and follow-up expectations.
* Review appointment attendance, follow-up progress, purchases and reasons for lost sales.
* Coordinate post-event follow-ups with Sales and retention campaigns with CRM.
* Use customer and sales feedback to improve future activations.

**5. Performance & Reporting**

* Report weekly on partner outreach, confirmed activities, qualified leads, appointments, costs and attributable sales.
* Track performance by partner, event and referral source using CRM tags, QR links or referral codes.
* Monitor cost per qualified lead, cost per purchasing customer and sales after cancellations and returns.
* Assess activation profitability with Finance using product margins and relevant costs.
* Recommend which partnerships and activities to expand, improve or discontinue.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Relevant experience in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, activations or business development.
* Strong networking, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills.
* Experience generating customer leads and delivering measurable commercial outcomes.
* Ability to manage activities independently, from outreach and planning to execution and reporting.
* Understanding of budgets, lead qualification, conversion and customer acquisition costs.
* Clear communication in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, presentations, WhatsApp Business and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled evening or weekend events.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in fashion, premium retail, beauty, hospitality or lifestyle services. Existing relationships with Kolkata communities, clubs, residential associations and relevant businesses will be an advantage.

title: Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description:
Customer Care Transformation Consultant

**Engagement:**
 Monthly contract. Full-time on the client through diagnostics, then a delivery role as the program moves into training and monitoring.

About the role
  

OriginBluy is running a Customer Care Gold Standard program for a large utility that serves more than 23 lakh households through 60+ walk-in service centres and an inbound call centre.

The consultant is our person on the ground: they diagnose how service works today, help define the Gold Standard, and stay through training and monitoring until the client’s own managers can hold the standard.

They report to the Principal Coach and work directly with the client’s customer care leadership, centre managers and call centre teams.

What you’ll do

**Diagnose**

* Run mystery shopping at walk-in centres: brief and calibrate the shoppers, score visits and consolidate the findings
* Select and listen to recorded calls with a focus on outliers (best, worst, repeat and escalated calls) and find the root cause of each: behaviour, process, system or policy
* Interview centre managers, call centre team leads and functional heads
* Pull together existing SOPs, scripts, QA formats and MIS into one baseline

**Define**

* Map the end-to-end customer journey for the top contact reasons, both walk-in and call
* Draft the Gold Standard: interaction standards, scripts, SOPs, escalation paths and the scorecard
* Build the cost-benefit case with client Finance: contact volumes, repeat rates, cost per contact
* Run dry runs of the new standard with a pilot group and refine it

**Deliver and sustain**

* Co-deliver CSE and manager workshops with the trainer
* Administer the Ready-for-floor certification test
* Run post-training mystery shopping and call audits, produce centre-wise scores and prepare packs for leadership reviews
* Coach centre managers and TLs to observe, score and coach against the standard

What you bring

**Must have**

* **10–15 years in customer service operations**
  , including all three of the following:
* **Inbound call centre:**
   managed or ran operations or quality for an inbound voice operation, ideally 50+ seats. Hands-on with call quality monitoring, AHT, first-contact resolution, CSAT and repeat-call analysis.
* **Walk-in service centres:**
   managed a network of customer service centres or branches. Knows queue and token management, counter processes, document-heavy service requests and how to manage a multi-location network.
* **Transformation projects:**
   led at least two service transformation or process improvement projects end to end. This could be SOP standardisation, a service redesign, a contact-centre turnaround, or harmonising processes after a merger, with results you can show.
* Comfortable with data: builds analyses in Excel, works with call logs and MIS, and can turn numbers into a business case
* Can run a good interview and a good workshop. Credible with a functional head and comfortable with a frontline executive.
* **Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English**
   (spoken; written Gujarati preferred)
* Willing to travel extensively within Gujarat

**Good to have**

* Experience in utilities, city gas distribution, power distribution, telecom, banking or insurance, meaning large regulated consumer bases with high volumes of service requests
* Familiarity with regulator-defined service standards and complaint timelines (e.g., PNGRB, state electricity regulatory commission norms)
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or COPC exposure
* Experience with outsourced or agency staffing models in contact centres
* Training delivery or facilitation experience

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* A credible baseline from mystery shopping and call audits that the client’s leadership accepts
* A Gold Standard draft built from the client’s own best interactions, signed off by the client owner
* A cost-benefit case that the client’s Finance team has validated
* Strong working relationships with centre managers and call centre TLs, so that they see the program as support rather than an audit

Personal attributes

* Good at reading and getting on with people on the shop floor; earns trust quickly with frontline teams
* Rigorous with evidence: separates what they saw from what they were told
* Discreet with client data and with individual performance information
* Self-directed and able to run the program on the ground without close supervision

  **CAPEX/OPEX budgets**

  **procurement governance policies**

  **entire lifecycle**

  **supply risks**

  **supply continuity**

  **procurement policies, SOPs**

  **ethical standards**

  ,
  **spend analytics dashboards**

  **audit readiness**

  **regulatory compliance**

  **risk mitigation**

in medical equipment spend through strategic sourcing, standardization, and negotiations

title: Area Manager - Cardiac Surgery
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Kerala and Mangalore. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.
  
  
The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
* Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
* Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
* Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
* Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
* Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
* Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
* Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
* Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
* Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
* Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

title: Account Coordinator-Senior Associate
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Competency**
Client Excellence – Account Excellence
  
  
**Role Type**
Senior Account Coordinator
  
  
**The opportunity**
Senior Associate at C&I team supports the Account Manager and the Account Leadership team; Global Client serving Partner, Global Client Executive to develop and manage relevant activities on designated Priority accounts. The Senior Account Coordinator will be expected to provide high quality and insightful support to account teams on Go-to-market activities. The Senior Account Coordinator will build network across the account leadership and within GDS to develop account knowledge to benefit the regional/global Account team and our relationship and business with the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Account Management**

* Own account reporting and ensure relevant stakeholders receive and understand reported data
* In liaison with the Client Service Partner and Director, own the account planning process and ensure regular reviews against planned milestones and targets.
* Understand the strategic communication and stakeholder engagement requirements to progress the account plan agenda, and work with global teams to respond and deploy
* Provide relevant knowledge to Account teams – focus on dissemination of business analysis and research, competitive intelligence and relevant firm thought leadership
* To liaise and work with onshore account teams and internal business services groups to scope new support requirements, build processes for the execution of account management tasks, and ensure effective transition of work to the remote GDS support platform
* Client Relationship Development
* Contribute to complex account and business development needs, including global account planning, go-to-market research and strategy, pursuit or sales support, pitch development, among others
* Work with BMC point of contact to plan and execute marketing initiatives that directly drive revenue
* Accelerate strategy execution, particularly around prioritized Regions and strategic solutions.
* Understand market trends, what is on our clients' agenda and how these translate into revenue generating opportunities. Monitor solution revenue to understand success, opportunities, underperformance
* Communication
* Coordinate with global network of regional account team meetings. Send updated account and sector content and information.
* Develop and maintain relationships with service lines, Accounts, Market Segments, Emerging Markets and subsectors to serve as a two-way conduit for connection and communication
* Responsible for working to develop high impact relationships and embedding ABD support into the processes of the accounts
* Responsible for project management, quality control, review of deliverables, and for embedding the principles of exceptional client service of being connected, responsive and insightful in our support to the account teams and ABD stakeholders
* Facilitation of knowledge sharing

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Succinct and structured oral and written communications skills with proven ability to explain complex concepts in a crisp, clear, concise, and graphic-rich style, using appropriate analytics and visualization tools.
* Experience in Account Management and preparing sales and pipeline reporting, as well as providing insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients
* Experience in Microsoft tools like excel and PPT

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Any Graduate
* 4-8 years' experience in Account management and data reporting and analysis
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Demonstrated strong written and oral communication skills
* Ability to use both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis methodologies, including financial analysis skills, to synthesize information, review data inputs and provide analytic insights

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Account Management and data reporting skills
* Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc
* Credible experience working in a fast-moving, client-driven environment

**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
* Experience using Procurement portals (i.e., SAP Fieldglass or Ariba)

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* A professional with strong interpersonal skills - confidence, maturity & ability to build strong client relationships

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**About The Team**
The zMedia Center of Excellence team develops and implements marketing campaigns across various Paid Social and Search Engine Marketing (SEM) platforms to achieve both brand and performance goals. We are seeking a new team member who has the skills, knowledge and expertise to build, manage and implement Search Engine Marketing (SEM) campaigns at scale across multiple platforms. This team member is a performance marketer excited by new challenges and looking to develop the breadth and depth of campaign management and analytical capabilities!
  
  
Primary responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Build, QA, launch, and optimize Google SEM and Demand Gen campaigns for multiple lines of business

* Support various SEM workstreams including campaign audits, troubleshooting, reporting, and analyses

* Attend virtual team meetings occurring during the evenings in India Standard Time
* Understand rules, regulations, and data ecosystems related to paid marketing and identify and communicate issues when they arise

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* 2-5 years of work experience in SEM, including hands-on execution of campaigns such as Google Search and Microsoft Search with annual budgets exceeding $250K USD.
* Proven ability to effectively manage campaigns to drive strong business results
* Experience with newer Google Ads capabilities including Performance Max, AI Max, and Demand Gen
* Innovative mindset with a track record of successfully implementing experiments to improve performance
* Detail-oriented with strong quantitative and analytical skills. Experience analyzing large amounts of data from multiple sources and compiling them into insights & recommendations to improve results.
* Familiarity with incrementality testing and conversion event implementation and QA
* Strong problem-solving and time management skills
* Comfortable working asynchronously with team members in North America
* Fluent in English and strong written/verbal communication skills
* BS degree or equivalent experience in Business, Economics, Statistics or related field preferred.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
  
  
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

title: AI Content Marketer
description: About CultureMonkeyCultureMonkey is building HR tech for companies that take people seriously.We help organisations listen to their people better through employee engagement surveys, lifecycle surveys, pulse surveys, action planning, and people analytics. But the real thing we are building is not just software...We are helping companies build workplaces where people feel heard, understood, and valued.We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS company working with mid-market and enterprise customers across geographies. Over a million employees in 150+ countries trust us with something important: the honest voice of how they feel at work.And the way people find us is changing fast. They do not just Google us anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. That shift is exactly where this role comes in.About the RoleWe are looking for an AI Content Marketer who can make CultureMonkey the answer... on Google, and inside every AI engine people now ask first.This role sits right between content, SEO, product, and distribution.You will write content that HR leaders actually finish. You will make sure it ranks, gets cited, and keeps earning attention long after you hit publish.This is not a "write a blog and move on" role.This is a role about being remembered.You will own how a fast-growing brand gets found, read, and trusted in a search world that AI is rewriting in real time.What You Will DoWrite content people actually finish. Blogs, case studies, and playbooks that are clear, human, and genuinely useful.Write for the answer, not just the algorithm. Content built to rank on Google and get cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.Use AI as a real part of your workflow, for research, drafting, and scaling, then edit hard so every piece stays accurate, original, and human.Run keyword and prompt research in Ahrefs and Search Console to publish content that ranks and holds its place.Refresh and re-optimize existing content so top pages keep their rankings as search intent and SERPs shift. Content decay is where organic traffic quietly leaks.Build domain authority through internal linking and structured outreach: guest posts, backlinks, and partnerships.Distribute with intent across newsletters, LinkedIn, Reddit, and product communities. Right message, right channel, right timing.Partner across teams on landing pages, sales and marketing emails, and ad copy, all research-backed.Track what matters, from CTR and organic traffic to keyword rankings and visibility in AI answers, and let the data shape the next draft.Most importantly... do not just write content that fills a calendar. Write the content that people, and AI, actually trust.What We Are Looking For1 to 2 years in content marketing, content writing, SEO, or a similar role where your writing had to perform, not just publish.Someone who writes clearly because they think clearly. Practical, useful, no filler.Someone who treats SEO and AI search as strategy, not jargon.Someone who uses AI fluently but never blindly. You can tell a sharp draft from generic filler, and you fix the difference.Comfort with data. Rankings, CTR, and traffic should tell you what to write next, not intimidate you.Strong follow-through. You track open items, hit publish dates, and keep multiple pieces moving without being chased.A curious, proactive streak. You would rather test an idea than wait for permission.Someone who takes feedback without ego and turns it into sharper work.Bonus points if you have played with keyword tools, AI writing tools, or have a portfolio you are proud to show.You Will Love This Role IfYou like writing that actually gets read, not just filed away.You enjoy turning a messy topic into a clean, useful piece.You get a quiet thrill from watching a page climb the rankings.You want to crack how to get cited by ChatGPT and Perplexity, not just Google.You like data pointing you to your next move.You want your work to have visible impact quickly.You enjoy working with people who move fast, care deeply, and still know how to have fun.Why Join CultureMonkeyYou will work on content that genuinely matters to the people reading it.You will help companies listen to their employees better, not just push another dashboard.You will join a content practice that is still being shaped, so your ideas on process, tooling, and how we win AI search will actually matter.You will work directly with a fast-moving team that values sharp thinking, ownership, and honesty over hierarchy.You will be part of a team that believes people grow when they are trusted, heard, and given room to contribute.We practice what we build for customers: people-first experiences, high ownership, empathy, flexible work, learning, fun, and a real sense of belonging.Things move fast here. Decisions happen in days, not quarters. Good ideas travel quickly. And when you do good work, you will see its impact almost immediately.The Kind of Person We Are Hoping To MeetSomeone who is curious about how AI is changing search, and wants to be early to it.Someone who can turn a blank page into something people actually want to read.Someone who cares about the reader on the other side of the screen, not just the keyword.Someone who wants to build a content engine, not just hit publish.Someone who believes great content is not about volume, it is about being the answer people trust.If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

Experience in furniture, interior design, architecture, premium products, or B2B marketing will be an added advantage.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
**Role Overview**
The Marketing Operations Specialist will play a critical role in enabling a high-performing SaaS marketing team through scalable processes, reliable systems, and strong operational guidance. This role will own campaign execution within Marketo, support data hygiene and governance initiatives, manage key marketing technologies, and help ensure seamless lead lifecycle operations from acquisition through routing to sales development.
  
  
This person will partner closely with demand generation, sales development, content, and operations teams to deliver high-quality campaign builds, troubleshoot technical issues, optimize workflows, and maintain reporting consistency. They will also ensure strong alignment between marketing and sales by supporting program builds, explaining operational processes, and maintaining accurate attribution and tracking frameworks—including UTM strategy and various martech integrations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Marketing Automation & Campaign Execution**

* Build, QA, and launch campaigns in Marketo, including emails, nurtures, landing pages, forms, lists, and program templates.
* Maintain scalable program architectures and ensure proper attribution setup.
* Manage lead scoring, lifecycle stages, and routing workflows in partnership with Revenue Operations.
* Troubleshoot automation or campaign issues, ensuring timely resolution.

**Marketing Technology & Integrations**

* Support administration and daily operations of tools including Marketo, Leandata, Outreach and other components of the martech. Having experience in tools handling ABM efforts, digital campaigns and third-party sourcing tools is preferred.
* Ensure integrations (especially Salesforce ↔ Marketo) function properly and data flows are accurate.

**Data Hygiene & Governance**

* Maintain data quality standards, including normalization, deduplication, segmentation, and enrichment.
* Monitor database health and proactively address data gaps or inconsistencies.

**Lead Management & Operational Processes**

* Support the full lead lifecycle across marketing and sales development—including routing, various data logic, handoff routing, and SLA adherence.
* Collaborate with SDR leadership to ensure clean handoffs, accurate tracking, and operational insights that improve performance.
* Provide clear documentation and operational guidance to help marketing and sales understand processes and best practices.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Technical Expertise**

* 2–4+ years in marketing operations, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment.
* Strong hands-on experience with Marketo, including program setup, cloning frameworks, tokens, smart campaigns, and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities, Campaigns).
* Understanding of API connections, enrichment tools, and data management principles.

**Operational Knowledge**

* Solid understanding of lead lifecycle journeys, program attribution and routing logic.
* Experience supporting and collaborating with Sales Development / SDR teams.
* Familiarity with attribution models, UTM management, and campaign tagging.
* Ability to translate operational concepts into clear explanations for non-technical marketing partners.

**Analytical & Process Skills**

* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues across systems and workflows.
* Detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to maintaining clean, accurate data.
* Ability to create documentation, playbooks, and enablement materials for internal teams.
* Comfortable managing multiple projects, meeting deadlines, and partnering cross-functionally.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication skills—both technical and non-technical.
* Collaborative and proactive approach to partnering with marketing, sales development and operations.
* Adaptability within a fast-moving SaaS environment.

*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

Teams collaborate closely across content, scripting, production, editing, operations, client servicing, publishing, and analytics to move ideas from insight to execution. BigBrainCo. offers an environment where professionals can take meaningful ownership of client outcomes, build practical expertise across the complete content lifecycle, and contribute to campaigns designed for measurable audience and business impact. The company values organised execution, clear communication, creative quality, responsive collaboration, and continuous learning as it scales content operations for multiple client accounts.

**About the Role**

The Content Manager owns the day-to-day content execution pipeline for assigned client accounts. Through research, content calendars, production coordination, publishing operations, community management, and analytics, this role turns client objectives into timely, platform-ready deliverables. You will coordinate scripts, props, graphics briefs, shoots, editors, videographers, client reviews, and publishing sequences while protecting service-level timelines. The role also owns Instagram and YouTube execution, including captions, covers, SEO metadata, thumbnails, cards, end screens, and feature testing. Success means every deliverable progresses predictably, meets visual and channel standards, reaches clients for review at least 48 hours before key milestones, and produces clear insight through weekly reporting on audience and content performance. Reporting to the Production Lead, you will serve as the operational owner connecting creative quality, reliable delivery, client alignment, and measurable channel outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own research for assigned client niches and convert emerging hooks, formats, trends, and competitive insights into actionable content ideas that strengthen calendar relevance and audience performance.
* Build and maintain monthly and weekly calendars across static posts, carousels, Reels, YouTube long-form videos, and Shorts, keeping publishing sequences accurate as priorities change.
* Coordinate script delivery, props, graphics briefs, and shoot readiness so clients receive scripts at least 48 hours before shoots and production teams have the inputs required for execution.
* Oversee on-set framing and visual requirements across Instagram 9:16 and YouTube 16:9 formats, protecting brand consistency and ensuring footage is usable for intended channels.
* Brief editors on priorities, edit styles, and turnaround expectations; determine batch or rolling workflows based on campaign urgency and ensure drafts reach clients 48 hours before go-live.
* Own publishing operations by writing captions, selecting cover frames, testing Instagram features, and executing YouTube titles, descriptions, timestamps, tags, cards, end screens, and thumbnail coordination.
* Monitor comments and audience sentiment, engage constructively, remove or report toxic content, resolve execution queries with client servicing, and produce weekly performance reports covering views, watch time, retention, CTR, growth, and engagement.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Hands-on experience managing content calendars, coordinating shoots, and working with editors, videographers, script writers, operations teams, and client-facing stakeholders across multiple concurrent deliverables.
* Strong working knowledge of Instagram and YouTube publishing, platform algorithms, content trends, competitive benchmarking, visual framing standards, brand consistency, and platform-specific content best practices.
* Practical YouTube SEO and analytics capability, including metadata, tags, thumbnails, cards, end screens, captions, and interpretation of views, watch time, retention, CTR, follower growth, engagement, and sentiment.

**Additional Plus**

* Prior experience working directly with clients or within a client-facing content, social media, or digital marketing team is an advantage for managing expectations and approvals.
* Experience supporting accounts across multiple industries, formats, and publishing schedules can help you adapt research and execution decisions to different audience and campaign requirements.
* Familiarity with testing emerging Instagram features, coordinating thumbnail requirements, and improving workflows through performance insights will strengthen your ability to drive channel outcomes.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring hands-on ownership of content execution, from market research and calendar planning through shoot coordination, editing traffic, approvals, publishing, community moderation, and reporting. You understand how each stage affects the next and use a clear operating rhythm to protect quality and deadlines.
* You are highly organised and comfortable managing multiple client accounts, deliverables, stakeholders, and changing priorities without losing visibility into commitments. You keep calendars current, surface risks early, and maintain SLA discipline around scripts, drafts, reviews, and go-live milestones.
* You combine creative judgement with operational precision. You can assess hooks, formats, captions, cover frames, framing standards, brand consistency, and platform requirements while coordinating effectively with script writers, videographers, editors, operations, and client servicing teams.
* You communicate confidently in writing and conversation, whether preparing captions, briefing editors, updating clients, or presenting performance results. You are comfortable reading views, watch time, retention, CTR, follower growth, engagement, and sentiment, then translating those signals into practical next steps.
* You stay curious about industry developments, audience behaviour, platform changes, and competitive content. You take initiative, work independently, and remain accountable for moving client work forward in a fast-paced agency environment.

**Why Join Us**

* Own the complete content execution pipeline for real client accounts from day one, with direct influence over research, production readiness, publishing quality, community experience, and measurable channel performance.
* Work closely with a Production Lead and cross-functional creative, editorial, operations, and client servicing teams in a fast-paced agency environment where disciplined execution creates visible client impact.
* Build practical expertise across content strategy, production coordination, Instagram and YouTube operations, SEO, analytics, and audience management while working across diverse industries and content formats.
* Follow a clear growth path toward Production Lead and other senior content leadership opportunities while contributing to a collaborative, creative, and high-energy culture.

**What We Offer**

* Meaningful ownership of end-to-end content execution for diverse client accounts, giving you broad exposure across strategy, research, production, publishing, SEO, community management, and performance analytics.
* Close collaboration with experienced production and cross-functional teams, with the opportunity to learn through real campaign delivery, feedback cycles, and performance-led decision-making.

title: Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategist - LinkedIn + Cold Emailing
description:
We're looking for someone who knows how to
**turn LinkedIn outreach and cold email into predictable B2B pipelines.**

If you've built outbound systems, managed high-volume outreach campaigns, experimented with automation tools, and consistently generated qualified meetings for B2B businesses, we'd love to meet you.

At Myntmore, you'll work with multiple founders and B2B companies across industries, building and scaling outbound systems that drive real business outcomes.

**This is a hands-on outbound role, not a paid marketing, social media, or brand marketing position.**

Must-Haves

* **Location:**
  Mumbai (mandatory)
* **Experience:**
  3+ years in B2B Lead Generation, Outbound Sales, Demand Generation, or GTM
* **LinkedIn Outreach:**
  Proven experience running LinkedIn prospecting and outreach campaigns at scale
* **Cold Emailing:**
  Hands-on experience building, launching, and optimising cold email campaigns
* **Automation & Tools:**
  Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, Smartlead, Instantly, Sales Navigator, or similar platforms
* **Data & Research:**
  Strong understanding of ICP definition, prospect sourcing, lead enrichment, and list building
* **Communication:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* **Joining:**
  Immediate joiner or available within 15 days

**Compensation:**
₹6–15 LPA, depending on experience, plus performance-based incentives.

**Working hours:**
Full-time, 10 AM–7 PM.

What You'll Do

**1. LinkedIn Outreach at Scale**

* Build and manage outbound campaigns targeting relevant B2B decision-makers.
* Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator and automation tools to source prospects and execute structured outreach.
* Develop personalised messaging, connection requests, follow-ups, and outreach sequences.
* Improve connection acceptance rates, response rates, and qualified meetings booked.

**2. Cold Email Campaigns**

* Build and execute cold email campaigns from scratch, from prospect sourcing to meetings booked.
* Set up and manage email sequences, follow-ups, segmentation, and personalisation.
* Work with tools such as Smartlead, Instantly, Apollo, and other outbound platforms.
* Understand email deliverability, domain and inbox setup, bounce management, and campaign optimisation.

**3. ICP Research & Prospecting**

* Define Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and identify the right industries, companies, and decision-makers.
* Build high-quality, targeted prospect lists using research and data enrichment tools.
* Identify buying signals, business pain points, and opportunities to improve targeting.
* Test different ICPs, segments, and messaging angles to identify what drives results.

**4. AI, Automation & Growth Systems**

* Use tools like Clay and other AI-powered platforms to enrich prospect data, personalise outreach, and automate repetitive workflows.
* Build scalable outbound processes rather than relying on manual, repetitive execution.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency through integrations, automation, and AI.
* Continuously experiment with new tools and workflows to improve output.

**5. Pipeline Ownership & Optimisation**

* Own weekly and monthly outreach and qualified-meeting targets.
* Track campaign metrics, including acceptance rates, reply rates, positive responses, and meetings booked.
* Analyse performance, identify bottlenecks, and iterate on campaigns.
* Build repeatable outbound playbooks that consistently generate qualified B2B opportunities.
* Collaborate directly with founders and clients to align outreach with their sales goals.

**6 Client Strategy & GTM Execution**

* Work directly with founders and clients across multiple B2B industries to understand their business models, offerings, target audiences, and revenue goals.
* Develop customised outbound and GTM strategies for each client based on their ICP, industry, market positioning, and growth objectives.
* Identify the right mix of LinkedIn outreach, cold email, prospecting, and automation to generate qualified opportunities.
* Experiment with different industries, ICPs, messaging angles, and outreach strategies to identify what works best for each client.
* Act as an extension of each client's growth team, providing strategic inputs while owning campaign execution and performance.
* Communicate campaign insights, results, and recommendations to clients, continuously refining strategies based on performance.
* Manage multiple client accounts simultaneously, adapting your approach to different industries, sales cycles, and business objectives

Who We're Looking For

You're a great fit if you:

* Have
  **actually executed LinkedIn outreach and cold email campaigns at scale,**
  not just managed or supervised them.
* Know how to build prospect lists, write outreach sequences, configure tools, and optimise campaigns end to end.
* Understand the difference between generating leads and generating qualified sales conversations.
* Are comfortable working with automation tools and building efficient outbound workflows.
* Can analyse campaign data and make decisions based on results.
* Take ownership of pipeline outcomes instead of focusing only on activity metrics.
* Enjoy testing new ICPs, messaging angles, tools, and strategies to improve results.

**Please note:**
This role is specifically for hands-on B2B outbound lead generation. Experience limited to paid advertising, SEO, social media management, content marketing, or general brand marketing will not be sufficient.

About Myntmore

Myntmore is a B2B growth company specialising in LinkedIn personal branding, AI-powered outbound lead generation, and scalable growth systems.

We've worked with 300+ clients, delivered 900+ websites, and helped generate over $80M in revenue.

We partner with founders and B2B businesses to build predictable pipelines through targeted prospecting, LinkedIn outreach, cold email, and AI-led automation.

Why Join Myntmore?

* Work directly with founders on real B2B pipeline challenges.
* Build outbound systems for multiple businesses across industries.
* Get hands-on exposure to advanced prospecting, enrichment, AI, and automation tools.
* Take ownership of measurable business outcomes.
* Work in a performance-driven environment with incentives linked to impact.
* Grow your expertise in modern B2B outbound, GTM, and revenue generation.

**Think you can turn outbound into a predictable pipeline? Apply now.**

We are seeking a data-driven, analytical, and highly proactive Associate – PPC to own and scale our paid marketing initiatives. As an Associate, you are beyond the entry-level tactical execution stage. You will bridge the gap between creative marketing strategy and hardcore data analysis, directly influencing our customer acquisition costs (CAC) and return on ad spend (ROAS).

**Campaign Strategy & Execution**
: Plan, build, and scale end-to-end PPC campaigns across channels like Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, Shopping, YouTube), Microsoft/Bing Ads, and Paid Social (Meta, LinkedIn, or platform-specific networks).

Continuously optimize live campaigns using advanced bidding models (Target CPA, Target ROAS). Conduct regular keyword research, competitive benchmarking, and negative keyword filtering.

Collaborate with creative and content teams to conceptualize high-converting ad copy, landing pages, and visual assets. Run structured A/B tests on creatives and extensions to systematically boost Click-Through Rates (CTR) and Conversion Rates (CVR).

: Monitor daily/weekly performance metrics. Build and maintain transparent reporting dashboards (using Looker Studio, Tableau, or Excel) to deliver actionable insights on key metrics like CPC, CPA, ROAS, and Quality Score.

**Technical Implementation:**
Partner with web development teams to deploy and troubleshoot tracking tags via Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform pixels.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

Experience: 2–5 years of hands-on experience managing medium-to-large budget PPC campaigns (either agency-side or in-house).

**Platform Expertise**
: Expert-level mastery of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager is mandatory. Strong understanding of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).

**Data-Driven Mindset:**
Excellent command over Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs/XLOOKUPs are second nature).

**Analytical Rigor:**
Ability to turn complex, massive data sets into clear executive summaries and operational roadmaps.

**Certifications**
: Active Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications are highly preferred.

**Soft Skills:**
Strong time management skills, an eye for technical detail, and a proactive attitude toward staying up-to-date with shifts in privacy standards (cookie-less tracking) and platform automation.

title: Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)
description: Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)Location: Gurgaon · Type: Full-time About Voice ArenaVoice Arena builds frontier evals, models and datasets for voice AI. Our mission is to make machines talk like humans, and to measure honestly how close they are.We run public leaderboards for speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and speaker diarization, with many more yet to come. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use them to see how speech models perform on real speech, in real conditions and across languages, rather than on clean read audio.Behind the boards is a research and engineering team that builds its own datasets, trains the models that keep its evaluations accurate and publishes its methods. What sets us apart:Research that gets published. Three papers at Interspeech 2026, where Voice Arena is also the Diamond Sponsor. Our methods go through peer review, not just a blog post.Partners across the field. We brought Hindi and Indian English to Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard, and we partner with NVIDIA. Model providers send us new models for public and private evaluation.Data nobody else has. Monsoon, our dataset initiative for the Global South, is working towards 1,000 languages by 2027. Our accented English corpus covers 8 accents and 6,000 hours. This data gives us held-out test sets that models have not seen in training.A research community. Voice Research Club runs paper-first sessions for voice AI researchers, starting in San Francisco and New York, with more cities to follow.About the roleVoice Arena's boards are only as useful as the people who see them. When a new speech model launches, the right researcher, founder or AI leader should hear what our evals say about it within a day. Today that depends on a few people posting when they can. We want it to be a system.We're hiring a Product Ops & Growth lead to own how Voice Arena reaches the people who matter: the researchers who build speech models, the founders and engineers who ship voice products, and the AI and data leaders who decide which models their companies buy. You will scale our presence on X and LinkedIn, and find new ways to put our leaderboards, benchmarks and datasets in front of the right people.The core question for this role is simple: does everyone who builds, ships or buys voice AI know what Voice Arena says about the models they care about?This is a highly autonomous role. You'll work directly with the founders and the research team, sitting between the product and its audience. Growth here is not about follower counts for their own sake. It is about reaching the right people, and that is how you will be measured.In this role, you willThe work runs as one loop: know who we need to reach, get our work in front of them, learn what lands, and feed it back into the product:Map the people we need to reach. Build and keep current the lists of who matters: speech and voice researchers at model labs, founders and engineers at voice platforms, and AI and data leaders at enterprises that buy voice AI. Know who they follow, where they spend time and what they share.Scale Voice Arena on X. Own our X presence end to end: leaderboard updates, benchmark launches, threads and charts. Make sure most major voice AI model launches are covered on our boards within a day of release, and that the right people see it.Scale Voice Arena on LinkedIn. Grow our company page and the founders' presence, and run targeted promotion so our posts reach researchers at labs, teams at voice platforms and AI leaders at large enterprises.Run launches. Plan and ship every release, from new leaderboards and benchmarks to datasets and papers: timing, founder posts, threads, visuals, and the follow-up that keeps a launch alive after day one.Build distribution beyond our own accounts. Work with creators, researchers and partners who already have the audience we need, so our results travel through voices people trust.Run product ops. Keep the boards fresh and the site sharp: track new model releases, work with the research team on what gets evaluated next, and turn audience feedback into changes on voicearena.com.In a typical week, you might:Track every voice AI model launch and get our results out the same dayPlan and schedule a benchmark launch thread with the research teamBuild a target list of voice researchers and AI leaders, and set up a LinkedIn campaign to reach themBrief a group of creators on a new leaderboard and coordinate their postsLook at who each post reached and who engaged, and change next week's planWhat matters mostEverything in the loop serves two outcomes. They are how this role will be measured.1. Reaching the right peopleReach only matters if it is the right reach. A post seen by a million people who will never build or buy a speech model is worth less than one seen by the hundred people who do. Your job is to make sure Voice Arena is in front of those people, consistently. In practice:Know the audience by name. Keep clear, current lists of the researchers, builders and buyers we need, and know which of them already follow us.Measure who, not just how many. Track reach and engagement among the people we target, not just impressions and follower counts.Be first on launches. Be the place people check when a new voice model ships, by getting our results out fast.Earn the reshare. Make posts researchers want to share: clear charts, honest numbers, no hype.2. Scaling X and LinkedIn into systemsToday a few people post when they can. You'll turn that into a repeatable engine that runs every day, through launches and quiet weeks alike. In practice:Run a calendar. Keep a weekly calendar of leaderboard posts and releases across Voice Arena's accounts and the founders' accounts.Build templates. Create reusable formats for leaderboard updates, launch threads and charts, so quality stays high as volume grows.Spend on reach with intent. Use targeted LinkedIn and X promotion to reach specific groups, and cut whatever does not reach them.Grow a creator network. Build lasting relationships with creators and researchers who regularly cover voice AI.Close the loop. Report what worked each week, and feed what the audience wants back into the product and research roadmap.What we offerHigh ownership. Own Voice Arena's reach from day one, with direct access to the founders.A front-row seat. See every new voice model and every result before it goes public.Real impact. Your work decides whether the labs, builders and buyers of voice AI see what our evals say.Room to grow. Build the growth function at an early company and shape how it scales.Minimum qualifications2+ years in growth, marketing, community or product ops, ideally at a tech, AI or developer-focused companyA track record of growing an audience on X or LinkedIn, for a company or for yourselfStrong writing: you can turn a technical result into a clear post, thread or chart captionComfort with data: you track what each post reached and change course based on itGenuine interest in AI, and the curiosity to learn how speech models are built and evaluatedHigh ownership: you ship without waiting to be told, and you sweat the detailsPreferred qualificationsYou don't need to match every bullet. title: Associate Content Manager
description:
**Role snapshot**

You run two things end to end. First, the Instagram personal brands of our founder and core team, from research and scripting to the shoot and a fully programmatic edit. Second, our influencer marketing: finding creators, closing partnerships and keeping them posting about us.

**Title**
:- Associate Content Manager

**Location:**
- Gurgaon, India (onsite, in office)

**Type**
:- Full time

**Platform**
:- Instagram

**You Run:**
- The founder's and core team's Instagram profiles, plus our influencer partners

**Reports**
to:- Head of Marketing

**What you'll doInstagram personal branding**

1. **Research.**
   Track what is working on Instagram every week: formats, hooks, audio, pacing and edit styles. Find the outlier reels in the founder and business niche and bring your next bets to the weekly review, backed by numbers.
2. **Script.**
   Turn founder calls, voice notes, podcasts and Slack threads into tight scripts. Weave in each person's real journey and point of view, land the hook in the first 2 seconds, and keep one idea per reel.
3. **Shoot.**
   Plan and direct talking-head and B-roll shoots in the office: light, mic, framing, and getting the best take from a busy founder in the least time.
4. **Edit in code.**
   Edit every video programmatically with Claude Code, using HyperFrames and Remotion for motion graphics, animation, captions and sound. Build reusable templates so each reel ships faster than the last.
5. **Support the team.**
   Help the founder and core team members with their own production, from prep and shoot setup to the final cut.
6. **Publish and learn.**
   Run the content calendar, get the owner's approval before anything goes live, and post on time. Track retention, shares, saves and follows; double down on what works and kill what does not.

**Influencer marketing**

1. **Outreach.**
   Find and reach out to new influencers whose audience matches ours.
2. **Partnerships.**
   Agree deliverables, timelines and what we give in return, and close the deal in writing.
3. **Coordination.**
   Keep every partner posting about us on schedule, and follow up the day a post slips.
4. **Keep our promises.**
   Make sure every partner gets everything we promised them, on time.
5. **Content for partners.**
   Write their posts and edit their videos when they need it.

**What we're looking for**

1. **Full time, onsite.**
   You work from our Gurgaon office every day. This is not a remote or hybrid role.
2. **Instagram native.**
   You can show reels you made, for yourself or someone else, and explain why each one worked or did not.
3. **Research first.**
   You spot a trend before it peaks and back your opinion with views, retention and follower data.
4. **A storyteller.**
   You can pull a real story out of a founder and shape it into a hook, a turn and a payoff.
5. **Comfortable in code.**
   You already edit with Claude Code, or you learn fast and are happy working in a terminal. Basic HTML, CSS or JavaScript helps.
6. **Organised with partners.**
   You can run many creator relationships at once, track every promise in both directions and follow up without being chased.
7. **A creative eye.**
   You are the last check on quality and you say no to weak creative.

**Nice to have**

* Experience running influencer or creator partnerships
* Hands-on work with Remotion or HyperFrames
* A motion design background (After Effects or similar)
* AI video tools such as Higgsfield
* An Instagram account you grew yourself
* Content for B2B, SaaS or startup founders

📩
**Please share your CV at hr@inboxkit.com**

**Hiring@inboxkit.com**

title: UGC Content Creator (Remote Internship)
description:
**About Uzi World Digital**

Uzi World Digital is a digital marketing agency based in Kolkata, India. We offer web design, SEO, digital PR, social media marketing, online reputation management, branding, and digital advertising for brands, public figures, and creators.

**About the Internship**

Your first step into digital marketing can start in front of the camera. This internship gives college students the chance to become one of the faces of Uzi World Digital, creating short-form videos such as Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts that represent our work, culture, and values. It is built for students who are just starting out and want to learn how a digital agency works, with structured guidance and mentorship throughout and room to bring their own personality and ideas to the content.

**What You Will Do**

* Script, shoot, and edit short-form videos with guidance from our team. No prior editing experience is needed, training is provided, and mobile apps like CapCut are enough.
* Represent Uzi World Digital authentically on camera and through storytelling
* Develop video ideas with our marketing and creative teams, based on campaigns and trends
* Publish content on Uzi World Digital’s official channels and engage with the audience
* Learn to read basic analytics such as views, engagement, and shares to improve your content

**What You Will Get**

* Hands-on training in short-form video production, from idea to publishing
* Insight into how a digital agency handles content strategy, brand storytelling, and performance
* Mentorship from the founder and senior team members
* Real-world projects for your portfolio, across different industries
* Room to showcase your creativity and build your personal brand
* Certificate of Internship and Letter of Recommendation, based on performance and contribution
* Flexible remote schedule

**Who Can Apply**

This internship is strictly for students who are at the beginning of their journey. You are a good fit if you are:

* 18 years of age or above
* A first-year or early-stage undergraduate student currently enrolled in a college or university
* New to content creation, with little or no prior experience in video editing or social media management
* Comfortable on camera, curious about social media, and eager to learn from scratch
* Self-motivated and able to manage your time in a remote setup

This programme is built for beginners, so experienced creators may find it too introductory.

**What You Will Need**

* A smartphone with a good-quality camera, or a dedicated camera
* A clean, well-lit, presentable location to use as your background

**Internship Details**

* **Duration:**
  3 months
* **Commitment:**
  1 to 2 hours per day
* **Mode:**
  Remote
* **Applications:**
  Open year-round, reviewed on a rolling basis

**Please Note**

This is a learning-focused internship with no monetary compensation involved. It is structured as a training programme, and its value lies in mentorship, guided practice, real project exposure, and a certificate and letter of recommendation that support your early career. Content created during the internship will be published on Uzi World Digital’s official channels and may be reused by the agency for brand purposes. You are welcome to share your work on your own profiles as well. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by email within 7 days.

title: Account Coordinator-Senior Associate

The Senior Account Coordinator will be expected to provide high quality and insightful support to account teams on Go-to-market activities. * Understand the strategic communication and stakeholder engagement requirements to progress the account plan agenda, and work with global teams to respond and deploy
* Provide relevant knowledge to Account teams – focus on dissemination of business analysis and research, competitive intelligence and relevant firm thought leadership

* Work with BMC point of contact to plan and execute marketing initiatives that directly drive revenue
* Accelerate strategy execution, particularly around prioritized Regions and strategic solutions.
* Understand market trends, what is on our clients' agenda and how these translate into revenue generating opportunities. Monitor solution revenue to understand success, opportunities, underperformance
* Communication

title: BTL Assistant Manager -Marketing
description:
Job Description: Assistant Manager / Manager – BTL Marketing
  
  
Business Vertical: Wires & Cables
  
  
Company: Sturlite
  
  
Department: Marketing
  
  
Position: Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager / Manager
  
  
Experience: 6 to 8 years of relevant experience
  
  
Reporting To: Head – BTL Marketing
  
  
Location: Bangalore, India
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic and execution-oriented BTL Marketing professional to drive below-the-line marketing initiatives for Sturlite’s Wires & Cables business. The role will focus on strengthening brand visibility and market presence, enhancing channel engagement, influencing purchase decisions, and driving business growth through targeted trade marketing initiatives and on-ground activations.
  
  
The incumbent will work closely with sales teams, channel partners, distributors, dealers, retailers, electricians, contractors, and other relevant stakeholders to plan and execute impactful BTL programs across key markets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* BTL Strategy & Execution
* Plan and execute BTL marketing initiatives aligned with business objectives, brand strategy, and sales priorities.
* Develop and implement market-specific activation plans to improve brand awareness, product visibility, and consumer preference.
* Drive on-ground marketing activities, including market activations, promotional campaigns, product demonstrations, roadshows, and local events.
* Ensure timely and effective execution of campaigns across identified markets and sales territories.
* Channel & Trade Marketing
* Design and execute dealer, distributor, and retailer engagement programs to strengthen channel relationships and improve brand preference.
* Develop trade promotion schemes, retail visibility initiatives, point-of-sale (POS) materials, merchandising programs, and in-shop branding.
* Identify opportunities to improve product visibility and brand recall at electrical retail outlets and channel partner locations.
* Collaborate with sales teams to support market expansion, channel activation, new product launches, and achieve business targets.
* Electrician, Contractor & Influencer Engagement
* Plan and execute engagement programs for electricians, electrical contractors, installers, and other key purchase influencers.
* Organize electrician meets, contractor meets, product awareness sessions, technical demonstrations, loyalty programs, and recognition initiatives.
* Support the development of influencer engagement and advocacy programs to improve brand consideration and product recommendations.
* Build and maintain engagement calendars for key influencer segments across priority markets.
* Market Development & Competitor Intelligence
* Work closely with regional and territory sales teams to identify market opportunities and prioritize BTL investments.
* Conduct market visits to assess brand visibility, channel engagement, competitor activities, and effectiveness of existing programs.
* Track competitor promotions, trade schemes, retailer engagement initiatives, and market activation practices.
* Translate field insights into actionable recommendations for improving marketing effectiveness and market penetration.
* Agency & Vendor Management
* Coordinate with activation agencies, event partners, printers, fabricators, and other vendors for campaign execution.
* Develop campaign briefs, evaluate vendor proposals, and ensure quality, cost efficiency, and adherence to timelines.
* Monitor execution quality through field visits, photographic evidence, campaign reports, and stakeholder feedback.
* Ensure adherence to company brand guidelines, procurement processes, and vendor compliance requirements.
* Budgeting & Performance Measurement
* Assist in developing and managing the annual and monthly BTL marketing budgets.
* Track campaign expenditure, vendor payments, and budget utilization against approved plans.
* Define and monitor KPIs such as outlet coverage, number of activations, influencer participation, campaign reach, visibility compliance, cost per activation, and lead or sales contribution wherever measurable.
* Prepare periodic performance dashboards and post-campaign reports, highlighting outcomes, learnings, and improvement opportunities.
* Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of BTL activities and recommend optimization measures.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Collaborate with sales, product management, brand marketing, regional marketing, and supply chain teams to ensure integrated execution.
* Support new product launches, seasonal campaigns, regional promotions, and market specific business initiatives.
* Ensure availability of marketing collateral, promotional materials, and campaign-related product information at the right locations and time.
* Share regular updates on campaign progress, market feedback, and key business opportunities with the BTL Head.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely execution of planned BTL activities and campaigns.
* Dealer, retailer, electrician, contractor engagement and participation.
* Retail outlet coverage and quality of in-store branding and visibility.
* Effectiveness of trade promotions and market activation programs.
* Campaign expenditure versus approved budgets.
* Cost efficiency and measurable return on BTL investments.
* Improvement in brand visibility and preference across target markets.
* Contribution to lead generation, channel productivity, and sales growth, wherever attributable.
* Quality and timeliness of campaign reporting and market intelligence.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education:

MBA/PGDM in Marketing or a relevant postgraduate qualification; candidates with a strong track record in trade marketing or BTL execution may also be considered.
  
  

* Experience:

Approximately 6 to 8 years of relevant experience in BTL marketing, trade marketing, channel marketing, or field marketing.
  
  

* Experience in electricals, wires and cables, building materials, lighting, paints, adhesives, consumer durables, or a similar channel-driven industry is preferred.
* Hands-on experience in dealer and retailer activation, influencer engagement, trade promotions, vendor management, and on-ground campaign execution.
* Experience working with regional sales teams and managing multiple markets or territories is desirable.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong execution, planning, and project management skills.
* Understanding distributors, dealers, retailers, and influencer ecosystems.
* Good commercial acumen, budgeting, and vendor negotiation skills.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to analyze campaign performance and derive actionable insights.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with marketing dashboards and reporting tools is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel extensively across assigned markets.
* High ownership, accountability, and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

title: Manager - AI GTM and Market Intelligence
description: About GoKwikGoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling checkout optimization, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik powers 15,000+ merchants globally, processes ~$2 billion in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI-powered infrastructure across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.Why This Role MattersMost GTM teams wait for demand to declare itself. This role builds the systems that find it first. As Manager — AI GTM and Market Intelligence, you will own the engine that identifies high-fit D2C merchants before they raise a hand, the internal tools Marketing and Sales rely on daily to see what our spend is actually producing, and the proprietary data stories that establish GoKwik’s authority in the market. This is a builder’s role rather than an analyst’s: the output is working software and published research other teams depend on, not reports. You will use AI as your primary build leverage, partner closely with Demand Generation, Sales, Brand and PR, and own each system end to end — from the idea to the thing running in production.What You’ll OwnAI Outbound & Signal Pipeline - Own GoKwik’s outbound motion end to end: build the ICP from proprietary merchant data and third-party market sources, detect intent signals such as checkout migrations, funding rounds and founder activity, and convert them into AI-personalised outreach that reaches high-fit D2C brands before they enter the market. Marketing Intelligence Platform - Own the internal tools Marketing, Sales and CS run on: the funnel from lead to go-live, ad spend joined to closed deals for true cost-per-outcome, competitive share of voice, and self-serve AI reporting that removes the dependency on manual data pulls. Each tool ships with a user guide and must be actively used by the team it was built for.Data-Led Thought Leadership - Turn GoKwik’s proprietary transaction data into publishable industry research no competitor can replicate. Own the data and the narrative from first principles to final draft, in partnership with Brand and PR. Attribution & Funnel Integrity - Own how marketing performance is measured: canonical definitions for lead, MQL, SQL and go-live, campaign taxonomy and UTM governance, and distinct attribution for outbound and signal-sourced pipeline in Salesforce. Hold these definitions steady across Marketing, Sales and Finance when numbers are contested.Automation & Reliability - Run these systems as production software, not side projects. Own the scheduled jobs, monitoring and alerting that keep them trustworthy, and design alerts that stay quiet until something genuinely needs attention.Enablement & Documentation - Build for handover from day one. Every tool, dashboard and automated workflow carries written documentation, a named owner and a walkthrough session, so no system depends on one person’s context to keep running.Who You Are4–6 years of experience across growth, demand generation, marketing analytics, revenue operations or product, with a track record of building tools rather than only reporting on them.Demonstrable experience building working internal tools, automations or data products using AI as the primary build leverage. You should be able to walk us through something you shipped that other people depended on, and what broke along the way.Strong SQL and comfort interrogating a number to its source before it is acted on. Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and with a data warehouse.Commercial fluency in D2C, eCommerce, payments or B2B SaaS go-to-market. You understand what a lead, an MQL and a go-live mean, and why the definitions get argued about.Proven experience running outbound or lifecycle campaigns, including prospect research, segmentation, sequencing and reply handling.Excellent written communication. A large part of this role is explaining a number to a senior stakeholder who will act on it, and writing research that stands up to external scrutiny.Comfortable owning systems in production: when a scheduled job fails, you investigate rather than escalate.Hands-on experience with ad platforms and campaign measurement across Google, Meta or emerging AI ad surfaces is a strong plus.A computer science degree or a background as a software engineer is not required. What matters is the judgment to know what is worth building and the ability to direct AI tooling to build it correctly.Why GoKwikAt GoKwik, you work at the intersection of go-to-market, product and data. This role sits on a foundation that already exists: a live platform of internal GTM products, an outbound engine with a scored universe of more than 16,000 D2C brands, and first-party transaction data across 15,000+ merchants that no competitor can replicate. You are not starting from a blank page, and you are not inheriting a backlog of requests — you are taking custody of systems people already use and deciding where they go next.You get unusual autonomy and unusually direct exposure: the freedom to choose what gets built, a short line to senior stakeholders, and work that is visible externally through published research as well as internally through the tools leadership reviews. For someone who wants to build rather than brief, in a performance-driven team with real ownership from week one, there are few roles in Indian eCommerce with this much surface area.Required SkillsAI stakeholder management Problem-solving marketing automation analytics Business growth

title: GMx Manager-Delivery Improvement Design thinking-Strategy And business design
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**GMX- Manager- Delivery Improvement – Design Thinking and Strategy & Business Design**
At EY GDS – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY, Managed Services (MS) is a significant part of our business, comprising more than $7b in revenue with major clients across the globe. We help clients with people based, asset based & integrated solutions, leveraging our deep sector and domain expertise to deliver enhanced value to our clients.
  
  
GMx is part of the Managed Services Global Enabled Business Unit (MS GEBU) that provides end-to-end support for Managed Services (MS) opportunities — from solutioning and pricing to negotiation, contracting, transition, risk management and delivery improvement. Its purpose is to make MS expertise more accessible across Super Regions and Service Lines, as well as to reduce firms risk, reduce fragmentation and improve consistency. **The opportunity**
This team is responsible for identifying systemic bottlenecks, developing and implementing best practices, tools, and methodologies, and driving continuous improvement to elevate client satisfaction and maximize project profitability.

In this role, you will attend and synthesize client and internal meetings, rapidly grasp the proceedings, and convert them into compelling, value‑based slideware, build offering points of view (POVs), and go‑to‑market (GTM) materials. You will also plan and facilitate design thinking workshops to unlock customer‑centric solutions and drive pursuit or delivery outcomes.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 8–10 years overall experience in consulting, strategy, product/solution marketing, or business analysis roles with demonstrated content leadership (POVs, GTM, executive storytelling).

Client & stakeholder engagement

* Rapid creation of PowerPoint presentations
* Build content & structure the output or message basis the enterprise persona
