Design thinking & facilitation
  
  

* Plan and run design thinking workshops (problem framing, empathy, ideation, prototyping) with clear objectives, agendas, and artifacts; drive convergence to prioritized solutions and next steps.
* Coach cross functional teams on DT mindsets, tools, and rapid experiment techniques; convert outputs into tangible deliverables and backlogs.

Engagement delivery & governance
  
  

* Structure workplans, risks, and interlocks across pursuit/delivery workstreams; prepare SteerCo updates and execution dashboards
* Uphold EY quality, brand, and confidentiality standards across all materials and interactions.
* Knowledge & brand stewardship- ensure finalized assets (POVs, GTM decks, credentials) are in alignment to the branding guidelines

* Qualification: MBA or a Master’s degree in any discipline (business, engineering, design, or related field)
* Certifications or prior training in Design Thinking
* Advanced PowerPoint and visual‑storytelling skills; experience working with branded templates and content submission processes
* Build content & structure the output or message basis the enterprise persona
* Business acumen across one or more industries with a track record of leading the engagement
* Strong facilitation background, including scoping and running design‑thinking workshops end‑to‑end
* Proven ability to synthesize meetings into structured narratives, prioritize what matters, and communicate insights to senior stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to communicate complex concepts simply and influence senior stakeholders.

**Core Capabilities:**

* Storytelling & Structure: Builds logical, persuasive narratives; distils complex topics into “executive‑ready” materials, content & output basis the enterprise persona
* Design Thinking & Co‑creation: Applies DT stages (align/discover/define/design/embed); drives outcomes and buy‑in

* Facilitation & Stakeholder Management: Orchestrates workshops, decisions, and interlocks across functions
* Quality & Brand: Adheres to brand and submission standards; curates re‑usable knowledge.
* Solid Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong presentation & communication skills
* Quality oriented personality

**Functional Capabilities:**

* Intellectual Curiosity: A proactive desire to understand current requirement and find new ways to define and prove impact.
* Consulting Mindset: Poised, professional, and capable of managing stakeholder expectations and navigating complex organizational dynamics.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Storytelling & Structure: Builds logical, persuasive narratives; distils complex topics into “executive‑ready” materials, content & output basis the enterprise persona
* Design Thinking & Co‑creation: Applies DT stages (align/discover/define/design/embed); drives outcomes and buy‑in
* GTM & POV Development: Connects problems to solution value; crafts differentiated offering POVs and GTM assets
* Facilitation & Stakeholder Management: Orchestrates workshops, decisions, and interlocks across functions
* Quality & Brand: Adheres to brand and submission standards; curates re‑usable knowledge.
* Solid Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong presentation & communication skills
* Quality oriented personality

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Exceptional capacity for creative thinking and problem identification and resolution.
* Self-driven.
* Keen on detailing and logical reasoning.
* Maintain healthy group dynamics.
* Provide directions to the team based on management directive.
* Capability to engage professionally with individuals from varied cultures and geographic regions.
* Ability to juggle multiple projects/activities simultaneously.

* Acknowledge and commemorate both team and individual achievements, as well as outstanding performance.

**What We Look For**

* Advanced PowerPoint and visual‑storytelling skills; experience working with branded templates and content submission processes
* Business acumen across one or more industries with a track record of leading the engagement
* Strong facilitation background, including scoping and running design‑thinking workshops end‑to‑end
* Proven ability to synthesize meetings into structured narratives, prioritize what matters, and communicate insights to senior stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to communicate complex concepts simply and influence senior stakeholders.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. title: Assistant Director
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Commercial Excellence – Assistant Director**
As an Assistant Director in Strategic Pricing & Insights team under Commercial Excellence, you will specialize in financial and commercial leadership for EY’s large and complex opportunities to improve for winnability and profitability. You will design and execute pricing strategies, work on innovative commercial models, help shape deal constructs, build compelling business cases, architect differentiated competitive strategies, advise engagement teams and articulate the value of EY’s offers to clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**




+ Architect and lead pricing strategies for complex pursuit: Collaborate with pursuit teams and stakeholders to prepare business cases, design commercial structures, analyze proposed solutions, create fit-for-purpose charging models, optimize deal positioning and value proposition, and develop client facing proposals and presentations.
+ Build trust-based relationship with leadership: Provide actionable insights that enable EY leadership to make pricing and commercial decisions that create superior returns for EY by understanding the total value creation of an opportunity and identifying client’s willingness-to-pay.
+ Monetize the value of EY’s differentiated solution, mitigating commercial risks: Design and execute innovative pricing and commercial models (e.g., outcome-based, risk-reward, consumption-based) incorporating behavioral economics techniques to accelerate client value while safeguarding EY’s margin and risk exposure.

Validate solution estimates against typical market approaches to identify sources of differentiated value and/or optimize them for competitiveness.

title: Business Lead, Digital Product Management
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Data Analytics & Computational Sciences
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Business Intelligence
  
  
**Job Category**
Professional
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead is an experienced role bridging business needs and digital solutions while leading and developing a team of professionals.
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements that enable successful delivery and adoption of digital, analytics, automation, data science, and AI products. The role works across business, product, design, data, engineering, quality, and technology partners to identify business needs, define requirements and future-state capabilities, shape product priorities, and guide digital solutions from discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role collaborates closely with Product Managers, and is responsible for leading and developing a team, setting priorities, managing performance, and strengthening business analysis and product management capabilities
  
  
Business Analysis & Problem Definition
  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders, product teams and business analysts to ensure strategic priorities, business processes, pain points, opportunities, risks, and desired outcomes are effectively understood and documented.
* Guide and mentor business analysts in planning and facilitating discovery sessions through stakeholder interviews, workshops, process analysis, data analysis and user research.
* Provide oversight and direction on process and systems assessments, business requirements documentation, epics, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions align with business objectives and product management best practices.
* Review and coach analysts on developing structured recommendations and business cases that support informed decision-making and investment prioritization.

Digital Product Management
  
  

* Lead and develop business analysts, providing guidance on product management practices, prioritization, and execution.
* Support adherence to product management frameworks, governance processes, and ways of working to ensure consistency across products and teams.
* Oversee product vision, roadmaps, backlogs and establish clear priorities for delivery teams.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, data, UX/design, and other teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to leverage digital technologies, data, automation, analytics, and AI to improve business outcomes, assessing whether AI is the appropriate solution based on value, user need, data readiness, feasibility, risk, and required oversight.

**Product Performance & Business Value**

* Review and coach analysts on defining measurable product outcomes, KPIs, adoption metrics, and value measures, including relevant measures for AI-enabled capabilities such as reliability, output quality, user trust, exception rates, and productivity improvement.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for optimization and enhancement, using AI-assisted analysis to detect patterns, adoption barriers, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Track expected and realized value from digital investments, using AI to synthesize performance, financials, adoption, and user data.
* Recommend whether products or capabilities should be enhanced, scaled, consolidated, or retired based on value, performance, adoption, risks, and strategic fit.

Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership
  
  

* Serve as a key connection point between SCE Product Managers and Business Analyst using AI-assisted synthesis to improve shared understanding of needs, decisions, requirements, and delivery implications.
* Build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities and perspectives, using AI to organize inputs, compare options, clarify areas of agreement, conflict, and unresolved risks.
* Facilitate decisions on requirements, priorities, scope, trade-offs, and delivery, using AI-supported analysis to present options and implications while ensuring accountable stakeholders make final decisions.
* Communicate product roadmaps, progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to leadership, using approved AI tools to accelerate concise, audience-appropriate updates that are reviewed for accuracy and context.
* Translate technical and AI concepts, capabilities, limitations, risks, and trade-offs into clear business language, and translate business needs into actionable direction for technology teams.

People Management & Team Development
  
  

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of business analysts, product professionals, and related roles, including building their ability to use approved AI tools responsibly to improve work quality, speed, and business impact.
* Establish clear objectives, priorities, roles, and performance expectations, including expectations for appropriate AI use, verification of outputs, data protection, and accountability for final work products.
* Provide ongoing feedback, coaching, performance management, and career development, using AI-assisted preparation where appropriate while retaining personal judgment and accountability for employee decisions.
* Allocate work and resources based on priorities, capacity, skills, and development opportunities, using AI-supported workload and scenario analysis to inform—not determine—management decisions.
* Mentor team members in business analysis, product management, stakeholder engagement, Agile ways of working, and responsible application of AI to research, synthesis, requirements, testing, and communication.
* Establish consistent standards and best practices for requirements, product documentation, prioritization, delivery, and AI-assisted ways of working, including validation, traceability, privacy, security, and governance expectations.
* Identify capability gaps and create development plans to strengthen team effectiveness, including AI literacy, prompt and context design, critical evaluation of outputs, data fluency, and value measurement.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team culture that encourages responsible experimentation, shared learning, and scaling of proven AI-enabled practices.

**Other Duties**
Cultivate and Sustain Collaboration: Collaborate across teams to build trust, open communication, and shared ownership of project goals.
  
  

* Champion J&J Values: Model J&J C.E.O. Leadership Behaviors and values to reinforce a healthy and motivating workplace culture.
* Support Team Cohesion: Plan and participate in team-building activities, knowledge-sharing sessions, and feedback loops that foster trust, collaboration, and team cohesion.
* Encourage Growth: Support mentorship, and continuous learning within the team.

**Required Minimum Education**
: Bachelor’s Degree (with 7+ years of experience) and/or Master’s Degree (with 5+ years of experience)
  
  
**Required Years Of Related Experience**

* 5+ years of relevant experience

**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Bachelor's degree and/or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering or Supply Chain.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, product management, digital transformation, technology delivery, or related disciplines in highly regulated business environments.
* Demonstrated people management experience, including coaching, performance management, prioritization, and employee development.
* Digital acumen and strong business analysis experience, including process analysis, requirements definition, future-state design, and stakeholder facilitation.
* Experience managing digital products or technology-enabled capabilities through multiple stages of the product lifecycle.
* Experience developing product roadmaps, managing backlogs, writing requirements/user stories, and prioritizing features.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development and cross-functional delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with business, engineering, architecture, data, and other technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and decision-making skills.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to engage senior leaders
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Accountability, Advanced Analytics, Analytical Reasoning, Business Intelligence (BI), Business Requirements Analysis, Communication, Data Analysis, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data Privacy Standards, Organizing, Problem Solving, Statistical Analysis Systems (SAS) Programming, Systems Development, Technical Credibility, Technical Writing, Workflow Analysis

title: Director of Product Management
description:
**Who are we?**
RZR Global is an AI-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Director/Senior Director of Product Management to lead the strategy and execution for our DSP Platform,Connected TV (CTV) product line and new initiative . This role owns the foundations that make the DSP scalable and self-serve (campaign workflows, bidding/pacing primitives, reporting/measurement surfaces, APIs, experimentation), while also driving CTV-specific capabilities (supply integrations, deal mechanics, creative standards, measurement, brand safety, and performance).
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of engineering, data/ML, ad operations, supply partnerships, and revenue teams, translating market needs into platform bets and shipping roadmaps that improve scale, performance, reliability, and margin. The ideal candidate has deep programmatic advertising experience (especially CTV), strong platform product instincts, and a track record of building and leading high-performing PM teams.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Product Strategy & Roadmap (Platform + CTV)
  
  

* Define and communicate a 12-24 month product vision for DSP Platform and CTV aligned with company OKRs (revenue growth, margin, scale, retention).
* Own the roadmap and prioritization across platform investments and CTV-specific capabilities (supply, deals, measurement, creative, policy).
* Build business cases for major initiatives and decide build vs buy vs partner.

**Sprint Planning & Delivery Monitoring**

* Lead sprint planning and backlog grooming for Platform and CTV squads: define sprint goals, prioritize work, clarify scope, confirm capacity, and manage cross-team dependencies.
* Ensure stories are execution-ready with clear acceptance criteria, instrumentation requirements, rollout plans, and a shared Definition of Ready/Done.
* Monitor sprint delivery health using lightweight metrics (commit vs complete, velocity trends, cycle time, blocked work) and drive corrective actions (re-prioritization, scope management, escalation of blockers).
* Facilitate sprint reviews and retrospectives to improve predictability, quality, and team health; convert learnings into backlog actions and process improvements.

DSP Platform Ownership (Foundational Capabilities)
  
  

* Drive improvements in campaign creation & management (self-serve UX, bulk tools, validations, rules).
* Own bidding & decisioning primitives (targeting, frequency, pacing, budget control, bid modifiers).
* Improve experimentation & measurement surfaces (A/B testing, lift frameworks, reporting truth sources).
* Evolve reporting & insights (near-real-time performance, diagnostics, alerting, finance reconciliation).
* Own APIs & integrations (advertiser/agency workflows, trafficking, data onboarding).
* Partner with engineering to set and maintain reliability, latency, and throughput SLOs for platform-critical systems.

CTV Product Leadership (Demand + Supply + Measurement)
  
  

* Own end-to-end CTV buying experience: inventory access, deal support (PMP/PG), targeting, creative QA, brand safety, and measurement integrations.
* Partner with Supply/Partnerships and AdOps to expand CTV reach while protecting quality (fraud mitigation, allow/block controls, supply-path insights).
* Ensure compatibility and operational excellence across industry standards

Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM

title: Assistant Branch Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

At JP Morgan Chase, we understand that customers seek exceptional value and a seamless experience from a trusted financial institution. That's why we launched Chase UK to transform digital banking with intuitive and enjoyable customer journeys. With a strong foundation of trust established by millions of customers in the US, we have been rapidly expanding our presence in the UK and soon across Europe. We have been building the bank of the future from the ground up, offering you the chance to join us and make a significant impact.

As a Data Domain Architect Assoc Senior within the International Consumer Bank (ICB), you will play a pivotal role in advancing the integration of Chase and JPMorgan Personal Investing data platforms to support business growth and scalability. You will contribute to the design and delivery of high-performing, scalable data products and datasets within a medallion-architected data lake house environment. These solutions will power analytics, reporting, operational processes, data science initiatives, and regulatory use cases across the organization.

Working within a global, cross-functional team of engineers, analysts, and product managers, you will help define data architecture standards, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and ensure the quality, performance, and governance of critical data assets.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Partner with business stakeholders, analysts, and platform users to understand data requirements, business objectives, and functional needs.
* Design scalable, reliable, and performant data architectures and domain models that support enterprise data products and analytical workloads.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to develop and enhance data pipelines, datasets, and lakehouse solutions aligned with architectural standards and best practices.
* Validate and test data models, transformations, and enhancements to ensure accuracy, quality, and alignment with business requirements.
* Establish and maintain technical documentation, data definitions, lineage information, and user-facing documentation supporting platform capabilities.
* Implement and manage data quality controls, validation frameworks, reconciliations, and operational runbooks to ensure data integrity and platform reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement and innovation by identifying opportunities to optimize data structures, processes, and platform performance.
* Support Agile delivery practices and contribute to the successful execution of strategic data initiatives across global teams.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Minimum 6+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Management, Business Analysis, or a related field.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale data platforms, data products, and analytical solutions.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling concepts, experience designing and implementing scalable data products within a Lakehouse Medallion Architecture.
* Ability to translate complex business problems into scalable technical solutions and actionable requirements.
* Experience collaborating effectively within Agile and cross-functional teams while managing responsibilities independently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders across varying levels of technical expertise.
* Proven analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Self-motivated with the ability to manage priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
* Passion for driving innovation, operational excellence, and adoption of data best practices.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Experience within Financial Services, Wealth Management, Investment Management, Brokerage, or Consumer Banking environments.
* Knowledge of modern cloud-based data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and enterprise data ecosystems.
* Familiarity with data governance, regulatory reporting, and data quality management frameworks.
* Experience supporting analytical use cases including business intelligence, data science, operational reporting, and commercial analytics.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

title: Bio Market Development Manager
description:
Overview:

The **Bio Market Development Manager** is primarily responsible for identifying, developing, and managing the biologics marketing strategy to support current and mid-term business opportunities in the region. As an integral part of team, the person is required to work with other cross-functional team such sales, marketing, service etc... within the broader India organization, as well as global stakeholders to execute global and regional initiatives to drive customer satisfaction and success.

This role is an important interface between customers and development of cutting-edge LC and MS based measurement solutions.A successful candidate’s scientific expertise and marketing knowledge will provide a strong foundation for success, while Waters’ commitment to talent development offers exceptional opportunities to achieve their long-term career aspirations.

  
Responsibilities:

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define the strategy and coordinate the activity across a network of regional business development teams to grow the lead and opportunity pipeline via customer events and key account activities at customer events and key account visits
* Manage INDIA biopharma & Biologics campaigns with the Demand Generation team using market specific content and Waters Compass platform to drive customer engagement and sales opportunities and measure campaign effectiveness using appropriate metrics
* Develop and manage marketing tactics through various marketing channels such as industry events, seminars, digital (webinar and email) campaigns, targeted account-based marketing etc. to drive near-term business goals and strategic thought leadership
* Work with India Biologics stakeholders in campaign localization including but not limited to marketing collaterals, training support and alignment of local initiatives/campaigns to meet country sales objectives
* Build an in-depth knowledge of the needs of Biopharma/Large Molecule customers
* Manage relationships across a matrixed organization with Professional Services teams, Sales, Marketing and Commercial Operations regionally and globally.
* Plan and Execute multidimensional marketing plan across the India region
* Collaborate with key opinion leaders to bring their stories of scientific success to a worldwide audience
* Provide the voice of the Biopharmaceutical customer to corporate Product Management to ensure the needs of Indian customers are fed into the development of new solutions
* Provide accurate business analysis reports to make data driven marketing decisions
* Build customer facing presentations and audio-visual content to support sales enablement
* Provide regular market research updates through various sources (external and internal) to keep up with latest market development in biopharmaceuticals industry.

Qualifications:

**Key Requirements & Experience:**

* Honours Science Degree or higher
* MBA or post graduate qualifications is preferred

**Experience**:

* More than 10 years in bio pharma / Biologics industry is compulsory

* Business to Business marketing with a scientific bias ideally involving Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry i.e. HRMS etc. in the Biopharmaceutical & Large Molecule industry/Institutions
* Experience in biopharmaceutical/biotech &/or large molecules institutions with deep understanding of biopharmaceutical R&D processes/workflows and associated regulations
* Experience in LC/MS (HRMS) method development and/or analysis of biopharmaceuticals is desirable
* Experience in emerging biopharmaceutical modalities and gene & cell therapies is a plus

**Competencies:**

* In depth understanding of Biopharmaceutical analysis with LC and MS based systems
* Marketing Plan development and execution
* Strong communication skills, Presentation both oral and written
* Team ethic with a passion for customer success

**Travel:**

* Travel in PAN India
* Up to 30% to 40% of working time travelling

Company Description:

Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of ~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

*Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.*

title: Client Partner Manager
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.  
  
**Description**  
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Bangalore team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.  
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.  
Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
Experience in gaming app category preferred.  
Experience managing a sales team preferred  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.  
Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Build Your Career At CRY**
----------------------------

We believe in the power of every individual’s potential and rely on the values of justice and equity to drive our work culture.

Our longest serving employee has worked in CRY for over 31 years so we’re clearly doing something right that resonates with our people – and that is making a real difference!

  

#### ***Senior Manager (Brand)***

*Bangalore*

***Location:*** *Bangalore*

***Function:*** *Communications*

***About CRY:***  
*Recognized as India’s most trusted NGO, Child Rights and You (CRY) works tirelessly to ensure happier and healthier childhoods for India’s underprivileged children.*

*CRY addresses children’s critical needs by working with parents, teachers, Anganwadi workers, communities, district and state level governments as well as the children themselves. Over the last 4 decades, CRY has impacted the lives of over 4.7 million children across 20 states in India.*

***Your Challenges:***

*Does it anger you to see children who have lost their childhood? Are you outraged when you see human rights being violated? Do you believe that people have the power to change our world for the better?*

*Do you stand up for what is right?*

*If you do, then read on…*

*At CRY – Child Rights and You, every single person works towards creating a happier, more ‘just’ world for children. We have opportunities in our Communication function, tailor-made for people with the passion, drive and intelligence, and the urge to face new challenges.*

***Your Role:***

*As a person in this position, you will be responsible for managing one of India’s best-known non-profit brands. You will formulate and execute national communication plans in collaboration with the Resource Generation and Volunteer Action teams.*

*The role will involve developing and executing creatives, marketing and branding materials to strengthen the CRY brand and promote its related products. You will collaborate with internal functions to implement communication plans and effectively engage CRY stakeholders. You will also be responsible for managing and maintaining CRY’s web presence, including the CRY website and the organisation’s information across various digital platforms.*

*Additionally, you will ensure appropriate brand visibility through the sourcing of media space on a free-of-cost or discounted basis and manage vendors for branding, communication and media-related activities.*

***You:***

*You must be a Graduate/Post Graduate in Marketing/ Brand Communications or Humanities/ Cultural Studies with 7 to 9 years’ experience in a brand communications role in a mid-sized, multi-location organization. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English is essential. Experience in a similar field will be an added advantage.*

***Write in:*** *Please email your application to careers@crymail.org mentioning the post applied for on the subject line.*

title: Senior Category Manager–South Business
description:
Senior Category Manager–South

Business

Location: Bengaluru | Company: AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir)

About AppsForBharat

At AppsForBharat, we are building Sri Mandir, a platform that helps millions of devotees

connect with their faith through technology. Our v ision is to make religious and spiritual

experiences more accessible by combining deep cultural understanding with innovative

digital experiences.

We are looking for a Senior Category Manager – South Business to build and scale our

South-focused puja business. This is an entrepreneurial role for someone who can own

business outcomes end-to-end, make sharp commercial decisions, and build a differentiated

category by understanding customer needs, rituals, product assortment, and pricing.

The Role

As the Senior Category Manager, you will own the South business P&L and drive its growth

by building a relevant product catalog, defining pricing strategies, identifying new business

opportunities, and improving app orders and customer conversion.

You will work closely with the puja calendar owner, marketing, creative, product, and

retention teams, to translate regional rituals, festivals, and customer insights into

commercially successful offerings.

This role offers the opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up, with

significant ownership and the ability to shape category strategy.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business & P&L Ownership

* Own the end-to-end P&L for the South business, driving revenue growth, profitability,

and sustainable business performance.

* Define business goals, key performance indicators, and category-level growth plans.

* Identify opportunities to improve margins, increase average order value (AOV), and

drive repeat purchases.

* Track business performance, identify gaps, and take data-backed decisions to

improve outcomes.

2. Category Strategy & Catalog Development

* Build and scale a differentiated South-focused puja catalog based on regional

customer needs, rituals, and preferences.

* Define product assortment, SKUs, bundles, and offerings for key rituals, festivals,

and everyday devotional needs.

* Identify underserved customer segments and new category opportunities.

* Work with relevant teams to evaluate product feasibility, availability, and operational

readiness before launching new offerings.

* Continuously refine the catalog based on customer demand, sales performance, and

emerging opportunities.

3. Pricing & Commercial Strategy

* Define pricing strategies for new and existing offerings, balancing customer value,

competitiveness, and profitability.

* Run pricing experiments to understand customer willingness to pay and improve

conversion.

* Evaluate product-level economics, margins, discounts, and promotional

effectiveness.

* Develop strategies for bundling, upselling, and cross-selling to improve revenue per

order.

4. Growth & App Order Expansion

* Drive growth in South business orders through relevant category initiatives and

customer-focused offerings.

* Identify opportunities across app discovery, merchandising, conversion funnels, and

customer journeys.

* Partner with product and growth teams to improve category visibility, conversion, and

repeat engagement.

* Analyse customer behaviour and business data to identify growth levers and

prioritise high-impact initiatives.

5. Festival, Ritual & Consumer Insights

* Partner closely with the puja calendar owner to understand upcoming festivals,

regional rituals, and high-intent purchase occasions.

* Translate festival calendars and ritual insights into relevant products, bundles,

campaigns, and launch plans.

* Develop a deep understanding of South Indian devotional practices and differences

in customer preferences across regions.

* Use customer feedback, market research, and sales trends to continuously improve

the category proposition.

6. Cross-functional Execution

* Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns,

product communication, and festival-led initiatives.

* Work with product, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure smooth execution

of category launches and business initiatives.

* Drive alignment across stakeholders and ensure timely execution of priorities.

* Take ownership of outcomes while operating with limited hand-holding in a

fast-paced environment.

What We're Looking For

* Category management experience: Experience managing a category or business

with clear ownership of commercial outcomes, revenue, or P&L.

* Strong commercial acumen: Ability to make sound decisions on pricing,

assortment, margins, promotions, and business growth.

* Entrepreneurial mindset: Comfortable building from the ground up, navigating

ambiguity, and taking end-to-end ownership.

* Analytical thinking: Ability to interpret business metrics, identify opportunities, and

convert insights into actionable growth plans.

* Customer-centricity: Strong understanding of consumer behaviour and the ability to

build offerings around customer needs.

* Execution excellence: Ability to work cross-functionally, manage multiple priorities,

and deliver measurable business outcomes.

* Learning agility: Curiosity to understand South Indian rituals, regional nuances, and

devotional customer needs, even without prior domain expertise.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C, online marketplaces, or other

consumer internet businesses.

* Experience managing a category or business with revenue and profitability targets.

* Exposure to assortment planning, pricing experiments, promotions, merchandising,

and conversion optimization.

* Familiarity with South Indian markets, regional consumer behaviour, or devotional

categories is an advantage, but not mandatory.

Why Join Us?

* Own and build a business with direct accountability for P&L and growth.

* Work at the intersection of consumer internet, commerce, and India's rich devotional

ecosystem.

* Build differentiated offerings for a large and diverse customer base.

* Work closely with cross-functional teams and influence business strategy.

* Take on an entrepreneurial role with the opportunity to create meaningful,

measurable impact.

title: Channel Account Manager
description:
TechBiz Global is a international recruitment and talent acquisition consultancy connecting world-class companies with top-tier professionals globally. We are currently sourcing talent on behalf of an industry leader in cybersecurity distribution.

Our client is a next-generation cybersecurity value-added distributor providing end-to-end security solutions tailored to diverse enterprise requirements. Focusing on enabling secure digital transformation through advanced, scalable, and adaptable technologies, they collaborate closely with leading global vendors and regional partners to address evolving cyber threats.

Team members benefit from working in a dynamic environment with a strong emphasis on innovation, customer success, and competitive differentiation in the cybersecurity market.

We are seeking an experienced **Channel Account Manager** to be based on-site in Bengaluru. In this key role, you will manage and grow relationships with channel partners including distributors, resellers, and system integrators to drive revenue growth and market expansion for an industry-leading cybersecurity portfolio.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Partner Ecosystem Management:** Identify, onboard, and build long-term relationships with strategic channel partners, resellers, and system integrators.
* **Business Planning & Strategy:** Develop and execute joint business and go-to-market (GTM) plans, set revenue targets, and conduct regular business reviews with key partners.
* **Sales & Pipeline Execution:** Track pipeline metrics, forecast revenue, negotiate deals, and manage sales reporting using modern CRM tools.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Coordinate seamlessly with internal sales, technical, and marketing teams to provide ongoing sales enablement and technical support to partners.
* **Enablement & Satisfaction:** Ensure partner teams are well-trained on product offerings and value propositions while maintaining high levels of partner satisfaction.
* **Market Intelligence:** Stay current on cybersecurity industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor strategies to continuously strengthen the channel value proposition.

* **Channel Sales Expertise:** Proven track record in channel sales and partner management within a high-performing partner ecosystem.
* **Industry Background:** Relevant experience in Cybersecurity, IT Distribution, or Enterprise Technology solutions.
* **Account & Relationship Management:** Strong capability to drive revenue growth, negotiate complex deals, and maintain sustainable partner ties.
* **Analytical & Strategic Skills:** Proficient in business planning, basic financial analysis for forecasting, and managing pipeline metrics via CRM platforms.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills across both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field (MBA or equivalent business qualification is a plus).
* **Location Commitment:** Ability to work full-time on-site at the client’s Bengaluru office.

title: Business Development Associate – US
description:

Founded by Neelakantha Bhanu Prakash, the World’s Fastest Human Calculator and a TEDx speaker, Bhanzu delivers high-energy, concept-first learning experiences that help students build confidence in math and analytical thinking.

title: Assistant Manager - Sales
description:

title: TPM/RGM Practice SME
description:
TPM & RGM Practice SME
  
  
**About The Role**
Cognizant’s Industry Solutions Group (ISG) is seeking a senior TPM & RGM Practice SME for the Consumer Goods practice. This individual will serve as Cognizant’s primary domain authority for Trade Promotion Management and Revenue Growth Management — driving pre-sales solutioning, building platform alliances, representing Cognizant at industry forums, and providing functional advisory support on client engagements.
  
  
Primary platform focus: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM (first preference) and XTEL TPM/RGM (second preference).
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain & Solutioning Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the TPM/RGM domain authority across Cognizant’s Consumer Goods practice — designing end-to-end solution architectures covering trade planning, fund management, promotion execution, deduction management, and RGM analytics.
* Lead client solution design workshops and discovery sessions, driving alignment between business objectives (volume, margin, trade ROI) and platform capabilities.

Pre-Sales & Bid Support
  
  

* Lead RFP/RFI responses as the primary TPM/RGM domain voice — authoring solution narratives, effort models, and PoC demonstrations for Salesforce CG Cloud and XTEL engagements.
* Collaborate with Sales and Delivery teams on pursuit strategy and competitive positioning; build and maintain reusable solution accelerators, proposal templates, and reference architectures.

Thought Leadership & Practice Development
  
  

* Publish whitepapers, point-of-view papers, and industry blogs on TPM/RGM trends, platform innovations, and CPG commercial technology; represent Cognizant at conferences and speaking engagements.
* Build and contribute to Cognizant’s TPM/RGM CoE — defining best practices, developing delivery playbooks and reusable assets, and mentoring junior consultants within the Consumer Goods practice.

Alliance & Partnership Management
  
  

* Serve as Cognizant’s primary relationship manager with key TPM/RGM platform partners — Salesforce CG Cloud, XTEL, and relevant ISVs — nurturing joint GTM engagement, co-sell pipeline, and aligned solution roadmaps.
* Track partner roadmaps and identify partnership opportunities with CPG ecosystem players (o9, Anaplan, BluePlanner) to extend Cognizant’s TPM/RGM service portfolio; develop joint collateral and partner sales plays.

Industry Forum Participation & External Engagement
  
  

* Represent Cognizant at CPG technology conferences and industry forums (Salesforce Consumer Goods Summit, CGT events, XTEL user groups); deliver presentations and panel discussions on trade transformation and AI-driven RGM.
* Engage analyst communities (Gartner, Forrester, IDC) to position Cognizant’s capabilities; build an external professional network across CPG trade marketing and technology communities to generate leads and surface new service opportunities.

Techno-Functional Lead — Customer Project Support
  
  

* Serve as senior functional advisor on select engagements — providing domain expertise during blueprint, fit-gap, and go-live phases without owning day-to-day workstream delivery.
* Act as the functional escalation point for delivery teams — resolving complex design decisions and conducting periodic quality reviews of solution documents and test plans.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
Domain & Technical Skills
  
  

* Deep functional expertise in TPM (trade planning, fund management, promotion execution, settlement, deduction management, post-event analytics) and RGM (pricing strategy, pack-price architecture, mix management, net revenue optimization).
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM (primary) — account planning, fund configuration, promotion lifecycle, deduction management, and MuleSoft integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with XTEL TPM/RGM (second preference) — trade fund setup, promotion planning, claims processing, and SAP/Oracle ERP integration architecture.
* Experience on at least 2 full-cycle TPM/RGM implementations; proficiency in delivery artifacts (BRDs, fit-gap documents, configuration workbooks, UAT scripts) and platform partner/alliance engagement.

Pre-Sales & Consulting Skills
  
  

* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills — able to influence VP/Director-level stakeholders; proven track record contributing to and winning CPG/Consumer Goods RFPs.
* Strong analytical and problem-structuring skills; ability to translate business challenges into platform solutions and produce high-quality proposals, PoVs, and solution collateral.

title: Manufacturing Process Improvement Engineer
description:

This position works closely with design engineers, equipment vendors, program managers, marketing, and quality engineers to support the development of new electromechanical products. This includes the development of new equipment and process flows as well as developing cost estimates for labor and capital. They will also provide ongoing sustaining support to production lines at our global make sites.  
  
This role is more focused on process validation, ongoing process development, yield improvement and cost improvement.

* Key participant in the development of new production processes and/or adapt existing production processes for assembly, calibration and testing
* Define specifications for production equipment and interact with mechanization (in house) and/or equipment suppliers to ensure equipment will meet specifications
* Key participant in global new product development project teams to enable successful launch of new products
* Collaborate with other departments on process specifications, quality aspects, product specifications and continuity of equipment
* Influence product designs during new product development phase to ensure economical and defect free manufacture
* Developing new or improved manufacturing and testing processes that are necessary to achieve the performance and cost requirements of future device applications
* Organize the arranging of sample lines and process development equipment
* Key participant in advanced quality planning activities
* Coordinates all functional requirements, the reviewing of designs and debugging /qualifying new high volume assembly /test equipment or tooling
* Transferring knowledge to make site personnel
* Support improvement projects to reduce cycle time, defects and manufacturing costs
* Work with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure processes are capable, have sufficient controls in place, can meet out delivery requirements, and meet our cost targets
* Evaluate technical capabilities including tooling design, build experience, maintenance program, processes and process controls, cell automation- if required, quality control systems, and material knowledge

* A university degree required (i.e. Bachelors degree) or equivalent relevant work experience
* Must be a team player able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
* Strong communication skills; oral, written and presentation
* Strong organization, planning and time management skills to achieve results
* Strong personal and professional ethical values and integrity
* Holds self-accountable to achieving goals and standards

* Proven experience improving production yield, reducing scrap/process variation and delivering manufacturing cost improvements.

* Conduct regular plant visits to support outage planning, improve plant performance, reduce downtime, and promote IMI CCI aftermarket solutions.
* Build and maintain long‑term relationships with plant owners/operators to secure ongoing business and future sales references.
* Plan and manage sales activities by ensuring accurate, up‑to‑date information in the CRM (SFDC).
* Stay informed about global and local market trends, upcoming projects, and relevant industry events within the assigned territory.

  

**Sales**

* Maintain and regularly update all commercial activities in the IMI CCI CRM as per management requirements.
* Stay informed on customer tender portals/sources and record them in CRM.
* Coordinate with inside sales to obtain and submit budgetary proposals for customer outages.
* Receive RFQs, translate/clarify, and forward them to inside sales promptly.
* Review proposals from inside sales and submit them to customers quickly, preferably in person.
* Actively follow up on submitted proposals.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As our products and services scale the globe, we work behind the scenes to secure infrastructure to build Google's future. The Strategic Partnership Office is the organization that operates at the intersection of industrial innovation, external affairs, and civic impact, creating bridges between Google’s technology capabilities and the real-world partners that extend our reach and mission.
  
  
As part of the SPO (Strategic Partnership Office), the Economic and Community Development team is a vertically integrated organization responsible for analyzing and mitigating economic, community, and labor risks to deliver an optimized inventory of assets meeting the operating needs of the business, and to ensure economic growth and resilience leveraging place-based strategies our markets. title: Manager Software Engineering
description:
**Manager Software Engineering**

  

**Are you passionate about leading engineering teams that build high-volume production systems using modern technologies?**

  

**Would you like to combine Java, Springboot and GEN AI experience with technical leadership in the healthcare space?**

  

**About the Business**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Healthcare vertical, our solutions focus on transforming operations and improving health outcomes across the healthcare industry. While our solutions are centered around robust data assets, we also leverage sophisticated technology, applied analytics and deep healthcare expertise while ensuring the highest standards of privacy and security to help healthcare organizations make confident decisions and solve complex challenges. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/healthcare .

  

**About the Team**

We organize our engineering teams into collaborative Squads that bring together Software Engineers, Quality Engineers, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to build and deliver customer-focused solutions.

Our teams value continuous learning, innovation, inclusivity, and shared ownership. We encourage engineers to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, mentor others, and help shape the future of our products and platforms.

  

**About the Role**

You will lead and develop an engineering team delivering production systems and high-volume applications, while remaining close enough to the technology to contribute when needed. You will work across Engineering, Product, and Design, helping the team deliver commitments, solve complex technical challenges, and build expertise in Java, Springboot and GEN AI.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Empower, guide, and maximize a team of mission-driven engineers to solve challenging problems in the aviation industry by building using cutting-edge technology.
* Collaborate with Engineering leadership and cross-functional partners (including Product, Design, Marketing) to establish roadmaps and strategy that help serve and grow the business and represent engineering-driven considerations to ensure all stakeholder groups are aligned on company priorities, expectations, and contingencies.
* Contribute to technical development and discussions as necessary to ensure the team is building technology that scales and meets the business needs by Providing both ongoing support and mentorship to direct reports, strategically aligning their skills, interests, and career aspirations with business needs; defining, streamlining, and guiding the projects they work on; and both initiating and inviting conversations around performance, development, and morale
* Deliver results in the fast-paced environment of a growing startup while always treating team members and colleagues with empathy & humanity
* Successfully partner and lead resources in solving complex business needs. Perform reviews to ensure enterprise and architectural standards and processes are followed. Complete management responsibilities to include performance management, hiring and coaching of staff, and resource planning.
* Carry out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies, procedures, and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems.
* Ensure all staff is provided with training and resources needed to perform their jobs to the most outstanding degree possible. Ensure all staff is provided with frequent feedback and coaching in order to meet and exceed individual and team performance goals consistently.
* Manage and encourage new ideas from staff to foster improvements through innovations. Empower the staff to be accountable and responsible for their own actions and decisions. All other duties as assigned.
  

**Requirements**

* Experience with technologies mainly focused on Java and Springboot background in addition to GEN AI exposure.
* Background in the healthcare space or related field is an added advantage with atleast 4+ years of team lead or engineering management experience with Proven track record of effectively developing direct reports through continual feedback and goal-setting and growing them through the ranks of an engineering organization.
* Advanced understanding of modern software development practices and methodologies, and the ability to roll up your sleeves and contribute when necessary
* Experience directly working on or managing teams working on production systems and high-volume applications, successfully navigating the relationship between Engineering, Product, and Design teams with collaboration, mentoring, learning from other engineers, and treating colleagues with empathy and respect.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with all stakeholders, internal drive to problem-solve, both creatively and pragmatically to scope, prioritize, and deliver on project commitments and learn new technologies quickly.
* Strong skills in setting, communicating, implementing, and achieving business objectives and goals through the direct management of others.
* Strong organization/project planning, time management, and change management skills across multiple functional groups and departments, and strong delegation skills involving prioritizing and reprioritizing projects and managing projects of various size and complexity.
* Advanced problem-solving experience involving leading teams in identifying, researching, and coordinating the resources necessary to effectively troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues; prior success extracting/translating findings into alternatives/solutions; and identifying risks/impacts and schedule adjustments to facilitate management decision-making.

title: Analyst, Relationship Manager, Credit Program Small, Small Medium Enterprises
description:
**Business Function**

Corporate and Investment Banking provides corporate customers with a full range of Commercial banking products and services including cash management services, current accounts time deposits, trade finance, working capital finance, term loans and foreign exchange, Through our continued commitment, DBS has cultivated long standing relationships with its customers in the region that are based on account relationship management, service differentiation product development and rigorous credit standards.

**Job Purpose**

* To acquire and build a well diversified portfolio within the IBG 4 segment. The portfolio should provide revenue from diversified sources such as assets, trade, cash, treasury, fees etc. and the portfolio should lead to a healthy income with an acceptable risk to the bank.
* The Relationship Manager is expected to deliver these results in accordance with the lending guidelines prescribed by the bank.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Source New to Bank Asset relationships within IBG 4 Segment up to T/O of 100 Crore, aligned to Bank Lending Policy
* Ensure a good Net Interest Income as well as fee across the portfolio and also ensure regular revenue streams through Cross Sell of Trade, Liabilities, Cash, Treasury, Fee, etc.
* Play an instrumental role in increasing the Profitability of the Branch.
* Ensure proper monitoring of Portfolio and maintaining the delinquencies at NIL.
* Implement & execute IBG4 business strategy to increase market share & to achieve targets consistent with IBG4 –Topline and Bottom line targets with focus on a diversified portfolio and reduce concentration risk in the portfolio.
* Build DBS Brand Value and enhance network in the location by various marketing activities, collaborations and events.
* To comply with the Bank’s process & policies and ensure positive ratings during all Country / Group audits

**Job Duties & responsibilities**

* Source New to Bank Asset relationships within IBG 4 Segment up to T/O of 25 Crore, aligned to Bank Lending Policy and also ensure sanction and disbursement of the same, in liaison with Customer, Risk and Operations team.
* Cross Sell of Asset, Trade, Cash and Treasury Product actively.
* To achieve the individual Budgeted revenues through all product parameters
* Conduct Proper Due diligence while on-boarding New Asset Relationships.
* On board clients with a clear account plan highlighting the revenue potential, risks and mitigants.
* Increase the wallet share with the customer by constantly exploring opportunities to cross sell other products offered by the bank.
* Constant Monitoring of the Portfolio and ensure Timely Renewals. Provide regular feedback to the credit and portfolio team about various developments in the client’s business. Work closely with the monitoring team for early warning signals and take appropriate actions as identified.
* Thorough monitoring of accounts sourced and keep track on customer’s business and report any early warning signals.
* Ensure Timely Renewals of Accounts.
* Ensure that the covenants and conditions prescribed by the credit team are consistently met.
* Adherence to strict KYC/AML requirements.
* MIS to be provided to the central team for further reporting, within the stipulated guidelines.
* Timely Completion of Learning Programs as assigned by DBS for time to time
* To comply with the Bank’s process & policies.
* To be in touch with local business stakeholders including existing, prospective clients, market leaders, CA’s, Influencer’s and Industry association to be updated on the current market practice and local intelligence.
* To be responsible for submitting any material information around business Opportunities and Industry/Customer Risk, same shall be reported to the senior functional management at regular interval.

**Requirements**

* Overall 3- 5 years of experience in sales.
* 2-3 years of sales experience in SME/Business Banking Lending.
* 2-3 years experience in Working Capital sales and service portfolio
* Proven sales track record in asset business in the SME/Business Banking segment.
* Knowledge of competitors and marketplace
* Market knowledge and experience in the SME segment, with reference to customer preferences and requirement is preferred.

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelors in finance / Economics/Commerce or MBA or CA

**Core Competencies**

* Excellent Communication & Listening Skills, Good Sales & Negotiation Skills

**Technical Competencies**

* Working Capital Finance Knowledge

**Work Relationship**

* Manager / Direct Report

**DBS India - Culture & Behaviors**

DBS is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Expected value driven behaviors are:

* Demonstrate Business Performance through PRIDE 2.0 Value Based Propositions
* Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers & Reduce Complaints
* Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Self Knowledge, Skills and develop Competencies aimed at continuous improvement
* Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity.

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and versatile **Executive Assistant & Operations Manager** to oversee day-to-day short-term rental operations, provide high-level administrative support to the Business Owner, and drive business development initiatives for **Sajavat Couture**.

This multi-faceted hybrid role requires excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, high hospitality standards, and a passion for luxury fashion client relations. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic environment, easily switches between administrative tasks and client-facing communication, and takes full ownership of assigned projects.

Key Responsibilities

1. Airbnb & Property Management Operations

* **Guest Communication & Experience:** Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective and staying guests. Respond promptly to inquiries, manage bookings, send pre-arrival details, and answer questions to ensure a 5-star experience.
* **Turnover & Logistics Coordination:** Coordinate cleaning schedules, property maintenance, handymen, and restocking of essential supplies between guest stays.
* **Listing & Revenue Optimization:** Maintain listing accuracy, update calendars, monitor pricing to maximize occupancy/revenue, and manage guest reviews.
* **Problem Resolution:** Handle guest requests, troubleshooting, or property emergencies efficiently and diplomatically.

2. Executive Assistance to Owner

* **Calendar & Schedule Management:** Organize personal and business calendars, schedule meetings, set reminders, and prevent scheduling conflicts.
* **Inbox & Correspondence Handling:** Manage internal/external correspondence.
* **Travel & Personal Support:** Arrange travel itineraries, book transport/accommodations, track expenses, and manage minor personal administrative errands as needed.
* **Task Tracking:** Act as a reliable gatekeeper and central organizer to ensure priority projects and deadlines are met across all business ventures.

3. Business Development & Client Outreach

* **Catalog Distribution & Sales Outreach:** Proactively share digital lookbooks, line sheets, and product catalogs for new Sajavat Couture collections with target clients, retailers, and high-value buyers.
* **Client Relationship Management:** Maintain and update the client database (CRM/WhatsApp Business), log client preferences, and follow up on inquiries or pending orders.
* **Lead Generation Support:** Identify prospective sales channels, boutique partners, or private clients to expand brand reach.
* **Order & Inquiry Support:** Assist with initial client consultations, sizing queries, custom order follow-ups, and post-purchase communications.

Qualifications & Key Requirements

* **Experience:** 1+ years of experience in administrative, hospitality management (Airbnb/short-term rentals), luxury retail, or business development roles.
* **Tech Proficiency:** Airbnb Hosting platform and management tools. Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) / MS Office. Messaging & CRM tools (WhatsApp Business, Instagram DM management, basic email marketing software).
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* **Organizational Skills:** Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing tasks, multitask effectively, and operate independently with minimal oversight.
