title: Senior Brand Manager
description:
Job Description: Senior Brand Manager

**Company:** Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** Senior Brand Manager  
**Department:** Branding & Marketing Strategy  
**Location:** Kharadi, Pune – Head Office  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 4+ Years  
**Salary:** ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 per month, depending on skills and experience  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM

About Osumare Marketing Solutions

Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a full-service branding and digital marketing agency offering integrated solutions across brand strategy, brand identity, creative communication, website development, performance marketing, social media management, SEO, and digital growth.

We work with brands across multiple industries to build distinctive brand identities, strengthen market positioning, improve customer engagement, and drive business growth through strategic and creative marketing solutions.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and creative **Senior Brand Manager** who can independently handle end-to-end brand strategy, brand positioning, communication planning, campaign conceptualization, and brand development for the agency's clients.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding client businesses, researching target audiences and competitors, developing brand strategies, defining brand communication, and ensuring consistent brand execution across digital and offline touchpoints.

The ideal candidate should combine strategic thinking, creative excellence, strong communication skills, and practical execution capabilities. The candidate must be comfortable coordinating with internal creative, content, social media, web development, and performance marketing teams to translate brand strategies into effective marketing campaigns.

Key Responsibilities1. Brand Strategy & Positioning

* Develop comprehensive brand strategies aligned with client business objectives, target audiences, and market opportunities.
* Define brand positioning, value propositions, brand purpose, brand personality, and key differentiators.
* Conduct brand discovery and audits to understand existing brand perception, strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities.
* Identify target audience segments, customer personas, purchase motivations, and consumer behaviour.
* Develop brand positioning frameworks and strategic recommendations to establish a distinctive market presence.
* Ensure brand strategies are commercially relevant, differentiated, and consistent with long-term business goals.

2. Brand Identity & Development

* Lead the development and refinement of brand identities for new and existing clients.
* Work with creative teams on brand names, logos, colour palettes, typography, visual language, and supporting brand assets.
* Develop brand guidelines, visual identity systems, and brand usage standards.
* Define tone of voice, messaging frameworks, communication styles, and brand personality.
* Ensure consistency across websites, social media, advertising creatives, presentations, brochures, and other marketing materials.
* Review creative deliverables to ensure alignment with approved brand strategy and identity guidelines.

3. Brand Communication & Messaging

* Develop brand messaging frameworks, key communication pillars, taglines, and value propositions.
* Create communication strategies for product launches, service launches, brand campaigns, and market expansion.
* Guide copywriters and creative teams in developing impactful and consistent brand communication.
* Ensure that brand messaging reflects the target audience's needs, business objectives, and competitive positioning.
* Review campaign copy, promotional messaging, website content, and advertising communication for brand consistency.
* Translate complex business offerings into clear, compelling, and differentiated brand narratives.

4. Integrated Marketing Campaigns

* Conceptualize and plan integrated branding campaigns across digital and offline channels.
* Develop campaign briefs, creative directions, communication themes, and execution plans.
* Coordinate with social media, performance marketing, SEO, content, design, and web development teams.
* Ensure campaigns communicate a consistent brand message across all relevant customer touchpoints.
* Support campaign planning for product launches, seasonal promotions, brand awareness, lead generation, and customer engagement.
* Monitor campaign performance with relevant teams and recommend improvements to strengthen brand impact.

5. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Conduct industry research, competitor benchmarking, and brand landscape analysis.
* Identify market trends, consumer insights, emerging opportunities, and competitive gaps.
* Evaluate competitor positioning, messaging, visual identity, marketing strategies, and customer communication.
* Use research findings to develop differentiated brand strategies and creative campaign concepts.
* Prepare brand audit reports, competitor analysis documents, and strategic recommendations for clients.

6. Client Management & Strategic Consulting

* Understand client business models, products, services, objectives, and growth challenges.
* Participate in client meetings, discovery sessions, and strategic planning discussions.
* Present brand strategies, campaign concepts, creative directions, and recommendations to clients.
* Translate client requirements into clear briefs for creative and marketing teams.
* Manage client feedback, expectations, approvals, and revisions professionally.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve client branding and recommend additional strategic initiatives.
* Build strong client relationships through strategic thinking, accountability, and quality delivery.

7. Creative Direction & Quality Control

* Provide strategic creative direction to graphic designers, copywriters, video editors, and other creative professionals.
* Evaluate creative concepts based on brand relevance, originality, clarity, and target audience appeal.
* Ensure all deliverables meet established brand standards and project requirements.
* Review creative outputs before client presentation or final delivery.
* Maintain consistency in brand communication across all campaign assets.
* Encourage creative innovation while ensuring alignment with business objectives and brand guidelines.

8. Project Planning & Execution

* Develop brand project plans, timelines, deliverables, and execution roadmaps.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of branding projects.
* Manage multiple client accounts and branding assignments simultaneously.
* Monitor project progress, identify bottlenecks, and ensure timely completion.
* Maintain documentation of brand strategies, approved guidelines, communication frameworks, and client feedback.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned projects, from initial research and strategy through execution and final delivery.

9. Brand Performance & Reporting

* Establish appropriate brand KPIs based on campaign objectives and client requirements.
* Collaborate with digital marketing teams to evaluate brand awareness, engagement, audience response, and campaign effectiveness.
* Interpret available campaign data and consumer insights to identify areas for improvement.
* Prepare brand performance summaries, campaign reviews, and strategic recommendations.
* Use insights from campaign performance and market feedback to refine future brand strategies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, Advertising, Branding, or a related field.
* Minimum **4+ years of relevant experience** in brand management, brand strategy, integrated marketing, advertising, or a branding agency.
* Strong understanding of brand positioning, brand identity, brand architecture, brand communication, and marketing strategy.
* Experience in developing brand strategies, communication frameworks, and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Excellent market research, competitor analysis, and consumer insight capabilities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to develop creative briefs and provide effective direction to design and content teams.
* Strong presentation, client management, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Excellent project management, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and deliver within deadlines.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Google Slides, Excel, Google Sheets, and documentation tools.

Preferred Experience

* Previous experience working in a digital marketing, advertising, creative, or branding agency.
* Experience handling multiple client brands across different industries.
* Experience in brand launches, rebranding, brand identity development, and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Familiarity with digital marketing channels, social media, performance advertising, SEO, and website communication.
* Experience preparing brand strategy presentations, pitch decks, brand guidelines, and campaign proposals.
* A portfolio or case studies demonstrating successful branding projects and strategic contributions.

Key Competencies

* Strategic and analytical thinking
* Strong creative judgment and conceptualization
* Brand storytelling and communication
* Client relationship management
* Cross-functional team coordination
* Attention to detail and quality consciousness
* Decision-making and problem-solving
* Time management and task prioritization
* Accountability and end-to-end ownership

Performance Expectations

The Senior Brand Manager will be expected to:

* Independently develop and execute brand strategies based on client business objectives.
* Deliver clear, actionable, and differentiated brand positioning recommendations.
* Maintain high standards of brand consistency across all client deliverables.
* Ensure timely execution of assigned branding projects.
* Provide clear strategic briefs and constructive creative direction to internal teams.
* Manage client communication and approvals efficiently.
* Identify opportunities for brand growth, differentiation, and improved communication.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of brand initiatives.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on diverse brands and industries.
* Exposure to end-to-end branding and integrated digital marketing projects.
* A collaborative environment involving strategy, creative, content, and performance marketing teams.
* Opportunities to develop strategic thinking, client consulting, and leadership capabilities.
* A role with meaningful ownership of branding projects and client deliverables.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume along with a portfolio or case studies highlighting their experience in brand strategy, positioning, identity development, integrated campaigns, or brand communication.

**We are looking for a strategic thinker who can turn business objectives into strong brand strategies and translate those strategies into effective, consistent, and impactful brand experiences.**

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Pune, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Branding: 4 years (Preferred)

title: Paid Media Manager
description:
Job Description: Paid Ads Manager / Performance Marketing Manager

**Company:** Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** Paid Ads Manager / Performance Marketing Manager  
**Department:** Performance Marketing  
**Location:** Kharadi, Pune – Head Office  
**Experience Required:** 4+ years preferred  
**Salary:** As per experience and expertise  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM

About Osumare Marketing Solutions

Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a full-service branding and digital marketing agency specializing in performance marketing, SEO, social media management, branding, website development, creative strategy, and digital growth solutions.

We manage digital marketing campaigns for clients across multiple industries, helping businesses generate qualified leads, acquire customers, increase sales, and achieve measurable growth through data-driven marketing strategies.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and result-oriented Paid Ads Manager who can independently plan, execute, manage, optimize, and scale paid advertising campaigns across multiple platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete performance marketing lifecycle, from understanding client business objectives and developing media plans to campaign setup, audience targeting, budget allocation, conversion tracking, optimization, reporting, and performance improvement.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads, along with experience in e-commerce advertising, Google Shopping campaigns, remarketing, lead generation, and conversion-focused campaigns.

The candidate should be capable of managing multiple client accounts, handling advertising budgets responsibly, identifying performance improvement opportunities, and delivering measurable results while maintaining campaign profitability and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities1. Paid Advertising Strategy & Planning

* Develop comprehensive paid advertising strategies aligned with client objectives, target audiences, and business goals.
* Understand client products, services, target markets, sales processes, and customer acquisition requirements.
* Prepare media plans, advertising budgets, channel allocations, campaign structures, and performance forecasts.
* Identify the most suitable advertising platforms based on campaign objectives, audience behaviour, and industry requirements.
* Develop strategies for lead generation, e-commerce sales, website traffic, brand awareness, app promotion, and customer acquisition.
* Establish campaign KPIs such as cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rate, and customer acquisition cost (CAC).
* Conduct competitor research, keyword research, audience research, and advertising opportunity analysis.

2. Google Ads Management

* Independently plan, set up, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.
* Manage Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and remarketing campaigns as applicable.
* Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, negative keyword management, and search term optimization.
* Develop effective campaign structures, ad groups, bidding strategies, and conversion-focused ad copy.
* Optimize Quality Score, click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), conversion rates, and cost per acquisition.
* Manage Google Merchant Center feeds and product advertising for relevant e-commerce accounts.
* Analyze search terms, impression share, auction insights, and campaign-level performance.
* Identify wasted advertising spend and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency.
* Stay updated on Google Ads features, automation capabilities, policies, and campaign best practices.

3. Meta Ads Management

* Plan, execute, and optimize campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
* Manage lead generation, website conversion, sales, remarketing, engagement, and awareness campaigns.
* Develop audience strategies using interest targeting, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, and retargeting where appropriate.
* Set up campaign structures, placements, budgets, bidding strategies, and conversion objectives.
* Collaborate with creative teams to develop effective ad concepts, messaging, formats, hooks, and calls to action.
* Monitor campaign fatigue, frequency, CTR, CPM, CPL, CPA, and conversion rates.
* Conduct A/B tests for creatives, audiences, copy, landing pages, and campaign settings.
* Optimize lead quality and conversion performance rather than focusing only on lead volume.
* Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns while controlling acquisition costs.

4. LinkedIn Ads Management

* Plan and manage LinkedIn advertising campaigns for B2B clients.
* Develop targeting strategies based on industry, company size, job title, seniority, function, and relevant professional audiences.
* Manage Lead Gen Forms, website conversion campaigns, sponsored content, and other suitable campaign formats.
* Support B2B lead generation, account-based marketing initiatives, and high-value customer acquisition.
* Monitor lead quality, cost per lead, engagement, and conversion performance.
* Coordinate with client sales teams to understand lead quality and improve campaign targeting.
* Optimize campaigns based on business outcomes and the quality of leads generated.

5. E-commerce & Shopping Ads

* Plan and manage paid campaigns focused on online sales and revenue growth.
* Manage Google Shopping and Performance Max campaigns for eligible e-commerce businesses.
* Coordinate product feed optimization, Merchant Center diagnostics, product categorization, and product-level performance analysis.
* Develop product segmentation and budget allocation strategies based on margins, demand, inventory, and sales performance.
* Monitor ROAS, CPA, average order value, conversion rate, and revenue contribution.
* Identify high-performing products and campaigns for scaling.
* Coordinate with website and e-commerce teams to improve landing pages, checkout experiences, and conversion rates.

6. Conversion Tracking & Analytics

* Set up and validate conversion tracking using Google Ads, Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager.
* Work with developers to implement tracking for forms, purchases, calls, WhatsApp enquiries, and other relevant conversion actions.
* Understand and troubleshoot tracking discrepancies, attribution issues, and conversion measurement errors.
* Monitor campaign performance using GA4, advertising platform dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Use available CRM and sales data to evaluate lead quality, qualified leads, sales conversion, and revenue attribution.
* Ensure that campaign decisions are based on reliable data and properly configured conversion events.
* Understand attribution models, conversion windows, consent requirements, and privacy-conscious measurement practices.

7. Campaign Optimization & Scaling

* Monitor campaign performance regularly and implement data-driven optimization strategies.
* Identify underperforming keywords, audiences, ad sets, placements, creatives, and landing pages.
* Conduct structured experiments to improve campaign efficiency and conversion performance.
* Optimize budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative combinations.
* Scale successful campaigns while maintaining target CPL, CPA, ROAS, or other agreed KPIs.
* Diagnose performance fluctuations and recommend corrective measures.
* Identify opportunities to reduce wasted spend and improve advertising account efficiency.
* Maintain a systematic testing and optimization process across client accounts.

8. Landing Page & Conversion Rate Optimization

* Evaluate landing pages for relevance, user experience, messaging consistency, and conversion potential.
* Collaborate with design, content, and web development teams to improve landing page performance.
* Recommend improvements to headlines, forms, calls to action, page structure, loading speed, and mobile experience.
* Analyze conversion funnels and identify drop-off points.
* Support landing page A/B testing and conversion rate optimization initiatives.
* Ensure consistency between advertisements, landing pages, and the client's actual offerings.

9. Budget Management & Financial Accountability

* Manage advertising budgets responsibly across multiple platforms and client accounts.
* Allocate budgets according to campaign performance, business priorities, and growth opportunities.
* Monitor daily and monthly spending to avoid overspending and budget wastage.
* Maintain accurate campaign budget forecasts and expenditure reports.
* Communicate budget requirements, scaling opportunities, and performance risks proactively.
* Ensure campaign spending aligns with client approvals and agreed commercial objectives.

10. Reporting & Client Communication

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly campaign performance reports.
* Present key metrics, performance trends, campaign insights, and optimization recommendations.
* Explain campaign performance, challenges, and corrective actions clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Track campaign KPIs against agreed targets and identify gaps.
* Coordinate with account managers and client servicing teams for updates and approvals.
* Maintain documentation of campaign structures, budgets, experiments, and optimization activities.
* Provide actionable recommendations rather than merely reporting numerical results.

11. Team Collaboration & Ownership

* Coordinate with graphic designers, copywriters, video editors, SEO specialists, social media managers, and web developers.
* Provide clear creative briefs based on audience insights, campaign objectives, and performance data.
* Ensure advertising creatives and landing pages are aligned with campaign requirements.
* Manage multiple client accounts and campaigns simultaneously.
* Take complete ownership of assigned accounts, from strategy and setup to optimization and reporting.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and maintain high standards of execution.
* Identify and communicate issues proactively instead of waiting for instructions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in paid advertising or performance marketing preferred.
* Strong practical expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Working experience in LinkedIn Ads and B2B lead generation.
* Knowledge of Google Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube Ads, and e-commerce advertising.
* Experience managing multiple campaigns, advertising accounts, and budgets.
* Strong understanding of keyword research, audience targeting, bidding strategies, remarketing, and campaign optimization.
* Practical knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads conversion tracking, and Meta Pixel.
* Ability to analyze advertising data and make performance-driven decisions.
* Understanding of CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS, CAC, and conversion rate.
* Experience with lead generation funnels, landing pages, and conversion rate optimization.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify or WooCommerce.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and offline conversion tracking.
* Experience with B2B marketing, real estate lead generation, or high-ticket services.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Advertising or other relevant advertising platforms.
* Familiarity with Looker Studio and performance reporting dashboards.
* Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications.
* Experience working in a digital marketing agency and managing multiple clients across industries.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on relevant client objectives and agreed targets, including:

* Achievement of target CPL, CPA, ROAS, and conversion goals.
* Quality and business relevance of leads generated.
* Campaign efficiency and responsible budget utilization.
* Improvement in conversion rates and advertising performance.
* Accuracy of tracking, analytics, and reporting.
* Timeliness of campaign launches, optimizations, and deliverables.
* Quality of strategic recommendations and experimentation.
* Client satisfaction, account retention, and proactive communication.
* Ownership, accountability, and consistency in execution.

*KPIs will be defined according to each client's industry, budget, conversion funnel, and business objectives. Results depend on market conditions, offer competitiveness, website performance, and other factors beyond advertising execution.*

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a professional who:

* Can independently handle end-to-end paid advertising campaigns without constant supervision.
* Has strong practical knowledge of multiple advertising platforms.
* Understands the difference between generating leads and generating qualified, revenue-producing leads.
* Can make strategic decisions using campaign data rather than assumptions.
* Is proactive in identifying problems and implementing solutions.
* Takes complete ownership of assigned accounts and budgets.
* Can coordinate effectively with internal teams and clients.
* Is committed to continuous learning and keeping up with changes in advertising platforms.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should share their updated resume along with details of their paid advertising experience, platforms managed, approximate advertising budgets handled, industries served, and measurable campaign results.

Candidates with relevant case studies demonstrating improvements in CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, lead quality, or customer acquisition performance will be preferred.

**We are looking for a hands-on performance marketing professional who can take complete ownership of paid advertising campaigns, manage budgets responsibly, and consistently work toward measurable business outcomes.**

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in manufacturing or industrial product sales, new customer acquisition, and developing long-term relationships with key customers.

* Promote SMT equipment, machinery, and engineering products to potential customers.

title: Category Lead
description:
About Lenskart.com

Lenskart is one of the world's fastest-growing eyewear brands 3,00+ stores and counting across India and a fast-expanding international footprint. Behind every store, every shelf, and every campaign sits a single question: what do we put in front of the customer, and why? That's the question this role owns.

**The opportunity**

As the brand scales across India and into new markets, we're looking for a Category Head to own its most important asset: the product.

This is a category-leadership role with real ownership. You'll decide what sells each season, how it's priced, how it's planned, and how it performs owning the category from the first sketch with the design team to the sell-through report at quarter-end. You'll balance a designer's eye for what's beautiful with a merchant's instinct for what sells, and you'll be measured on both the desirability of the range and the health of the P&L.

If you want to shape a brand's identity through its product and own the commercial outcome of those choices this is that role.

**What you'll own**

* **Category strategy & P&L.**
  Own the assortment and commercial performance of the category frames, sunglasses, and premium ranges driving revenue, margin, and full-price sell-through against clear targets.
* **Range & assortment architecture.**
  Define the seasonal range and good-better-best structure: hero products, newness, price tiers, and the breadth-versus-depth calls that keep the brand both premium and commercial.
* **Buying & merchandise planning.**
  Own open-to-buy, range planning, allocation, and inventory health the right product, in the right store and channel, in the right quantity, at the right time, with disciplined markdown management.
* **Pricing & margin.**
  Set the pricing architecture and promotional strategy that protects the brand's premium positioning while delivering category profitability.
* **Product lifecycle & launches.**
  Partner with Product and Design to brief, build, and launch new collections managing the full lifecycle from introduction and ramp-up to refresh and exit.
* **Cross-functional partnership.**
  Work hand-in-hand with Design, Marketing, Retail, Visual Merchandising, and Supply Chain to bring the range to life in-store and online and turn launches into commercial moments.
* **Data-led decisions.**
  Use sell-through, conversion, attach rate, and customer data to sharpen every assortment, pricing, and planning call and to course-correct fast.
* **Team leadership.**
  Build, lead, and mentor a category team of buyers, merchandisers, and planners as the brand scales.

**What you bring**

* Deep category management, buying, or merchandising experience in fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail, ideally with category P&L ownership.
* The rare blend of product instinct and commercial rigour an eye for what's desirable and the numbers to back what sells.
* Strong financial fluency: OTB, margin, markdown, and inventory planning are second nature.
* A feel for premium and brand-led product you understand how assortment choices build (or dilute) a brand.
* Excellent cross-functional leadership across Design, Marketing, Retail, and Supply Chain.
* The energy and structure to scale a category in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Merchandising, Retail Management, Business, Fashion, or a related field.
* 10–15+ years in category management, buying, or merchandise planning, including team leadership.
* Experience owning a category or range for a multi-store retail brand strongly preferred.
* Background in eyewear, fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail is a strong plus.

title: Manager Growth & Strategic Initiatives
description:

relationships, coordinating with government ministries and departments, supporting project

execution, and driving business development initiatives. The role also involves promoting our

Fostac Training and Certification programs across multiple states, generating leads,

opportunities into business.

Collaborate with clients, government ministries, departments, institutions, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful planning and execution of projects.

Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients and act as the primary point of contact for communication, coordination, follow-ups, and issue resolution.

Oversee and participate in training programs, workshops, seminars, and events to support organizational operations and enhance knowledge and engagement.

Ensure accurate and efficient management of client, training, sales, and project-related data. Maintain updated records and prepare regular reports on leads, conversions, activities, and business performance.

Analyze business, sales, client, and training data to identify trends and provide insights that support informed decision-making and strategic planning.

**Cross-Functional Coordination:**

Coordinate with internal departments and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of projects, training programs, events, sales activities, and client requirements.

Manage and utilize organizational software, CRM systems, data management platforms,

and other digital tools to improve operational efficiency and streamline processes.

**Business Development Initiatives:**

Drive initiatives aimed at expanding the organization's client base, increasing training registrations, developing partnerships, and exploring new markets and opportunities.

**External Representation & Partnerships:**

Represent the organization at government meetings, conferences, training programs, exhibitions, promotional events, and other external engagements while fostering partnerships and strengthening the organization's brand presence.

Be willing to travel extensively across different states as required for business development, training promotion, client meetings, government coordination, events, and sales activities.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong client relationship and negotiation skills.

Sales and business development mindset.

Ability to communicate training and certification programs effectively.

Comfortable with extensive interstate travel and field sales.

Government/client coordination experience.

Good data management and analytical skills.

Proficiency in CRM, MS Excel, and business software.

Strong follow-up and lead-conversion abilities.

Event and training coordination skills.

Ability to work independently as well as with cross-functional teams.

Professional presentation and networking skills.

The primary objective of this role is to strengthen client and government relationships, drive business growth, promote Fostac Training & Certification programs across different states, generate and convert sales opportunities, and ensure smooth execution of organizational projects and training initiatives.

title: Associate Manager Product Growth
description:
**Overview**
**How are you creating an impact?**
We are looking for a dynamic and commercially oriented
**Associate**
**Manager**
**Product Growth,**
to drive the strategy, development, positioning, launch, and lifecycle management of products and learning solutions for the
**Higher Education market.**
The role will be responsible for translating market, faculty, student, and institutional needs into compelling product propositions, while partnering closely with Editorial, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Customer Success, and Global Product teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be able to combine
**product thinking, market understanding, commercial acumen, digital fluency, and strong execution capability**
to build products that drive adoption, revenue, engagement, and long-term customer value.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**
**Product Lifecycle & Adoption**

* Create structured plans for product launch, adoption, renewal, and lifecycle management.
* Monitor adoption at institutions, faculty, course, and student levels.
* Develop intervention plans for products with low adoption or declining usage.
* Recommend product revision, repositioning, bundling, migration, or discontinuation based on performance.

**Revenue & Commercial Management**

* Own and contribute to product-level revenue and margin targets.
* Develop annual product business plans and revenue forecasts.
* Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing, discounting, commercial models, and profitability.
* Monitor product performance against budget and forecast.
* Identify corrective actions for underperforming products

Identify opportunities for:
  
  

- Institutional contracts
- Digital subscriptions
- Bundling
- Custom publishing
- Licensing
- Institutional solutions
- E-commerce
- Cross-sell and upsell

**Internal Positioning & Messaging**

* Defining and communicating the product’s unique value proposition, positioning, and key differentiators, translating product capabilities into clear, compelling messages that resonate with target audiences.
* Develop product positioning frameworks that clearly articulate the customer problem, product solution, key benefits, differentiators, and business value.
* Translate complex product features, content, and technology into simple, customer-centric benefits and outcomes.
* Develop competitor positioning and differentiation statements to help Sales teams communicate the product’s strengths effectively.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure consistency of product messaging across campaigns, websites, email, social media, webinars, events, and sales collateral.
* Equip Sales and KAM teams with product messaging toolkits, battlecards, pitch decks, talking points, and competitive response guides.
* Ensure that internal stakeholders have a clear understanding of “What the product is, Who it is for, Why it matters, and Why customers should choose it.”

**List Management & Product Data Governance**

* Own and maintain the master list of active products, ensuring completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timely updates.
* Maintain accurate product information including product name, ISBN/SKU, edition, discipline, segment, pricing, status, format, digital availability, and other relevant attributes.
* Establish strong data hygiene and governance processes for product and campaign-related databases.
* Ensure product lists are campaign-ready and sales-ready for Marketing, Sales Enablement, e-commerce, reporting, and business operations.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure new products, revisions, discontinued products, pricing changes, and product status updates are reflected accurately and on time.
* Maintain appropriate product lists for marketing campaigns, sales collateral, CRM, e-commerce, reporting, compliance, and management reviews.

**Sales Enablement & Planning**

* Enable Sales and KAM teams to effectively communicate product value, articulate differentiation, handle objections, and drive customer adoption.
* Develop and maintain sales enablement tools, including product decks, battlecards, pitch documents, FAQs, competitive guides, product comparison sheets, and objection-handling guides.
* Conduct regular product training and sales enablement sessions to ensure teams understand product features, positioning, target customers, use cases, and value propositions.
* Partner with Sales leadership to identify sales process gaps, productivity opportunities, and adoption barriers.
* Support the effective use and optimization of CRM and sales technology platforms to improve sales visibility, productivity, and execution.
* Develop and maintain sales reporting, dashboards, forecasting, and performance tracking to support data-driven decision-making.
* Support territory planning, account prioritization, opportunity management, and pipeline planning in collaboration with Sales and KAM teams.
* Ensure CRM data integrity, completeness, consistency, and governance across relevant product and customer records.
* Analyze sales and customer data to identify product trends, whitespace opportunities, adoption gaps, and revenue opportunities.

**We are looking for someone with:**
**Product Management Expertise**

* Strong understanding of product lifecycle management - ideation, development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
* Ability to develop product strategy, roadmap, positioning, and value proposition.
* Strong understanding of market research, customer insights, competitor analysis, and portfolio management.
* Ability to translate customer and market needs into product requirements and actionable product initiatives.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, pricing, margins, adoption, and profitability.

**Sales Enablement**

* Ability to translate product features into sales propositions and customer benefits.
* Experience developing sales decks, product brochures, battlecards, FAQs, competitor comparisons, objection-handling guides, and product demos.
* Strong understanding of sales processes, pipeline management, account prioritization, and opportunity management.
* Ability to conduct product training and enablement sessions for Sales and KAM teams.
* Strong collaboration skills to bridge Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.

**CRM, Marketing Automation & Technology**

* Strong working knowledge of CRM platforms such as Salesforce/SFDC.
* Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* Understanding of CRM data management, lead management, campaign workflows, and reporting.
* Ability to leverage technology to streamline processes and improve sales and marketing efficiency.
* Familiarity with e-commerce platforms and digital customer journeys is desirable.

**Data & Analytics Expertise**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret sales, marketing, customer, product, and campaign data and convert insights into actions.
* Experience with dashboards, reporting, forecasting, and performance tracking.
* Knowledge of GA4 or similar digital analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of marketing and product KPIs including conversion, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, pipeline, and revenue.
* Advanced MS Excel skills; familiarity with Power BI or other visualization tools is an advantage.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex product concepts in a simple, compelling, customer-focused manner.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Sales, Marketing, Editorial, Technology, Finance, Operations, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for internal and external audiences.

**Strategic & Commercial Thinking**

* Strong business acumen and commercial orientation.
* Ability to connect product decisions with revenue, margin, customer value, and business objectives.
* Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on execution mindset
* Strong understanding of competitive dynamics and ability to develop data-backed recommendations.

**Education / Domain Knowledge**

* Preferred Educational Background: MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Product Management, Business Strategy, or related discipline.
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.

**Preferred Industry Experience:**

* Higher Education Publishing
* EdTech / Digital Learning
* SaaS / Technology
* Education Services
* Academic Content / Learning Solutions

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. As a leading education partner for millions of educators, learners, and professionals, we are expanding the possibilities of content and technology to make learning better in a connected world.
  
  
This position offers a strong foundation and a clear growth path toward product management for the right candidate. title: Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)
description:
Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)

Location: Gurgaon · Type: Full-time 

About Voice Arena

Voice Arena builds frontier evals, models and datasets for voice AI. Our mission is to make machines talk like humans, and to measure honestly how close they are.

We run public leaderboards for speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and speaker diarization, with many more yet to come. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use them to see how speech models perform on real speech, in real conditions and across languages, rather than on clean read audio.

Behind the boards is a research and engineering team that builds its own datasets, trains the models that keep its evaluations accurate and publishes its methods. What sets us apart:

* Research that gets published. Three papers at Interspeech 2026, where Voice Arena is also the Diamond Sponsor. Our methods go through peer review, not just a blog post.
* Partners across the field. We brought Hindi and Indian English to Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard, and we partner with NVIDIA. Model providers send us new models for public and private evaluation.
* Data nobody else has. Monsoon, our dataset initiative for the Global South, is working towards 1,000 languages by 2027. Our accented English corpus covers 8 accents and 6,000 hours. This data gives us held-out test sets that models have not seen in training.
* A research community. Voice Research Club runs paper-first sessions for voice AI researchers, starting in San Francisco and New York, with more cities to follow.

About the role

Voice Arena's boards are only as useful as the people who see them. When a new speech model launches, the right researcher, founder or AI leader should hear what our evals say about it within a day. Today that depends on a few people posting when they can. We want it to be a system.

We're hiring a Product Ops & Growth lead to own how Voice Arena reaches the people who matter: the researchers who build speech models, the founders and engineers who ship voice products, and the AI and data leaders who decide which models their companies buy. You will scale our presence on X and LinkedIn, and find new ways to put our leaderboards, benchmarks and datasets in front of the right people.

The core question for this role is simple: does everyone who builds, ships or buys voice AI know what Voice Arena says about the models they care about?

This is a highly autonomous role. You'll work directly with the founders and the research team, sitting between the product and its audience. Growth here is not about follower counts for their own sake. It is about reaching the right people, and that is how you will be measured.

In this role, you will

The work runs as one loop: know who we need to reach, get our work in front of them, learn what lands, and feed it back into the product:

1. Map the people we need to reach. Build and keep current the lists of who matters: speech and voice researchers at model labs, founders and engineers at voice platforms, and AI and data leaders at enterprises that buy voice AI. Know who they follow, where they spend time and what they share.
2. Scale Voice Arena on X. Own our X presence end to end: leaderboard updates, benchmark launches, threads and charts. Make sure most major voice AI model launches are covered on our boards within a day of release, and that the right people see it.
3. Scale Voice Arena on LinkedIn. Grow our company page and the founders' presence, and run targeted promotion so our posts reach researchers at labs, teams at voice platforms and AI leaders at large enterprises.
4. Run launches. Plan and ship every release, from new leaderboards and benchmarks to datasets and papers: timing, founder posts, threads, visuals, and the follow-up that keeps a launch alive after day one.
5. Build distribution beyond our own accounts. Work with creators, researchers and partners who already have the audience we need, so our results travel through voices people trust.
6. Run product ops. Keep the boards fresh and the site sharp: track new model releases, work with the research team on what gets evaluated next, and turn audience feedback into changes on voicearena.com.

In a typical week, you might:

* Track every voice AI model launch and get our results out the same day
* Plan and schedule a benchmark launch thread with the research team
* Build a target list of voice researchers and AI leaders, and set up a LinkedIn campaign to reach them
* Brief a group of creators on a new leaderboard and coordinate their posts
* Look at who each post reached and who engaged, and change next week's plan

What matters most

Everything in the loop serves two outcomes. They are how this role will be measured.

1. Reaching the right people

Reach only matters if it is the right reach. A post seen by a million people who will never build or buy a speech model is worth less than one seen by the hundred people who do. Your job is to make sure Voice Arena is in front of those people, consistently. In practice:

* Know the audience by name. Keep clear, current lists of the researchers, builders and buyers we need, and know which of them already follow us.
* Measure who, not just how many. Track reach and engagement among the people we target, not just impressions and follower counts.
* Be first on launches. Be the place people check when a new voice model ships, by getting our results out fast.
* Earn the reshare. Make posts researchers want to share: clear charts, honest numbers, no hype.

2. Scaling X and LinkedIn into systems

Today a few people post when they can. You'll turn that into a repeatable engine that runs every day, through launches and quiet weeks alike. In practice:

* Run a calendar. Keep a weekly calendar of leaderboard posts and releases across Voice Arena's accounts and the founders' accounts.
* Build templates. Create reusable formats for leaderboard updates, launch threads and charts, so quality stays high as volume grows.
* Spend on reach with intent. Use targeted LinkedIn and X promotion to reach specific groups, and cut whatever does not reach them.
* Grow a creator network. Build lasting relationships with creators and researchers who regularly cover voice AI.
* Close the loop. Report what worked each week, and feed what the audience wants back into the product and research roadmap.

What we offer

* High ownership. Own Voice Arena's reach from day one, with direct access to the founders.
* A front-row seat. See every new voice model and every result before it goes public.
* Real impact. Your work decides whether the labs, builders and buyers of voice AI see what our evals say.
* Room to grow. Build the growth function at an early company and shape how it scales.

Minimum qualifications

* 2+ years in growth, marketing, community or product ops, ideally at a tech, AI or developer-focused company
* A track record of growing an audience on X or LinkedIn, for a company or for yourself
* Strong writing: you can turn a technical result into a clear post, thread or chart caption
* Comfort with data: you track what each post reached and change course based on it
* Genuine interest in AI, and the curiosity to learn how speech models are built and evaluated
* High ownership: you ship without waiting to be told, and you sweat the details

Preferred qualifications

*You don't need to match every bullet. Apply even if you meet only some of these.*

* Experience running launches for a technical product, developer tool or AI company
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager or X ads and audience targeting
* An existing network among AI researchers, builders or creators
* Experience running creator or influencer campaigns
* Basic design skills for charts and visuals (Figma, Canva or similar)
* Comfort with outreach and data tools such as Apollo, spreadsheets or simple scripts, and with AI tools that help you move faster

Why join Voice Arena

* Shape how voice AI gets built. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use our boards to decide which models to build, ship and buy.
* See every model first. Work with the newest speech models across languages, often before most of the field has tried them.
* Grow something with substance. You'll be growing a brand built on real research: papers at Interspeech 2026, a Hugging Face partnership and benchmarks the field checks.
* Reach the whole world's speech. Our data and evals reach far beyond English, across the wider Global South, so the audience is global.
* Join early. Join a small, talent-dense team early, and shape the product, the team and how we grow.

How to apply

Send your CV, a short note and links to accounts, posts or campaigns you've grown to amritansh@voicearena.com.

**Key Account Manager, Offline**

**Glanbia**

**Join this dynamic team focused on delivering better nutrition for every step of life’s journey**

**The Opportunity**

The Key Account Manager is responsible for driving profitable growth across assigned strategic accounts by building strong customer partnerships, delivering revenue and margin targets, and executing joint business plans.

The role is the primary commercial interface between Glanbia and key customers, ensuring excellence in assortment, availability, visibility, promotions, inventory management, service, and customer profitability. The KAM will work closely with Marketing, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Finance, and Customer Service to deliver sustainable growth and strengthen Glanbia’s position across priority offline channel

**Responsibilities**

**Account Management & Business Growth**

* Own end-to-end business delivery for assigned key accounts, including revenue, volume, NSV, gross profit, and market share objectives.
* Develop annual and quarterly account plans aligned with company and customer priorities.
* Identify growth opportunities through assortment expansion, improved distribution, new product launches, premiumization, and customer-specific programs.
* Build strong relationships with buyers, category teams, commercial stakeholders, and senior customer leadership.
* Lead annual Joint Business Planning discussions and translate agreed priorities into clear initiatives, targets, owners, and timelines.
* Track delivery against the JBP and initiate corrective actions where performance is off plan.

**Commercial Negotiation & Trade Investment**

* Lead negotiations on annual trade terms, pricing, margins, promotions, listings, visibility, and commercial agreements.
* Manage customer trade investment within approved budgets and improve return on investment.

**Sales Performance & Analytics**

* Monitor sell-in, sell-out, inventory, distribution, assortment, and promotional performance by customer and SKU.
* Use customer and market data to identify gaps, risks, and growth opportunities, and convert insights into actions.
* Maintain accurate account forecasts and provide customer inputs for business planning and S&OP reviews.
* Track competitor pricing, promotions, assortment, and in-store execution.

**Demand, Supply & Service Management**

* Partner with Demand Planning, Supply Chain, and Customer Service to ensure product availability and healthy inventory.
* Minimize stock-outs, excess inventory, aged stock, short supplies, and order fulfilment issues.
* Coordinate timely order processing and drive improvement in customer service levels and OTIF.

**Execution Excellence**

* Ensure agreed assortment, availability, visibility, pricing, planograms, and promotional plans are executed across customer outlets.
* Drive high-quality launch execution for new products and track post-launch performance.
* Undertake periodic market visits to assess execution standards, shopper experience, and competitor activity.

**KPIs & Success Metrics**

* Annual Business Revenue, Margins, and market share delivery
* Account profitability and trade spend ROI
* JBP achievement and growth initiative delivery
* Sell-out growth, distribution, assortment, availability, and visibility
* Forecast accuracy, inventory health, service level, and OTIF
* New product listing, launch execution, and post-launch performance

**The Skills you will bring to the team**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred.
* 6+ years of experience in FMCG, consumer healthcare, sports nutrition, consumer goods, Modern Trade, Pharmacy, or related channels with at least 3+ years of experience in Key Account management.
* Demonstrated experience managing strategic national or regional accounts and commercial negotiations.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint;

**Where and how you will work**

The opportunity will be based in
**Gurgaon, India**
with hybrid working arrangements available which offer you a greater choice in how you work and live, giving you a better work-life balance.

**What we would like to offer you!**

The opportunity to develop your career on a global stage, continuous learning through an on-demand learning platform, and a competitive compensation package including staff discounts, generous family leave policy, health & dental plan and competitive salary.

**About Glanbia**

Glanbia is a better nutrition company with three divisions: Performance Nutrition, Health & Nutrition and Dairy Nutrition. Collectively and with our partners we offer an incredible breadth of expertise in nutrition. We employ a team of 5800 people, work with global food and beverage companies, and sell our award-winning and market-leading brands and ingredients in more than 100 countries worldwide

At Glanbia, we celebrate diversity, because we know that our individual strengths make us stronger together. We welcome and encourage interest from a variety of candidates, we will give your application consideration, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

At Glanbia, our culture celebrates individuality, knowing that together we are more.

description:
**Position Title:**Sensory Scientist

**Position Type:** Regular - Full-Time

**Requisition ID:** 45150

**In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.**

**About the role.**

The Sensory Scientist reports to the Sensory UX Innovation Manager, Asia Pacific and South African (APACSA) and is based in Delhi, India.

This role applies sensory and consumer/customer research best practices and methodologies, to provide guidance and insights to McCain’s regional and local Product Development teams throughout the stage gate process.

This position is a key member of a Asia Pacific and South African (APACSA) regional Sensory UX team and provides direction and training to various stakeholders on all sensory aspects of McCain’s products. Sensory Scientist partners with cross-functional teams to integrate sensory practices and testing, where appropriate, throughout the product development process.

The role is responsible for using and creating sensory Consumer/customer and analytical methods to guide product development, enable successful innovation launches and guide renovation efforts. The Sensory Scientist designs and leads testing plans with scientific rigor, issues reports and creates actionable recommendations to stakeholders.

The Sensory Scientist collaborates with R&D, Marketing, Consumer Insights, Operations, and other internal and external partners on new products, processes, quality improvements and cost savings to drive McCain’s profitable growth.

As part of the Global Sensory and User Experience team, the Sensory Scientist also works with internal team members to expand McCain’s global sensory capabilities. This includes the optimization and standardization of sensory tools and the development of new or hybrid methods. It also includes developing new training materials, assessing and onboarding new vendors, identifying and closing gaps the company has in regard to its sensory needs, and contributing to investigations regarding the linkage between sensory methods or attribute intensities to instrumental test methods.

The position executes and reports sensory and consumer/customer research studies. As such, the Sensory Scientist builds and maintains strong relationships with core vendors, supervises the application of best scientific practices by such vendors and manages test costs and timelines.

This position is based in the McCain HO. Ad hoc travel to regional plants and research venues (including Research Agency sites, Universities etc) may be required (eg for product tastings/review and other R&D focused activities as required). McCain will reimburse travel costs for such work-related travel

**What you’ll be doing.**

* Partners with Consumer Insights, Research and Development, Marketing, Packaging, Supply Chain, and other business and product teams to guide the optimization of innovation products, product improvements, and define product quality as part of building consumer led specifications.
* Drives projects through appropriate product and packaging consumer/customer and sensory learning plans from optimization to confirmatory testing, inclusive of building foundational product knowledge, protecting product quality, and enhancing consumer/customer understanding.
* Facilitates consumer/customer interactions to grow consumer/customer empathy. Examples of this include meetings with Customers to review and define product development briefs and sensory review of stimulus, as well as leveraging any consumer/customer research being conducted by Sensory UX or Consumer Insights, to bring exposure of the internal McCain R&D team to the consumer.
* Facilitates the running of robust, objective, and fit for purpose, round table/cook ups:
* + With relevant McCain R&D/Technical Operations/Quality/Commercial team members, to make the right decisions at the right time regards prototypes, market samples etc, and/or to educate and immerse the team in product/category insight.
  + The Sensory Scientist will lead moderation of such sessions, where it is appropriate. The Developer will also moderate for routine, lower risk panels.
  + The set up is carried out by the R&D Product/Pack Developer, under guidance from the Sensory Scientist

* Courageously champions product design and product quality as the sensory representative on the Research & Development and business teams.
* Further strengthens best sensory practices within the Research & Development teams and provoke a ‘sensory’ and ‘experimental’ mindset.
* Applies design of experiments (DoE) to sensory and consumer/customer testing.
* Translates data to insights through synthesis of qualitative consumer/customer learning and interpretation of statistical analyses of quantitative sensory and consumer/customer data.
* Communicates key findings in a relevant and easy to understand manner and guide business teams to next steps in the product development process.
* Develops and fosters strong relationships with key sensory and consumer testing vendors (including research agencies, Universities etc) to ensure flawless execution of tests and appropriate pricing.
* Partners with the business to activate Product Stewardship programs. These focus on measuring and understanding the competitive space (internally or using external Trained Panel and consumer/customer research) and giving actionable guidance, that may lead to renovation activities.
* Works with The Sensory UX Innovation Manager, APACSA, to forward the Sensory UX agenda through the region. There may be occasions where participation in the broader McCain Sensory and UX team and/or R&D team is required eg team meetings, methodology review, relevant training sessions etc.

**What you’ll need to be successful.**

* Bachelor’s degree in Sensory Science, Food Science, Statistics, Psychology, or a related field.
* Master’s degree with emphasis in Sensory Science preferred.
* Minimum 4 years of sensory science and consumer research experience across multiple research methodologies.
* Experience planning and executing sensory and consumer research in collaboration with R&D and Consumer Insights teams.
* Strong understanding of sensory evaluation techniques, including discrimination testing, descriptive analysis, internal panel management, and consumer research methodologies.
* Working knowledge of applied statistics, Design of Experiments (DoE), and multivariate analysis techniques.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, synthesize complex data into actionable insights, and communicate findings effectively to diverse audiences.
* Experience managing external vendors and research partners is preferred.
* Knowledge of food chemistry, biochemistry, and statistics is desirable.
* Scientific curiosity and a strong commitment to experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning.

**About the team.**

This role is part of the APACSA Sensory UX team and reports to the Sensory UX Innovation Manager, APACSA. The Sensory Scientist works closely with regional and global Sensory UX colleagues as well as cross-functional partners across R&D, Consumer Insights, Marketing, Operations, Packaging, and Commercial teams. The position plays an important role in strengthening McCain’s sensory capabilities and fostering a consumer-led innovation culture across the region.

About Eitonics Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

Eitonics Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an emerging technology startup operating across the HealthTech and HospitalityTech sectors. The company develops innovative digital solutions that address real-world operational challenges and improve business efficiency.

Our HealthTech product, **LOBMAX PCS-D**, is a cloud-based dialysis center management platform designed to digitize patient records, streamline dialysis center operations, and improve access to clinical and administrative information.

We are looking for a proactive, customer-focused, and relationship-oriented **Client Success Manager** to manage client relationships, drive customer satisfaction, support product adoption, and contribute to business growth.

Role Overview

As a Client Success Manager, you will be responsible for building strong relationships with existing and prospective clients, ensuring smooth onboarding, coordinating product demonstrations, addressing customer concerns, and improving overall client experience.

You will work closely with the founding team and internal stakeholders to understand client requirements, drive product adoption, maintain engagement, and identify opportunities for customer retention and business expansion.

This role offers an opportunity to work directly with leadership and gain hands-on experience in B2B client management, SaaS products, customer success, and business development within a growing technology startup.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Client Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Communicate professionally with clients through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and online meetings.
* Understand client requirements, expectations, and business challenges.
* Conduct regular follow-ups to maintain client engagement and satisfaction.
* Act as a primary point of contact for client communication and coordination.
* Escalate client concerns to the relevant internal teams and ensure timely resolution.

**2. Customer Success & Product Adoption**

* Manage client onboarding and facilitate smooth implementation of company products, including LOBMAX PCS-D.
* Coordinate product demonstrations, introductory meetings, and training sessions.
* Help clients understand product features, workflows, and business benefits.
* Monitor client engagement, product adoption, and satisfaction levels.
* Collect client feedback and coordinate with internal teams to improve the customer experience.
* Identify potential customer retention risks and take proactive steps to address them.

**3. Business Development & Account Growth**

* Identify potential clients and research relevant organizations across target industries.
* Follow up on leads generated through LinkedIn, email, telephone calls, referrals, and other channels.
* Schedule product demonstrations and coordinate meetings with prospective customers.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, renewals, referrals, and additional business.
* Collaborate with the sales team to convert qualified prospects into customers.
* Support the achievement of client engagement, retention, and revenue-related targets.

**4. Client Communication & Issue Resolution**

* Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clients.
* Understand client issues and coordinate with product, technical, and business teams for resolution.
* Track customer queries, complaints, and resolution timelines.
* Ensure clients receive regular updates on pending issues and action items.
* Maintain a customer-first approach while balancing client expectations and business priorities.

**5. Reporting & Internal Coordination**

* Maintain accurate client databases, CRM records, interaction logs, and follow-up trackers.
* Prepare weekly reports on client meetings, feedback, onboarding progress, customer satisfaction, and business opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure effective client servicing.
* Assist the founding team with client presentations, business communication, and strategic coordination.
* Develop and improve standard operating procedures for client onboarding, communication, and relationship management.

Eligibility & Qualifications

* MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Business Administration, General Management, or a related field.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Excellent interpersonal, relationship-building, and problem-solving abilities.
* Confidence in handling client calls, meetings, presentations, and professional correspondence.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, Google Sheets, email, and online meeting platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple clients, prioritize tasks, and complete follow-ups on time.
* A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and a strong customer-first mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced startup environment.

Preferred Experience & Skills

* Experience in client servicing, customer success, account management, sales coordination, or business development.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, SaaS platforms, or customer engagement systems.
* Exposure to healthcare technology, hospital management systems, dialysis centers, or hospitality technology.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and communicate product value effectively.
* Experience managing customer databases, preparing reports, and tracking performance metrics.

Salary & Benefits

* **Fixed Salary:** ₹20,000 per month.
* **Performance Incentives:** Additional incentives based on defined targets and performance.
* Direct exposure to customer success, B2B relationship management, and SaaS business operations.
* Opportunity to work closely with the founding team and contribute to business growth.
* Professional development in client management, communication, product adoption, and account growth.
* Opportunity to work in a growing HealthTech and HospitalityTech startup.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is confident, articulate, organized, and customer-oriented, with a genuine interest in building long-term client relationships. About You  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.
* Experience in Relationship Management, Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or Product Management within the Banking, Payments, Cards, Fintech, or broader BFSI sector.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Professional who is willing to work with cross functional team to work with Product managers and EY IT team

**Job Description – HR Executive**

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Company:**
NovL Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

2–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
Bangalore, India

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented HR Executive to manage end-to-end talent acquisition and recruitment activities, along with team handling and coordination. The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing skills, good communication abilities, and the capability to manage recruitment teams and ensure timely closure of open positions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Acquisition & End-to-End Recruitment**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements to candidate onboarding.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand job descriptions, candidate profiles, and hiring priorities.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, databases, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial HR interviews, and assess candidates based on role requirements.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates and interview panels to ensure a smooth recruitment process.
* Manage salary discussions, offer negotiations, and offer releases in coordination with management.
* Track candidate progress, maintain recruitment records, and ensure timely follow-ups until joining.
* Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future hiring requirements.
* Monitor recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, interview-to-selection ratio, offer acceptance, and joining ratio.

**2. Recruitment Team Handling**

* Manage and coordinate the day-to-day activities of the recruitment team.
* Allocate hiring requirements among recruiters based on priorities and expertise.
* Monitor recruiter productivity, sourcing activities, interview schedules, and closure targets.
* Conduct regular team reviews to track recruitment progress and identify hiring bottlenecks.
* Guide team members on sourcing strategies, candidate screening, and effective recruitment practices.
* Ensure recruiters meet hiring deadlines and maintain the required quality of candidate submissions.
* Support the team in closing critical and challenging positions.
* Prepare and share recruitment status reports with management.
* Maintain effective communication and coordination within the team to achieve overall hiring targets.

**3. Recruitment Operations & Reporting**

* Maintain an updated recruitment tracker and candidate database.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment reports.
* Track open positions, shortlisted candidates, interviews, offers, and joining status.
* Ensure timely communication with candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* Identify process improvements to increase sourcing efficiency and recruitment turnaround time.

**Required Skills**

* 2–5 years of experience in talent acquisition and end-to-end recruitment.
* Experience in handling or coordinating a recruitment team.
* Strong knowledge of sourcing techniques and recruitment platforms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and work towards hiring targets.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and recruitment tracking tools.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely closure of open positions.
* Quality of candidate submissions and selections.
* Recruiter productivity and team target achievement.
* Offer acceptance and candidate joining ratios.
* Accuracy of recruitment reports and candidate tracking.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A hands-on HR professional with strong end-to-end recruitment experience, the ability to manage multiple hiring requirements, and the leadership skills to coordinate and drive a recruitment team towards timely hiring closures.

**2. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment for technical and non-technical positions, including leadership and niche technology roles.
* Work closely with business and delivery heads to understand hiring requirements, workforce plans, and resource priorities.
* Manage recruitment pipelines, sourcing strategies, interview coordination, candidate assessments, offer management, and onboarding.
* Track recruitment metrics, hiring turnaround time, offer acceptance, and joining ratios.

**3. Performance Management & Employee Development**

* Manage the performance appraisal cycle, including goal setting, KPI alignment, feedback collection, performance reviews, and salary revision coordination.
* Partner with managers to establish measurable performance expectations and improve accountability.
* Facilitate employee development plans, performance improvement plans, and career progression discussions.
* Drive employee feedback mechanisms, manager connects, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Align performance outcomes with business priorities, market benchmarks, and internal compensation structures.

**4. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Coordinate monthly payroll processing, salary inputs, variable pay, incentives, reimbursements, and full and final settlements.

* Oversee PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements in coordination with the relevant internal teams or external advisors.

* Support managers in addressing employee concerns, workplace conflicts, and performance-related challenges.
* Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous learning.
* Plan and coordinate virtual engagement activities, celebrations, and employee recognition programs.

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies.

* Support internal audits and compliance requirements, including relevant ISO and CMMI-aligned HR processes.
* Coordinate background verification, employment verification, and employee documentation checks.
* Identify compliance gaps, implement corrective actions, and maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.

**7. HR Analytics, Automation & Process Improvement**

* Develop and maintain HR dashboards covering headcount, attrition, recruitment, employee performance, payroll, and engagement.
* Generate periodic HR reports and management updates to support data-driven decisions.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR activities using HRMS platforms, Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Excel, and other relevant tools.

* Partner with leadership, business heads, and delivery managers to align HR initiatives with organizational goals.

new ones.

have a passion for Clean Code, scalable architectures, Test Driven Development and DevOps.  
We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer with strong programming skills to join our  
dynamic team. If you are passionate about technology and eager to work on challenging projects, we want  
to hear from you!

* Develop and enhance our flagship Video, Audio, Automotive and Sports metadata software

solutions.  

* Design applications with a Platform-first mentality where scale, consistency and reliability are

at the core of every decision.

Job Description:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining  
high-quality software applications using Java. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define,  
design, and ship new features, while also ensuring the performance, quality, and responsiveness of  
applications.

Key Responsibilities:  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable and robust Java applications.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to gather requirements and

translate them into technical specifications.  

* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards.
* Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Troubleshoot and debug applications to optimize performance and resolve issues.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including planning, development,

testing, and deployment.  

* Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve skills

and knowledge.  

* Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and collaboration within the

team.
