Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  

* **4 to 6 years** of professional experience in software development, with a strong focus on one or

more programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, SCALA, GoLang.  

* Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
* Proficiency in Java frameworks such as Spring, Hibernate, or similar.
* Knowledge of database systems (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and SQL.
* Experience of working with event driven architectures
* Understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, etc.).
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as in a team

environment.  

* Familiarity with front-end technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
At Shills Professional, we believe that great businesses are built by great people. We are committed to connecting the right talent with the right opportunities and helping organizations build strong, capable, and future-ready teams.

We are looking for a proactive and people-oriented
**Talent Acquisition Specialist**
who is passionate about recruitment, enjoys interacting with people, and can manage the end-to-end hiring process while delivering a positive candidate experience.

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will be responsible for identifying, attracting, evaluating, and hiring suitable candidates across various roles. You will work closely with hiring managers to understand manpower requirements, develop effective sourcing strategies, and ensure timely closures without compromising on candidate quality.

**1. End-to-End Recruitment**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding job requirements to candidate onboarding.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand role expectations, required competencies, and hiring priorities.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial telephonic interviews, and assess candidate suitability.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with candidates and interview panels.
* Follow up with candidates and hiring managers to ensure timely feedback and closure.

**2. Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Management**

* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, professional networks, and other relevant channels.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future requirements.
* Identify innovative sourcing strategies to attract relevant talent.
* Maintain an updated database of candidates and ensure proper tracking of recruitment activities.

**3. Candidate Experience & Engagement**

* Communicate professionally with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Keep candidates informed about interview schedules, feedback, selection decisions, and next steps.
* Ensure a smooth, transparent, and positive candidate experience.
* Manage offer discussions, follow-ups, and joining confirmations.

**4. Recruitment Coordination & Reporting**

* Track recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, sourcing effectiveness, interview-to-selection ratio, and offer-to-joining ratio.
* Prepare regular recruitment reports and provide updates on open positions.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records and documentation.
* Coordinate with HR and relevant stakeholders for pre-joining formalities and onboarding.

Skills and Qualifications Required

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Prior experience in talent acquisition or recruitment is preferred.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to assess candidate suitability through structured screening and interviews.
* Familiarity with job portals, LinkedIn Recruiter, applicant tracking systems, or recruitment databases is an advantage.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Proactive approach, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset.

What are we looking for?

* A people person who enjoys building professional relationships.
* Someone who takes ownership of hiring requirements and follows through on commitments.
* A resourceful individual who can identify the right talent through multiple sourcing channels.
* A professional who balances hiring speed with candidate quality.
* Someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced work environment.

Why Join us?

* Opportunity to develop expertise across the recruitment lifecycle.
* Exposure to diverse hiring requirements and talent markets.
* A collaborative environment that encourages learning, ownership, and professional growth.
* The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by connecting people with the right career opportunities.

**If you are passionate about connecting talent with opportunity and building teams that make a difference, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and become a part of Shills Professional!**

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
Qualys is seeking an experienced and highly strategic
**Principal Recruiter**
to join our Global Talent Acquisition team.
  
  
Reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Talent Acquisition, this is a senior individual contributor role responsible for leading some of the company's most critical and high-impact hiring initiatives globally.
  
  
This position is designed for a recruiter with deep expertise in executive search, talent intelligence, market mapping, and complex global hiring. The successful candidate will partner closely with senior leaders and executives to attract exceptional talent across technical and non-technical functions while helping shape hiring strategies that support the long-term growth of the business.
  
  
This is not a high-volume recruiting role. It is an opportunity to focus on strategic hiring, solve complex talent challenges, and influence business outcomes through exceptional talent acquisition expertise.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment for business-critical, highly specialized, and difficult-to-fill positions across Qualys globally.
* Partner directly with executives, senior leaders, and hiring managers to develop and execute effective talent acquisition strategies.
* Drive complex searches across technical and non-technical functions, including Engineering, Product Management, Cybersecurity, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Operations, and Executive Leadership.
* Develop and execute innovative search strategies for niche, emerging, and highly competitive talent segments where traditional recruiting approaches may be insufficient.
* Build and maintain strategic talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs through proactive sourcing, talent mapping, networking, referrals, market research, and competitive intelligence.
* Conduct organizational mapping, competitor analysis, and talent market research to identify and engage exceptional talent globally.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on talent availability, hiring strategy, compensation trends, market dynamics, and competitive talent landscapes.
* Influence hiring decisions through data, external market insights, and talent intelligence.
* Partner with stakeholders to define hiring requirements, assessment approaches, and candidate evaluation criteria to ensure high-quality hiring outcomes.
* Engage, assess, and attract high-caliber candidates across a broad range of functions, disciplines, and experience levels.
* Own candidate engagement and offer closure, effectively managing competing offers, compensation expectations, relocation considerations, and complex negotiations.
* Deliver an exceptional candidate experience while acting as a brand ambassador for Qualys.
* Leverage recruiting technologies, AI-enabled tools, and talent intelligence platforms to improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate engagement, and hiring outcomes.
* Champion best practices in strategic recruiting, executive search, talent mapping, candidate assessment, and stakeholder management.
* Partner with recruiters and recruiting leaders globally on critical hiring initiatives and particularly challenging searches.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve hiring effectiveness, quality of hire, recruiting efficiency, and candidate experience.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications :
  
  

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 12+ years of recruitment and executive search experience, with a demonstrated track record of hiring senior leadership and business-critical talent across multiple functions and geographies.
* Significant experience recruiting across both technical and non-technical functions.
* Proven success hiring for highly specialized, niche, and difficult-to-fill roles.
* Strong expertise in executive search, talent mapping, market intelligence, competitive research, and strategic sourcing.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align talent acquisition strategies to business objectives.
* Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
* Experience supporting hiring across multiple global regions and talent markets.
* Proven ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and successfully lead complex searches from strategy through closure.
* Experience leveraging Applicant Tracking Systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, AI-powered recruiting tools, and talent intelligence platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within cybersecurity, enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, AI, or other high-growth technology environments.
* Executive search firm or retained search experience.
* Experience recruiting for leadership, specialist, technical, and go-to-market functions on a global scale.
* Strong understanding of global talent markets and competitive hiring landscapes.

description:

**About Rostrum Education**

Rostrum Education supports students and families in their journey to gain admission to the world’s most competitive universities. With personalised mentorship, expert guidance, and a proven track record, we help students craft strong, standout applications.

In the 2025 admissions cycle, our students secured 10+ Oxbridge offers and 15+ Ivy League offers, showcasing the strength of our strategies and the quality of our mentorship. From Oxford to Harvard, Cambridge to Columbia, we help ambitious students turn their aspirations into achievement.

With Rostrum, students benefit from a strategy that can increase their chances of admission up to 5 times, helping them turn their ambition into achievement and applications into success stories.

We are looking for a driven and hands-on Senior HR Associate who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role requires someone who takes complete ownership of HR processes, is proactive in problem-solving, and is comfortable operating in a dynamic, evolving setup. This position handles employee recruitment, onboarding, benefits administration, performance management, and employee relations. You will be responsible for developing and updating HR policies, ensuring legal compliance, and supporting organizational culture and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Management in HR:**
  Partner with leadership to translate business goals into people strategies covering workforce planning, headcount and budgeting, talent retention, and culture-building; use HR data and analytics to advise on organizational structure and decisions, and proactively identify people-risks and opportunities to shape long-term HR strategy
* **Policy & Compliance:**
  Draft, review, and implement HR policies in alignment with organizational needs and legal requirements, ensuring 100% communication and documentation of updates; maintain a centralized policy repository and conduct periodic reviews to ensure relevance, clarity, and compliance
* **Performance Management:**
  Implement and drive KRA/KPI frameworks across teams, ensure timely completion of performance review cycles, coordinate with stakeholders for evaluations, and maintain accurate performance records to support data-driven decision-making

* **Payroll, Attendance & Benefits:**
  Manage and validate monthly attendance, resolve discrepancies prior to payroll processing, and execute accurate payroll through HRMS tools (e.g., Keka); ensure timely salary disbursement, maintain payroll records, and administer employee benefits including insurance, leave, and wellness programs while addressing employee queries
* **Learning & Development:**
  Identify training and development needs through performance insights and feedback, design and implement structured learning initiatives, and facilitate training sessions and workshops to drive continuous learning, skill enhancement, and employee growth
* **HR Operations:**
  Oversee the complete employee lifecycle including reference checks, onboarding documentation, employee records management (HRMS and physical), internal transfers, and exits, while ensuring process efficiency, accuracy, and continuous improvement; act as the first point of contact for employee queries and grievances, ensuring timely and effective resolution
* **End-to-End Employee Lifecycle Management:**
  Own and manage the complete employee journey, from offer acceptance and pre-boarding through onboarding, confirmation, career progression, internal mobility, and exit, as a single point of accountability; coordinate across recruitment, operations, payroll, and L&D at each milestone, and use lifecycle data to continuously improve the employee experience and flag retention risks early
* **Recruitment & Onboarding:**
  Manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle including Job Description creation, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, assessments, and offer rollout, while maintaining a structured hiring pipeline and ensuring a seamless, positive candidate experience; design and execute a well-structured onboarding program that enables smooth integration of new hires into the organization’s culture, values, and workflows

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Mandatory 4-5 years of hands-on HR experience across HR operations, Talent Acquisition and People Management
* Strong understanding of HR processes, systems, and best practices
* Familiarity with employment laws and compliance requirements
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-ownership, and dynamic environment

* Join a globally recognized and fast-growing organization in the education sector.
* Work in a dynamic, cross-functional team environment.
* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Exposure to international clients and projects with impact.
* Opportunities for professional development and advancement.

Gurugram, Haryana, India

**Experience:**
1-3 years

**About the Company**

TheHireHub.AI is transforming recruitment through intelligent technology that helps organizations discover, evaluate, engage, and hire talent more efficiently. Founded by experienced executive-search professionals, the company combines deep hiring expertise with AI-driven workflows designed for the realities of modern recruitment. Its platform supports sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and coordination, helping recruitment teams spend less time on administration and more time making strategic decisions. TheHireHub.AI serves mid-market and growth-stage businesses across India, APAC, and MEA, while building a growing global presence. Insights from more than 3,000 global hiring projects inform the company’s approach to creating practical, scalable recruitment solutions. Headquartered in Gurugram, the organization operates with a focused team and a strong culture of innovation, efficiency, and empowerment. Its mission is to make hiring faster and smarter, while its vision is to reshape recruitment through AI-enabled experiences. The company is committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace where people can take ownership, learn continuously, and contribute to meaningful improvements in the way teams and talent connect.

**About the Role**

The HR Analyst will support recruitment and core people operations by maintaining accurate data, coordinating hiring workflows, and turning HR information into useful insights. The role owns the reliability of candidate and employee records, recruitment reporting, interview coordination, and timely stakeholder communication. You will work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and internal teams to keep hiring activity organized and measurable. Success means improving process visibility, reducing coordination delays, and helping the organization make consistent, data-informed people decisions. This opportunity requires 1–3 years of hands-on recruitment experience and suits someone who is detail-oriented, analytical, organized, and motivated to build a career in HR within an AI-enabled talent technology company.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate candidate and employee information in HR and recruitment systems, improving data quality and ensuring stakeholders can rely on current records for timely hiring decisions.
* Coordinate recruitment workflows from candidate screening through interview scheduling and follow-up, reducing delays and creating a consistent experience for candidates and hiring teams.
* Prepare regular recruitment and HR reports covering pipeline movement, interview status, hiring activity, and process trends, enabling managers to identify bottlenecks and prioritize action.
* Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to track open roles, clarify requirements, and maintain visibility into progress, improving accountability across the hiring process.
* Support sourcing, screening, and candidate communication activities while maintaining professional, timely engagement that strengthens the organization’s ability to attract qualified talent.
* Identify recurring process gaps in recruitment administration and recommend practical improvements, helping the HR function scale with greater consistency and operational efficiency.
* Protect confidential candidate and employee information by following approved processes, maintaining documentation discipline, and escalating data or compliance concerns promptly.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Mandatory: 1–3 years of hands-on recruitment experience, including candidate coordination, screening support, interview scheduling, and follow-up across multiple hiring stages.
* Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and HR or applicant-tracking systems, with the ability to maintain accurate records, organize data, and prepare clear operational reports.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining reliable service for candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Basic understanding of recruitment metrics and HR operations, with a practical mindset for identifying trends, resolving process issues, and improving workflow visibility.
* Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, technology-led environment while collaborating effectively with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams.

**Additional Plus**

* Exposure to recruitment analytics, dashboards, or reporting automation that has helped improve pipeline visibility or hiring decisions.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled recruitment platforms, talent marketplaces, or HR technology workflows and an interest in how technology can improve access to opportunity.
* Experience supporting employer branding, candidate engagement, onboarding coordination, or other people operations activities beyond core recruitment administration.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring the mandatory 1–3 years of practical recruitment experience and a genuine interest in building a broader HR career. You are organized, dependable, and comfortable owning details that directly affect candidate and stakeholder experience.
* You can manage interview schedules, follow up consistently, maintain accurate records, and keep multiple hiring activities moving without losing quality. You use spreadsheets and systems confidently, understand the importance of clean data, and can turn routine recruitment information into clear updates or useful reports.
* You communicate professionally with candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers, adapting your style while keeping expectations clear. You are curious about process improvement and willing to question inefficient ways of working when a better solution is possible.
* You handle confidential information responsibly and understand that trust is central to HR operations. Most importantly, you are comfortable learning in a growing organization, taking ownership of outcomes, and contributing to a collaborative, inclusive environment where recruitment technology and human judgment work together to improve how people find opportunity.

**Why Join Us**

* Help build the people operations foundation of a global talent technology company, with direct exposure to recruitment, HR analytics, and AI-enabled hiring workflows.
* Work alongside teams improving how employers and candidates connect, giving you a practical opportunity to influence more accessible and merit-driven employment outcomes.
* Grow in a collaborative, fast-moving environment that values ownership, continuous learning, inclusive teamwork, and measurable improvements to everyday recruitment operations.

**What We Offer**

* Meaningful exposure to recruitment operations, HR analytics, talent marketplaces, and AI-powered hiring automation within a growing technology company.
* An inclusive, merit-driven working environment where your ideas, analysis, and process improvements can directly influence team effectiveness and candidate experience.
* Opportunities to learn from cross-functional collaboration with recruiters, hiring managers, and technology teams while developing a strong foundation for a long-term HR career.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description**
SUPER SCREWS PRIVATE LIMITED is a trusted partner to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) across multiple sectors, including automobile, engineering, electronics, and construction. The company focuses on delivering reliable, high-quality fastening solutions that support complex manufacturing and infrastructure needs. By working closely with diverse industrial customers, SUPER SCREWS plays a key role in critical supply chains and long-term production planning. Team members join a dynamic environment where operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement are central to the business.
  
**Role Description**
The Human Resources Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Faridabad. This role oversees end-to-end HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee engagement. The Human Resources Manager will develop and implement HR policies, support compliance with labor laws, and maintain accurate HR documentation and records. Daily responsibilities include partnering with leadership on workforce planning, managing payroll inputs and benefits administration in coordination with finance, and addressing employee queries and grievances promptly and fairly. The role also involves organizing training and development initiatives, supporting health and safety practices, and contributing to a positive, inclusive workplace culture.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in talent acquisition, interviewing, and onboarding to support hiring needs across departments.
* Experience with performance management, goal setting, and conducting or facilitating appraisals.
* Knowledge of HR policies, labor law compliance, and HR documentation, including contracts, letters, and records.
* Ability to manage payroll inputs, attendance systems, and benefits coordination with accuracy and attention to detail.
* Skills in employee relations, conflict resolution, and engagement initiatives to foster a respectful, collaborative culture.
* Proficiency with HR software or ERP systems, MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), and data reporting.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal skills, and the ability to work with stakeholders at all levels.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; professional HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a senior HR role, preferably in manufacturing or industrial sectors.

title: Assistant Manager - TA
description:
* Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented
**Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition**
to manage end-to-end recruitment activities, drive effective sourcing strategies, and ensure timely closure of critical positions across business functions. The ideal candidate should have strong stakeholder management skills, expertise in recruitment analytics, and the ability to lead recruitment initiatives in a fast-paced business environment.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* End-to-End Recruitment
* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from manpower requisition to offer release and onboarding coordination.
* Handle bulk hiring, lateral hiring, and niche recruitment across business and support functions.
* Recruit for positions across Sales, Operations, Customer Service, IT, HR, Finance, Marketing, and other departments.
* Ensure timely closure of open positions as per approved manpower plans and hiring targets.
* Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for critical and recurring positions.
* Sourcing Strategy
* Develop effective sourcing strategies using job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, consultants, and campus recruitment.
* Identify alternative sourcing channels to address talent shortages and high-rejection positions.
* Build and maintain a talent pool for current and future hiring requirements.
* Monitor market availability, salary benchmarks, competitor hiring trends, and candidate expectations.
* Stakeholder Management
* Work closely with hiring managers and department heads to understand job requirements, hiring priorities, and selection criteria.
* Conduct requirement-calibration meetings to improve candidate quality and reduce interview rejections.
* Share regular recruitment updates, hiring challenges, and closure timelines with stakeholders.
* Drive interview coordination, feedback collection, and timely decision-making.
* Team Management
* Guide and monitor recruiters to achieve individual and team hiring targets.
* Allocate requisitions based on priority, complexity, and recruiter capacity.
* Review recruiter productivity, sourcing effectiveness, interview conversion ratios, and offer-to-joining ratios.
* Coach team members on sourcing techniques, screening, candidate engagement, and recruitment processes.
* Recruitment MIS and Analytics
* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment dashboards.
* Track key recruitment metrics, including:

+ Time to Fill and Time to Hire
+ Requisition ageing and closure rate
+ Sourcing-channel effectiveness
+ Screening-to-interview conversion
+ Interview rejection ratio
+ Offer acceptance and joining ratio
+ Recruiter productivity

* Analyse recruitment bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure accuracy and timely maintenance of recruitment data in the ATS/HRMS.
* Candidate Experience and Employer Branding
* Ensure effective communication and a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with shortlisted candidates to minimise dropouts.
* Coordinate with internal teams to strengthen employer branding and improve candidate engagement.
* Ensure proper documentation and adherence to recruitment policies.
* Required Qualifications and Skills
* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably with experience managing a recruitment team.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end recruitment and multiple sourcing channels.
* Experience in bulk hiring, lateral hiring, and critical-position recruitment.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, recruitment dashboards, and HRMS/ATS platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple requisitions and deliver against strict hiring timelines.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and team leadership capabilities.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* Achievement of monthly and quarterly hiring targets.
* Timely closure of critical and ageing positions.
* Improvement in candidate quality and reduction in interview rejection rates.
* Improvement in offer acceptance and joining ratios.
* Recruiter productivity and team performance.
* Accuracy and timeliness of recruitment MIS.
* Hiring manager satisfaction and candidate experience.
* Cost-effective sourcing and recruitment.
* Desired Competencies
* Strategic and analytical thinking
* Team leadership and coaching
* Strong execution and ownership
* Effective stakeholder management
* Negotiation and influencing skills
* Problem-solving and decision-making
* Ability to work in a dynamic, target-driven environment

title: Vice President, Talent Acquisition
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm’s growth continues to outpace market growth and today operates from ten offices across the United States one office in the middle east and one office in Gurugram.
  
  
The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
  
  
Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.
  
  
The Delivery Enablement (DE) team supports internal stakeholders by providing a robust operational backbone across TAS, TES, OCFO, PI, IM, IB and TRS. The team includes Talent Acquisition (TA), Human Capital Management (HCM), Commercial Strategy, Marketing, Data Analytics, Accounting & Finance and Delivery Excellence. As Portage Point continues to grow, the DE team is laser focused on scalability, quality and automation.
  
  
The Vice President (VP), TA opportunity represents a unique opportunity for a highly capable recruiting professional with a proven track record of sourcing and placing top tier candidates. This is Portage Point’s first dedicated Talent Acquisition hire based in India and will be responsible for building and owning the TPI recruiting function from the ground up, in close partnership with the global TA team and local HCM leader. The Vice President, TA will work alongside the Practice Line Leaders to drive high volume and strategic recruiting outcomes across TPI. This VP will focus on flawless execution of the recruitment strategy, sourcing premier talent across various levels and delivering a best-in-class candidate and stakeholder experience, including full ownership of the end-to-end recruiting lifecycle – sourcing through offer execution.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with hiring managers to identify and secure top talent across various career levels
* Own end-to-end recruiting execution within an application tracking system, including requisition management, candidate communication, interview scheduling and pipeline reporting
* Run effective TA processes that decrease interview to hire ratios and increase offer extension to acceptance ratios
* Develop and deploy effective sourcing strategies
* Accurately convey the Portage Point employee value proposition and unique advantages of each role and practice line
* Deliver an efficient and highly communicative experience to candidates and stakeholders
* Manage external agency relationships and reduce overall agency spend
* Develop and execute strategic recruiting initiatives and events
* Maintain standard operating procedures, talent dashboards / reports and recruiting exhibits
* Effectively leverage TA technology and support the research and implementation of new solutions
* Accurately report activities, outcomes and flag potential opportunities and threats
* Manage process changes by developing adequate levels of awareness, desire, knowledge, ability and reinforcement
* Facilitate effective employment branding
* Champion referral bonus program and education internally around open hiring needs
* Share and manage TA best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required
* Contribute to creating a high-performing and inclusive culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gururgram, India
* Invested in a team-based culture and motivated to collaborate in office three days per week
* Six plus years of lateral recruiting experience, primarily in sourcing out of investment banking, private equity or other financial / professional services firms
* Expert in candidate sourcing and selection
* Skillful in screening and / or behavioral interviews
* Experience with employment branding, diversity recruitment and change management
* Full-cycle, end-to-end recruiting experience within an applicant tracking system (ATS), including ownership of interview scheduling
* Direct experience with ATS management is strongly preferred, such as Lever, Greenhouse or Ashby
* Ability to successfully work independently as well as in a small, collaborative team environment
* Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy as Portage Point’s first India-based TA hire, exercising strong judgment and independent decision-making
* High degree of maturity with a proven ability to interact with senior executives
* Effectively communicates analysis through Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint including high-quality messaging, structure and formatting
* Eagerness to be responsive at all times, including flexibility to overlap with U.S. team working hours given the cross-time-zone collaboration this role requires
* Proven track-record of success in high pressure, time-constrained environments
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including strong e-mail etiquette
* Top-tier organizational skills and attention to detail
* Self-starter and entrepreneurial spirit, with the ability to build a function from the ground up

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Enterprise Recruitment Representative - Arden University
description:
ApplyBoard simplifies the study abroad application process by connecting international students, international student advisors, and educational institutions on one personalized platform. For more than a decade, ApplyBoard's team members have been dedicated to breaking down barriers to international education, while thriving at a company that invests in their career growth. Our six core values guide us in our mission to educate the world, and are the foundation of our company culture. As an organization built on diversity, our team members are representative of the students we support.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
We are seeking a driven, well-connected, and organized professional to represent Arden University in Germany across the South Asia market. The successful candidate will lead targeted enrollment growth, enhance partner satisfaction, and serve as a liaison between Arden University, ApplyBoard, and external recruitment partners (agents). This is a hands-on, field-focused role with travel and stakeholder coordination.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing Every Day:**

* Expand international recruitment channels and plan marketing and recruitment strategies for college/university recruitment in assigned regions
* Participate in education fairs; deliver presentations to agents and prospective students; respond to inquiries from prospective students and recruitment partners.
* Conduct a high volume of partner engagement (minimum 5–8 recruitment partner visits daily) and train partners and their counselors on processes, top schools/programs, and admission requirements;
* Plan and deliver regional webinars and seminars with recruitment partners and the internal sales team.
* Ensure recruitment partner quality through regular agent training and by increasing the volume of international applicants to meet semester targets.
* Develop and maintain positive relationships with key internal stakeholders at Arden University and within ApplyBoard.
* Lead regular meetings with the University Recruitment team to monitor targets, market developments, and alignment with strategic objectives.
* Stay current with region-specific industry trends and competitor activity; provide market intelligence to ApplyBoard and Arden University leadership.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* 1-2 years of experience in account management, sales, or recruitment, preferably in the education sector.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Education, or a related field preferred.
* Strong understanding of enrollment processes and strategies within differentiated institutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with internal and external stakeholders.
* Proficient in CRM software and data analysis tools.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Extensive travel (15 working days per month).

**About ApplyBoard**
ApplyBoard empowers students around the world to access international education. Our global team leverages cutting-edge technology to build innovative tools and share sector insights that support our network of international students and 1,500+ partner institutions. We've helped more than 1,300,000 students from over 180 countries with their study abroad journey so far, and we're just getting started.
  
  
Ready to join us? We're grateful for your interest in joining the ApplyBoard team. However, only select applicants will be contacted for an interview.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence tools to support the hiring process, potentially while reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing applicant responses. These tools don't replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by our team members. If you'd like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
  
  
ApplyBoard welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates in all aspects of the hiring and selection process.

title: Academic Program Manager
description:
**About Virohan:**

Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an
**education–to-industry partner**
building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms. Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles. Today, Virohan has trained 13,000+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.

Backed by
**global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),**
we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest-growing sectors.

**Role Overview:**

As the Point of Contact for the Facilitator Success Team at Virohan, you’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring we hire, train, and support high-quality Trainers/Facilitators across our campuses pan-India. This role combines elements of talent acquisition, capability development, and operational management, with the ultimate goal of building a strong and reliable facilitator workforce that delivers exceptional student outcomes.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**Hiring & Requisitions:**

* Identify facilitator needs across campuses in coordination with corporate academics teams.
* Raise timely hiring requisitions to the HR team and track closure progress.
* Conduct interviews to assess facilitator fitment for Virohan’s teaching model.
* Ensure candidate evaluation is consistent and aligned with classroom expectations.

**Training & Capability Building:**

* Plan and execute training for newly joined facilitators, in partnership with the Academic and L&D teams.
* Track training participation and performance metrics to ensure delivery-readiness.
* Organise refresher training or upskilling sessions based on feedback and performance.

**Facilitator Management:**

* Act as the primary contact for facilitators post-joining, addressing operational, performance, and engagement concerns.
* Monitor key metrics such as attendance, classroom effectiveness, and student feedback.
* Support performance improvement plans and retain high-performing faculty.

**Deployment & Operational Coordination:**

* Ensure the timely deployment of trained facilitators across campuses.
* Maintain deployment trackers, hiring dashboards, and MIS.
* Flag potential faculty gaps or risks and proactively work toward resolution.

**Process Improvement:**

* Build scalable systems and SOPs to manage facilitator hiring, training, and deployment.
* Regularly review faculty performance data and recommend operational improvements.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

The HR Manager will be responsible for managing the full spectrum of Human Resources functions including recruitment, employee relations, performance management, payroll coordination, compliance, and organizational development. The role ensures alignment of HR practices with business objectives and fosters a positive workplace culture.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**1. Recruitment & Talent Management**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for all levels including sourcing, interviewing, selection, and onboarding
* Coordinate manpower planning with department heads
* Ensure timely closure of positions with quality hires
* Oversee induction and probation confirmation processes

**2. Employee Relations & Engagement**

* Act as a point of contact for employee grievances and resolve issues professionally
* Promote a positive work culture and employee engagement initiatives
* Conduct regular interaction with employees to understand concerns and improve retention

**3. Performance Management**

* Implement and monitor performance appraisal systems
* Support HODs in goal setting, performance reviews, and feedback processes
* Identify training and development needs based on performance gaps

* Coordinate payroll processing with Accounts / Payroll vendor
* Ensure accuracy of attendance, leave, incentives, deductions, and statutory compliances
* Maintain HR records, employee files, and HRMIS systems

* Ensure compliance with labor laws, PF, ESIC, gratuity, and other statutory requirements
* Draft, update, and implement HR policies, SOPs, and employee handbook
* Handle audits, inspections, and statutory filings

**6. Training & Development**

* Plan and execute employee training and development programs
* Support leadership development and succession planning
* Encourage learning and skill enhancement across teams

**7. Exit Management**

* Handle resignation processes, exit interviews, and final settlements
* Analyze attrition trends and suggest corrective measures

**Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of HR policies, labor laws, and HR best practices
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to handle confidential information with integrity
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills
* Proficiency in MS Office and HRMS tools

**Qualification & Experience**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent
* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant HR experience
* Experience in handling HR operations independently is preferred

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

General description of role:

The Global Offer Management Specialist supports the global offer management process from offer acceptance through the employee’s start date. This role coordinates offer documentation, pre-hire requirements, background check activity, candidate communications, stakeholder follow-up, and system updates to help ensure a smooth, timely, and compliant onboarding experience for new hires and internal transfers. The Specialist works closely with Talent Acquisition, HR, hiring managers, and regional partners to maintain accurate data, resolve routine issues, and support consistent execution of global offer processes.

**Job responsibilities**:

**End-to-End Offer Process Management**

* Support the offer lifecycle globally from offer acceptance through start date, ensuring required steps are completed accurately and on time.
* Prepare, review, and issue offer documentation using approved templates and regional guidance.
* Coordinate and track pre-hire activities, including background checks, work authorization, references, and other market-specific requirements.
* Monitor offer-related milestones and service-level expectations, following up with candidates and stakeholders as needed.
* Identify routine delays or data discrepancies, resolve where possible, and escalate more complex issues to the appropriate partner.

**Candidate Experience & Communication**

* Serve as a key point of contact for candidates after offer acceptance, providing timely updates and clear guidance.
* Guide candidates through pre-employment requirements and onboarding tasks in a professional, supportive manner.
* Respond to routine candidate questions related to documentation, start dates, pre-hire requirements, and onboarding logistics.
* Ensure candidate communications are accurate, consistent, and aligned with the company’s employer brand.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, hiring managers, Compensation & Benefits, Payroll, and regional HR teams to confirm offer details and pre-hire readiness.

* Provide regular status updates and flag potential risks or delays to collaborators throughout the pre-hire process.
* Support hiring managers by confirming start dates, tracking readiness achievements, and sharing relevant pre-start updates.

**Compliance, Data Integrity & Documentation**

* Follow established offer and pre-hire processes in alignment with local labor requirements, internal policies, and data privacy standards.
* Maintain accurate candidate and offer data in HR systems, including ATS, HRIS, background screening platforms, and related tools.
* Prepare contracts, addenda, and supporting documentation using approved terms and templates.
* Maintain complete and audit-ready records for assigned offer and pre-hire activities.

**Process Improvement & Standardization**

* Support the documentation and consistent execution of standardized global offer management processes.
* Find opportunities to improve workflows, reduce manual effort, and enhance candidate and collaborator experience.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives, pilots, and system enhancement activities related to offer management and onboarding.
* Track and maintain offer-related data and metrics, such as pre-hire completion status, start-date readiness, and issue trends.

**Systems & Tools**

* Use applicant tracking systems, HRIS, background screening platforms, digital signature tools, and reporting resources to manage assigned offer activity.
* Complete accurate data entry, status updates, task tracking, and workflow management within required systems.
* Share feedback on system usability, data quality, and process gaps to support ongoing improvements.

* 3+ years of experience in HR, Talent Acquisition operations, onboarding, recruiting coordination, or a similar operational role.
* Experience supporting time-sensitive processes across multiple collaborators, regions, or time zones .

* **Adaptability:** Works comfortably across different cultures, time zones, systems, and regional requirements.

title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  

* Business acumen, and the ability to communicate to executives, business domain stakeholders and technical staff.
* Strong project management, acumen and familiarity working in agile environments.
* Experience with innovation and ideation methods, such as design thinking and product management.
* Demonstrated influence, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work well with others and exhibit leadership.
* Be an excellent communicator and collaborator, engaging with multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders. Team player with collaborative and inclusive approach.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  

* 10+ years in data governance, model risk, technology risk, compliance or a related analytical role.
* Bachelors degree in field like Computer Science, Information technology, Math, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance (with focus on analysis) etc. and/or relevant proven work experience is required

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

*“We are going to relentlessly chase perfection, knowing full well we will not catch it, because nothing is perfect. But we are going to chase it because, in the process, we will catch excellence.” — Vince Lombardi*

**Role Purpose**
================

The India Delivery Operations Manager leads the daily management system for MyAdvice delivery teams based in Bengaluru. This leader is accountable for whether assigned employees produce the required work, at the required quality, on the required schedule.

Operational excellence is a daily discipline at MyAdvice. This leader reviews performance data during the workday, coaches employees and local leads, addresses shortfalls directly, and escalates risks early. The role requires visible, in-office leadership and the resolve to hold people accountable for output, quality, attendance, and follow-through.

This role does not replace functional leadership. Functional leaders define the work, quality standards, priorities, and client-service tradeoffs for their functions. The India Delivery Operations Manager makes those expectations operational every day for the Bengaluru team.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Run the daily operating rhythm**
----------------------------------

* Lead a daily operating review that covers staffing, attendance, planned work, completed work, quality, rework, blockers, and client-impacting risks.
* Review performance data during the workday. Identify emerging shortfalls early and agree on a concrete recovery plan or escalation.
* Maintain visible, accurate scorecards for assigned teams and ensure that every measure uses an agreed definition, data source, and quality standard.
* Coordinate daily priorities with U.S.-based functional leaders and align local work to current client and business needs.
* Create, maintain, and enforce practical role-level SOPs and checklists for recurring work; make expectations easy to follow, identify gaps, and update documentation as work changes.

**Manage people and performance**
---------------------------------

* Set clear expectations for attendance, work output, quality, professional conduct, and timely communication.
* Coach employees and local leads using factual performance data. Address missed expectations promptly, document recurring issues, and involve functional leaders or HR when appropriate.
* Communicate expectations, performance feedback, recovery plans, and escalations clearly, directly, and consistently so employees understand both the required standard and the next action.
* Recognize strong performance and support role-based incentives that reward sustained output and quality.
* Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain capable delivery employees in partnership with HR and functional leaders.

**Protect quality and client experience**
-----------------------------------------

* Monitor quality and rework trends, identify root causes, and make sure corrective actions are completed and verified.
* Escalate client-impacting quality, capacity, or service risks early, with a clear summary of the issue, the immediate containment action, and the decision needed.
* Ensure local process execution follows functional standards and documented procedures. Do not unilaterally change functional quality standards or client priorities.

**Build the Bengaluru delivery center**
---------------------------------------

* Create a focused office environment that supports collaboration, reliable attendance, coaching, and high-quality work.
* Partner with the Vice President of Operations on office capacity, local facilities needs, hiring plans, and the timing for additional management layers as the team grows.
* Serve as the local operational point of contact for the Bengaluru office while maintaining a clear separation between workplace administration and delivery accountability.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* The Bengaluru team consistently meets defined output, quality, attendance, and timeliness expectations.
* Shortfalls are identified during the workday, discussed directly, and resolved through documented recovery plans or timely escalation.
* Functional leaders have confidence that India-based delivery work follows agreed standards and that recurring issues receive sustained attention.
* Quality defects, preventable rework, missed commitments, and unexplained attendance issues decline over time.
* The office can scale from its initial team without losing clarity, management discipline, or client focus.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Willingness to work deeply with AI tools.
* Ten or more years of operations, delivery, production, business-process, or service-management experience in India, including direct responsibility for team performance.
* Demonstrated experience managing employees through clear productivity and quality standards, coaching, and performance improvement.
* Comfort with operational reporting, spreadsheets or dashboards, and using data to make day-to-day management decisions.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with U.S.-based functional leaders and conduct clear, direct performance conversations.
* Demonstrated ability to turn operational standards into clear, practical SOPs, checklists, and written guidance that employees can use consistently.
* Sound judgment, discretion, and consistency in direct people management and client-impacting escalations.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience managing teams that support digital marketing operations, web production, onboarding, customer operations, or technology-enabled services.
* Experience launching, expanding, or leading an in-office delivery center or hybrid workforce.
* Experience improving a process through automation, quality assurance, capacity planning, or workflow redesign.

**Position Details**

* Compensation: Base plus performance bonus
* Position Type: Full-time
* Work Location: Bangalore (Bengaluru), India
* Travel: May require occasional local or nation travel (less than 5% of the time, *if at all).*
* Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer (90% at desk, 10% of time walking); Ability to lift up to 30lbs and use typical office equipment (computer, keyboards, printer, etc.).

**Benefits**

* Employer contributed medical insurance (100% premium covered by the company)
* Provident Fund (PF) contributions as per policy
* Leave Policy: 12 Sick/Casual Leaves + 18 Annual Leaves + 10 Company Holidays
* Flexible Schedules + Early Out Fridays!
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Free mental health support, financial/legal consultations and more
* Tuition Reimbursement Program (up to 1 lakh annually) + Executive Mentorship Program
* Ongoing personalized coaching and career development support
* Casual Dress (non-client facing roles) and Fun Work Environment
* Weekly Core Value Award, Project Fantastic (client collaboration) and more!

description:
**Senior Functional Consultant**

**Company:** Tridots Tech Pvt Ltd  
**Location:** Porur, Chennai  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About Tridots Tech

Tridots Tech Pvt Ltd is an IT solutions and consulting company specializing in ERP implementation, business process automation, and customized digital solutions. We partner with businesses to simplify complex workflows, improve operational efficiency, and drive meaningful business transformation through technology.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a results-driven **Senior Functional Consultant** who can bridge the gap between business challenges and technology solutions. This role is ideal for a professional who understands business processes, enjoys engaging with clients, and can transform complex requirements into practical, scalable, and effective solutions.

You will take ownership of functional consulting activities, guide clients through implementation processes, and collaborate with technical teams to ensure solutions deliver measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Business Consulting & Requirement Analysis**

* Engage with clients to understand their business models, operational workflows, challenges, and objectives.
* Conduct requirement-gathering sessions, stakeholder interviews, and process analysis workshops.
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation and optimization.
* Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications and implementation plans.

**2. Solution Design & Implementation**

* Design functional solutions aligned with client requirements and business goals.
* Configure and implement business applications based on approved functional specifications.
* Map existing workflows to system capabilities and recommend suitable process improvements.
* Coordinate with developers for customizations, integrations, and technical enhancements.
* Ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with implementation best practices.

**3. Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key point of contact between clients and internal technical teams.
* Communicate solution approaches, project updates, risks, and dependencies clearly.
* Conduct product demonstrations, user training, and functional walkthroughs.
* Manage client expectations and support effective resolution of functional issues.

**4. Testing, Deployment & Support**

* Prepare functional test scenarios and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Validate implemented solutions against business requirements.
* Coordinate deployment activities, user onboarding, and post-implementation support.
* Troubleshoot functional issues and ensure timely resolution in collaboration with relevant teams.

**5. Documentation & Project Coordination**

* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), process flow diagrams, and user guides.
* Track requirements, change requests, action items, and implementation milestones.
* Maintain accurate project documentation and communicate progress to stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of consulting practices and implementation quality.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in Functional Consulting, ERP Implementation, Business Process Consulting, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of business workflows and enterprise application implementation.
* Excellent client-facing communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and design functional solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making abilities.
* Experience in functional configuration, testing, documentation, and user training.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with technical and non-technical teams.
* A proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Preferred Experience

* Experience with ERP systems, business management applications, or process automation projects.
* Hands-on experience with ERPNext or the Frappe Framework.
* Understanding of business functions such as Finance, Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, HR, or Operations.
* Familiarity with software development life cycles, Agile methodologies, and project management practices.

What Makes You a Good Fit?

* You think beyond requirements and focus on solving the underlying business problem.
* You can confidently communicate with clients and convert discussions into actionable solutions.
* You balance business priorities with technical feasibility.
* You take ownership of deliverables and work proactively to overcome implementation challenges.
* You enjoy learning new technologies and improving the way businesses operate.

Why Join Tridots Tech?

* Work on real-world business transformation and digitalization projects.
* Gain exposure to diverse business processes and client environments.
* Collaborate closely with consulting, development, and implementation teams.
* Build expertise in enterprise solutions, functional consulting, and process automation.
* Grow in a collaborative environment that values initiative, accountability, and continuous learning.

Apply Now

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at **jobs@tridotstech.com**.

description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress.
