**The AVP – Employee Relations and Compliance**
is responsible for developing, governing, and executing the employee relations and HR regulatory compliance framework for the India GCC. This role ensures adherence to applicable labour and employment laws, statutory obligations, employee relations processes, workplace investigations, and compliance governance requirements.
  
  
The incumbent will serve as the compliance subject matter expert and governance lead, partnering closely with Legal, Payroll, HR Operations, Facilities, Procurement, external labour compliance vendors, and business leaders to mitigate risk, maintain audit readiness, and ensure an equitable, compliant, and positive employee experience.
  
  
The role will be accountable for labour compliance oversight, regulatory monitoring, statutory inspections, compliance audits, policy governance, employee grievance management, disciplinary processes, and employee relations strategy across the India organization.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Compliance Governance

–Own and lead the end-to-end employment and labour compliance framework for the India GCC.
  
  
–Ensure compliance with applicable Central and State employment laws, labour regulations, and statutory obligations.
  
  
–Establish governance mechanisms for monitoring compliance obligations, statutory filings, registrations, renewals, notices, record maintenance, and payments.
  
  
–Build and maintain a compliance calendar and compliance dashboard covering all employment-related statutory requirements.
  
  
–Monitor regulatory changes and assess business impact, ensuring timely implementation of new compliance requirements.
  
  
–Drive compliance awareness and training programs for People leaders and employees.
  
  
–Act as the primary compliance escalation point for labour law matters.
  
  

* Labour Law & Statutory Compliance Management

–Oversee compliance with employment related legislation
  
  
–Ensure statutory filings, registrations, renewals, inspections, notices, and returns are completed accurately and within timelines.
  
  
–Partner with Payroll and HR Operations to ensure all payroll-linked statutory requirements are met.
  
  

* Employee Relations & Workplace Governance

–Develop and execute the Employee Relations strategy for the GCC.
  
  
–Lead employee grievance resolution, disciplinary actions, misconduct investigations, workplace complaints, and conflict management.
  
  
–Drive fair, consistent, and legally compliant employee relations processes.
  
  
–Support leaders with performance-related employee matters, conduct concerns, workplace disputes, and behavioral issues.
  
  
–Ensure compliance with internal policies, code of conduct requirements, and ethical standards.
  
  
–Partner with Legal where required on complex employee matters and litigation risks.
  
  
–Lead workplace investigations and ensure appropriate documentation, governance, and closure.
  
  

* Compliance Vendor & Regulatory Relationship Management

–Manage relationships with external labour compliance vendors and legal advisors.
  
  
–Oversee labour law registrations, statutory record maintenance, compliance audits, regulatory filings, and labour inspection support through vendors.
  
  
–Coordinate responses to government authorities, inspectors, labour departments, and other regulators.
  
  
–Monitor vendor performance through SLAs, audit outcomes, compliance metrics, and governance reviews.
  
  
–Serve as the internal liaison for all labour compliance related regulatory interactions.
  
  

* Audit, Risk & Controls

–Lead labour compliance audits and compliance self-assessments.
  
  
–Ensure organizational readiness for internal audits, regulatory inspections, external audits, and diligence exercises.
  
  
–Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for emerging compliance risks.
  
  
–Develop controls to ensure sustainable compliance adherence.
  
  
–Drive corrective action tracking and closure of audit observations.
  
  
–Maintain evidence repositories and statutory documentation for audit purposes.
  
  

* Policy Governance & Employee Experience

–Own policy governance for employment-related policies and procedures.
  
  
–Review, update, and implement policies to align with legislative and organizational requirements.
  
  
–Ensure compliance requirements are embedded into employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, transfers, promotions, leave management, separations, contractor management, and workforce engagement.
  
  
–Partner with business and People leaders to maintain a positive employee experience while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation.
  
  

* Reporting, Analytics & Governance Forums

–Develop compliance dashboards and executive reporting mechanisms.
  
  
–Provide regular updates to GCC Leadership and People Leadership teams on compliance status, risks, audits, investigations, and corrective actions.
  
  
–Use compliance and employee relations data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in law, Employment Law, Labour Relations, Human Resources, or related discipline.
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and employment compliance and regulatory frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of employee relations and workplace governance practices
* Experience managing employment compliance audits, investigations, and labour inspections.
* Certifications in Labour Laws, Compliance, Industrial Relations, or Compliance Management are preferred.

**Preferred Experience**
–15+ years of experience in HR Compliance, Employee Relations, Labour Relations, HR Operations, or Industrial Relations.
  
  
–Experience in BFSI GCC, multinational corporations, or regulated environments is strongly preferred.
  
  
–Experience working with external compliance and payroll vendors.
  
  
–Demonstrated experience managing labour inspections, audits, regulatory inquiries, and investigations.
  
  
–Strong experience designing scalable compliance governance frameworks.
  
  
**Core Competency & Behavioural Description**

* Regulatory Compliance Expertise: Deep understanding of labour laws, statutory requirements, regulatory frameworks, and compliance governance.
* Employee Relations: Strong capability in grievance management, investigations, disciplinary processes, and workplace conflict resolution.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor compliance and employee relations risks proactively.
* Audit & Controls: Experience designing compliance controls and driving audit readiness.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to partner effectively with business leaders, legal teams, payroll teams, regulators, and external vendors.
* Policy Governance: Strong capability in developing, reviewing, and implementing policies and compliance frameworks.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to use compliance data and people analytics to drive decisions and identify emerging risks.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence leaders at all levels.
* Investigation & Judgment: Demonstrated capability to conduct impartial investigations and make sound risk-based decisions.

description:
**ABOUT AMGEN**
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
  
  
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the
  
  
Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

* Coordinate implementation of approved benefit design changes and new initiatives.

* Develop and maintain process documentation, controls, project plans, and operating procedures to support effective program delivery.

**Vendor & Broker Management**

* Serve as an operational point of contact for assigned vendors and brokers.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed service requirements, deliverables, and timelines.
* Investigate service issues, coordinate corrective actions, and escalate significant risks as appropriate.
* Facilitate vendor governance meetings, track action plans, and ensure timely resolution of open items.
* Support procurements, contract renewals, implementations, transitions, and third-party risk management activities.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Apply established benefits governance requirements and operational controls across assigned activities.
* Maintain benefits documentation, process records, governance materials, and audit evidence.
* Identify potential compliance, control, or operational risks and coordinate appropriate remediation activities.
* Support regulatory change implementation by coordinating operational updates and stakeholder actions.
* Support internal and external audits through data collection, documentation, and issue resolution activities.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Analyse benefits cost, utilization, participation, employee experience, and vendor performance data.
* Interpret trends and translate findings into actionable recommendations for Benefits Managers and stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and performance metrics.
* Support program evaluation, benchmarking activities, and business case development.
* Prepare analyses and insights for leadership reviews, governance forums, and stakeholder decision-making.

**Employee Experience & Communications**

* Partner with Benefits Operations and Communications teams to deliver benefits education and engagement initiatives.
* Coordinate communication activities related to benefit changes, annual enrolment, and employee awareness campaigns.
* Review benefits materials for operational accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Use employee feedback, service metrics, and operational insights to identify opportunities to enhance the employee experience.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Establish effective working relationships with HR Operations, Finance, Legal, Procurement, brokers, vendors, and regional stakeholders.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities to support timely and accurate benefits delivery.
* Facilitate issue resolution and alignment across stakeholders involved in benefits operations and projects.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Typically, 5+ years of experience in benefits, total rewards, HR operations, or a related field.
* Experience administering or coordinating employee benefits programs.
* Experience working with benefits vendors, consultants, brokers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong project coordination and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including interpretation of benefits and operational data.
* Knowledge of benefits governance, compliance requirements, and operational controls.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and exercise judgment within established policies and procedures.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting benefits programs across multiple countries or regions.
* Experience with global benefits operations, vendor governance, and program implementation.
* Exposure to healthcare, insurance, retirement, and wellbeing program administration.

Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate’s route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. title: Associate Director, Early Talent
description:
**Description**
Associate Director, Early Talent
  
  
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Build the capability from the ground up - Define the early talent operating model, governance, processes, technology needs, partner ecosystem and implementation roadmap.
* Create the global framework - Establish consistent principles, program standards and candidate

experiences that can be adapted to local talent markets, regulations and business requirements.
  
  

* Shape the portfolio - Build internship, graduate, apprenticeship and other early-career pathways aligned with workforce plans, future skills and growth priorities. Assess and optimize the existing portfolio, including opportunities to consolidate duplicative campus recruiting, university partnerships and marketing efforts, and evaluate programs that may no longer have the ROI or

strategic fit.
  
  

* Build the campus ecosystem - Identify priority institutions and develop trusted relationships with university leaders, placement teams, faculty, student bodies and relevant academic networks.
* Build the early talent brand - Create a differentiated proposition and lead year-round campus campaigns, content, pre-placement engagements and build engagement initiatives.
* Deliver with the business - Partner across global Business, HR and Talent Acquisition teams to translate demand into hiring plans, entry requirements, assessments and development experiences. Connect early talent strategy to future skill gaps and build-vs.-buy workforce decisions.
* Measure and improve - Use data on reach, quality, diversity, conversion, cost, experience, performance and retention to improve outcomes and demonstrate programme value.

**Qualification Requirements :**

* A proven record of building an early talent or campus hiring capability from its early stages - notonly operating an established annual programme.
* Strong knowledge of the full early talent lifecycle - not only recruitment - including programmedesign, candidate engagement, onboarding, development and outcome measurement
* . Established relationships across leading universities and institutions Globally
* Substantial experience designing or leading early talent programs across multiple countries,regions or global business groups, balancing global consistency with local requirements.
* A strong track record in building early talent employer brands and creating campus experiences that improve awareness, engagement and hiring outcomes.
* Strong ability to partner with business leaders and help them establish priorities in the campusspace.
* Strong executive presence, program leadership and analytical capability, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and work effectively across cultures and time zones.
* It requires flexibility to collaborate across global time zones.
* Travel will be based on need.

**Critical Skills**

* Early Talent Strategy
* Campus Recruiting
* Employer Branding
* Program Development & Governance
* Stakeholder Management
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills

**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com
  
  
**Additional Information**
Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  
**Summary**
The Associate Director, Early Talent is responsible for establishing and leading the organization's global Early Talent and campus hiring capability. This role creates the strategy, operating model, partnerships, governance, and delivery approach required to build and scale the Early Talent function globally. The position serves as the owner of the global Early Talent framework, ensuring it can be effectively adapted across markets while supporting local business and talent needs. A key focus of the role is building the Syneos Health Early Talent brand and driving consistent Early Talent programs and experiences across the organization.

title: Senior Operations Manager, FAI-KFE
description:
**Description**
The Senior Operations Manager owns the operational excellence of our India site within Frontier AI (Knowledge Fulfillment Engine Org). Leading a multi-layered organization of 500+ data associates, this role demands a leader who combines strategic vision with relentless execution — someone who can simultaneously architect the future state of site operations while delivering flawless daily execution against challenging SLAs.
  
  
This is not a maintenance role. The successful candidate will challenge the status quo, eliminate inefficiency, raise the performance ceiling, and leave the operation materially stronger than they found it. This role requires comfort with ambiguity, the ability to context-switch between strategic planning and tactical problem-solving, and the judgment to know which mode a situation demands. Regular engagement with senior leadership on strategy, risk, and performance is expected.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the end-to-end operational P&L for the HYD site, driving measurable improvements in cost-per-unit economics while maintaining or exceeding quality SLAs across all active programs.
* Drive workforce planning in partnership with Finance, aligning labor capacity models to demand forecasts and managing flex strategies (overtime, cross-training, temporary labor) to maintain SLA compliance during volume fluctuations.
* Define and execute a multi-year operational strategy for Data Services at the site, anticipating shifts in program volume, automation adoption, and workforce composition, and proactively positioning the site to absorb new workstreams.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Product, and Program teams to define tooling requirements, influence product roadmaps based on operational friction data, and validate feature releases through structured UAT processes.
* Own the site's quality ecosystem — establishing closed-loop mechanisms where defect root causes are identified, corrective actions are implemented within one sprint cycle, and systemic patterns are escalated with data-backed proposals to Engineering and Product teams.
* Architect scalable processes that reduce dependency on headcount growth, leveraging automation, tooling improvements, and workflow redesign to deliver throughput gains quarter over quarter without proportional cost increases.
* Build and lead a high-performing leadership team (Operations Managers, Team Managers), setting differentiated performance expectations, calibrating talent rigorously, and maintaining a ready-now succession pipeline for all critical roles.
* Champion a data-driven culture where every operational decision is grounded in statistical analysis, A/B testing of process changes is standard practice, and anecdotal reasoning is challenged.
* Build and sustain an engagement model that delivers measurable year-over-year improvement in associate retention and engagement scores, with specific interventions tied to root-cause analysis of attrition drivers.
* Serve as the site's executive voice to senior leadership — translating operational data into strategic narratives, owning regular business review inputs, drafting strategic papers for director-level decision forums, and proactively surfacing risks with mitigation plans.
* Operate as a force multiplier across the cluster, sharing best practices, standardizing processes across sites, and contributing to org-wide mechanisms that raise the performance ceiling for peer sites.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

* Experience managing large teams across multiple locations and languages, or experience as an acting operations manager

* 1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
* Experience delivering against a large organization's long-term strategy and goals

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in natural language data labeling, data annotation, linguistic annotation or other forms of data markup, or experience in editorial writing
* Experience with Six Sigma tools and Lean techniques, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience with automation and any version control tools
* Experience with data and analysis tools including Microsoft Excel and SQL
* Experience working cross-functionally and with a wide range of employees with different skill sets
* Master's degree or above in Operations , Computer Science, or equivalent; or equivalent experience applying quantitative analysis to business problems.

* Experience providing continuous improvement recommendations for HR process streamlining.

description:

**Manager - Integration Solutioning & Technical Leadership (US Shift)**

Department: Integrations

Reports To: Senior Manager / Director

Location: Hyderabad (Hybrid) - working with clients primarily in North America

Shift: US Shift (aligned to US business hours, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM IST)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6-10 years

Team Size Managed: 2-4 Technical Consultants (US-shift and cross-region)

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Manager to lead Integrations for a portfolio of US-based clients, working in the US shift. You will lead and grow a team of Technical Consultants responsible for integration solutioning and development — owning technical direction, guiding solution design, and ensuring high-quality delivery of new and enhanced integration interfaces. You will be the primary integrations point of contact for client leadership during US business hours, drive periodic leadership connects through demos and meetups, and step in hands-on to help the team solve complex issues on integration interfaces when needed. Our team already uses AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, you will deepen and scale this practice across the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* 1. Lead and manage a team of 2-4 Technical Consultants — set priorities, plan capacity, run performance reviews, hire and develop talent, mentor on solutioning, and drive accountability for integration outcomes.

* 2. Own integration solutioning end to end — translate client requirements and change requests into robust designs (APIs, file-based flows, middleware patterns) and guide the team through build and delivery.

* 3. Lead and review the solutioning work done by Technical Consultants — ensure code quality, reusability, maintainability, and alignment with platform and integration standards.

* 4. Act as the technical lead for key integration engagements — drive architecture decisions, design reviews, and complex solutioning discussions with clients and internal stakeholders.

* 5. Drive client leadership connects with US clients through demos and meetups, in their time zone — showcase integration capabilities, walk through solution approaches, align on roadmap priorities, and strengthen executive-level confidence in delivery.

* 6. Own escalations and production issues on integration interfaces during US hours — debug failures, unblock consultants on complex interface problems, restore stable data flows, and communicate status to client stakeholders.

* 7. Stay hands-on with Python and integration tooling to review, guide, and when required, contribute to builds and troubleshooting on integration interfaces.

* 8. Build on the team's existing use of AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, strengthen AI-assisted design, coding, review, and documentation practices so the team delivers faster with consistent quality.

* 9. Partner with India-based Product/Engineering teams on platform capabilities, ensuring clean handoffs across time zones on integration patterns and enhancements needed for scalable client solutions.

* 10. Build and maintain solutioning standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation so the team can deliver consistently as engagement volume grows.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 6-10 years of experience in technical consulting, integration solutioning/development, or similar roles within HRTech/SaaS or enterprise software.

* Proven experience managing Technical Consultants or similar delivery teams (3+ years in a people-management role) — including hiring, performance management, quality oversight, and owning delivery outcomes.

* Strong hands-on programming ability in Python — comfortable writing, reading, reviewing, and debugging integration code.

* Solid expertise in system integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, middleware) with the ability to design and solution complex integration landscapes.

* Demonstrated ability to help teams diagnose and resolve issues on integration interfaces in production environments.

* Experience engaging client leadership through demos, technical meetups, and executive-facing solution discussions.

* Experience working with US/North American clients, and willingness to work the US shift on a sustained basis.

* A quick learner who already uses AI tools for solutioning and writing code (e.g., LLM-based assistants, coding copilots) and can strengthen this practice across a delivery team.

* Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills — able to explain technical designs clearly and lead solution discussions with both technical and leadership audiences.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance leadership responsibilities and hands-on technical contribution.

**Good to Have**

* JavaScript experience — a plus for integration builds, scripting, and related client-side or middleware work.

* Prior direct experience with the Darwinbox platform or similar HRMS/HCM products.

* Exposure to standard and custom integration patterns (SFTP, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware tools).

* Experience scaling AI-assisted solutioning and coding practices across a consulting or engineering team.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

Within the first two quarters, this person will have become the trusted integrations lead for US client leadership, established clear ownership of integration solutioning and development quality across their team, built a strong rhythm of client leadership demos and meetups, helped stabilize and resolve complex integration interface issues, and strengthened the team's existing AI-driven approach to solutioning and coding — leaving behind a high-performing US-shift Technical Consultant team capable of scaling delivery with consistent quality.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

This role anchors PXT support for a set of Corporate Operations teams in India under Udit Madan — one of the most strategically dense Principal HRBP charters in Amazon India. Three businesses, each large enough to demand its own people strategy, each navigating a different kind of change at once: ASCS is in business transformation, SCOT is in team-and-org evolution, and the broader Corp Ops portfolio is consolidating its PXT support model alongside a multi-year, GenAI-led workforce transformation. The incumbent partners directly with multiple L8 leaders (tech and non-tech), sets the HR strategy for the combined client group, and operates with the autonomy and influence of a Principal — shaping org design, talent, culture, and workforce transformation rather than executing someone else’s plan. The connective tissue is the common disciplines — org design, span-of-control, leadership depth, talent movement, change leadership — applied to three distinct problems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Org design & planning: set HR strategy and goals for the client group; lead org design, succession, and change leadership across all three businesses within OP1/OP2/R&O/S-Team goals..
* Talent management: drive forward-looking promotions, succession and top-talent movement incl. L7L8; coach senior business and tech leaders; partner with Comp/Benefits/Stock in a high-mobility market.
* Workforce planning: partner with Finance & Recruiting on OP1/OP2/R&O headcount; set sourcing strategy and strengthen the senior tech/science pipeline.
* Data & culture: use Clarity to diagnose and influence; role-model Leadership Principles and preserve Day-1 culture through scale.
* Function as a coach and consultant to key leaders and their respective organizations; engage in strategic planning meetings to translate business needs into HR plans.
* Review and analyze business metrics including data on retention and employee experience to recommend systemic improvements and drive data-informed decisions.
* Engage COE partners (HR Partner, Talent Management, Organizational Effectiveness, Talent Acquisition, Compensation) to define and tackle organizational obstacles and drive broader PXT initiatives.
* Leverage data, functional expertise, and sound judgment to influence long-term decisions, drive organizational effectiveness, and evolve ways of working across both functions.
* Explore and apply GenAI tools where they add value to HR work, combining AI with human expertise while maintaining transparency, accountability, and sound judgment.

  
About the team  
the Amazon Stores PXT team provides high leverage HRBP support to multiple Stores organization working closely with leaders owning global charters. The HRBPs are at forefront of driving the leadership vision for the teams and driving excellence at the site. They engage across Tech, Business, and Non Tech customer groups working on unique problems to drive higher productivity, better experience, and building strong leadership and culture.

------------------------

* 10+ years of human resources management, or 10+ years of human resources leadership experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of compensation/total rewards, talent management, performance management, compliance, and organization design and development

description:
**Position**: Director-Talent Acquisition

**Location**: Mumbai (Andheri west)

**Industry**: Exhibitions.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a results-obsessed **Director**-**Talent Acquisition** who understands one thing clearly-strong sales teams drive business. This role is about building, scaling, and sustaining high-performing sales teams not just hiring resumes, but hiring closers, managing performance, and ensuring targets are met through the right people, structure, and accountability.

**What You’ll Own**

**Sales Recruitment (Core Focus)**

-Own end-to-end hiring for Business Development, Sales Managers, City Heads, and Sales Leadership.

-Drive rapid hiring for exhibitions across multiple cities.

-Build strong pipelines of target-driven, high-closure sales talent.

-Reduce hiring TAT and ensure quality hires, not just quick joins.

**Team & Vendor Management**

-Build, mentor, and lead the internal recruitment team.

-Manage and optimize external consultants and recruitment partners (non-retainer basis).

-Ensure adherence to recruitment budgets and policies.

**Employer Branding & Process Excellence**

-Strengthen employer branding to attract top sales talent.

-Improve recruitment processes, interview frameworks, and candidate experience.

-Leverage job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and networking to build strong talent pools.

**Sales Performance & Target Management**

-Partner with business heads to define sales targets, KRAs, and incentive structures.

-Track performance of existing sales teams against targets.

-Drive performance reviews, corrections, and improvement plans for underperformers.

-Support leadership with data-driven insights on sales productivity.

**Managing Current Sales Employees**

-Ensure sales teams are aligned, motivated, and accountable.

-Oversee onboarding, ramp-up, and early productivity of new sales hires.

-Handle sales attrition proactively through engagement and performance clarity.

-Act swiftly on performance issues while maintaining fairness.

**HR Operations & Discipline**

-Ensure payroll, incentives, attendance, and compliance are flawless for sales teams.

-Implement clear HR policies that support high-performance sales culture.

-Maintain strict adherence to timelines, reporting, and accountability.

**Who You Are**

-Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration or related field.

-15–21 years of HR experience with heavy exposure to sales hiring

-Proven track record of hiring and managing target-driven sales teams

-Strong understanding of incentives, performance metrics, and sales behavior

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced HR Manager who will act as a generalist across both our India and US locations. You will oversee day-to-day HR operations, lead recruitment, and manage facilities, while staying hands-on with execution. This role suits someone who can set up good processes, handle the operational details themselves, and work across two countries and time zones with confidence.

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations and Compliance

* Manage the full employee lifecycle across both locations: onboarding, confirmations, transfers, separations, and exit formalities.
* Own payroll inputs, attendance, leave, and benefits administration in coordination with payroll providers or internal finance.
* Maintain employee records and HRIS data accurately, and ensure policies are current and consistently applied.
* Ensure compliance with local labour laws. In India, this includes PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax, Shops and Establishments registrations, and POSH obligations. In the US, this includes federal and state employment requirements, I-9 verification, and benefits compliance
* Handle employee queries, grievances, and disciplinary matters in a fair, documented, and confidential manner.
* Prepare HR reports and dashboards (headcount, attrition, leave, compliance status) for leadership.

Recruitment

* Own end-to-end hiring for both locations: requisition intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, and joining formalities.
* Work with hiring managers to define role requirements and interview processes.
* Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job boards, and campus or employer-branding channels.
* Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and offer acceptance rates.
* Support a consistent candidate experience across India and US hiring processes, including any cross-border hiring considerations.

Facilities and Workplace Administration

* Oversee office operations in both locations: space planning, seating, supplies, housekeeping, and maintenance.
* Manage vendor relationships and contracts for facilities services (housekeeping, security, pantry, AMC, utilities, courier, and similar).
* Coordinate workplace safety, fire and emergency drills, and statutory safety inspections as required.
* Manage the budget for facilities and admin, and track spend against it.
* Support travel, visa-related logistics, and coordination where needed.

Hands-On Generalist Work

* Handle HR queries and tasks directly rather than only delegating them.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, events, and recognition programs.
* Contribute to policy drafting and process improvement across both locations.
* Act as a point of coordination between the India and US teams on HR matters.

Qualifications

* Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10 to 15 years of HR generalist experience, with at least 2 years in a managerial or lead role.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance. Familiarity with US employment law and multi-state compliance is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in full-cycle recruitment, including for mid-level and senior roles.
* Experience managing facilities or admin functions, or coordinating vendors and budgets.
* Experience working with a team or stakeholders across more than one country.
* Proficiency with HRIS and payroll systems, and strong skills in Excel or Google Sheets.

Key Competencies

* Operational discipline: Keeps processes accurate, documented, and on schedule.
* Confidentiality and judgement: Handles sensitive employee matters with discretion and fairness.
* Cross-cultural communication: Works well with teams in different countries and time zones.
* Hands-on ownership: Takes tasks from start to finish without needing close supervision.
* Stakeholder management: Builds trust with employees, managers, and leadership.

Adaptability: Manages competing priorities in a growing organisation.

Kindly share your detaila at praveen.dighe@hwtglobal.com**

title: Senior Learning Technology & Innovation Consultant
description:
**Job Description**

**Overview**

If you enjoy working at the intersection of learning, technology, and customer experience, this role is for you.

Help shape the future of customer learning at NIQ. NIQ is transforming how customers learn, adopt, and get value from our data, products, and platforms. In this role, you’ll help design, build, and scale the technology solutions behind digital learning experiences that support NIQ’s large, global FMCG and T&D clients as they move from onboarding to confident product adoption.

Work on visible, strategic initiatives. You’ll contribute to global, leadership-visible client learning initiatives, including the implementation of a new Learning Experience Platform. From configuring and optimizing AI-enabled learning systems to developing integrations, automation, and technical enhancements, you’ll play a hands-on role in building a modern, scalable global learning ecosystem. You’ll collaborate across Product, AI, Technology, UX, and content teams, acting as a bridge between business requirements and technical solutions.

Build future-ready technical skills. This role provides the opportunity to deepen your expertise across learning technology, AI, automation, integrations, and front-end customization while experimenting with emerging tools and turning ideas into practical solutions. You’ll apply strong systems thinking and hands-on technical skills to continuously evolve NIQ’s customer learning ecosystem.

**Responsibilities**

Learning Technology Innovation & Platform Operations

Technical execution, optimization, and scalability of NIQ’s learning ecosystem.

* Support the design, implementation, configuration, testing, and launch of a new Learning Experience Platform (LXP).
* Optimize learning content discoverability through platform configuration, audience segmentation, content taxonomy and metadata, and connections to related learning technologies.
* Leverage HTML, CSS, and code snippets to maintain platform front-end customizations and enhance learner-facing experiences.
* Partner with external vendors and NIQ technology, platform, & UX teams to implement integrations, platform enhancements, and escalate technical troubleshooting.
* Partner with NIQ AI & Technology teams to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to streamline content creation, governance processes, and maintenance workflows
* Maintain and collect priorities for the learning technology product roadmap, translating learner and business needs into platform improvements and technical requirements.
* Troubleshoot advanced learning technology issues, including learner access, SCORM/xAPI, rendering, completion tracking, integrations, and content interoperability.
* Test new platform capabilities, releases, integrations, and technical enhancements and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
* Contribute to ongoing platform administration, including content setup, publishing, QA, troubleshooting, and learner support, and maintain documentation to ensure continuity across the team.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Learning Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Digital Technology, or a related field.
* 5-7+ years of experience in learning, customer education, enablement, or learning technology within a global SaaS or technology-driven organization
* 3+ years experience administering or configuring learning platforms (LMSs/LXPs)
* Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions and partnering effectively with technology, engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong technical problem-solving and systems thinking, with the ability to work across interconnected platforms and technologies.
* Experience supporting or leading complex technology implementations, enhancements, or platform optimization initiatives.
* Fluency in written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Core Technical Skills

* LMS/LXP platforms such as Skilljar, Workday, or Docebo, including configuration, administration, and SCORM/xAPI troubleshooting
* HTML and CSS
* APIs, integrations, data workflows, and automation
* AI and automation tools such as Copilot, Claude, and Power Automate
* Content architecture and discoverability, including metadata, taxonomy, segmentation, and search optimization

Nice to have:

* JavaScript, JSON, Python, or other scripting experience
* Front-end development or technical prototyping experience
* Experience implementing a new enterprise learning platform
* Experience with SaaS platforms, digital adoption tools, and content management systems
* Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of customer learning at NIQ while building expertise in AI, learning technology, platform innovation, and digital experience design.

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

In the 2025 admissions cycle, our students secured 10+ Oxbridge offers and 15+ Ivy League offers, showcasing the strength of our strategies and the quality of our mentorship. From Oxford to Harvard, Cambridge to Columbia, we help ambitious students turn their aspirations into achievement.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a driven and hands-on Senior HR Associate who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role requires someone who takes complete ownership of HR processes, is proactive in problem-solving, and is comfortable operating in a dynamic, evolving setup. This position handles employee recruitment, onboarding, benefits administration, performance management, and employee relations. You will be responsible for developing and updating HR policies, ensuring legal compliance, and supporting organizational culture and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Management in HR:**
  Partner with leadership to translate business goals into people strategies covering workforce planning, headcount and budgeting, talent retention, and culture-building; use HR data and analytics to advise on organizational structure and decisions, and proactively identify people-risks and opportunities to shape long-term HR strategy
* **Policy & Compliance:**
  Draft, review, and implement HR policies in alignment with organizational needs and legal requirements, ensuring 100% communication and documentation of updates; maintain a centralized policy repository and conduct periodic reviews to ensure relevance, clarity, and compliance
* **Performance Management:**
  Implement and drive KRA/KPI frameworks across teams, ensure timely completion of performance review cycles, coordinate with stakeholders for evaluations, and maintain accurate performance records to support data-driven decision-making
* Employee Engagement & Relations: Strengthen employee experience by conducting regular check-ins, feedback surveys, and engagement initiatives; analyze feedback data to identify trends and gaps, present actionable insights to management, and drive initiatives that enhance workplace culture, collaboration, and employee satisfaction
* **Payroll, Attendance & Benefits:**
  Manage and validate monthly attendance, resolve discrepancies prior to payroll processing, and execute accurate payroll through HRMS tools (e.g., Keka); ensure timely salary disbursement, maintain payroll records, and administer employee benefits including insurance, leave, and wellness programs while addressing employee queries
* **Learning & Development:**
  Identify training and development needs through performance insights and feedback, design and implement structured learning initiatives, and facilitate training sessions and workshops to drive continuous learning, skill enhancement, and employee growth
* **HR Operations:**
  Oversee the complete employee lifecycle including reference checks, onboarding documentation, employee records management (HRMS and physical), internal transfers, and exits, while ensuring process efficiency, accuracy, and continuous improvement; act as the first point of contact for employee queries and grievances, ensuring timely and effective resolution
* **End-to-End Employee Lifecycle Management:**
  Own and manage the complete employee journey, from offer acceptance and pre-boarding through onboarding, confirmation, career progression, internal mobility, and exit, as a single point of accountability; coordinate across recruitment, operations, payroll, and L&D at each milestone, and use lifecycle data to continuously improve the employee experience and flag retention risks early
* **Recruitment & Onboarding:**
  Manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle including Job Description creation, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, assessments, and offer rollout, while maintaining a structured hiring pipeline and ensuring a seamless, positive candidate experience; design and execute a well-structured onboarding program that enables smooth integration of new hires into the organization’s culture, values, and workflows

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Mandatory 4-5 years of hands-on HR experience across HR operations, Talent Acquisition and People Management
* Strong understanding of HR processes, systems, and best practices
* Familiarity with employment laws and compliance requirements
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-ownership, and dynamic environment

**Why Join Us?**

* Join a globally recognized and fast-growing organization in the education sector.
* Work in a dynamic, cross-functional team environment.
* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Exposure to international clients and projects with impact.
* Opportunities for professional development and advancement.

**Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**

At Rostrum Education, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of race, religion, gender, nationality, disability, or sexual orientation.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** **Business Development Executive / Manager**

**Company:** LIVXS  
**Location:** Sector 43, Gurugram (On-site)  
**Experience:** 1–3 years in Business Development, Sales, Lead Generation, or a relevant industry  
**Department:** Business Development  
**Verticals:** Weddings, Corporate Films, Corporate Events, Studio, Club, Learning, and Wedding Films

**1. About LIVXS**

LIVXS is a Gurgaon-based event management and creative company established in 2004. We work across weddings, corporate events, films, brand promotions, studio productions, and other creative projects, delivering professional services and memorable experiences for diverse clients and brands.

**2. Role Overview**

The Business Development Executive/Manager will be responsible for generating leads, acquiring new clients, building business relationships, and driving revenue for their assigned vertical.

The role involves cold calling, email and WhatsApp outreach, client meetings, proposal presentations, follow-ups, and CRM management. The candidate will work closely with the Client Servicing Team and relevant internal teams to convert business opportunities into confirmed projects.

**3. Key Responsibilities** **A. Lead Generation and Client Outreach**

* Research and identify potential clients, companies, brands, agencies, and business partners relevant to the assigned vertical.
* Generate new leads through online research, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and industry directories.
* Conduct regular cold calls, cold emails, WhatsApp outreach, and follow-ups.
* Introduce LIVXS services, understand client requirements, and schedule meetings with prospective clients.

**B. Client Meetings and Proposal Coordination**

* Attend online and offline client meetings to understand requirements, budgets, and project expectations.
* Explain LIVXS services and present relevant proposals, concepts, and quotations.
* Coordinate with the Client Servicing Team for proposal preparation, costing, revisions, and presentations.
* Communicate client feedback and requirements to internal teams and follow up until the opportunity progresses.
* Support negotiations and business closures in coordination with the concerned team.

**C. Client Relationship Management**

* Maintain professional communication with prospective and existing clients.
* Coordinate with clients regarding meetings, proposals, requirements, and follow-ups.
* Build long-term relationships to encourage repeat business, referrals, and new opportunities.
* Ensure timely communication between clients and internal teams during the business development stage.

**D. CRM Management – Zoho Bigin**

* Record all leads, contacts, companies, and opportunities in Zoho Bigin.
* Update call outcomes, lead status, meeting details, proposal progress, follow-up dates, and next steps.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all client interactions.
* Track leads through the sales pipeline and update converted, lost, or inactive opportunities with appropriate remarks.
* Ensure regular follow-ups and prevent active leads from being missed.

**E. Sales Targets and Reporting**

* Work towards assigned monthly and quarterly targets for lead generation, meetings, proposals, and revenue.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline of potential clients and business opportunities.
* Share regular updates on outreach, meetings, proposals, follow-ups, and conversions.
* Coordinate with the vertical head and internal teams to review progress and resolve pending issues.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and cross-selling wherever relevant.

**4. Vertical-Specific Responsibilities**

The employee will be assigned a particular vertical and will focus on generating relevant leads and business opportunities for it.

* **Weddings:** Connect with prospective wedding clients, families, wedding planners, venues, and industry partners.

* **Corporate Films:** Approach companies, brands, marketing teams, and agencies for corporate videos, brand films, promotional films, and video production.
* **Studio:** Generate leads for studio bookings, shoots, productions, and related creative services.

* **Learning:** Generate leads from individuals, institutions, companies, and organisations relevant to LIVXS Learning's offerings.

* 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales, lead generation, or client acquisition.

title: Manager / Senior Manager – Plant HR, IR & Administration
description:
**Location:**
IMT Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana

**Industry:**
Manufacturing (Automotive Components / Engineering Preferred)

**Experience:**
5–10 Years

**Qualification:**
MBA / PGDM in HR, Industrial Relations or equivalent

**Salary:**
₹6–8 LPA,

**Employment:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Reporting To:**
CEO, with operational coordination with the Plant Head

**Role Overview**

**We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Plant HR professional to establish, implement and independently lead the complete Human Resources, Industrial Relations and Administration function at our manufacturing facility in Manesar, with a workforce of approximately 101–200 staff.**

**This is a function-building role**
, requiring someone who can develop HR policies, establish statutory compliance processes, manage shop-floor manpower, implement HR systems and create a structured, disciplined and employee-focused work environment.

The ideal candidate should have practical manufacturing experience and the confidence to manage HR operations independently while working closely with plant leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Establish the HR Function from Scratch**

* Design and implement HR policies, SOPs, procedures and employee documentation systems.
* Establish recruitment, onboarding, confirmation, attendance, leave, payroll and exit processes.
* Develop employee handbooks, appointment letters, job descriptions, reporting structures and performance frameworks.
* Evaluate and implement a suitable HRMS, biometric attendance and payroll system.
* Create HR dashboards, employee databases and compliance monitoring systems.
* Establish a structured HR operating model aligned with the factory's manpower and production needs.

**2. Plant HR & Workforce Management**

* Manage HR activities for permanent, contractual, technical and shop-floor employees.
* Plan manpower requirements in coordination with production, maintenance, quality and other departments.
* Lead recruitment of operators, technicians, supervisors and managerial staff.
* Manage workforce deployment, shifts, attendance, overtime, leave and absenteeism.
* Develop strategies to reduce employee turnover and improve workforce stability.
* Implement performance monitoring, employee communication and disciplinary processes.

**3. Industrial Relations & Statutory Compliance**

* Establish compliance processes under applicable Central and Haryana labour laws and the four Labour Codes.
* Oversee PF, ESIC, wages, gratuity, bonus, leave, working hours and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Conduct a baseline audit of current statutory registrations, licences, records and compliance gaps.
* Maintain relevant registers, documentation, statutory returns and compliance calendars.
* Coordinate with labour authorities, statutory consultants and external auditors.
* Manage employee grievances, disciplinary proceedings, disputes and worker relations.
* Ensure proper documentation and compliance for all contract labour arrangements.
* Support statutory, customer and third-party compliance audits.

**4. Contract Labour & Payroll Management**

* Manage relationships with manpower contractors and staffing agencies.
* Monitor contractor manpower deployment, attendance, wage payments and compliance.
* Establish payroll approval and verification processes in coordination with Finance.
* Ensure timely processing of salaries, statutory deductions and benefits.
* Track manpower costs, overtime expenditure and contractor billing.
* Introduce controls to minimise payroll errors and prevent non-compliance.

**5. Employee Engagement, Training & Performance**

* Establish employee induction, orientation and communication programmes.
* Design performance appraisal and review processes for different employee categories.
* Identify training requirements jointly with production and departmental heads.
* Coordinate technical, behavioural, supervisory and compliance training.
* Establish employee grievance and feedback mechanisms.
* Implement practical initiatives to improve retention, productivity and workplace discipline.

**6. Factory Administration & Welfare**

* Coordinate administration of security, housekeeping, canteen, transport and employee welfare facilities.
* Develop service standards and monitor administrative vendors.
* Work with the EHS function to support employee safety, awareness and welfare compliance.
* Establish policies and mechanisms for POSH, workplace conduct and grievance redressal.
* Coordinate with factory management on employee facilities and welfare improvements.

title: Performance and Reward Consultant
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Performance and Reward Consulting**
.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
The Performance and Reward Consultant provides insight-led consulting and decision support across performance and reward. Based in Hyderabad, the role will initially support activities across Europe, working with Performance and Reward Partners, Country People Heads and specialist colleagues to deliver high-quality advisory and selected operational support.
  
  
The role translates policy, analytics and market information into clear options and recommendations, supports cyclical processes and strengthens standardisation, control and continuous improvement. As priorities evolve, the role may rotate across geographies, stakeholder portfolios, products, processes and projects.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Provide guidance, constructive challenge and technical knowledge across performance, compensation and related Performance and Reward matters, interpreting policy and seeking specialist input where required.
* Support cyclical processes, including year-end performance and pay review, market data, pay equity reviews, fixed pay range reviews, variable pay reviews and other activities within scope.
* Translate analytics, internal data, market information and emerging trends into clear narratives, options, recommendations and decision-ready insights.
* Build and maintain standard management information using agreed definitions and templates, including performance distributions, pay outcomes, expenditure against budget, population eligibility and internal equity views.
* Undertake targeted analysis, scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis; identify anomalies, pay compression, outliers and variances from policy norms; and propose appropriate questions or actions.
* Prepare stakeholder engagement materials and leadership-ready packs; simplify complex Performance and Reward topics into clear messages; and contribute to governance papers, committee materials, regulatory reporting and external disclosures where required.
* Manage the day-to-day execution of reward programmes and complex queries, working with Performance and Reward Partners, Country People Heads, Analytical and Operational Associates and specialist teams to validate data, reconcile inputs and outputs, document exceptions and ensure effective hand-offs.
* Maintain decision traceability and a strong control environment by recording assumptions, data sources, methodologies and outcomes; identifying and escalating risks promptly; improving playbooks, templates, training, documentation and data dictionaries; automating repeatable reporting where possible; and contributing to knowledge sharing, cross-training and continuous improvement.

**To be successful you will:**

* Hold a master’s degree in Human Resources or a related discipline.
* Have relevant experience in performance, reward, compensation or a related field, preferably within financial services or another regulated environment.
* Have strong knowledge of performance and reward principles, policy interpretation and cyclical delivery, with the ability to frame practical outcomes.
* Demonstrate the ability to interpret complex analytics and translate findings into concise, evidence-based recommendations.
* Have strong analytical skills, with advanced capability in Microsoft Excel and, where relevant, business intelligence tools, supported by disciplined data handling, quality assurance and documentation.
* Demonstrate clear written communication and confident verbal storylining for senior and non-technical audiences.
* Have a sound understanding of governance, internal control, audit, legislation and regulatory requirements relevant to performance and reward.
* Demonstrate structured problem-solving, sound judgement, stakeholder consulting capability, learning agility and the ability to plan and prioritise under tight timelines while working collaboratively across geographies, businesses and specialist teams.

**What success looks like**
Cyclical and in-year deliverables are completed on time, with minimal late escalation. Management information and analysis are accurate, timely and require little rework. Insights are clear and decision-ready, reducing stakeholder uncertainty and unnecessary data debate.
  
  
Hand-offs are smooth, with strong partnership feedback across Performance and Reward Partners, Analytics, Operations and other stakeholders. Standardisation and automation improve efficiency and reduce manual reporting effort. Assumptions, data sources, exceptions and decisions are documented clearly and can be audited.
  
  
The role demonstrates flexibility and contributes effectively as the portfolio evolves beyond the initial Europe scope.

**Position Title:**
Enablement / Copilot Coordinator
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time

**Overview**
Our Digital Technology team helps employees leverage technology to work more effectively, collaborate better, and deliver greater business value. As McCain continues to expand the use of Microsoft Copilot, AI tools, automation, and modern workplace technologies, effective adoption and user enablement are critical to realizing business value.
  
  
The Enablement & Copilot Coordinator supports the successful rollout, adoption, and ongoing use of Microsoft Copilot and other productivity technologies. This role works closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, trainers, and employees to coordinate communications, training activities, adoption campaigns, user feedback, and reporting.
  
  
The successful candidate is a highly organized and proactive professional who combines technology curiosity, strong communication skills, and change management capabilities to help employees confidently adopt new ways of working.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Enablement & Copilot Coordinator is responsible for coordinating employee enablement activities that drive awareness, adoption, and effective use of Microsoft Copilot and related digital workplace tools.
  
  
This role serves as a key liaison between technology teams and end users, ensuring employees have access to training, resources, communications, and support needed to successfully embrace new capabilities. The position focuses on execution, coordination, user engagement, and continuous improvement rather than technical development.
  
  
**Key Responsibilites**
**Copilot Adoption & Enablement**

* Support enterprise deployment and adoption initiatives for Microsoft Copilot and other AI-enabled productivity tools.
* Coordinate enablement activities that help employees understand and effectively use new capabilities.
* Assist with rollout planning, readiness activities, and adoption campaigns.
* Identify adoption barriers and escalate opportunities for improvement.
* Support business units during onboarding and early adoption phases.

**Training & Learning Coordination**

* Coordinate training sessions, workshops, office hours, and learning events.
* Schedule presenters, manage attendance tracking, and support logistics.
* Maintain learning content, quick-reference guides, FAQs, and user resources.
* Assist with the creation of role-based learning materials and enablement content.
* Promote continuous learning and skills development across the organization.

**Communications & User Engagement**

* Develop and coordinate communications related to Copilot adoption and digital workplace initiatives.
* Create newsletters, announcements, success stories, and awareness campaigns.
* Support employee communities, collaboration channels, and engagement forums.
* Help showcase practical use cases and adoption success examples.

**Adoption Analytics & Reporting**

* Track participation, engagement, and adoption metrics.
* Maintain dashboards, reports, and status updates for stakeholders.
* Analyze user feedback and identify trends, opportunities, and challenges.
* Assist leaders in understanding adoption progress and areas requiring additional focus.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Partner with business teams, Digital Technology teams, HR, Communications, and Learning teams.
* Coordinate stakeholder meetings and follow-up activities.
* Maintain project plans, action logs, and implementation schedules.
* Support change management and business readiness activities.

**User Feedback & Continuous Improvement**

* Gather employee feedback regarding Copilot experiences and enablement programs.
* Help identify recurring issues, questions, and enhancement opportunities.
* Escalate improvement recommendations to appropriate technology teams.
* Contribute to ongoing refinement of adoption programs and learning experiences.

**Governance & Responsible Use**

* Promote responsible and secure use of AI technologies.
* Support awareness of privacy, security, compliance, and governance requirements.
* Ensure enablement materials align with company policies and standards.

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS**

* Increased adoption and usage of Microsoft Copilot and related productivity tools.
* High participation rates in enablement and learning programs.
* Positive employee feedback regarding training and support experiences.
* Timely execution of adoption campaigns and communications.
* Accurate and actionable adoption reporting.
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction and collaboration.
* Effective promotion of responsible AI practices.

**Job Qualifications & Experience**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Communications, Learning & Development, Human Resources, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 2-5 years of experience in technology enablement, learning coordination, change management, digital workplace programs, project coordination, training, communications, or related disciplines.
* Experience supporting organizational technology adoption initiatives preferred.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and Power Platform, is desirable.
* Exposure to Microsoft Copilot, AI tools, or digital transformation initiatives is an asset.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project coordination abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable presenting information and facilitating learning sessions.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret adoption data and feedback.
* Customer-focused approach with a passion for helping others succeed.
* Curiosity about emerging technologies and AI-enabled productivity tools.

**Other Information**

* Individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities.
* Suitable for an early-to-mid career professional with some experience coordinating programs, training, adoption, or change initiatives.
* Provides a development path toward Enablement Lead, Change Lead, Adoption Lead, Digital Workplace Lead, or AI Deployment & Enablement roles.

title: Client Partner Manager
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.  
  
**Description**  
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Bangalore team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.  
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.  
Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
Experience in gaming app category preferred.  
Experience managing a sales team preferred  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.  
Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.
