title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  

* Business acumen, and the ability to communicate to executives, business domain stakeholders and technical staff.
* Strong project management, acumen and familiarity working in agile environments.
* Experience with innovation and ideation methods, such as design thinking and product management.
* Demonstrated influence, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work well with others and exhibit leadership.
* Be an excellent communicator and collaborator, engaging with multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders. Team player with collaborative and inclusive approach.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  

* 10+ years in data governance, model risk, technology risk, compliance or a related analytical role.
* Bachelors degree in field like Computer Science, Information technology, Math, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance (with focus on analysis) etc. and/or relevant proven work experience is required

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  Leading and Providing end-to-end L2/L3 support for core banking applications, ensuring adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and operational KPIs. Proactively monitoring system health, managing incidents and service requests, and ensuring high availability of business-critical services.

* **Driving End to End Automation**

Lead the implementation of end-to-end CI/CD automation using Gitlab, Jenkins and Nexus, reducing manual effort while improving deployment consistency, Security and release efficiency.

* **Containerisation, Kubernetes & EKS Engineering**

Hands on proficiency in containerisation, including Docker and Kubernetes/EKS, with the ability to troubleshoot workloads, optimise cluster performance, and design/maintain Helm charts.

* **Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**
    
  Supporting ongoing maintenance activities including defect resolution, patching, and platform upgrades. Driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance application stability, performance, and scalability in line with Barclays’ strategic technology objectives.

* **Change, Release & Environment Management**
    
  Managing application changes through the Barclays change governance framework, ensuring controlled and compliant deployments across environments. Supporting release activities with minimal disruption to production services.

* **Incident, Problem & Root Cause Analysis**
    
  Leading incident triage, performing root cause analysis, and implementing permanent fixes. Contributing to problem management processes to reduce recurring incidents and improve system resilience.

* **Stakeholder Collaboration & Demand Support**
    
  Working closely with business users, development teams, and infrastructure partners to manage demand, prioritise enhancements, and support delivery of the application backlog and strategic initiatives.

* **Operational Excellence & Process Optimisation**
    
  Identifying opportunities to streamline processes, automate repetitive tasks, and implement best practices to improve operational efficiency and user experience.

* **Risk, Compliance & Controls**
    
  Ensuring compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards. Supporting risk management activities including controls monitoring, incident reporting, and documentation (e.g., RCSAs, records inventory).

* **Environment & Infrastructure Coordination**
    
  Collaborating with infrastructure, database, and middleware teams to manage application environments, capacity planning, and performance tuning.

* **Business Continuity & Resilience**
    
  Supporting disaster recovery planning, failover testing, and continuity processes to ensure minimal disruption to critical banking services.

* **Domain** Banking & Financial Systems

* **Technical Skills** AWS, GitLab, Jenkins, Terraform and Ansible, Kubernetes, Nexus, Python or PowerShell or Any scripting Language Windows/RHEL

* **Good-To-Have:** Datadog , Snyk or SonarQube, ServiceNow/JIRA/Confluence, Java , Safe Agile, Knowledge Fiserv suite of applications

**You may also require the following skills and experience:**

Strong understanding of ITIL practices (Incident, Problem, Change Management)

Experience working within regulated financial services environments.

Ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure production support environment.

Effective communication and stakeholder management skills

Continuous learning mindset to adapt to evolving banking technologies and platforms.

  
  

You may be assessed on the key skills needed for success in this role, including application support, incident and problem management, risk and controls, system reliability, and technical expertise in banking platforms.

  
  

This role is based in our Bengaluru office.

**Purpose of the role**

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Lead a healthy, capable and outcome-owned engineering group that delivers X3 readiness while protecting quality, customer continuity, people development and sustainable delivery capacity.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Experience leading software engineering teams delivering commercial, cloud or ERP products.
  
- Technical fluency across modern backend engineering, SQL/databases, APIs, legacy modernisation, SaaS delivery and automation.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Ability to manage distributed teams, dependencies, hiring, performance, development and difficult conversations.
  
- Comfort with delivery metrics, quality gates, reliability, support economics and evidence-based governance.
  
- Strong English communication and the judgement to balance near-term delivery with long-term capability.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Use developer and operator feedback, platform adoption, delivery flow, reliability, support effort and cost to guide capacity and improvement. Be fluent in secure delivery, identity, telemetry, lifecycle and rollback decisions for the group; implementation depth and tool use remain with the relevant engineers.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Experience scaling India engineering capacity in a global product organisation.
  
- Hands-on exposure to L4G/4GL, Progress 4GL, Web/Syracuse, data migration or batch processing.
  
- Sage X3/Xtrem and enterprise application language experience.
  
- Cloud platform, migration programmes, partner ecosystems or regulated SaaS.
  
- Formal people leadership qualification or Agile coaching experience.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 10+ years in software delivery, including 3+ years managing or leading engineering teams. Degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science or a related field.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- Squads have named owners, realistic capacity, clear dependencies and a visible path to each evidence gate.
  
- Delivery predictability, quality, retention, engagement and technical capability improve over time.
  
- India delivery owns meaningful outcomes with effective global collaboration rather than serving as a hand-off function.
  
- Customer continuity, supportability and rollback remain protected while modernisation accelerates.
  
\*Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities \*\*become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.\*
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Product Managers, Architects, Principal Engineers, People teams, Programme Management, Security, Cloud Support/L3, Customer Services, partners and senior leadership across regions. Maintains practical Europe/North America overlap for decisions and escalation.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Developing Talent, Innovation and Collaboration. Creates clarity, gives context, removes blockers and holds a high bar with humanity.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Own delivery capacity, staffing, prioritisation flow, quality, dependencies, risk and continuity for one or more multidisciplinary squads.
  
- Create the conditions for engineers, automation specialists, product and architecture partners to deliver measurable outcomes rather than activity.
  
- Hire, onboard, coach, develop and retain talent in India while building effective links with Europe, North America and APAC colleagues.
  
- Run transparent delivery and risk reviews; ensure quarterly evidence gates, monthly scorecards and scope guardrails are respected.
  
- Partner with Architects and Product Managers on sequencing, trade-offs, escalation, operational readiness and customer impact.
  
- Ensure incident learning, support knowledge transfer, security, inclusion and psychological safety are part of normal delivery.
  
Decision ownership:
  
People and capacity decisions, delivery sequencing within mandate, risk escalation, team operating model and readiness recommendations. Escalates material product, architecture, security, legal or commercial decisions with evidence.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

title: Service Desk Support
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
  
Are you ready to lead and inspire a team of talented professionals towards delivering services that make a real impact? As a Services Delivery Team Lead at Kyndryl, you’ll have the opportunity to take the lead in guiding our squads towards delivering exceptional end-to-end services. As a facilitator of agile practices, you'll be instrumental in optimizing workflows, identifying bottlenecks, and eliminating obstacles to supercharge squad performance. Armed with your deep technical expertise, you'll champion high-quality deliverables throughout the technical services lifecycle, not only meeting but exceeding our customer business needs.

* Leverage Kyndryl Bridge insights and data-driven recommendations to improve service performance and stability.

Utilize data, AI-driven insights, and platform modernization best practices to deliver innovative solutions and continuous service improvements.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
  
Kyndryl has a global footprint, which means that as a technical leader at Kyndryl, you will have opportunities to work on projects and collaborate with colleagues from around the world. This role is dynamic and influential – offering a wide range of professional and personal growth opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Proven experience leading technical team(s) through incident, problem and change management, as well as root cause analysis

* Ability to effectively communicate with both technical and customer stakeholders
* Industry recognized certifications in the aligned supporting area (e.g., CompTia A+, ITIL, SDA, SDM, Public/Private Cloud, Mainframe etc.)
* Must be fluent in English language(s)
* Facilitating the smooth transfer of knowledge to the entire team.
* Conduct assessments to identify the specific needs and challenges the team face during the transition
Develop and deliver training programs to equip individuals with the necessary skills and knowledge for their new roles.  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* This position is open for tenured Band 5, Band 6A open for lateral movement, tenured Band 6A and Band 6B open for lateral movement.
* Bachelor's degree in related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Experience with an ITIL driven service organization
Six Sigma, PMP, and/or ITIL certifications  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

LSEG Data | Corporate Actions

The successful candidate will lead teams through complex transformation programmes while establishing and scaling AI-enabled software delivery, multi-agent engineering practices, and governed engineering control planes across the Software Development Lifecycle.

  
  

Technical

I lead AI-first engineering teams delivering complex products, migrations, and transformation programmes. I bring deep expertise in multi-agent software delivery, engineering control planes, agent orchestration, context engineering, and AI-enabled SDLC practices.

I establish standards for agent-assisted requirements, architecture, development, testing, governance, security, and operations while ensuring human accountability remains clear for all material decisions.

  

Mandatory Experience

Strong hands-on engineering background in either .NET/C# or Java enterprise development.

Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell or Bash.

Experience developing and operating containerised applications using Docker and modern cloud-native engineering practices.

Experience leading engineering teams delivering distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, and modern software platforms.

Desirable Experience

React

Python

Go

Rust

C

C++

Azure

AWS

AI orchestration frameworks, MCPs, agent governance, and model evaluation frameworks

  

Customer Focus

Risk Management

I establish governance and control frameworks for AI-enabled engineering. I ensure agents, models, tools, and delivery workflows operate within defined security, compliance, operational resilience, and risk boundaries.

I balance delivery speed with appropriate engineering controls, auditability, observability, and release readiness.

  

Leadership

I lead high-performing engineering teams through product delivery, platform modernisation, cloud adoption, and large-scale transformation initiatives.

I create a culture where engineers effectively collaborate with AI agents, enabling teams to focus on architecture, decision-making, innovation, and customer outcomes rather than repetitive execution.

I coach and develop engineers, technical leads, and future leaders while building a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

  

Analytical

I establish measurable evidence for AI effectiveness, engineering productivity, quality improvement, delivery acceleration, operational resilience, and business outcomes.

title: Business Development Representative Manager - US Market
description:
**About Within**  
  
Tldr on us: **Series B, $91M raised, 7x growth** last year.

Digital Transformation gave rise to a $600B consulting Industry. AI Transformation will be 10x bigger and will be delivered through agents. We built that.

Our AI discovers how work actually happens across every team and application, Structures it into a living Context Graph, and Improves it continuously.

ServiceNow mapped 900+ processes in 9 days. DoorDash captured 3,800+ finance operations in 14 weeks. That's not a project. That's compounding intelligence.

OpenAI, Google, DoorDash, and Stripe use Within to transform how they transform. We shipped GPT-4 document chat within 12 hours of OpenAI's API launch.

We move fast, reward agency, and care deeply about our customers, our team, and our mission.

**At Within, you will thrive if:**

* **Velocity:** You're seeking a culture of rapid iteration and constant change that turns into lasting impact.
* **Agency:** You're seeking a role where you can take initiative and embody ownership.
* **Care:** You hold yourself to high standards, and enjoy close collaboration with others who care deeply and hold themselves to equally high standards.
* **Energy:** You bring drive and optimism to everything you do. You thrive on finding creative solutions to ambiguous problem statements.

**Qualifications**

Own whether Within's India BDR engine actually works - not just whether the activity numbers look busy.

As the Business Development Manager for our US GTM motion, you build and run Within's India-based BDR team from the ground up: hiring, coaching, and figuring out in real time what does and doesn't translate when a Bengaluru-based rep is trying to earn ninety seconds of attention from a US transformation leader.

This is a high-ownership, high-growth role that will require a doer and builder mentality.

This is the role we're looking for an individual with 4–7 years of relevant experience, including at least 1–2 years directly managing a BDR/SDR team, as well as:

* Real coaching instincts - you should be able to describe a specific call you improved by coaching it, not just a metric you moved.
* Comfort owning a number (team pipeline) the way a revenue leader owns closed revenue, not just an activity dashboard.
* Experience building a playbook from scratch rather than inheriting a mature one.
* Working-manager instincts: you're in calls and coaching day to day, not relaying targets from somewhere else.

**What you'll do**

* Hire, ramp, and manage a team of BDRs and Senior BDRs covering the US market.
* Own the team's pipeline number and be accountable for it the way an AE is accountable for closed revenue.
* Run live call coaching and deal-quality reviews as a real, recurring practice, not a monthly check-in.
* Build and iterate the messaging, sequencing, and qualification playbook specifically for US buyers being reached from an India base.
* Partner with AE and marketing leadership on handoff quality, feedback loops, and territory/account allocation.
* Represent the India BDR function in company planning - comp, headcount, and career-path decisions that affect this team need someone in the room who runs it day to day.

**Who you might be**

* You've managed a BDR/SDR team before, ideally one built to prospect into the US market from an India base.
* You'd rather sit in on a call and fix the actual problem than read a metrics dashboard and guess.
* You've built a playbook before, not just executed one someone handed you.
* You want to be in the room for comp, headcount, and career-path decisions that affect your team, not just told about them afterward.

**What success looks like - Primary KPIs**

* Team pipeline number, visible and credible to GTM leadership
* Rep ramp time and quota attainment across the team
* Team attrition and retention, particularly in year one
* Playbook iteration - specific, evidenced changes made and adopted

**Benefits:**
-------------

* **Equity** in addition to competitive cash compensation
* **100% Employer-Paid Medical, Dental & Vision options!**
* Paid Parental Leave
* $500 Annual Learning Fund
* $150 Monthly Wellness Fund
* 401k via Betterment
* Relocation support to San Francisco Bay Area (where applicable)
* Office-related Perks:

  + **BART or Caltrain to the office?**: Contribute pre-tax funds to a Parking & Transit account, and you will never be taxed for it!
  + **Lunchtime, Leveled Up**: Enjoy curated local eats delivered to the office daily to enjoy with the team over an engaging conversation
  + **Snack Central**: Drinks and snacks for every craving - from healthy bites to Within team favorites.
  + **Safe & Secure Bike Room**: Commute in and safely store your bike.

*Within is an equal opportunity employer. Within provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.*

Compensation Range: ₹35L - ₹45L

description:
**About Kaseya**

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

  

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a customer-centric, quality-driven, and automation-minded Operations Manager to lead a 24x7 remote IT operations team supporting global MSP customers. This role is responsible for team performance, operational governance, customer escalations, case management, RCA ownership, service quality, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with a solid technical infrastructure background and thrives in a highly collaborative environment. While dedicated Quality Excellence, Automation, and Reporting teams provide specialist support, this leader must champion a Quality-First and Automation-First mindset, leveraging data, insights, and technology to continuously improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency.

* Lead, coach, and develop Engineers, Senior Engineers, Team Leads, and Supervisors in a 24x7 operational environment.
* Conduct performance reviews, coaching sessions, talent assessments, succession planning, and training programs.

* Own daily operational performance, workload management, queue health, SLA/SLO compliance, and service quality.
* Drive end-to-end incident, request, and case management activities.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational risks and customer-impacting issues.

* Act as the primary operational escalation leader for critical customer issues.
* Lead customer recovery efforts, executive communications, and cross-functional resolution activities.
* Own Root Cause Analysis (RCA), corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and closure governance.
* Ensure lessons learned are translated into operational improvements.

* Champion a Quality-First mindset, ensuring consistent execution, documentation standards, communication quality, and operational excellence.
* Champion an Automation-First culture by identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and increase scalability.
* Collaborate with Quality, Automation, and Reporting teams to convert insights into measurable operational improvements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using analytics, trends, and customer feedback.

**Required Qualifications**

* Build strong partnerships with Product, Engineering, Support, Service Delivery, Customer Success, QA, Automation, and Reporting teams.
* Act as the operational voice of the customer by identifying recurring issues, product gaps, and service challenges.
* Lead or contribute to strategic improvement projects that enhance customer experience, operational effectiveness, and service delivery maturiRequired Qualifications
* 8+ years of experience in IT Operations, NOC, Service Desk, Managed Services, or Infrastructure Support.
* 3+ years of people management experience leading technical operations teams.
* Strong technical background in Windows/Wintel infrastructure, Active Directory, Networking, Virtualization, Monitoring, and Incident Management.
* Proven experience managing customer escalations, RCA processes, and operational governance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Automation-First Mindset

* Customer-Obsessed
* Data-Driven

* Strong Communicator & People Leader

description:

------------------

  

**Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self-expression, and human connection.** Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one-of-a-kind vintage and luxury.

  

Poshmark is the largest community marketplace for fashion where anyone can buy, sell and share their personal style. With millions of shoppers and seller stylists, Poshmark brings together a vibrant community every day to express themselves and share their love of fashion.

As a **Community Associate, Disputes** you are responsible for providing front-line customer support to our growing Community. You will triage and respond to high volumes of time-sensitive customer inquiries-related to orders, their account, and provide detailed product education. Our goal is to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction while assisting with a seamless user experience. Your ability to investigate, resolve issues, and communicate effectively will be critical in maintaining Poshmark’s high standards of customer satisfaction.

**The ideal Community Associate...**

* understands empathy is the key to helping others
* exercises strong problem-solving skills
* showcases endless patience and contagious positive energy
* has excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Is self motivated and thrives working independently.

**Responsibilities:**

* Engage with Poshmark users regarding dispute cases via email support
* Investigate all aspects of an order and find resolutions for dispute cases filed by buyers
* Respond to users in a timely, friendly, and professional manner
* Execute decisions to fairly resolve disputes following Poshmark’s return policies
* Communicate with Poshmark users in a friendly, helpful, and patient manner via email
* Gather feedback and suggestions from the Community
* Strive to exceed Volume, First Response Time, Resolution Rate and CES (Customer Effort Score) goals
* Flexibility to work on holidays and occasional overtime, as required.

**Requirements:**

* **Overnight shift**: 7:30pm/9:30pm/11:30pm Sun-Thurs/Tues-Sat/Fri-Tues
* **AUS shift**: 3:30am IST Sun-Thurs/Tues-Sat/Fri-Tues
* 0-3 years of equivalent experience in customer service or community support, particularly in e-commerce. Customer service via email using Salesforce or previous support experience dealing with US-Based customers preferred; new college graduates are encouraged to apply
* Strong Macbook navigation and typing skills
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with keen attention to detail
* Willing to work on holidays and provide support over weekends, as required
* Problem-solving mindset with the ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Ability to collaborate and interact with managers and peers primarily from the US office headquarters with professionalism
* Enthusiastic about community, customer service, and spreading love and kindness
* Endless patience and a positive attitude with the ability to turn a negative into a positive.
* Competitive by nature; thrives off the success of a team
* Believes that helping users is crucial to the growth and success of the company

**6-Month Accomplishments:**

* Independently handle trained cases with efficiency and accuracy
* Provide resolutions based on guidelines and policies
* Meet daily case goals on a consistent basis

**12+ Month Accomplishments:**

* Navigate assigned Tier cases with ease
* Absorbed tier knowledge without depending on resources
* Meeting and or exceeding all performance metrics

* Self-disciplined and respect to processes.

The Senior Change Management Analyst is an experienced individual contributor responsible for supporting ITIL-aligned IT change management. Reporting to the Change Manager, the role reviews and coordinates Requests for Change (RFCs), prepares CAB materials, maintains the change calendar, validates implementation readiness, supports stakeholder communications, monitors outcomes, and recommends continual improvements. The role does not own enterprise change policy, manage people, or serve as final approver for high-risk changes unless formally delegated.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Support consistent, ITIL-aligned execution of the change process under direction of the Change Manager.
* Review RFCs for completeness, risk, impact, approvals, testing evidence, implementation steps, validation criteria, communications, and rollback planning.
* Coordinate with change owners, technical teams, service owners, release teams, incident management, vendors.
* Maintain accurate change records, calendar entries, meeting notes, decision logs, and audit-ready evidence. Escalate scheduling conflicts, readiness gaps, policy exceptions, high-risk changes, and change-related incidents.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Change Governance and RFC Quality**

* Apply approved change policies, procedures, templates, workflows, risk models, and approval paths in daily change activities.
* Review RFCs for business justification, scope, affected services, dependencies, outage needs, approvals, implementation, validation, and backout plans.
* Return incomplete or unclear records to change owners and document required corrections according to process guidelines.
* Verify correct classification and routing for standard, normal, emergency, expedited, major, minor, vendor release-related, infrastructure, application, cloud, security, and vendor-driven changes.

**CAB and Change Meeting Support**

* Prepare CAB agendas, change summaries, risk highlights, schedule views, meeting materials, and decision documentation.
* Assist the Change Manager with facilitation, timekeeping, risk callouts, notes, follow-up tracking, deferrals, approvals, and action items.
* Escalate high-risk, high-impact, conflicting, business-critical, or poorly documented changes before CAB review.

**Risk, Impact, and Readiness Assessment**

* Evaluate readiness based on service impact, technical complexity, outage duration, customer impact, security exposure, data sensitivity, dependencies, and rollback feasibility.
* Constructively challenge weak implementation plans, inadequate testing evidence, incomplete dependency analysis, missing communications, or unrealistic rollback steps.
* Escalate unresolved concerns, policy exceptions, and changes requiring additional review by service owners, cybersecurity, compliance, release management, or business stakeholders.

**Calendar, Scheduling, and Communications**

* Maintain the enterprise change calendar and monitor maintenance windows, blackout periods, and resource constraints.
* Identify collisions, overlapping outages, resource conflicts, and competing implementation windows; coordinate schedule alignment with release, project, application, infrastructure, cloud, security, vendor, and operations teams.
* Draft and distribute approved communications; ensure service desk and support teams understand outage windows, expected symptoms, business impact, workarounds, and escalation contacts.

**Emergency Change, PIR, Metrics, and Tooling**

* Support emergency changes by verifying urgency, risk, approvals, implementation details, validation, communications, and after-the-fact documentation.
* Support post-implementation reviews for failed, backed-out, emergency, high-risk, major, or incident-causing changes; document lessons learned, corrective actions, owners, due dates, and follow-up status.
* Prepare dashboards, trend summaries, audit evidence, and KPI reporting for success rate, failed changes, emergency volume, unauthorized changes, change-related incidents, approval cycle time, standard adoption, and CAB action closure.
* Use ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar ITSM tools to review, route, schedule, document, report, and audit changes; recommend workflow, notification, dashboard, template, and automation improvements.

**YOUR PROFILE**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5 or more years in IT service management, IT operations, infrastructure support, application support, release management, project coordination, or production support.
* 3 or more years of hands-on experience supporting an enterprise IT change management process.
* Current ITIL certification required, preferably ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Experience reviewing RFCs, maintaining change calendars, preparing CAB materials, supporting emergency changes, and documenting post-implementation review outcomes.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or comparable ITSM platforms.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices, including change enablement, incident, problem, service request, configuration, release, service level, and continual improvement.
* Ability to translate technical information into business impact, risk, operational readiness, and stakeholder communication requirements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for meeting notes, status updates, process documentation, and stakeholder communications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL 4 Practitioner: Change Enablement.
* Experience in regulated or audit-driven environments such as Financial Services.
* Experience supporting cloud, hybrid infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, application, database, endpoint, and enterprise platform changes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release automation, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and automated change approval models.
* Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC1, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar control frameworks.
* Experience creating dashboards and analytics using ServiceNow Performance Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting standard change models, risk scoring frameworks, process training materials, and stakeholder communication templates.

**Required Technical Skills and Core Competencies**

* **ITSM and Change**: ITIL-aligned workflows, RFC quality, classifications, approvals, calendars, risk assessment, and closure.
* **Risk Judgment:** Identifies service, business, technical, security, compliance, and scheduling risks before implementation.
* **Service Tools:** Use ITSM tools to review, route, schedule, document, report, and audit change records.
* **Process Discipline:** Applies governance consistently while keeping the process practical and understandable.
* **Technology Ops:** Working knowledge of infrastructure, applications, networks, databases, cloud, cybersecurity, endpoints, and production support.
* **Accountability:** Follows up, maintains accurate records, meets deadlines, and escalates unresolved risks properly.
* **Reporting:** Create and interpret dashboards, KPI summaries, trend reports, data quality checks, and audit evidence.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Builds effective relationships across technical teams, service owners, vendors, audit, and business stakeholders.
* **Documentation:** Create clear meeting notes, change summaries, process guidance, work instructions, and communications.
* **Communication:** Explains technical change activity clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Collaboration Tools**:Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Visio, or equivalent tools.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Simplifies workflows, standardizes repeatable work, improves templates, and reduces rework.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Merchants should be able to use Amazon’s fulfillment capabilities wherever they sell. Making that possible requires software that connects sales channels with fulfillment services, simplifies complex supply chain workflows, and gives merchants visibility into what happens after an order is placed.  
Amazon’s Multi-Channel Commerce and Fulfillment team is looking for a Software Development Manager in Hyderabad to lead an engineering team building these capabilities. Our work helps merchants access Amazon’s supply chain services beyond the Amazon marketplace and manage their businesses through connected, intuitive experiences.  
In this role, you will own the technical direction and delivery of a  
product and services portfolio, from merchant-facing workflows to the distributed systems behind them. You will partner with product managers and engineering teams across Amazon to translate customer problems into a focused roadmap, make architectural decisions, and deliver reliable software. The technical challenges include coordinating workflows across independently owned services, maintaining consistent order and shipment state, and making complex integrations easier for merchants to use.  
We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can develop engineers, bring clarity to ambiguous problems, and balance delivery speed with long-term system health. You will have end-to-end accountability for your team’s software and its customer outcomes, including architecture, execution and production operations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Set technical direction: Own your team’s architecture and engineering roadmap, making explicit tradeoffs across customer value, reliability, delivery timelines and operational cost.  
Deliver customer outcomes: Partner with product and program leaders to turn merchant needs into well-scoped initiatives with measurable success criteria.  
Build dependable systems: Lead the design and delivery of distributed services and customer experiences that integrate with Amazon’s fulfillment and supply chain platforms.  
Develop the team: Hire and coach engineers, provide actionable feedback, and create opportunities for technical growth and increasing ownership.  
Own operational performance: Establish metrics for service health and customer experience, strengthen testing and observability, and address recurring defects at their source.  
Lead across team boundaries: Align partner teams on interfaces and dependencies, resolve technical disagreements, and communicate decisions and risks clearly to leadership.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 7+ years of engineering experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

**Manager - Integration Solutioning & Technical Leadership (US Shift)**

Department: Integrations

Team Size Managed: 2-4 Technical Consultants (US-shift and cross-region)

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Manager to lead Integrations for a portfolio of US-based clients, working in the US shift. You will lead and grow a team of Technical Consultants responsible for integration solutioning and development — owning technical direction, guiding solution design, and ensuring high-quality delivery of new and enhanced integration interfaces. You will be the primary integrations point of contact for client leadership during US business hours, drive periodic leadership connects through demos and meetups, and step in hands-on to help the team solve complex issues on integration interfaces when needed. Our team already uses AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, you will deepen and scale this practice across the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* 1. Lead and manage a team of 2-4 Technical Consultants — set priorities, plan capacity, run performance reviews, hire and develop talent, mentor on solutioning, and drive accountability for integration outcomes.

* 2. Own integration solutioning end to end — translate client requirements and change requests into robust designs (APIs, file-based flows, middleware patterns) and guide the team through build and delivery.

* 3. Lead and review the solutioning work done by Technical Consultants — ensure code quality, reusability, maintainability, and alignment with platform and integration standards.

* 4. Act as the technical lead for key integration engagements — drive architecture decisions, design reviews, and complex solutioning discussions with clients and internal stakeholders.

* 5. Drive client leadership connects with US clients through demos and meetups, in their time zone — showcase integration capabilities, walk through solution approaches, align on roadmap priorities, and strengthen executive-level confidence in delivery.

* 6. Own escalations and production issues on integration interfaces during US hours — debug failures, unblock consultants on complex interface problems, restore stable data flows, and communicate status to client stakeholders.

* 7. Stay hands-on with Python and integration tooling to review, guide, and when required, contribute to builds and troubleshooting on integration interfaces.

* 8. Build on the team's existing use of AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, strengthen AI-assisted design, coding, review, and documentation practices so the team delivers faster with consistent quality.

* 9. Partner with India-based Product/Engineering teams on platform capabilities, ensuring clean handoffs across time zones on integration patterns and enhancements needed for scalable client solutions.

* 10. Build and maintain solutioning standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation so the team can deliver consistently as engagement volume grows.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 6-10 years of experience in technical consulting, integration solutioning/development, or similar roles within HRTech/SaaS or enterprise software.

* Proven experience managing Technical Consultants or similar delivery teams (3+ years in a people-management role) — including hiring, performance management, quality oversight, and owning delivery outcomes.

* Strong hands-on programming ability in Python — comfortable writing, reading, reviewing, and debugging integration code.

* Solid expertise in system integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, middleware) with the ability to design and solution complex integration landscapes.

* Demonstrated ability to help teams diagnose and resolve issues on integration interfaces in production environments.

* Experience engaging client leadership through demos, technical meetups, and executive-facing solution discussions.

* Experience working with US/North American clients, and willingness to work the US shift on a sustained basis.

* A quick learner who already uses AI tools for solutioning and writing code (e.g., LLM-based assistants, coding copilots) and can strengthen this practice across a delivery team.

* Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills — able to explain technical designs clearly and lead solution discussions with both technical and leadership audiences.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance leadership responsibilities and hands-on technical contribution.

**Good to Have**

* JavaScript experience — a plus for integration builds, scripting, and related client-side or middleware work.

* Prior direct experience with the Darwinbox platform or similar HRMS/HCM products.

* Exposure to standard and custom integration patterns (SFTP, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware tools).

* Experience scaling AI-assisted solutioning and coding practices across a consulting or engineering team.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

Within the first two quarters, this person will have become the trusted integrations lead for US client leadership, established clear ownership of integration solutioning and development quality across their team, built a strong rhythm of client leadership demos and meetups, helped stabilize and resolve complex integration interface issues, and strengthened the team's existing AI-driven approach to solutioning and coding — leaving behind a high-performing US-shift Technical Consultant team capable of scaling delivery with consistent quality.

title: Software Engineering - Technical Specialist
description:

**Your Role**

As a Software Engineering Technical Specialist, you will develop solutions in specific domains such as Security, Systems, Databases, Networking Solutions, and more. Your leadership will be demonstrated in your work, to your customers, and within your teams.

* Demonstrate strong communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams.
* Identify opportunities for business transformation and recommend technology-driven improvements.
* Communicate complex technical and business concepts effectively to customers and stakeholders.
* Serve as a trusted advisor for resolving customer business and technical challenges.
* Analyze, define, and solve complex problems through structured decision-making.
* Collect, evaluate, and integrate information from multiple sources to support timely business decisions.
* Improve service effectiveness, operational efficiency, and delivery through technology and best-practice methodologies.
* Design, develop, integrate, and deliver highly scalable distributed software solutions.
* Drive the continuous evolution and enhancement of software products and platforms.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, and partner teams.
* Develop solutions and functionality that address customer and business requirements.
* Participate in and support the Agile software development lifecycle.
* Groom and refine features and user stories to ensure delivery readiness.
* Estimate effort, identify technical risks, and manage project dependencies.
* Communicate risks, dependencies, and technical considerations to project stakeholders.
* Ensure high-quality feature delivery within established timelines.
* Drive the remediation of technical debt and security vulnerabilities.
* Maintain and upgrade third-party components to ensure product stability, security, and compliance.
* Mentor and coach engineers on software development best practices.
* Guide teams in designing and implementing secure, scalable, and highly available distributed systems.
* Promote engineering excellence through technical leadership and knowledge sharing.
Contribute to the innovation, growth, and success of software products and solutions.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

• Lead functional design and implementation of Oracle EPM Cloud solutions supporting Fleet Procurement and Fleet Accounting processes.

• 15+ years of overall experience in financial systems with 7+ years of hands-on Oracle EPM Cloud experience

• Configure and support FCCS and EPBCS to enable fleet financial consolidation, planning, forecasting, and management reporting.

• Partner with Fleet Accounting, Finance, and FP&A teams to define future-state planning and consolidation models aligned with Oracle Fusion Financials.

• Design and implement integration flows between Oracle Fusion ERP (GL, FAH, AP, AR) and Oracle EPM Cloud using standard adapters, data management, and integration tools.

• Define metadata structures including dimensions, hierarchies, account mappings, cost centers, intercompany, and fleet-specific reporting attribute

• Support design of fleet cost allocation models, capitalization tracking, depreciation analysis, and financial performance reporting in EPM.

• Lead data validation, reconciliation, and variance analysis between Oracle Fusion ERP and Oracle EPM Cloud.

• Collaborate with Data Migration and Technical teams to support initial loads, incremental data refreshes, and reconciliation processes.

• Support SIT, UAT, and parallel close activities to validate EPM outputs against ERP financial results.

• Develop and validate EPM reports, dashboards, Smart View templates, and management reporting artifacts.

• Support planning cycles including budget, forecast, and scenario modeling related to fleet procurement, utilization, and lifecycle costs.

• Provide functional guidance during cutover, deployment, and post-go-live hypercare for EPM components.

• Work closely with PMO, Solution Architects, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment between EPM design and overall program objectives.

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or related field.

• Strong functional expertise in FCCS and EPBCS, including consolidation, planning, forecasting, and financial reporting.

• Solid understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials including GL, FAH, AP, AR, and how ERP data feeds EPM.Oracle EPM Functional Consultant

• Experience designing EPM solutions for large-scale ERP transformation programs with multi-region deployments.

• Strong knowledge of financial close, consolidation, intercompany eliminations, and management reporting.

• Experience integrating Oracle EPM Cloud with Oracle Fusion ERP using standard integration frameworks.

• Hands-on experience with Smart View, EPM reporting, and data reconciliation techniques.

• Strong analytical skills with ability to translate fleet-related financial data into actionable insights.

• Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.Oracle Financial Consolidation and Close Cloud (FCCS)Implementation Certification, Oracle Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud(EPBCS) Implementation Certification, Oracle EPM Cloud Data Management Certification

  
  
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
