title: Director of Global Security Operations
description:
MongoDB's Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Director of Global Security Operations to build and lead GSO's first dedicated team in India. This is a foundational leadership role: your first mandate is to stand up a 20-person team from scratch.

This team's first mission will be extending US based teams in three different areas:

* Vulnerability management - AI driven detection, triage and workflow management of vulnerabilities from code to components to applications to infrastructure
* Launch readiness - shifting security analysis left to proactively address security needs as far upstream from product launch as possible
* Core enterprise security - projects focusing on improving protection against insider threats and and newly emerging AI Governance and Security needs

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

### **Who We Are**

GSO secures MongoDB's products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.

### **Responsibilities**

* Recruit, hire, and onboard a 20-person team including 3 managers - across vulnerability management, launch readiness, and core enterprise security
* Stand up the operating rhythms, tooling, and documentation the India team needs to work as a first-class part of GSO from day one
* Get new hires productively engaged quickly and working seamlessly with required stakeholders
* Actively manage matrix reporting, ensuring ambiguity doesn't slow the team down — resolve competing priorities between local and functional leadership before they become the team's problem
* Represent the India team's capacity, constraints, and growth needs back to GSO leadership
* Build the durable leadership bench and processes that let the India team operate as an accountable, outcome-owning part of GSO going forward
* Build and lead an inclusive, high-performing global team by setting clear goals and operating rhythms; coaching and developing talent through regular, candid feedback and career conversations; monitoring team health and engagement; recognizing strong performance and addressing performance concerns early and fairly; and communicating change early with clarity and context

### **Requirements**

* 12+ years of experience in security operations, security engineering, or a related technical discipline, including at least 5 years in a people-leadership role
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Direct, hands-on experience in at least one of: vulnerability management, security automation or workflow tooling, or enterprise security operations
* A track record of hiring and ramping a technical team quickly while holding the line on quality and culture
* Experience operating successfully in a matrix structure — with the judgment to manage functional dotted-line relationships without losing ownership of your own team
* Comfort with a mandate that will evolve as the team matures — you're building this job as much as filling it
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills across geographies and time zones spanning the US, EMEA, and India

*Don't feel that you meet all of the requirements? We encourage you to apply anyway — studies show strong candidates sometimes rule themselves out prematurely. MongoDB has a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and high-performing environment, and we want to keep improving our ability to deliver for customers.*

### **Nice to Haves**

* Background specifically in vulnerability management platforms, security orchestration/automation (SOAR) tooling, or enterprise security operations at scale
* Prior experience in a matrix organization with international, distributed reporting lines

### **Success in This Role Means**

* The India team is fully staffed and operating to MongoDB's standards for quality, pace, and culture
* Ability to step into direct delivery level accountability vs. extending capabilities of other teams once the initial team build phase is complete
* The India GSO team has moved from a build-phase support function to owning clear, accountable delivery in vulnerability management, workflow automation, and enterprise security

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Mgr. Partner Operations
description:
**Why UKG**
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
  
  
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
**Job Description**
UKG is seeking a people-focused and operationally strong Partner Operations Manager to build, lead, and develop a team in India that delivers reliable, scalable support across UKG’s global partner ecosystem. This manager will be accountable for team performance, service delivery, operational controls, and the consistent execution of recurring partner operations workflows.
  
  
Working across UKG’s partner organizations, the manager will oversee support for multiple partner motions and programs, including technology, broker, services, GPO/PE, and other business programs as assigned.
  
  
The role partners closely with onshore Partner Operations leaders, partner-facing teams, Finance, Legal, IT, and other cross-functional stakeholders to manage intake, approvals, contracting, onboarding, lifecycle, reporting, billing, renewals, and offboarding activities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is an experienced people manager who can establish clear priorities, develop high-performing teams, maintain strong service and data-quality standards, and continuously improve processes. The individual will balance hands-on operational leadership with effective escalation management, cross-functional collaboration, and a strong commitment to partner and stakeholder experience.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities Include**

* Recruit, onboard, train, coach, and manage a Partner Operations team in India, establishing clear roles, performance expectations, development plans, and annual goals.
* Create an inclusive, accountable, and high-performing team culture grounded in UKG values, continuous learning, collaboration, and operational excellence.
* Manage daily operations, workload allocation, queue health, schedules, leave coverage, and month- and quarter-end readiness to consistently meet business requirements and service-level expectations.
* Own team performance through regular coaching, quality reviews, productivity and service metrics, timely feedback, recognition, and performance management.
* Oversee recurring operational requests and ensure accurate, timely records across designated systems and workflows.
* Ensure the team completes administrative, data-entry, validation, and documentation activities in accordance with established procedures, controls, and service-level commitments.
* Establish quality-control practices for reviewing submitted information, required approvals, completeness, and accuracy; ensure missing, inconsistent, or non-standard items are resolved or escalated promptly.
* Lead operational support for partner intake, qualification, approval, contracting, onboarding, lifecycle management, renewal, termination, and offboarding workflows.
* Maintain governance over account, contact, hierarchy, geographic, agreement, status, renewal, and termination data in Salesforce and other designated systems.
* Oversee lead entry and tracking, account matching, data-quality reviews, attribution clean-up, and related record-management activities.
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of recurring files, reports, and data submissions for commissions, referral fees, program administration, forecasting, billing, and financial operations.
* Manage commercial program administration, including fee and billing files, payout preparation, vendor or program tracking, and follow-up on payment issues.
* Monitor assigned support queues, ensure timely responses to routine inquiries, and provide clear ownership and escalation paths for non-standard or high-risk issues.
* Serve as a trusted operational partner to onshore Partner Operations leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, communicating capacity, performance, dependencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Document and standardize processes, maintain operating procedures and training materials, and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale work.
* Provide operational leadership for technology, broker, services, GPO/PE, and other partner programs as assigned, adapting team capabilities as business needs evolve.

**Qualifications**

* Twelve or more years of experience in partner operations, sales operations, commercial operations, business process support, finance operations, or a related field, including at least five years of people-leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success building, leading, coaching, and developing operational teams in a fast-paced, service-oriented environment.
* Experience managing service delivery, operational queues, workload planning, performance metrics, quality controls, escalations, and business continuity.
* Strong knowledge of partner, customer, or commercial lifecycle processes, such as intake, approval, contracting, onboarding, lead management, data governance, billing, commissions, renewals, and offboarding.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders across functions, levels, cultures, and geographic locations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify risk, resolve operational issues, and use data to improve performance.
* Experience with Salesforce and Microsoft applications; familiarity with ERP, workflow, ticketing, reporting, or partner-management systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate priorities, performance, risks, and recommendations clearly.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a consistent focus on data accuracy, process compliance, and stakeholder experience.
* Ability to lead through change, manage competing priorities, and maintain team engagement and service continuity during peak periods.
* Willingness to provide leadership coverage during month-end and quarter-end periods and to travel on a limited basis, as required.

**Company Overview**
UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.

title: TC-CS-IAM-ISAM-Senior
description:
Location: Kolkata

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 16, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1747271

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Cyber Security-Senior IAM Consultant-ISAM**

As part of our EY-cyber security team, you shall Engage in Identity & Access Management projects in the capacity of execution of deliverables. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate.

  

**The opportunity**

We’re looking for Security Consultant in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with senior members of the team.

In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.

As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for customer applications using policy driven security, SSO, authentication and authorization, user provisioning/de-provisioning, and federation focusing on multiple protocols (SAML2.0, OpenID, OAuth2.0, WS-FED).

**Your key responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management solutions.
* Strong experience in designing and implementing Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions, including customer registration, profile management, and self-service account capabilities.
* Knowledge of CIAM best practices, including customer lifecycle management, identity federation, consent management, privacy compliance, and secure customer onboarding.
* Hands-on experience on IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access end-to-end implementation involving requirement gathering, designing, implementation, customization and testing.
* Implementation experience in Web Module, Federation Module and Advance Access control module of IBAM/ISVA
* Hands-on experience with IBM ISAM WebSEAL administration, including configuration and management of various junction types, reverse proxy services.
* Experience implementing Single Sign on, Multi Factor Authentication, adaptive authentication, and customer/partner identity solutions using ISAM/ISVA.
* Working experience in application integration with header-based, SAML2.0, OIDC, OAuth2.0, WS-Fed protocols.
* Experience in implementing social login and third-party Identity Provider (IdP) integrations using ISAM/ISVA for secure authentication and federation use cases.
* Ability to design and customize authentication policies, access controls, identity workflows, and customer-facing access experiences.
* Experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, web services, and identity-related connectors to enable seamless customer and application integrations
* Ability to develop and maintain ISAM custom JavaScript mapping rules, API protection policies, and federation configurations.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, and scripting technologies used for IAM customizations and automation.
* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.
* Experience in supporting platform administration activities, including upgrades, deployments, patching, and environment maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of certificate administration in ISAM, including troubleshooting SSL/TLS, signer, personal, and key database certificate-related issues.
* Understanding of IAM governance, configuration management, operational controls, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to work in a client-focused environment with flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Should have had direct client experience, including working with client teams in an on-site or offshore mode.
* Need to liaise with Business stakeholders and seek requirement clarification. Should be able to map business requirements to technical specifications.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 6 – 9 Years’ Work Experience

  

**Certification:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access

  

**What working at EY offers**

  

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* The Wholesale Client Services (WCS) team is responsible for the management and execution of client related service events through the full life-cycle of a client’s relationship with HSBC
* The Relationship Service Manager (RSM) is responsible for, but not limited to, the proactive management of services for an assigned portfolio of GIFT City branch to ensure a high quality of service is delivered at all times
* Coordinate onboarding activities on behalf of the Relationship Managers aligned to client requirements
* Act as primary point of contact for clients and internal colleagues for all services, Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and client exit. Work with various middle/back offices to ensure smooth delivery of client solutions and efficient feedback to client inquiries.
* Product & Implementation management for customer due diligence
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
* Support risk management activities in terms of handling Request for Information (RFI) related enquiries and the approval on low/ medium risk CDD periodic review cases for Relationship Managers
* Provide opinion on operational aspects with various departments (Global Liquidity and Cash Management , Global Market, Business Management, NSC, IT, Business Management, etc.)

Principal Responsibilities
  
  

* Client Service Manager – Client Services would be part of Central Client Services Team to support all service request of the client
* Work closely with relationship managers in the team and support them to complete all KYC process in a timely manner.

* Manage the Client Selection and Exit Management process
* Manage the Book of work and client list for GIFT City branch
* Leading the implementation of operational plans and priorities to drive delivery of the agreed client requirements, ensuring GIFT City requirements and variations in the business model are accurately accounted for in our client on-boarding methodology.
* Ensure the provision of transactional and channel support to clients, understanding their on-boarding requirements and ensuring their timely implementation.
* Undertake all required activities as directed by line manager or as agreed in annual objectives in support of the development of the Banking business
* Liaising with key legal and compliance teams external and Internal to ensure all related master circulars/ Directions and FEMA guidelines are being adhered too.
* Raise Fixed maturity liabilities
* Ensure compliance to International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) and other regulators guidelines

Customers / Stakeholders
  
  

* Provide timely response to client queries
* Draft reports, letters, memos etc., and assist in preparation of performance reports, returns and other ad hoc requests for the Relationship Managers
* Compile internal returns / analysis in support of the team
* Support Relationship Managers in the team by undertaking ad hoc tasks assigned by them

Leadership & Teamwork
  
  

* Active collaboration with internal stakeholders to orchestrate the process, sharing knowledge and information to ensure service excellence at all times
* Demonstrate proactivity and self-initiation, working with limited oversight
* Promotes high engagement, motivation levels and adherence to Group values
* Create robust team environment where skills and knowledge is openly shared to achieve team and business goals including embedding a best place to work environment
* Support the team as a fungible resource as and when required

Operational Effectiveness & Control
  
  

* Maintain and observe all HSBC control standards and implement and observe the Group Compliance Policy, including the timely implementation of recommendations made by internal/external auditors and external regulators
* Uphold the highest level of integrity and act as a role model for all HSBC values and business principles
* Demonstrate a commitment to excellence and perform to the highest standards
* Protect sensitive customer and bank information by ensuring documents, computers, files, and all confidential matters are appropriately handled as set forth by policy. Be vigilant in driving staff behaviour in an aligned fashion, holding them accountable for any violation of policy.
* Act as an escalation point regarding service issues and assist to identify and progress service improvement and sales opportunities

**Requirements**

* Solid understanding of Banking operations and its products / services, general knowledge of trade, treasury, and payment and cash management products and activities
* Relevant work experience supporting Relationship Managers or Sales teams in a financial institution (bank or non-bank)
* Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements
* Excellent client servicing skills (minimum 2 years of service in a client facing role)
* Results focused and an ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-moving environment
* Ability to work independently but also as a team player, with highly developed interpersonal skills
* Ability to prioritize competing demands
* Ability to understand and consolidate diverse and complex business information and identify and mitigate risk issues
* Be change oriented and explore ways of enhanced working and have a forward-thinking mind-set, in line with the Group’s values and strategy
* Excellent analysis and problem solving skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Fluent verbal and written English, Minimum Graduation or as required for the role, whichever is higher

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. title: Area Manager - Cardiac Surgery
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Kerala and Mangalore. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.
  
  
The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
* Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
* Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
* Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
* Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
* Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
* Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
* Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
* Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
* Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
* Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**
The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

title: Customer Relationship Executive
description:
Job Description: Customer Relationship Manager

Role Overview:

The Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) at Treet is responsible for overseeing and enhancing all customer interactions, ensuring seamless communication between leads, dealers, and internal teams. The CRM is expected to ensure effective lead conversion by minimizing delays in pitching or lapses in follow-up and preventing the loss of deals due to inadequate efforts. Proficiency in CRM software, Excel, and a strong orientation toward both customer engagement and team supervision are essential for success in this role.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Lead Management & Follow-ups:

* Supervise the tele calling executive(s), ensuring all leads are contacted and properly followed up.
* Personally call and follow up with key potential leads to maximize conversion.
* Monitor the sales team’s lead follow-up activities, ensuring timely and adequate pursuit of all opportunities.
* Maintain and update lead information accurately in the CRM software.
* Analyze lead conversion data to identify and reduce follow-up breaks or loss of deals due to insufficient engagement.

Sales Support & Order Processing:

* Generate and share accurate quotes with customers in a timely manner.
* Take and process sales orders efficiently.
* Facilitate connections between potential customers and dealers to enable smooth purchase fulfillment.

Customer Queries & Complaints Handling:

* Address and resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly, ensuring a positive experience.
* Provide thorough after-sales support to ensure long-term customer satisfaction.
* Personally interact with customers to identify issues and improve service quality.

Dealer Interaction & Coordination:

* Collaborate with dealers to ensure smooth and efficient order fulfillment.
* Keep dealers updated on new products, pricing, offers, and relevant information.

Business Development Coordination:

* Work closely with business development personnel, tracking and reviewing their activities for effective market expansion.
* Conduct daily calls with sales executives to monitor the current position of leads, ensure timely follow-ups, and identify any lead stagnation.
* Provide crucial back-office support, including the analysis and compilation of reports and customer data.

Reporting & Administrative Support:

* Prepare and maintain comprehensive reports on sales, receivables, lead status, and customer interactions.
* Ensure accurate documentation of all communications and transactions.

Skills & Competencies:

* Proficiency in CRM software and Excel.
* Strong tele calling skills and effective team supervision capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to build and maintain customer relationships.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to monitor, guide, and improve team follow-up efforts.
* Capability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple priorities efficiently.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: IT Servicedesk Specialist I
description:
**Snapshot:**  
Synchronoss Technologies, a global leader in personal Cloud solutions, empowers service providers to establish secure and meaningful connections with their subscribers. Our SaaS Cloud platform simplifies onboarding processes and fosters subscriber engagement using artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, and other advanced features, resulting in enhanced revenue streams, reduced churn, and faster time-to-market. Millions of subscribers’ trust Synchronoss to safeguard their most cherished memories and important digital content.
  
  
Synchronoss is seeking an experienced Service Desk Specialist with excellent communication skills and a strong desire to learn, to join our dynamic and supportive Service Desk team.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail, be comfortable managing Incidents and Service Requests, possess solid IT troubleshooting skills, and be flexible in working hours to support our internal customers in a fast-paced and engaging environment.
  
  
The Service Desk serves as the first point of contact for our global Synchronoss employees, ensuring all Incidents and Requests are handled in a standardized, efficient, and timely manner.
  
  
The team is responsible for providing the initial response to Incidents, including answering, updating, and responding to tickets. Wherever possible, issues are resolved at first contact; otherwise, they are accurately escalated to the appropriate internal IT teams for resolution.
  
  
Your role will include logging and categorizing requests in ServiceNow and tracking issues from start to resolution.
  
  
Good organizational skills are important to keep work and records up to date.
  
  
Responsibe to answer IT questions in person, over the phone, by email, and through MS Teams.
  
  
Assist with password resets and account unlocks, install software, and help set up mobile and office equipment.
  
  
Troubleshoot hardware and software issues and create simple FAQ guides and training documents for users.
  
  
Work closely with internal teams to make sure IT requirements are met and follow all Service Desk procedures.
  
  
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports as required
  
  
**How you will help::**  
The successful candidate will work under the guidance of the Service Desk Manager and Leads, following direction while contributing positively to the team’s overall performance.
  
  
Relevant tooling and process trainings will be provided.
  
  
**Who we have in mind::**  
0.6 Months to 2 years of experience in Helpdesk / Servicedesk roles.
  
  
Any graduate in Computer Science, Engineering or similar relevant field
  
  
Experience with MS Office (especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint), MS Teams, and ServiceNow is a plus.
  
  
**What we offer::**  
Synchronoss is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As a global company, we value and celebrate diversity and are committed to a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We take pride in fostering an inclusive environment based on mutual respect and merit. We are at our best when our workforce is dynamic in thought, experience, skill set, race, age, gender, sexual orientation, sexual expression, national origin and beyond.

title: Service Desk Support
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
  
Are you ready to lead and inspire a team of talented professionals towards delivering services that make a real impact? As a Services Delivery Team Lead at Kyndryl, you’ll have the opportunity to take the lead in guiding our squads towards delivering exceptional end-to-end services. As a facilitator of agile practices, you'll be instrumental in optimizing workflows, identifying bottlenecks, and eliminating obstacles to supercharge squad performance. Armed with your deep technical expertise, you'll champion high-quality deliverables throughout the technical services lifecycle, not only meeting but exceeding our customer business needs.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Partner with Delivery Managers to align customer service priorities with operational and business objectives.
* Develop a strong understanding of customer industries, business needs, and desired outcomes to ensure effective service delivery.
* Leverage Kyndryl Bridge insights and data-driven recommendations to improve service performance and stability.
* Lead the troubleshooting and resolution of complex technical and service-related issues as the primary technical resource.
* Manage squad workloads and priorities to ensure alignment with business goals, customer expectations, and SLAs.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders through effective communication, collaboration, and project updates.
* Coach, mentor, and support squad members through feedback, training, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Drive cross-functional service improvement projects by collaborating with multiple teams and agile squads to meet evolving customer needs.
Utilize data, AI-driven insights, and platform modernization best practices to deliver innovative solutions and continuous service improvements.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
  
Kyndryl has a global footprint, which means that as a technical leader at Kyndryl, you will have opportunities to work on projects and collaborate with colleagues from around the world. This role is dynamic and influential – offering a wide range of professional and personal growth opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Proven experience leading technical team(s) through incident, problem and change management, as well as root cause analysis
* 4.5+ years of Service Desk Operations & Training experience
* Ability to effectively communicate with both technical and customer stakeholders
* Industry recognized certifications in the aligned supporting area (e.g., CompTia A+, ITIL, SDA, SDM, Public/Private Cloud, Mainframe etc.)
* Must be fluent in English language(s)
* Facilitating the smooth transfer of knowledge to the entire team.
* Conduct assessments to identify the specific needs and challenges the team face during the transition
Develop and deliver training programs to equip individuals with the necessary skills and knowledge for their new roles.  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* This position is open for tenured Band 5, Band 6A open for lateral movement, tenured Band 6A and Band 6B open for lateral movement.
* Bachelor's degree in related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Experience with an ITIL driven service organization
Six Sigma, PMP, and/or ITIL certifications  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: IT System Administrator
description:
**About Us :-**

We are a healthcare technology company supporting virtual care programmes across the United States. Reliable IT  
  
operations, secure access, and careful handling of company and healthcare information are essential to our day-to-day  
  
work.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for 5-8 years experienced, hands-on IT Systems Administrator to support employees and day-to-day IT  
  
operations from India, primarily during U.S.-aligned working hours. The role combines Microsoft 365 administration, user  
  
support, onboarding and offboarding, with a critical focus on Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and Azure virtual  
  
machine operations. The successful candidate should be able to provision VMs, troubleshoot AVD and remote access  
  
issues, and resolve user access and connectivity problems. AWS knowledge is useful at a foundational or support level;  
  
strong practical Azure and AVD skills are the priority.

Critical Skill Area: Microsoft Azure & Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)

  

Hands-on Azure and AVD experience is the most important technical requirement. The candidate should be able to carry  
  
out routine administration and first-/second-level troubleshooting, follow change and security procedures, document  
  
actions, and escalate complex infrastructure issues with useful diagnostic details.

* Provision new Azure virtual machines using approved images and sizing; select the correct subscription, resource

  
group, region, VM size, disk configuration, and network settings according to documented requirements.  
  

* Start, stop, restart, and check the health/status of Azure VMs; identify common causes of a VM being unavailable.

  

* Support AVD user access: validate user/group assignment, application group or desktop assignment, host pool

  
association, and relevant access prerequisites.

* Troubleshoot AVD sign-in and connection problems, including users unable to see desktops/apps, failed connections,

  
session launch errors, profile-loading issues, and sessions that are disconnected or unresponsive.  
  

* Perform initial checks on session hosts: availability, registration/health status, capacity, resource utilisation, and

  
whether the host is accepting connections; escalate host-pool or service-level issues when needed.  
  

* Investigate remote access issues involving user permissions, Entra ID sign-in, MFA, network reachability, DNS, VPN

  
where applicable, and RDP/AVD client configuration.  
  

* Review Azure VM and AVD diagnostic information, activity logs, monitoring signals, and relevant error messages to

  
gather evidence before escalating.  
  

* Support AVD/RDP onboarding and offboarding, including granting and removing approved access and validating that

  
changes have taken effect.

* Assist with Windows VM maintenance such as routine updates, reboot coordination, disk-space checks, basic

  
performance troubleshooting, and post-maintenance validation, following change approvals.  
  

* Understand resource groups, virtual networks/subnets, network security groups (NSGs), managed disks,

  
snapshots/images, Azure Monitor, and Azure Backup; make changes only within approved permissions and  
  
procedures.  
  

* Follow secure-access practices: never expose RDP broadly to the internet, do not bypass access controls, and

  
escalate suspected security incidents or unauthorised access immediately.  
  

* Maintain clear ticket notes covering the issue, checks performed, findings, actions taken, outcome, and any escalation

  
or follow-up required.

**Microsoft 365 & User Administration**

* Handle routine Microsoft 365 administration for user accounts, licences, Outlook/Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive,

  
and SharePoint access.  
  

* Troubleshoot common sign-in, password/MFA, mailbox, Teams, and permissions issues; recognise when an issue

  
requires escalation.  
  

* Create/configure user accounts and access during onboarding; disable accounts, remove licences, and revoke access

  
during offboarding, following approved checklists.  
  

* Manage basic group membership, distribution list membership, shared mailbox access, and other approved access

  
requests.  
  

* Verify approvals before granting access or changing user accounts, licences, groups, or shared resources.

**User Support, Tickets & IT Operations**

* Own and progress assigned support tickets for U.S.-based users, prioritising by business impact and urgency.

  

* Acknowledge requests, communicate progress clearly, set realistic expectations, and update tickets before closure.

  

* Resolve common Windows, laptop, peripheral, connectivity, application, and account-access issues; escalate issues

  
outside the role's permissions or expertise.  
  

* Maintain accurate laptop and accessory inventory and asset assignment/acknowledgement records.

  

* Follow documented onboarding/offboarding checklists and record completion.

  

* Document repeat incidents and troubleshooting steps so the team can resolve similar issues consistently.

**AWS — Foundational / Secondary Support**

AWS is a secondary skill area rather than the primary ownership requirement. The candidate should have basic familiarity  
  
with the AWS console and be able to assist with straightforward support checks under guidance.  
  

* Understand the purpose of IAM users/roles and permissions, EC2 instances, security groups, and S3 buckets.

  

* Perform basic status and access checks, gather troubleshooting information, and escalate AWS issues that require

  
deeper administration.  
  

* Follow least-privilege and approval requirements; do not make unapproved changes to production resources or

  
permissions.

**Security, Documentation & Escalation**

* Follow access approval processes, least-privilege principles, MFA requirements, and company security procedures.

  

* Handle company and healthcare-related information carefully; do not include sensitive information in unauthorised

  
tools or ticket notes.  
  

* Escalate critical incidents, suspected security issues, repeated failures, or changes with production impact promptly.

  

* Maintain useful documentation for VM provisioning, AVD access, common connection issues, onboarding/offboarding,

  
and recurring incidents.

**Working Hours & Support Coverage**

This is an India-based role. The employee will primarily work U.S.-aligned hours to support the company's users and IT  
  
operations. Flexibility is required to provide support during India business hours when a critical incident or urgent business requirement makes it necessary. India-hours support is for critical needs and is not the routine working schedule.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Practical hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD); this is the critical technical

  
requirement.  
  

* Ability to provision Azure VMs and troubleshoot common VM availability, AVD sign-in, desktop/application access,

  
session, and connectivity issues.  
  

* Working understanding of Azure subscriptions, resource groups, VM sizing/disks, virtual networks, NSGs, and basic

  
Azure monitoring/logs.  
  

* Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365 user administration and common Outlook, Teams, account, licence, and

  
access issues.  
  

* Experience handling user support tickets and following structured onboarding/offboarding processes.

  

* Clear written and spoken communication, reliable ticket updates, good documentation, and willingness to escalate

  
appropriately.  
  

* Based in India and available to work primarily U.S.-aligned hours, with flexibility to support critical incidents during

  
India business hours.

**Nice to Have**

* Basic AWS exposure, especially IAM, EC2, security groups, and S3.

  

* Experience with Windows Server, RDP, Entra ID, MFA, VPN, DNS, and networking fundamentals.

  

* Familiarity with PowerShell or basic scripting for troubleshooting and repetitive tasks.

  

* Experience with Freshdesk or another ticketing/ITSM platform.

  

* Exposure to endpoint security, BitLocker, device inventory, or healthcare/regulatory environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Routine Azure VM and AVD requests are handled accurately, securely, and with appropriate documentation.

  

* AVD access and connection issues are investigated systematically, resolved where within scope, and escalated with

  
useful evidence when needed.  
  

* user tickets handled during U.S.-aligned working hours receive timely updates and are progressed according to urgency and agreed service expectations.

  

* Onboarding and offboarding tasks are completed using approved checklists, with access changes recorded.

  

* Critical incidents are escalated promptly, and the employee can provide critical India-hours support when required.

**Suggested Experience Level**
  
  
Experience level: Open to candidates with relevant hands-on IT administration and systems support experience.  
  
Demonstrable practical Azure and AVD capability is essential; the role title and seniority can be aligned to the candidate's depth of experience.

To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.

title: Senior Linux & UNIX Systems Administrator
description:
**Company Overview**
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Information Technology (IT) group at KLA is involved in every aspect of the global business. IT’s mission is to enable business growth and productivity by connecting people, process, and technology. It focuses not only on enhancing the technology that enables our business to thrive but also on how employees use and are empowered by technology. This integrated approach to customer service, creativity and technological excellence enables employee productivity, business analytics, and process excellence.
  
  
**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Linux & UNIX Administration**

* Administer, maintain, and support large-scale Linux and UNIX environments including:

+ Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
+ Oracle Linux
+ Solaris 10/11
+ Ubuntu and other enterprise Linux distributions

* Perform OS installation, upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and capacity planning.
* Develop automation using shell scripting, Ansible, Python, and other infrastructure automation tools.

**ERP & Mission-Critical Application Support**

* Provide infrastructure support for:

+ SAP S/4HANA
+ SAP ECC
+ Oracle ERP and associated applications
+ SAP application and database landscapes

* Coordinate with application, database, storage, network, and security teams to ensure high availability and optimal performance.

**High Availability & Clustering**

* Design, implement, manage, and troubleshoot:

+ Veritas Cluster Server (VCS)
+ Linux High Availability Clusters
+ Solaris Clustering environments
+ SAP High Availability architectures

* Ensure business-critical applications meet availability and recovery objectives.

**Kubernetes & Container Platforms**

* Deploy and administer:

+ Kubernetes clusters
+ Container platforms (Docker, Podman)
+ Container orchestration and lifecycle management

* Support modernization initiatives involving cloud-native and hybrid infrastructure solutions.

**Virtualization & Cloud Infrastructure**

* Manage VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, or similar virtualization platforms.
* Design and support virtualized enterprise workloads.
* Optimize infrastructure utilization and resource allocation.
* Support hybrid cloud integration and cloud migration initiatives.

**Storage & Data Protection**

* Administer enterprise storage environments including:

+ SAN storage
+ NAS storage
+ NFS/CIFS environments
+ Enterprise backup solutions

* Work with storage teams on provisioning, performance optimization, replication, and capacity management.

**Disaster Recovery & Replication**

* Design and maintain enterprise DR strategies supporting critical workloads.
* Implement and manage:

+ Storage replication technologies
+ VMware SRM
+ Database replication
+ DR automation and orchestration

* Conduct DR testing and recovery validation exercises.
* Ensure compliance with RTO and RPO requirements.

**Security & Infrastructure Compliance**

* Secure Linux and UNIX environments following industry best practices.
* Conduct security assessments, vulnerability reviews, and compliance audits.
* Identify infrastructure security gaps and drive remediation activities.
* Implement hardening standards, CIS benchmarks, and security controls.
* Collaborate with Cyber Security teams on risk mitigation and compliance initiatives.

**Vulnerability Management & Patching**

* Own enterprise Linux/UNIX patching programs.
* Coordinate vulnerability scanning and remediation activities.
* Ensure timely resolution of critical and high-risk findings.
* Maintain patch compliance and security reporting metrics.

**Infrastructure Solution Design**

* Lead architecture and infrastructure design initiatives.
* Develop scalable, resilient, and secure solutions supporting enterprise workloads.
* Create technical designs, implementation plans, and operational documentation.
* Participate in technology evaluation, proof-of-concepts, and platform selection.

**Hardware & Data Center Infrastructure**

* Manage enterprise server hardware platforms including:

+ Dell PowerEdge
+ HPE ProLiant
+ Cisco UCS
+ Oracle SPARC
+ Lead hardware lifecycle management, upgrades, firmware updates, and refresh programs.

* Coordinate with vendors for troubleshooting and support escalations.

**Technical Skills**

* Linux Administration (RHEL, Oracle Linux, Ubuntu)
* Solaris 10/11 Administration
* SAP S/4HANA Infrastructure
* Oracle Enterprise Platforms
* Veritas Cluster Server (VCS)
* Linux High Availability Clustering
* VMware / Nutanix / Hyper-V
* Kubernetes and Docker
* NAS and SAN Storage
* NFS, CIFS, Multipathing
* Disaster Recovery and Replication Technologies
* Vulnerability Management Tools
* Infrastructure Automation (Ansible, Python, Shell Scripting)
* Monitoring and Observability Platforms
* Enterprise Backup and Recovery Solutions

**Preferred Certifications**

* Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)
* Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA)
* Oracle Linux Certification
* Solaris Administration Certification
* VMware VCP
* Kubernetes CKA/CKAD

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of Linux/UNIX Administration experience in large global enterprise environments.
* 5+ years supporting SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, Oracle ERP, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Proven experience supporting global 24x7 production environments.

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*
Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. description:

**Introduction**
We are FIS. Our technology powers the world’s economy and our teams bring innovation to life. We champion diversity to deliver the best products and solutions for our colleagues, clients and communities. If you’re ready to start learning, growing and making an impact with a career in fintech, we’d like to know~ Are you FIS?
  
  
**About The Role**
A switch is a computer system which facilitates the transfer of electronic messages between terminal devices and appropriate network applications. ATM Switch plays an important role in the entire ATM connectivity. IST/Switch is an end-to-end software solution for businesses that manage real-world Electronic Payments, Mobile Commerce, and Internet payment processing across the entire payment lifecycle – merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, payment gateways and card associations.
  
  
The Technical Support Specialist (L2) for the Banking System is responsible for providing advanced technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for banking applications. This role serves as the second line of defense, escalating complex issues to L3 support when necessary while ensuring timely resolutions to maintain system stability and performance. The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving skills, experience in banking systems, and a client-focused approach.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Diagnose, analyze, and resolve technical issues related to the banking system
* Provide L2 support by investigating application errors, database issues, and system performance problems
* Collaborate with L3 support teams to ensure proper issue escalation and resolution
* Monitor application performance, system logs, and system memory alerts to identify potential issues
* Perform routine maintenance, DR DRILL, and apply patches or updates as needed
* Ensure UAT simulations and deployments
* Ensure that SIT is diligently performed before UAT deployments
* Support scheduled deployments, system updates, and configuration changes
* Ensure all required Documents/Pre-Requisites are fulfilled as per Client’s CAB (change advisory board) much in advance before the deployment cycle
* Work closely with developers, Client, and OEM vendors to resolve complex system issues within defined TAT
* Escalate unresolved critical issues to L3 support, ensuring proper documentation and analysis by following defined Escalation process
* Liaise with business users and stakeholders to provide technical insights and status updates
* Maintain detailed records of incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions
* Analyze and study root cause of issues and work towards a permanent fix
* Track repeat incidents and take necessary action with L3 Support
* Update knowledge base articles, FAQs, and internal documentation
* Provide training and guidance to L1 support teams and handle & manage the roster of the whole team
* Ensure compliance with banking regulations, security policies, and data protection standards
* Support audit processes and provide necessary documentation when required
* Monitor system access controls and assist in security-related configurations
* Monitor L1 team activities for day-to-day operations and coordinate with Bank and Vendors of Bank for daily operation
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in banking IT

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or any Circuit Branches
* Overall 6+ years of experience
* 3+ years of experience in application support or IT operations within the Banking Payment Domain
* Experience with SQL, Oracle, or other relational databases for query execution and scripting
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix and Windows server environments
* Experience with APIs, web services, and system integrations
* Understanding of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management, Automation)
* Perform SIT/UAT testing for all Change Requests and Incident fixes
* Should have worked in ISO8583 Switch related environment; IST Switch experience is advantageous
* Strong communication skills to interact with technical teams and clients

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with banking applications such as IST Switch ISO8583, VTS, MC & Boss Simulator, or similar systems
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills in banking systems and payment domain
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in banking IT

At FIS, we are as committed to growing our employees’ careers as our own business. We offer~
  
  
Opportunities to innovate in fintech
  
  
Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
  
  
Professional and personal development
  
  
Resources to contribute to your community
  
  
Competitive salary and benefits

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. title: Analyst IT
description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.**
It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
  
  
**Job Title Blue Yonder (BY) WMS Production Support Analyst**
**Location**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Blue Yonder (BY) Warehouse Management System (WMS) Production Support Analyst to provide L2/L3 support for warehouse operations supporting DTC (Parcel) and B2B fulfillment environments.
  
  
This role is responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving WMS production issues, ensuring smooth warehouse operations, maintaining integrations with OMS, ERP, TMS, and carrier systems, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. The candidate will collaborate closely with warehouse operations, IT teams, and onshore stakeholders to ensure system stability and operational excellence.
  
  
The role requires strong expertise in BY WMS architecture, MOCA queries, SQL troubleshooting, integrations, and order fulfillment workflows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Production Support & Incident Management
  
  

* Provide Level 2 / Level 3 production support for BY WMS environments.
* Monitor WMS production jobs, interfaces, and health systems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues impacting warehouse operations, order processing, and shipping workflows.
* Investigate production incidents and perform root cause analysis (RCA).
* Coordinate with infrastructure, integration, and business teams to restore service quickly.
* Manage track incidents, service requests, and problem tickets in Jira/ServiceNow.

BY WMS Functional Support
  
  
Support core WMS processes including
  
  

* Order allocation and wave planning
* Picking and packing operations
* Shipping and manifesting
* Parcel and LTL shipment processing
* Inventory movements and adjustments
* ASN processing and order confirmations

Troubleshoot issues impacting DTC (parcel) and B2B fulfillment flows.
  
  
Integration Monitoring & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Monitor and support integrations between BY WMS and OMS, ERP, TMS, and carrier systems.
* Investigate and resolve issues related to

+ API integrations
+ EDI transactions
+ message queues
+ file-based interfaces

* Validate inbound and outbound payloads and resolve data inconsistencies.
* Work with external systems such as Centiro, FedEx, UPS, DHL integrations.

Technical Troubleshooting
  
  

* Analyze issues using

+ MOCA queries
+ SQL queries
+ application logs
+ integration logs

* Support minor configuration fixes and data corrections in production.
* Assist development teams with issue replication and debugging.
* Support hotfix deployments when required.

Release & Deployment Support
  
  

* Participate in release validation and production deployments.
* Validate system health after releases.
* Support SIT/UAT defect validation and production readiness checks.
* Maintain release documentation and rollback plans.

Reporting & Label Support
  
  

* Troubleshoot issues with shipping labels and reporting tools.
* Support Jasper reports and Nice Label / BY Label Designer configurations.
* Assist operations teams with report validation and troubleshooting.

Operational Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Monitor daily warehouse operational metrics.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend system improvements.
* Create knowledge base documentation and runbooks.
* Drive automation and monitor improvements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Supply Chain, or related field
* 5+ years of experience in Blue Yonder / JDA WMS
* Strong knowledge of warehouse operations and fulfillment processes
* Hands-on experience with

+ MOCA queries
+ SQL troubleshooting
+ BY WMS configurations

* Experience supporting DTC parcel and B2B warehouse operations
* Experience with API / EDI integrations
* Experience with incident management and production support processes

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting carrier integrations (FedEx, UPS, DHL)
* Familiarity with TMS platforms such as Centiro
* Exposure to BY Labor Management or Yard Management
* Experience in Omni-channel fulfillment environments
* Knowledge of ITIL Production Support Processes
* Blue Yonder certifications

**Key Competencies**

* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Ability to handle high-priority production incidents
* Strong communication with operations and IT teams
* Ability to work in global support model (overlap with US EST)
* Ownership mindset with focus on operational stability and continuous improvement

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
**How We Work**
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
  
  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
  
  
Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.
  
  
Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .

title: Network Operations Center Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**

The
**GNOC Engineer**
is responsible for monitoring the organization's global network and infrastructure environment, identifying and responding to alerts and incidents, performing initial troubleshooting, and coordinating escalations with network, infrastructure, security, and other technical teams. The role requires strong operational discipline, communication, and the ability to work effectively in a
**24x5 shift**
environment with the potential to support a future 24x7 model.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Monitor network, infrastructure, connectivity, and service health using enterprise monitoring and management tools.

• Identify, validate, prioritize, and respond to alerts and incidents in accordance with defined SLAs and operational procedures.

• Perform
**Level 1/Level 2**
troubleshooting for
**network connectivity, WAN/LAN, VPN, wireless, firewall**
, and infrastructure-related issues.

• Create, update, and maintain incident and service tickets with accurate troubleshooting details and timelines.

• Escalate incidents to Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Service Desk, vendors, or other resolver groups when required.

• Follow established SOPs, runbooks, escalation procedures, and change-management processes.

• Perform proactive monitoring and identify recurring alerts, trends, and potential service-impacting issues.

• Support incident bridges and major incident activities, including timely communication and escalation.

• Coordinate with global teams and vendors during outages, maintenance windows, and service-impacting events.

• Maintain shift handover documentation and ensure clear communication of open incidents, risks, and follow-up actions.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including alert tuning, automation, documentation, and operational process improvements.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

•
**2+ years**
of experience in
**NOC, GNOC, network operations, infrastructure operations**
, or a similar technical operations role.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals:
**TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPN, and WAN connectivity.**

• Experience with network/infrastructure monitoring tools and ticketing platforms.

• Ability to troubleshoot incidents methodically using logs, monitoring data, connectivity tests, and documented procedures.

• Good understanding of incident, problem, and change management concepts.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly for incident escalation and shift handovers.

• Ability to work independently in a shift-based, 24x5 operational environment.

• Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize multiple alerts and incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• Experience with tools such as
**SolarWinds, PRTG, LogicMonitor, Datadog, Splunk, ServiceNow**
, or equivalent platforms.

• Exposure to
**Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto, Aruba, Meraki,**
or similar networking technologies.

• ITIL Foundation or equivalent operational knowledge.

• Networking certification such as CCNA or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Exposure to cloud networking, SD-WAN, SASE, or automation is a plus. What Success Looks Like

• Consistent monitoring and timely response to alerts and incidents.

• Meeting operational SLAs and escalation timelines.

• Accurate ticket documentation and effective shift handovers.

• Reduction of recurring alerts through proactive investigation and improvement.

• Strong collaboration with global resolver teams.

• Contributing to automation, standardisation, and readiness for future 24x7 operations.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a technically strong and dependable operations professional who can remain calm during outages, think through real-world scenarios, communicate clearly, and take ownership from initial alert through resolution or escalation. The ideal candidate should demonstrate practical troubleshooting ability rather than relying only on theoretical knowledge.
