We are hiring Microsoft 365 L1 Support Engineers to provide first-level technical assistance for Microsoft 365 applications and end-user issues. The role involves basic administration, incident resolution, ticket management, and escalation of complex issues to L2/L3 support teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide L1 support for Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Handle user creation, password resets, license assignment, group management, and basic Microsoft Entra ID administration.
* Support Microsoft Intune device onboarding, enrollment, and basic troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot Outlook configuration, mailbox access, email delivery, Teams login and calling, and OneDrive synchronization issues.
* Manage basic shared mailbox, distribution list, and user access requests according to approved processes.
* Log, track, update, and resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
* Escalate complex technical issues to L2/L3 teams with appropriate troubleshooting details.
* Maintain ticket documentation, troubleshooting records, and knowledge-base articles.
* Provide timely updates to users and ensure a positive end-user support experience.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of Microsoft 365 / Office 365 administration.
* Understanding of Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Familiarity with user creation, password resets, licensing, and group administration.
* Basic understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Intune.
* Experience with ticketing tools, incident management, and SLA-based support.
* Good communication, troubleshooting, and customer service skills.

**Preferred Experience:**
Experience in an IT help desk, service desk, or L1 technical support environment.
  
  
Skills: l1 support,o365,microsoft

title: DHS Technical Services Specialist
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

**Job Overview**
As a Digital Health Solutions (DHS) Technical Services Specialist for T-DOC and Tegris, your primary focus will be on managing project planning, installation, and aftersales services for hospital clients in Southeast Asia and India. * Manage project implementations from planning through installation, testing and commissioning (T&C), and final handover.

**Service Level Agreements (SLAs)**

* Prepare SLAs in line with company standards and customer requirements.
* Ensure customer requests are fulfilled within the agreed timelines and conditions defined in the SLAs.
* Support upselling opportunities with existing customers by identifying potential needs and providing consultative recommendations.

**Technical Support To Sales Team As And When Required**

* Provide technical support to the Sales team during quotation and tender phases by proposing cost-effective solutions that meet customer needs and requirements.
* Support the Sales team with technical presentations and product demonstrations, ensuring clear and effective communication of product and service features and benefits.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* At least 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in healthcare IT, network, or digital health solutions.
* Experience with healthcare integration projects and clinical workflows is highly desirable.
* Experience troubleshooting software, hardware, and network-connected systems.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Healthcare IT systems, digital health solutions, and hospital workflows
* Hospital Information Systems (HIS), Electronic Medical Records (EMR/EHR), and systems integration.
* Hospital interoperability standards and protocols.
* Experience working within CSSD (Central Sterile Services Department) and Operating Room (OR) environments.
* Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VPN, LAN/WAN).
* Server administration and SQL.
* Windows operating systems, software deployment, and system integration.
* Service management, SLAs, and regulatory/compliance requirements.

**Skills**

* Technical troubleshooting and problem resolution.
* Project management and implementation coordination.
* Customer training and technical presentations.
* Documentation, reporting, and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and customer-facing skills.

**Abilities**

* Manage projects independently from planning through customer acceptance.
* Work collaboratively with sales teams, customers, distributors, and partners.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Prioritize multiple tasks while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Identify service improvement and upselling opportunities.
* Ability to forge and maintain relationships with customers.

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

title: IT Service Management
description:
**At Chain IQ, your ideas move fast.**
Chain IQ is a global AI-driven Procurement Service Partner, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland, with operations across main centers and 16 offices worldwide. We provide tailored, end-to-end procurement solutions that enable transformation, drive scalability, and deliver substantial reductions in our clients' indirect spend. Our culture is built on innovation, entrepreneurship, ownership, and impact. Here, your voice matters - bold thinking is encouraged, and action follows ambition.
  
  
We are seeking a dynamic IT Service Management professional who thrives in a multifaceted role supporting the transition and ongoing operations of our AI-driven digital procurement platform. This role is ideal for a hands-on professional who combines strong IT Service Management expertise with application support, automation, low-code development, and operational excellence.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing incidents, service requests, platform operations, and service improvements while driving automation initiatives that reduce ticket volumes, improve user experience, and increase operational efficiency. We are looking for a self-starter who takes ownership, proactively identifies opportunities for improvement, and collaborates effectively across business and technology teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop a strong understanding of Chain IQ’s digital platforms, business processes, integrations, and service offerings supporting Source-to-Pay (S2P) operations.
* Manage and coordinate end-to-end IT Service Management activities, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Service Request Fulfilment, Knowledge Management, and Service Level Management.
* Provide Level 3 application support by diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex business application issues while ensuring SLA compliance and customer satisfaction.
* Analyse incident and service request trends, identify recurring issues, and drive permanent resolutions through root cause analysis and problem management practices.
* Design, develop, and maintain low-code/no-code solutions, workflows, automations, and self-service capabilities.
* Support AI Ops and intelligent automation initiatives by leveraging analytics, predictive insights, workflow automation, virtual agents, and AI-powered operational capabilities to reduce manual effort and improve service quality.
* Lead initiatives to reduce ticket volumes through automation, process optimization, knowledge management, self-healing capabilities, and proactive monitoring.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to identify improvement opportunities and translate operational challenges into scalable technology solutions.
* Monitor platform health, integration performance, system alerts, and operational metrics to proactively identify risks and service degradation.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, knowledge articles, support procedures, and service management artifacts.
* Demonstrate ownership and accountability by independently driving operational improvements, solving problems proactively, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum 6 years of experience in IT Service Management, Application Support, Service Operations, or Service Delivery functions.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Release Management, and Service Request Management.
* Knowledge of AI Ops, event monitoring, predictive analytics, and automation frameworks.
* Experience working with low-code/no-code platforms.
* Knowledge of service management platforms and experience managing service tickets, SLAs, and operational processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across applications, integrations, APIs, and data flows.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, web services, and system integrations.
* Working knowledge of SQL and data analysis techniques for investigation and reporting.
* Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to independently manage priorities and drive initiatives with minimal supervision.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking abilities.
* Experience supporting AI-enabled digital platforms and automation-led service organizations.
* Understanding of Service Integration and Management (SIAM), Agile delivery methodologies, and continuous improvement practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and customer-service orientation.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* ITIL Foundation Certification (mandatory).

**Join a truly global team.**
We offer a dynamic and international environment where high performance meets real purpose. We're proud to be Great Place to Work-certified and even prouder of the people who make that possible. Let’s shape the future of procurement - together.
  
  
**Chain IQ – Create. Lead. Make an impact.**

title: Salesforce System Administrator
description:
Job Type: Permanent - Full Time
  
  
Location: Mumbai
  
  
Job Category: IT
  
  
**Job Description**
Zurich Cover-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
  
  
In the post-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
  
  
**So, what’s the job?**

* You'll provide day-to-day Level 2 support for the Salesforce platform, ensuring timely resolution of user issues and platform-related requests.
* You'll configure and customize Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, including creating and maintaining dashboards and reports based on business requirements.
* You'll monitor Salesforce logs and proactively identify, troubleshoot, and remediate bugs and system issues.
* You'll act as the primary point of contact for Salesforce-related queries, providing end-user support and ad hoc training when needed.
* You'll collaborate with Salesforce users to gather feedback, understand pain points, and recommend platform enhancements.
* You'll assist users with production verification testing and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure successful deployment of changes.
* You'll support the testing team by participating in Salesforce regression testing for new releases and system updates.
* You'll manage Salesforce data and database integrity, including data cleansing, sandbox preparation, backup and restore activities, object optimization, and security settings.
* You'll maintain the overall health and security of the Salesforce org, including applying security updates, managing certificates, and ensuring platform stability

**And what are we looking for?**

* You'll hold a relevant qualification in IT, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
* You'll bring 5+ years of experience working with Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, with Experience Cloud and Pardot knowledge considered an advantage.
* You'll possess Salesforce certifications such as ADM301 or equivalent credentials.
* You'll have hands-on experience building and maintaining Salesforce Reports, Dashboards, and Lightning templates.
* You'll be familiar with Salesforce add-ons such as Conga, OwnBackup, or similar tools, which would be highly beneficial.
* You'll have experience delivering end-user training and supporting user adoption of Salesforce solutions.
* You'll demonstrate excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* You'll have proven experience working in complex Salesforce environments and applying strong problem-solving skills to identify and resolve root causes.
* You'll bring a proactive mindset, a strong willingness to learn, and a positive "can-do" attitude toward challenges and continuous development.

**So, why choose us?**
**We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.**
We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
  
  
**Job flexibility**
. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
  
  
**Career growth**
. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business - not for the business!
  
  
**Diversity and inclusion.**
We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
  
  
Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Sr. System Administrator
description:
**Senior Server Administrator – IT Infrastructure**
===================================================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Senior Server Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s server and IT infrastructure environment. The role will ensure that infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, highly available, and aligned with business requirements.

The successful candidate will provide senior-level technical expertise across physical and virtual server environments, operating systems, storage, backup, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure security. They will also play a key role in incident resolution, infrastructure projects, service improvements, and technical planning.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Server & Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer and maintain Windows and/or Linux server environments across physical and virtual platforms.
* Manage server hardware, operating systems, virtualisation platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure services.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
* Perform server builds, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning in accordance with established standards.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, configuration records, and technical procedures.
* Ensure infrastructure platforms are appropriately configured for availability, performance, and resilience.

### **Infrastructure Operations & Support**

* Provide senior-level technical support for infrastructure incidents, service requests, and problems.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, networking, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours support rota where required.
* Lead or support the resolution of major incidents and provide root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Work closely with service desk, network, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

### **Security & Compliance**

* Maintain server security in line with organisational policies and industry best practices.
* Manage operating system patching, vulnerability remediation, antivirus/endpoint protection, and security configuration.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements, and infrastructure risk assessments.
* Implement and maintain appropriate access controls, privileged access, and server hardening standards.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to investigate and remediate infrastructure security incidents.

### **Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity**

* Manage and monitor server backup and recovery solutions.
* Regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support the development and maintenance of infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Ensure critical infrastructure services meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.

### **Projects & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects, including server upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, virtualisation, and technology refresh programmes.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure services.
* Identify opportunities to automate routine administration and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain technical standards, processes, and best-practice procedures.
* Support capacity planning and future infrastructure strategy.

### **Stakeholder & Supplier Management**

* Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party suppliers.
* Provide technical guidance and communicate complex infrastructure issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support supplier management, technical reviews, and service improvement activities where required.
* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior infrastructure team members.

**Essential Skills & Experience**
---------------------------------

* Significant experience in a senior server/infrastructure administration role.
* Strong experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core infrastructure services.
* Experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, networking, and infrastructure architecture.
* Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong knowledge of server security, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and hardening.
* Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and performing root-cause analysis.
* Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management processes.
* Experience working with monitoring and infrastructure management tools.
* Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.

**Desirable Skills**
--------------------

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure platforms.
* Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting/automation technologies.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with enterprise storage technologies.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Linux, ITIL, or cloud certifications.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* **Technical expertise:** Demonstrates strong knowledge of server and infrastructure technologies.
* **Problem solving:** Able to diagnose complex technical problems and develop effective solutions.
* **Ownership:** Takes responsibility for infrastructure services and follows issues through to resolution.
* **Communication:** Communicates clearly with technical teams, management, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, performance, and efficiency.
* **Teamwork:** Works effectively across IT teams and supports knowledge sharing.
* **Resilience:** Able to manage priorities and remain effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------

* Infrastructure availability and reliability.
* Timely resolution of infrastructure incidents and problems.
* Successful completion of infrastructure projects and upgrades.
* Server patching and vulnerability remediation compliance.
* Backup success rates and successful recovery testing.
* Infrastructure security and compliance performance.
* Reduction in recurring incidents and infrastructure-related risks.
* Quality and accuracy of infrastructure documentation.
* Delivery of automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Senior Server Administrator will be a key member of the IT Infrastructure team, responsible for ensuring the stability, security, resilience, and performance of critical server and infrastructure services. The role requires a proactive and technically capable individual who can manage day-to-day operations while also contributing to strategic infrastructure improvements and business continuity.

description:
OnVUE Technical Support Coordinator (Advanced Associate)

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We’re a place where talented people with different viewpoints can have their voices valued and heard and we’re intentionally building a culture of belonging designed to attract and promote innovative, and skilled people, where everyone has the opportunity to make progress in their careers.

  
  

Your Opportunity

  
  

Join the Pearson operations team where we are dedicated to helping support candidates and clients throughout their certification testing process. The OnVUE Tech Support Team is an escalation point for our global testing candidates who may experience technical issues during the OnVUE exam process. As an Advanced Associate, you will focus on both live troubleshooting and post-issue research within the Pearson VUE case management system. If you are looking to work with a company that cares about its employees, including the importance of work-life balance, takes ownership of customer satisfaction, and cultivates an environment that integrates our Pearson values into everything we do – this is the place for you.

  
  

This is a candidate-facing role, where our coordinators will personally connect with test takers to offer support, guidance, and reassurance while walking customers through basic troubleshooting steps. Like every department within Pearson, our work goes beyond just delivering exams and focuses on our ability to allow learners to flourish. We are looking for team members who are ready and able to deliver a first-class level of customer service to our candidates and clients through skills we will help sharpen and grow. Our teams focus heavily on the importance of empathy and responding to candidate concerns – we don’t shy away from real-time feedback and consistent conversations with staff to ensure we never lose sight of our overall team, department, and company goals.

  

  
* **Title:**
  Advanced Associate
  
  
* **Location:**
  We are a global company and department, with team members are based in Bloomington, Minnesota and Noida, India. This position is based in Noida, India.
  
  
* **Hours:**
  You will be working a regular full-time position - working a 40-hour shift each week. We are hiring available shifts which will include hours in the afternoon/evening and/or weekends. For example, Sunday - Thursday, Saturday - Wednesday, Thursday - Monday or Tuesday - Saturday. Subject to change based on business needs.
  
  
* **New Hire Training:**
  During your first few weeks of onboarding, you’ll be asked to adhere to a training schedule that allows our teams to show you the ropes and create a foundation of required knowledge you’ll use throughout your career with Pearson.
  

  

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  
  

Technical Support and Troubleshooting

* Follow through on commitments and take responsibility for results, effectively prioritizing tasks. Identify and proposes solutions for barriers to leadership.
  

  

Deliver first-class customer service

* Effective verbal and written communication skills. Provide clear and concise directions to live candidates while troubleshooting, and/or explaining policies and/or testing procedures.
  
  
* Anticipate candidate needs, identifies, and resolves issues that impact the delivery of quality service.
  
  
* Use active listening to understand the candidate's concerns, demonstrating comprehension of the issue through the use of asking probing questions, providing supportive directions, and empathetic reassurance during high-stress situations.
  
  
* Ability to research, analyze, interpret, and document candidate interactions.
  
  
* Exhibits a positive can-do attitude and approach to tasks; meets new challenges and changes with an open mind; demonstrates commitment to the role and supporting a candidate.
  

  

Background Requirements

  
  

Education and Experience

  

  
* Minimum High School Diploma or equivalent
  
  
* Customer service experience preferred
  
  
* Basic technical troubleshooting experience preferred
  

  

Key characteristics we are looking for

  

  
* Passion for customer service and find joy in helping others succeed.
  
  
* Has a patient, positive, compassionate, and friendly demeanor.
  
  
* Thrive working with a team and technology.
  
  
* Eagerness to learn and willing to adapt to situations as business needs change and demand for service grows.
  
  
* Proficient standard technology including Windows, Microsoft 360 OneDrive, Excel, Word, and other related applications.
  
  
* Conflict management skills; diplomatic and sees feedback as an opportunity for growth.
  
  
* Time management skills; can quickly and effectively adapt to changes.
  
  
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and overcome objections.
  
  
* Strong attention to detail.
  
  
* Willing and able to work assigned shifts, flexible work arrangements and time off may be limited during specific times due to business demands. All overtime must be approved in advance.

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

**Insurity’s Next Cloud Operations Analyst**
As a Cloud Operations Analyst, you'll coordinate service management work across Insurity's Cloud AppOps environment — tracking incidents, problems, changes, and onboarding tasks through to closure, and keeping change control and SLA reporting on track. You'll work closely with engineers, and stakeholders using Jira to keep operational projects moving.
  
  
This role suits a detail-oriented, self-starting coordinator who juggles multiple tickets and projects at once and communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike. You'll fit well on our Cloud AppOps team if you bring strong ITSM instincts and the flexibility to reprioritize in a fast-moving operations environment.
  
  
What Our
**Cloud Operations Analyst**
Will Do
  
  

* Maintain ownership and accountability for service management assigned tasks and small projects.
* Document requirements, define scope and objectives for service management tasks and projects.
* Help breakdown service delivery requirements and delivery problems (incidents, problems, requests, and changes) into manageable parts and assess risk throughout the implementation.
* Identify risks and help develop mitigation plans.
* Track and bring task impediments, issues, and onboarding blockers to closure.
* Provide status reports to stakeholders.
* Support and participate in PI Planning, Scrums, and service review routines.
* Maintain and enhance service management operational procedures and runbooks.
* Facilitate operational areas such as but not limited to: Change Control, Incident Management, Problem Management, Request Management, FinOps and Disaster Recovery Exercises.
* Help manage internal team member and external vendor relationships necessary for a successful project delivery.
* Coordinate assigned operational projects, including meeting cadence, action tracking, and status reporting through closure.
* Collaborate with peers on best practices.
* Stay up to date on industry and job-related trends and best practices, including reading relevant publications, articles, blogs, etc.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Incident Management**

* Prepare and present root cause analysis and incident reports.
* Coordinate postmortem activities.

**Change Management**

* Coordinate weekly change control activities and approval process.
* Participate in the implementation of strategies to optimize operations.

**FinOps**

* Support incident, RCA, and credits review activities alongside senior leadership, ensuring the accuracy of related data.
* Map quarterly SLA credits owed to different clients based on outages across different products, in coordination with senior leadership.

**Who We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Perform the following skills at a proficient level:

+ Analytical and critical thinking
+ Written and oral English communication
+ Time management including work planning, prioritization, and organization
+ Ability to handle multiple priorities or tasks
+ Self-starter and quick learner
+ Detail-oriented
+ Active listener
+ Ability to collaborate and work autonomously
+ Flexible and adaptable
+ Service coordination and stakeholder follow-up
+ Incident triage and prioritization
+ Problem and change management discipline
+ Reporting accuracy and process adherence

  
  

* Minimum 2 years' experience in service management, operational coordination, incident / problem / change management, or project coordination within a Cloud environment.
* Bachelor's degree in related field (equivalent work experience may be considered).
* Proficient knowledge and experience with:

+ MS Office, notably MS Excel, MS Word, and MS Outlook
+ Agile project management methodology
+ Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence) with strong workflow discipline for incidents, problems, requests, and changes
+ ITSM-style ticketing, reporting, and dashboarding practices

* Travel required - 0-25%

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Your Role**

Join Megaport, a global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), as we continue to expand. We’re looking for a Technical Support Engineer with a background in networking who is passionate about helping customers and solving technical problems.

You’ll be the first point of contact for our customers, helping resolve technical and account-related issues via phone and web-based support. This is a dynamic, high-growth opportunity to work on real-world networking challenges while collaborating with teams around the world.

You’ll work independently, think creatively to resolve issues, and provide exceptional customer service. This role is ideal for someone looking to grow their career in a global tech company with a strong engineering culture and supportive team environment.

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Provide Technical Support and General Enquiry Customer Service via phone, email, and live chat.
* Meet or exceed support targets (KPIs and SLAs).
* Adhere to operating procedures and policies
* Accurately document all support activities using internal systems.
* Troubleshoot network, portal, and account-related issues using provided tools.
* Focus on resolving issues at first contact and keep customers informed.
* Spot opportunities to help customers improve their services.
* Collaborate with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to resolve cases.
* Clearly communicate and escalate unresolved technical issues.
* Support inbound sales and general inquiries.
* Think creatively to deliver the best outcome for each customer.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience in logical networking troubleshooting and solving networking-related issues (three years minimum).
* Studied or completed a degree in IT, Networking, or a related field.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
* Strong customer service skills.
* Able to work independently and collaborate with global teams.
* Detail-oriented, organised, and focused on delivering high-quality results.
* Eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment.
* Networking certifications (CCNA, CCNP, CWNA, etc.) are a plus.

**Working Hours**

* **Office-based role:**
  Sector 26, Gurgaon Delhi, Gurugram, Haryana
* **Schedule:**
  8.5 hours per shift
* You will be scheduled to work on weekends, public holiday and night shifts in a rotating cycle
* Working visits to the Locations which are under your responsibility for meeting partners, vendors, team, checking the quality of the network
* 90-day notice period for resignation after the trial period
* Working exclusively for Extreme Infocom Pvt. Ltd. and not for any other companies.

**What We Offer**

* \*Subject to the internal policies of Megaport, which may be updated from time to time\*:
* Family health insurance according to complany policy
* A motivated team combining industry experts and emerging talent.
* Recognition programs – including Legend and Kudos Awards.

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com

**NOTE:
*All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".***

*All applications will be treated in confidence.*

*Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy-related questions. Candidates who meet the selection criteria will be invited to attend an interview. Strictly no Recruitment Agencies.*

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Support Engineer - Level 1
description:
**Your Role**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Support Engineer (L1) to solve real-world networking challenges while collaborating with global teams. In this role, you’ll be the first line of response to customer-reported issues, taking ownership of tickets, performing essential diagnostics, and delivering exceptional support experiences. You’ll work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment that values reliability, proactive monitoring, and continuous learning. This position is ideal for a motivated engineer looking to build their career within a global technology company that fosters a strong engineering culture and a supportive, customer-focused team.

As a Support Engineer (L1), your primary responsibility involves efficiently addressing customer concerns communicated through tickets, live chat, and calls, ensuring clear and effective communication to understand and resolve issues promptly. Additionally, you’ll be responsible for the proactive monitoring of our systems and services to identify and rectify potential problems before they impact operations. When faced with complex or high-severity issues, you will gather essential diagnostics and seek guidance from Senior Support Engineers to ensure swift and accurate escalations. Your consistent presence across our shift rotations, ensuring coverage 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, underlines our commitment to providing uninterrupted support and maintaining operational continuity at all times.

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* **Customer Support & Service Excellence**
* Deliver exceptional technical support and customer service via phone, email, and live chat. Process incoming customer calls promptly following ticket submissions to clarify issues, address queries, and ensure accurate understanding.
* Skillfully assess and prioritize tickets based on urgency and operational impact, ensuring critical issues receive immediate attention.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction by resolving issues at the first point of contact whenever possible and keeping customers informed throughout the process.
* Meet or exceed defined KPIs and SLAs while adhering to established operating procedures and policies.
* Strive to independently resolve customer concerns at the first point of contact, escalating complex technical issues to Senior Support Engineers (L2) only when appropriate.
* Manage escalations between global teams (e.g., acting as a bridge between regional support teams) to ensure seamless communication and timely resolution.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customers’ services or improve their overall experience.
* **Service Monitoring & Incident Response**
* Proactively monitor company services, network ports, and peering platforms using alerting and incident response tools to ensure high availability and stability.
* Process alert logs, detect anomalies, and take immediate corrective measures, including opening vendor or customer tickets when necessary.
* Perform system initialization post-server reboots, verifying that traffic restores to pre-reboot baselines and escalating timely if performance inconsistencies occur.
* Create and update detailed incident reports, maintaining accurate, real-time updates on status pages for customer transparency.
* Regularly monitor aggregated content and performance graphs to track trends and identify potential service degradation.
* Process maintenance notifications (internal and external).
* **Knowledge Sharing**
* Contribute to building and maintaining an integrated internal knowledge base by documenting known issues, standard operating procedures, and basic troubleshooting guides.
* Maintain high-quality documentation for designs, configurations, known issues, troubleshooting procedures, and post-incident learnings to enable repeatable outcomes and team uplift.
* Learn and adopt new systems, monitoring applications, and support tools introduced across integrated global operations.

**Your Success Metrics**

* **Installation Efficiency & Quality**
* Track the number, timeliness, and success rate of service installations.
* Maintain a high first-time success rate, minimising rework or follow-up visits.
* Collect and analyse customer feedback post-installation to gauge satisfaction and identify areas for improvement.
* **Ticket & Alert Resolution Performance**
* Achieve a high percentage of received tickets and alerts resolved without further escalation.
* Achieve a strong First Time Resolution rate.
* Ensure essential diagnostic checks and detailed internal notes are completed for 100% of handled tickets within SLA timeframes.
* Ensure that all issues undergo thorough diagnostic checks before being resolved or escalated.
* Maintain strong adherence to KPIs and SLAs for response and resolution times.
* Quickly prioritize, categorize, and process monitoring alerts within target timelines, ensuring service-impacting events are properly communicated and documented.
* Maintain 100% accuracy in incident reports and status page updates to ensure full transparency for customers and internal teams.
* Aim for high first-contact resolution and reduced case reopen rates.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong foundational understanding of network infrastructure and protocols, including LAN/WAN fundamentals (Ethernet, switches, VLANs, IP addressing, ASN, prefixes, and BGP basics).
* Hands-on experience with a variety of network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, MikroTik, and similar platforms).
* Good understanding of networking protocols, including MPLS, OSPF, BGP, and other advanced routing protocols.
* Familiarity with network hardware platforms and tools used in technical support and network monitoring operations.
* Proven experience in logical troubleshooting and resolving networking issues (minimum of three years).

**Customer Support & Problem-Solving**

* Exceptional ability to assess, prioritise, and resolve customer issues efficiently while maintaining clear and professional communication.
* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on understanding customer needs and delivering effective solutions.
* Proven ability to monitor services proactively, detect anomalies, and take corrective action to maintain stability and reliability.

title: Product Deployment Specialist
description:
P
  
  
**roduct Deployment Specialist – Networking**
**About the Team**
Join a dynamic technology services team responsible for deploying, integrating, and supporting enterprise networking solutions for customers across diverse industry segments. The team focuses on delivering reliable, secure, and scalable network infrastructures leveraging Cisco technologies and industry best practices.
  
  
**Key Purpose of the Job**
The Product Deployment Specialist will be responsible for implementing, managing, and supporting Cisco networking and wireless solutions. The role involves deployment, migration, troubleshooting, optimization, and post-implementation support while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and network performance.
  
  
**Who We’re Looking For**
We are looking for a hands-on networking professional with strong expertise in Cisco Routing, Switching, Wireless, and Network Access Control technologies. The ideal candidate should have experience in enterprise network deployments, troubleshooting complex environments, and working directly with customers during implementation and support engagements.
  
  
**Your Role**
**Network Deployment & Implementation**

* Deploy and support Cisco Routing, Switching, and Wireless solutions.
* Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, OSPF, BGP, HSRP, and QoS.
* Implement and manage Cisco Catalyst Switches, ISR/ASR Routers, Catalyst 9800 Wireless LAN Controllers, and Cisco Access Points.
* Execute network upgrades, migrations, cutovers, and health check activities.

**Security & Access Control**

* Integrate networking solutions with Cisco ISE.
* Configure and support 802.1X authentication, TACACS+, and Security Group Tag (SGT)-based segmentation.
* Ensure network access control and policy compliance across enterprise environments.

**Monitoring & Optimization**

* Monitor and manage network infrastructure using Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco Spaces, and other network management tools.
* Diagnose and resolve performance, connectivity, and wireless issues.
* Recommend improvements to optimize network availability and performance.

**Documentation & Customer Support**

* Prepare High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), implementation plans, and as-built documentation.
* Provide post-deployment support and technical assistance to customers.
* Collaborate with internal teams and customer stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

**Technical Competencies**

* Cisco Routing & Switching
* Cisco Wireless (Catalyst 9800 WLC, Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points)
* OSPF, BGP, VLANs, HSRP, QoS
* Cisco ISE & Network Access Control (NAC)
* 802.1X, TACACS+, SGT-based Segmentation
* Cisco Catalyst Center & Cisco Spaces
* Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting
* SD-WAN (Preferred)

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Customer-centric approach and stakeholder management
* Effective communication and documentation skills
* Ability to work independently and manage deployment activities
* Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset
* Willingness to travel for customer implementations when required

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Cisco certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Enterprise, or equivalent will be an added advantage.
* Experience in enterprise networking deployment and support environments.

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.
  
  
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud, and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork, and a great sense of humor to help our customers be successful with MongoDB.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The position will be based in our Gurugram office. The standard work week will be Sunday to Thursday, every week.
  
  
Cool things you’ll do
  
  
You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
  
  
What you need
  
  
You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.
  
  
The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas
  
  

* Systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Understand core Kubernetes concepts, including containers, namespaces, custom resources and multi-cluster deployments
* Should have a good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
* Storage engineering experience, including NAS, SAN, SSD, multi-pathing, and caching
* Experience building and maintaining complex mission-critical production database systems
* Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
* Experience analyzing issues holistically, from the application tier through the database, down to the storage
* Be able to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc.
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills

If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
  
  
You should possess a genuine desire to help people, the ability to think on your feet and remain calm under pressure while solving problems in real-time. There’s a lot to learn, so the desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills is paramount. We work in a collaborative team environment, so a willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and good judgment to know when to seek help, is essential. We also aim to have diverse technical backgrounds and therefore different subject matter expertise is welcome.
  
  
*You do not need to have prior experience with MongoDB. We can teach you that!*
Bonus Points
  
  

* Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
* Experience with authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, AD
* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
* Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
* Experience with virtualization, Docker, Kubernetes (including CLI), ability to inspect resource / container status using relevant utilities and commands

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training.
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam.
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within MongoDB and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently.

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Within this team, the Specialist is a technical team member responsible for implementing changes to the network, incident troubleshooting and resolution, conducting routine maintenance, updating our management tools, and maintaining documented knowledge (e.g., SOP’s, guidelines).
  
  
The Specialist also communicates with internal customer contacts, 3rd party vendors, and management to drive incident/problem resolution, gather requirements, and coordinate changes.
  
  
Example efforts/assignments are:
  
  

* Implementation, and operation of

+ LAN and WiFi network upgrade
+ SD-WAN routing or QoS features
+ New connectivity between on-premise and cloud environments
+ A new remote site office network
+ New RADIUS or ACS authentication servers
+ A new VPN connection with a business partner
+ Network connectivity for IoT devices
+ Improved monitoring or automation capabilities

* Incident Resolution

+ WAN Link Failure
+ LAN Switch Failure / Replacement
+ WiFi Unable to Connect

* Maintaining

+ Current OS/code levels on devices
+ Documentation (diagrams, SOPs, config guidelines)
+ Toolsets (e.g., monitoring, authentication)

**Qualifications**
The Specialist should have proven hands-on experience in one or more technical sub-domains (e.g., WiFi, LAN, SD-WAN), experience across other areas of network technology, and familiarity with other infrastructure technologies (e.g., server OS, DHCP, Active Directory).
  
  
The Specialist also needs strong written and verbal (speaking) communication skills.
  
  
Sample Experience:
  
  

* 4+ years deep experience with one or more Cisco WiFi, LAN, or WAN technologies
* 1+ years’ experience with all of Cisco WiFi, LAN, and SD-WAN technologies
* Familiarity with Active Directory, DHCP, and various client and server OS’s
* 1+ years with network load balancers, VPN’s, and cloud networking
* 1+ years’ experience with multiple network tools and/or authentication servers
* Prior experience in either a network operations team
* Experience solving problems using packet capture analysis
* Experience with supporting manufacturing plant floor operations

Support audits, compliance, and governance processes

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  
  
Ability to work in high-pressure NOC/VNOC environments
  
  
Effective communication and stakeholder management
  
  
Fast learner with adaptability to new technologies

4–10+ years in Network Engineering (WAN/LAN/WLAN)
  
  
Experience in SD-WAN (Juniper & Cisco)

SD-WAN / CCNP / SASE certifications

**Description**
Amazon is looking for an experienced Inventory Planner with a background in inventory or supply-chain disciplines. They are also responsible for automating and building scale for processes that otherwise require manual inputs and effort. ISMs work with internal and external stakeholders to build the right processes and mechanisms to improve operational supply chain metrics. This position is responsible for developing and executing sales and inventory strategies to optimize availability and inventory turns. In this role, you will have end to end ownership of managing inventory and driving replication and speed initiatives. Drive tools to automate forecasting for sellers

Establish mechanisms to reduce costs across the supply chain through processes such as reduction in long zone shipments

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
**Role: Customer Experience Manager (CEM) – Coliving**

**Zolo | Coliving**

**Own the cluster. Drive performance. Deliver consistent experience.**

**Why this role exists**

Zolo’s coliving business operates at scale across multiple properties in each city.

While individual properties are managed by on-ground teams, consistent performance across occupancy, customer experience, and profitability depends on strong cluster-level ownership.

Each cluster needs a leader who ensures:

* Properties are full and revenue targets are met
* Customer experience is consistent and NPS remains high
* Teams are trained, disciplined, and aligned
* Issues are identified early and resolved quickly

This role exists to ensure that a cluster of 10–20 properties runs with control, consistency, and accountability — delivering both strong business outcomes and great customer experience.

If the CEM is strong, the cluster performs predictably and improves continuously.

If the CEM is weak, performance drops, issues repeat, and teams lose direction.

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own occupancy, NPS, and profitability across your cluster
* Drive execution discipline and SOP adherence across all properties
* Build, train, and manage a strong on-ground team
* Identify and solve operational and customer experience issues
* Use data and numbers to drive decisions and improvements
* Ensure properties are audit-ready and consistently maintained

This is not a coordination role.

It is full ownership of cluster performance and outcomes.

**About Zolo**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

**What you will be responsible for**

1. Own Cluster Performance & Business Outcomes

* Take full accountability for occupancy, revenue, and margins
* Track property-level performance metrics regularly
* Identify underperforming properties and drive improvement
* Ensure consistent achievement of targets across cluster

2. Drive Execution Discipline & SOP Adherence

* Ensure all properties follow defined SOPs and checklists
* Conduct regular reviews with ACEMs and property teams
* Build structured routines for daily, weekly, and monthly tracking
* Ensure consistency in execution across all properties

3. Lead & Develop On-Ground Teams

* Manage ACEMs, property managers, and housekeeping teams
* Train teams on customer experience, processes, and standards
* Identify performance gaps and take corrective actions
* Build a motivated, disciplined, and accountable team

4. Ensure Customer Experience & Manage Escalations

* Track NPS and customer feedback across properties
* Handle escalations and ensure quick resolution
* Drive root cause analysis and prevent repeat issues
* Ensure consistent guest/resident experience across cluster

5. Use Data & Numbers to Drive Decisions

* Track key metrics like occupancy, revenue, and cost
* Use data to identify trends and problem areas
* Take action based on numbers, not assumptions
* Drive performance improvements through data-led decisions

6. Audit Properties & Maintain Control

* Conduct regular property audits (hygiene, operations, processes)
* Identify gaps and ensure timely closure
* Maintain high standards across all properties
* Ensure properties are always audit-ready

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Cluster consistently meets occupancy and revenue targets
* High and stable NPS across all properties
* Strong SOP adherence and execution consistency
* Reduced escalations and faster issue resolution
* Well-trained, motivated, and accountable team
* Clear visibility and control over all properties

The cluster runs with discipline, predictability, and strong performance.

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You take ownership of outcomes across multiple locations
* You enjoy managing teams and driving performance
* You are disciplined and believe in structured execution
* You are comfortable working with numbers and targets
* You can handle pressure and make decisions on-ground
* You want to grow into larger operational leadership roles

**Experience we value**

* 1–3 years of experience in operations / multi-unit environments
* Experience managing teams (directly or indirectly)
* Exposure to customer-facing environments
* Basic understanding of business metrics (occupancy, revenue, cost)
* Strong execution and follow-up discipline

Hospitality experience is not mandatory. Ownership, leadership, and execution discipline are critical.

**The impact you will have**

* You directly influence revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* You shape customer experience across multiple properties
* You build and develop on-ground teams
* You ensure operational consistency at scale

**Why join now**

Zolo is scaling its coliving business aggressively across cities.

Cluster-level execution and leadership will define success.

This role is a critical stepping stone to larger city and business leadership roles.

If you believe in ownership, discipline, and driving outcomes at scale — this is the right role.

title: WFM Manager, LMAQ
description:
**Description**
Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate’s route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions.

description:
Sales & Care Operations Lead at InGoodHands 🚀
  
🌱 Who we are

InGoodHands is an early-stage, funded startup in Bangalore making medically supervised weight loss and metabolic health care accessible to India.

India is in the middle of a metabolic health crisis, and most people who need real care either don’t know it exists or don’t trust it yet. We’re here to change that.

🎯 What you’ll do

* You’ll own the full patient journey, from the first conversation with an incoming lead to the care and support that keeps them with us.

* You’ll build the processes, playbooks, and dashboards that help us scale. You’ll know where leads drop off, where patients get stuck, and what the team needs to do better.

* You’ll work directly with the founders, so your ideas ship in days, not quarters.

* You can turn a messy, recurring problem into a process that works—and get the team to follow it.
* You communicate clearly, handle difficult conversations with empathy, and follow through.
* You’re scrappy, you move fast, and you care about what happens to a patient after the sale.

Experience in healthtech, wellness, or consumer startups is a big plus, especially if you’ve worked with doctors, nutritionists, health coaches, or ongoing care programs.

A seat at the table from day one, working directly with the founders. The chance to build sales and care operations from the ground up, with real ownership and equity in what we’re building.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online. We hire the world's brightest minds, offering them an environment in which they can relentlessly improve the experience for customers. Innovation and creativity are built into the DNA of the company and are encouraged at all levels of employment. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity. We're making history and the good news is we've only just begun.  
  
Summary: Amazon is a highly data-driven company that is passionate about its customers. As our operations network grows across Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres, automation is key to delivering orders on time, with quality, safely and at lower cost. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 is where new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, are piloted, tested and proven on a live floor before they scale across the network.  
  
The Team Lead is a hands-on role at the centre of every pilot. They run the trials themselves, keep the pilot area safe, collect the data that proves or disproves each solution, and turn what works into standard work that other sites can adopt. This role suits someone with strong operations floor experience who is curious about technology, works well without direct supervision, and can get engineering, vendor and site teams moving toward the same outcome without having authority over them.  
  
A day in the life  
\*\*Job Deliverables:\*\*  

* Pilot execution:
* Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan, including operating and testing the equipment yourself
* Set up pilot stations, material flow and test scenarios before each trial window
* Flag deviations from the test plan, and equipment or process failures, the same day they happen
* Safety in automation zones:
* Enforce the safety controls for the pilot area
* Carry out pre-trial safety checks and risk assessments for every new setup or process change
* Report and investigate near-misses and incidents in the pilot area
* Data and reporting:
* Collect physical pilot data (time studies, cycle times, downtime and fault logs, exception counts) according to the Business Analyst's data plan
* Check data accuracy at the end of each trial day and publish the daily pilot report
* Keep a live issue log (equipment faults, process gaps, user feedback) and follow up with Engineering, Controls and vendors until each item is closed
* Standard work and scale readiness:
* Draft and update SOPs and Standard Job Instructions (SJIs) for each pilot as the process changes
* Build training material and train site associates and teams on new equipment when a pilot moves to a live site
* Capture floor learnings for the deployment package that goes with a solution when it scales to other sites
* Conduct 4M and 5S audits on pilot workstations every day and keep the lab audit-ready for leadership and vendor visits
* Coordinate vendor and engineering teams on the floor during installation, trials and troubleshooting windows
* Work with site operations teams to schedule trials at their sites without disrupting their production
* Deep-dive on pilot metrics and propose clear actions and process improvements
* Stand in for the Ops Lead when needed

------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
* Experience with Excel

description:
**Company**
: IIC Group (Innovative Instruments & Controls)
