: 8–12 years in LT, control and automation panel manufacturing, including at least 3 years leading a team

**Qualification**
: BE/B.Tech or Diploma in EEE, EIE or ECE

**Role Summary**

You will lead day-to-day production, testing and quality of MCC, PCC, VFD, APFC and PLC/automation panels. You make sure every panel leaves the shop floor on time, built to drawing, fully tested and documented. You will work as the link between Design, Stores/Logistics, Sales and the customer so production runs without rework or delays.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Management**

- Plan and run panel production schedules against order priorities and delivery commitments

- Lead and supervise wiremen, fitters and testing technicians, including allocating manpower and tracking productivity

- Make sure builds follow approved GA/schematic drawings, BOM and wiring standards

- Find bottlenecks, cut rework and improve cycle time and workmanship

- Enforce shop-floor safety, 5S and housekeeping

**VFD Testing, Troubleshooting & Commissioning**

- Carry out hands-on parameterisation, testing and troubleshooting of VFDs (Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Control Techniques, Danfoss, Delta, Mitsubishi or similar)

- Run motor-coupled and no-load testing, and check I/O, communication and protection functions

- Support site commissioning and resolve field issues when needed

**PLC Panel FAT & Testing**

- Prepare and run FAT procedures: I/O checks, network/communication tests (PROFINET, Modbus, Ethernet/IP), interlock and sequence simulation

- Lead customer and consultant FAT witness visits, and record and close punch points

- Carry out routine tests such as IR, HV and continuity, plus functional and power-on tests

**QC & Documentation**

- Prepare and maintain QC dossiers: inspection checklists, test reports, FAT protocols and reports, IR/HV records, calibration records and as-built markups

- Make sure panels comply with IEC 61439 / IS 8623, IEC 60204-1 and customer specifications

- Maintain NCR/CAPA records and support ISO quality system requirements

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

- Design: clarify drawings, feed back on manufacturability and control revisions

- Purchase/Stores/Logistics: track material readiness, shortages, dispatch planning, packing and documents

- Sales: confirm delivery dates, technical deviations and change orders

- Customer: handle progress updates, inspection scheduling, query resolution and handover

**Other**

- Any other responsibilities assigned by management in line with business needs

**Skills & Competencies**

- Strong hands-on knowledge of VFDs, PLCs (Siemens S7-1200/1500 preferred), HMIs and switchgear

- Able to read and interpret electrical schematics, GA drawings and BOMs

- Sound knowledge of panel testing practice and relevant standards

- Proven ability to lead a shop-floor team and meet deadlines

- Good communication skills in English and Tamil, with confidence dealing with customers and consultants

- Working knowledge of MS Excel/Office; exposure to EPLAN or AutoCAD Electrical is a plus

**Preferred**

- Experience with OEM or system-integrator panel shops serving pharma, F&B, water/wastewater or oil & gas

- Exposure to customer FATs witnessed by third-party inspectors

**Compensation**
: Competitive, based on experience

title: Chief Cloud Infrastructure & Security Officer
description:
Job Description

**Senior Director / Vice President, Cloud Operations & Security Engineering**

**Location:**
Chennai DLF

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
20+ years

**Role Summary**

Talentgigs is seeking an experienced technology leader to own and advance Production Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevSecOps, and Security Engineering.

This leader will bring deep technical judgment and a strong record of leading cloud-native production environments. They will build a capable, accountable organization that protects and operates critical services through reliable engineering, proactive security, automation, continuous monitoring, and disciplined incident management.

The role extends beyond traditional infrastructure management and information security management system (ISMS) compliance. The successful candidate will embed security and reliability in engineering and operational practices, reduce risk before it becomes an incident, and use automation and AI-driven operations to improve service health and response.

**Key Responsibilities**

Production Operations and Reliability

* Own the reliability, availability, performance, and operational readiness of production services.
* Establish clear service ownership, operational accountability, escalation paths, and on-call practices.
* Lead incident response, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and follow-through on corrective actions.
* Define and improve service-level objectives, service-level indicators, error budgets, and operational health measures.
* Strengthen change, release, capacity, resilience, backup, and disaster-recovery practices.
* Reduce recurring incidents and operational toil through engineering-led improvements.

**Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering**

* Set the direction for secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-aware cloud infrastructure.
* Lead the design and operation of cloud-native platforms, environments, networks, identity controls, and shared services.
* Promote infrastructure as code, standard platform patterns, self-service capabilities, and repeatable environment provisioning.
* Ensure platform design supports availability, recovery, observability, performance, and secure delivery.
* Guide capacity planning, cloud cost visibility, and optimization without compromising reliability or security.

**SRE and Operational Excellence**

* Build and mature SRE practices that make reliability measurable and part of day-to-day engineering.
* Develop observability across services using actionable metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and service health views.
* Improve deployment safety through progressive delivery, automated checks, rollback readiness, and resilient release practices.
* Use incident trends, operational data, and post-incident reviews to guide prioritized improvements.
* Create a culture of learning and accountability in which incidents lead to durable fixes.

**DevSecOps and Security Engineering**

* Embed security into software delivery, infrastructure management, and operational workflows.
* Lead practical security engineering across identity and access, secrets, configuration, network controls, workload protection, and data safeguards.
* Build automated security checks into build, test, deployment, and infrastructure pipelines.
* Establish continuous monitoring and threat detection with clear triage, escalation, and response ownership.
* Drive vulnerability prevention and remediation through asset visibility, risk-based prioritization, patching, secure configuration, and dependency controls.
* Strengthen cloud security posture and address risks across applications, platforms, identities, and operational processes.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to resolve security issues early and sustainably.
* Ensure audits and ISMS obligations are supported by effective technical controls and evidence, while keeping operational security and risk reduction at the center.

**Automation and AI-Driven Operations**

* Set an automation strategy that reduces manual work, improves consistency, and speeds up safe delivery and recovery.
* Apply AI and advanced analytics to suitable operational use cases, such as anomaly detection, alert correlation, incident triage, capacity forecasting, and knowledge retrieval.
* Establish appropriate safeguards, human oversight, validation, and access controls for AI-supported operational workflows.
* Measure automation outcomes through reduced toil, faster response, fewer repeat incidents, and improved service health.

**Organization and Leadership**

* Build, develop, and retain strong teams across production operations, cloud infrastructure, SRE, DevSecOps, and security engineering.
* Define organizational structure, role clarity, decision rights, service ownership, and measurable accountability.
* Develop senior technical leaders and create growth paths for engineering and operations talent.
* Work closely with product, application engineering, architecture, risk, and business leaders to align technology priorities with business outcomes.
* Communicate operational risk, service health, security posture, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders.
* Lead through technical credibility, sound judgment, collaboration, and consistent follow-through.

Required Technical Qualifications

* 20+ years of progressive experience in technology, infrastructure, production operations, cloud engineering, reliability, or security, including substantial leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated hands-on technical leadership in cloud-native production environments.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, networking, identity, compute, storage, and platform operations.
* Experience designing and operating containerized and orchestrated workloads, such as Kubernetes or comparable platforms.
* Practical knowledge of infrastructure as code, configuration management, CI/CD, source control, and deployment automation.
* Deep working understanding of SRE principles, observability, service-level objectives, incident management, resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Experience implementing security controls in cloud and software delivery environments, including identity management, secrets, vulnerability management, secure configuration, and threat detection.
* Experience establishing continuous monitoring, alerting, incident response, and security operations practices.
* Ability to assess architecture and operational risk, make trade-offs, and guide teams through complex technical decisions.
* Familiarity with cloud cost management and capacity planning in production environments.

**Required Leadership Qualifications**

* Experience leading multiple technical functions and managing managers or senior technical leaders.
* Track record of building technically strong teams with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to stay close to technical decisions while setting direction and enabling teams to execute.
* Proven leadership in major incidents, security events, operational change, or complex service transformations.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk and investment priorities to executive and non-technical audiences.
* A practical, engineering-led approach to governance, risk management, and compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to build trust and work across organizational boundaries.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience leading operations and security in a high-scale, high-availability, or business-critical environment.
* Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure and operational models into cloud-native platforms and practices.
* Familiarity with zero-trust principles, security architecture, threat modeling, and secure software supply chains.
* Experience with chaos engineering, resilience testing, game days, and recovery exercises.
* Experience using AI or machine learning to improve operational monitoring, incident workflows, or engineering productivity.
* Familiarity with security and service-management frameworks or standards relevant to the organization.
* Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or leadership certifications.

**Success Measures**

Success in this role will be assessed through sustained improvements in:

* Production service availability, reliability, performance, and recovery readiness.
* Incident frequency, severity, time to detect, time to restore, and recurrence rates.
* Adoption and quality of service-level objectives, observability, and service ownership.
* Vulnerability exposure, remediation timelines, secure configuration, and cloud security posture.
* Security monitoring coverage, alert quality, response readiness, and closure of corrective actions.
* Automation coverage, reduction in manual toil, and safe deployment frequency.
* Resilience, backup, disaster-recovery, and continuity test outcomes.
* Cloud cost visibility and efficiency while meeting reliability and security requirements.
* Team capability, role clarity, leadership depth, and accountability across the functions.
* The ability of engineering teams to adopt secure and reliable practices as part of normal delivery.

title: Manager 2
description:

* Operations and ensure team members facilitate processes, etc., to ensure compliance with policy and procedures. The ideal candidate will understand Collections & Recovery, and/or Bankruptcy Operations.

title: Manager - Strategy & Business Operations
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Manager, GBR Strategy & Business Operations**
, you will drive impactful contributions and focus on outcomes. You will be a key member of the
**Global Business Resilience (GBR)**
team, collaborating closely with the AVP & Head of Global Business Resilience and M&A Security, GBR leadership team members, and stakeholders across the enterprise. You will have the autonomy to lead, innovate, and improve organizational effectiveness while supporting governance, strategic planning, performance management, communications, and operational excellence across the GBR organization.
  
  
As a team of self-starters, you can work with impact alongside our vibrant people and culture while enjoying unmatched learning opportunities.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Support the development, execution, and refinement of GBR’s multi-year strategy, roadmap, and strategic priorities.
* Drive operational excellence through governance, business operations, planning processes, and leadership coordination across all GBR towers.
* Develop executive reporting, dashboards, scorecards, KPI frameworks, and performance insights to support decision-making.
* Lead internal communications initiatives, executive presentations, leadership messaging, and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Coordinate strategic initiatives, transformation programs, and continuous improvement efforts that strengthen organizational effectiveness and business outcomes.

Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, and commit to continuous learning. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture, creating unmatched career opportunities and impactful work.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, Finance, Marketing, Public Policy, or a related discipline.
* 9 to 12 years of experience in strategy, business operations, program management, consulting, governance, communications, or organizational effectiveness roles.
* Experience supporting senior leaders and managing cross-functional initiatives within a global organization.
* Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and analytical capabilities.
* Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience creating executive presentations, dashboards, scorecards, and business performance reporting.
* Proven ability to manage complex initiatives and drive outcomes across multiple stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, and Own It.

**These Will Help You Succeed**

* Experience supporting corporate security, business resilience, business continuity, crisis management, risk management, governance, or transformation organizations.
* Experience working within a global, geographically distributed team.
* Familiarity with organizational change management and strategic planning methodologies.
* Experience supporting executive leadership teams and enterprise-wide initiatives.
* MBA or other relevant advanced degree.
* Experience in consulting, strategy, PMO, governance, or transformation functions.
* Ability to influence without authority and coordinate across complex global stakeholder groups.

**Work Model**
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, the work model will be determined in accordance with business needs and hiring location. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting and may change based on business and client requirements.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Manager - Procurement
description:
The Procurement Manager is responsible for leading procurement activities for both inter-company and external supplier purchases, ensuring cost-effective sourcing, uninterrupted material availability, efficient logistics management, and supplier relationship development. The role requires expertise in procurement strategy, commercial negotiations, SAP systems, logistics coordination, and supply chain management within the process automation industry.
  
  
Procurement & Sourcing
  
  

* Manage end-to-end procurement activities for inter-group and external suppliers.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Ensure timely procurement of materials, components, and services to support business operations.
* Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes, cost optimization, and supplier performance.

Supplier Management
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and develop suppliers to support business requirements.
* Build strategic partnerships with key suppliers and internal group companies.
* Monitor supplier performance through KPIs such as delivery, quality, responsiveness, and cost competitiveness.
* Conduct periodic supplier reviews and corrective action follow-ups.

Commercial Negotiation
  
  

* Lead commercial negotiations for pricing, payment terms, contracts, and service agreements.
* Deliver year-on-year cost savings through strategic sourcing initiatives.
* Manage contract renewals and ensure favorable commercial terms.

SAP & Procurement Operations
  
  

* Oversee purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, and supplier master data within SAP.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies and approval workflows.
* Drive accuracy and efficiency of procurement transactions and reporting.

Logistics & Supply Chain Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate closely with logistics providers, production planning, warehouses, and suppliers to ensure on-time deliveries.
* Manage import/export processes, shipment tracking, and customs-related activities.
* Support inventory optimization and working capital improvement initiatives.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Collaborate with Planning, Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance, Quality, and Customer Service teams.
* Support business growth through proactive procurement planning and risk mitigation.
* Act as the key escalation point for supply disruptions and delivery challenges.

Process Improvement
  
  

* Drive digital transformation and process automation initiatives within procurement operations.
* Implement best practices in sourcing, supplier management, and logistics.
* Participate in continuous improvement and operational excellence projects.
* Graduate degree in Engineering, Commerce, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* 6-10 years of procurement and supply chain experience within the Process Automation or Industrial Automation industry.
* Strong understanding of procurement processes, strategic sourcing, supplier management, and logistics operations.
* Hands-on experience with SAP ERP systems (SAP MM preferred).
* Proven experience in commercial negotiations and contract management.

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles

Bachelor’s degree in accounting/finance or equivalent experience/qualification. Professional Certification in Accounting/Finance is an advantage.

Minimum 4 years of PTP experience in a large MNC, with at least 2 years in supervisory or management role.

* International and virtual environment
* Flexibility and great opportunity to learn

title: Director - IT Infrastructure
description:
**About Us**

Volante Technologies is the leading global provider of low-code cloud Payments as a Service solution for financial businesses. We are disruptors and innovators and we are growing fast. For the last three years, we have been the #1 seller of wholesale payment systems worldwide. At Volante, we are all about revolutionizing the world of Payments.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Director – IT Infrastructure to lead and manage the organization's internal IT infrastructure and services across multiple global locations. The role will be responsible for ensuring employees have secure, reliable, and efficient access to the technology, infrastructure, and IT services required to perform their roles effectively.

The Director will lead the Internal IT organization responsible for end-user computing, workplace technology, IT service delivery, corporate infrastructure, office networking, and related IT operations. This role will drive standardization, modernization, security, operational excellence, and a high-quality employee technology experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage the Internal IT organization supporting employees across multiple office locations and geographies.
* Ensure timely provisioning, deployment, lifecycle management, and support for employee laptops, desktops, mobile devices, peripherals, and other workplace technology.
* Own and manage corporate IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, identity and access services, office networks, Wi-Fi, VPN, collaboration platforms, and related technologies.
* Establish and maintain IT service management processes for incident, request, problem, change, asset, and vendor management.
* Ensure consistent IT service delivery and defined SLAs for employee support across all locations.
* Lead office IT infrastructure planning for new offices, expansions, relocations, and technology refresh initiatives.
* Develop and maintain standards for end-user computing, hardware, software, asset lifecycle management, and IT infrastructure.
* Partner with Information Security to ensure secure endpoint management, identity and access controls, patching, vulnerability remediation, and compliance with corporate security policies.
* Drive automation, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvements to enhance employee experience and operational efficiency.
* Manage IT budgets, procurement, hardware and software vendors, contracts, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Develop and lead a high-performing IT team, including geographically distributed resources and third-party service providers.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Corporate IT, or IT Service Delivery, including significant experience leading IT teams.

**Leadership Competencies**

The successful candidate should demonstrate strong people leadership, customer and employee focus, operational excellence, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, vendor management, financial accountability, problem-solving, and executive communication skills.

**Work Environment**

This role supports a geographically distributed organization and requires the ability to manage IT teams and service providers across multiple locations and time zones. The successful candidate should be comfortable supporting critical IT initiatives, major incidents, office infrastructure changes, and business priorities outside standard working hours when required.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About IDP**
IDP is the global leader in international education services, delivering global success to students, test takers and our partners, through trusted human relationships, digital technology and customer research. An Australian-listed company, we operate in more than 50 countries around the world.
  
  
Our team is comprised of over 7,000 people of various nationalities, ages and cultural backgrounds. Proudly customer-first, our expert people are powered by global technology. Together, we offer unmatched services, helping local dreams become realities, all over the world.
  
  
Learn more at www.careers.idp.com
  
  
****Role purpose****
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Engineering Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and coordinating multiple projects across diverse teams. Your primary focus will be on developing efficient processes, executing effective strategies, and ensuring the timely completion of projects. As an Engineering Manager, you will play a key role in researching and developing innovative products. You will also be responsible for creating project budgets and overseeing their successful execution throughout the year. Collaborating closely with various teams, you will ensure that projects are delivered on schedule and within budget, maintaining a high level of quality and adherence to organizational objectives.
  
  
****Key accountabilities****

* Lead and propose necessary processes to ensure a structured and predictable approach to software Engineering.
* Define and drive the technical strategy and development methodology.
* Plan and execute strategies for completing projects on time. Implement a system for monitoring and tracking project progress
* Balance, creating and repaying technical debt, and developing new features. Use technology and automation to help manage technical debt.
* Collaborate with organizational leadership to develop an annual budget for the engineering department. Assess the tools and technologies required for efficient project development. Regularly assess the effectiveness of budget allocations. Work with leadership to allocate budgets for tools, training, and staffing needed to support
* Set clear expectations, goals, and objectives for each team. Ensure a balanced distribution of work among teams to optimize productivity. Encourage collaboration between teams to promote knowledge sharing and cross-functional problem-solving. Implement performance metrics to monitor the progress of each team.
* Organize team-building activities that involve both your internal team and the vendor's team. This could include workshops, training sessions, or even informal gathering.
* Evaluate how emerging technologies could impact the team's skill requirements and project outcomes. Identify any gaps between the existing skills and those required to meet current or future project needs. Determine the need for training and talent development.
* Delegate technical decisions to your senior engineers but ask the right questions to ensure that the product is scalable, secure, and reliable.
* Bridge the gap between product management and Engineering team by facilitating necessary interaction
* Anticipate and identify potential risks associated with the technical strategy, including technological challenges, resource constraints, and market changes. Develop mitigation plans to address identified risks, ensuring that the technical strategy remains resilient and adaptable.
* Evaluate, select, and implement monitoring tools and systems to enhance the observability of the engineering infrastructure. Set up effective alerting and notification systems to promptly respond to any anomalies or critical events, ensuring a proactive approach to system health.
* Establishing Support Processes: Define and implement robust support processes to ensure timely and effective resolution of incidents and customer issues.
* Demonstrate a forward-looking mindset by establishing and driving engineering and technology roadmaps aligned to business objectives. Leverage industry experience, emerging trends, AI capabilities, and engineering best practices to continuously improve software engineering, operational excellence, platform capabilities, and organizational maturity. Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and modern engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve productivity, quality, scalability, and speed to market.

**Required Experience**
Minimum 6+ years of hard-core coding experience is mandatory
  
  
Excellent hands-on experience in coding in Python/Java, ‘AWS/Microservices will be added advantage’
  
  
Good to have front-end framework knowledge like REACT/Angular.
  
  
Over all 9-13 Experience is mandatory.
  
  
Mandatory 2+ years of people management experience required .

title: Channel Partner Manager - India
description:
**Imagine yourself…**

* Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
* Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project.
* Owning your ambition and fueling your career growth.

It’s possible with a role at
**Linx Printing Technologies**
(www.linxglobal.com).
  
  
Linx, a Veralto company, is a leading global provider of coding and marking solutions for date and batch coding of products and packaging across manufacturing industries. As part of the Linx team and the broader Veralto network, you’ll work with products that make an everyday impact on the food, medicine, and essentials we all rely on—and along the way, you’ll have the chance to make your mark and own your ambition with valuable career growth opportunities.
  
  
At Linx, we know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.
  
  
The
**Channel Sales Manager – India**
is responsible for leading and expanding Linx’s channel partner network across India to accelerate distributor performance, expand market share, and drive strategic key account sales in industrial printing and identification solutions, and will be based ideally in; Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai or New Delhi
  
  
**In this role, a typical day will look like:**

* Developing and executing a robust channel partner strategy aligned with annual sales objectives, fostering win-win partnerships that increase market penetration and strengthen Linx’s brand preference in India.
* Identifying, evaluating, and onboarding new channel partners in priority markets to broaden Linx’s reach and drive growth across the region.
* Driving distributor performance through regular business reviews, monitoring key metrics (revenue, bookings, sales funnel, installed base growth, aftermarket revenue) and providing coaching, commercial rigour, and tools to elevate partner sales effectiveness.
* Leading strategic engagement with key end-user customers in collaboration with distributors – developing and managing bespoke key account plans for our Continuous Inkjet (CIJ), laser, and thermal printing solutions, and supporting field trials and demo activities to accelerate sales cycles.
* Continuously assessing market trends and competitive landscapes, leveraging customer and market insights to refine product positioning, value propositions, and pricing strategies for the India market.
* Promoting rigorous use of CRM and sales enablement tools to improve sales pipeline accuracy, forecasting, and visibility, while equipping channel partners with value-driven selling narratives that highlight Linx’s reliability, low total cost of ownership, and high uptime advantages.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Willingness to travel up to 3 days per week (approximately 8 nights away from home per month) across India in order to engage with partners and key customers.
* 7+ years of experience in channel management and industrial B2B sales, ideally in technology, manufacturing, or industrial equipment sectors.
* Proven track record of managing distributor networks and driving partner-led sales growth, demonstrated by meeting or exceeding regional sales targets.
* Demonstrated success in key account management, with the ability to influence and win strategic customer deals directly and through channel partners.
* Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Electronics Engineering (or a related technical field)
* Experience working across diverse markets in India (or similar emerging regions), with insight into local market dynamics and cultural awareness.

Linx is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment
*where purpose meets possibility*
: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.

title: Manager Engineering
description:
**Career Area**
Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
The Engineering Manager – Data Science is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing multiple pods of data scientists and machine learning engineers while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery of data science products and platforms. This role partners closely with AI product owners, AI architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure data science solutions are technically sound, scalable, and aligned to strategic outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Leadership & Talent Development
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists and ML engineers
* Set clear performance expectations and support career development
* Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture

Technical & Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Provide technical guidance across data science and ML solutions working closely with AI Architects
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards and MLOps practices
* Review model designs and deployment strategies

Delivery & Execution Management
  
  

* Own delivery execution and capacity planning
* Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
* Manage risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with AI Product Owners and business stakeholders
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly

Quality, Governance & Responsible AI
  
  

* Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance standards
* Uphold responsible AI principles

Degree Requirement
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Post Graduate or higher is desired.
  
  
Skill Descriptors
  
  
**Engineering Management**
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high‑performing technical teams delivering complex data science and machine learning solutions. Provides clear direction, sets expectations, and holds teams accountable for outcomes while supporting individual growth and engagement. Balances people leadership, technical oversight, and delivery execution in a fast‑moving environment.
  
  
**Data Science & Machine Learning**
Strong working knowledge of data science, machine learning, GenAI and statistical modeling concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation. Able to guide and review technical approaches, challenge assumptions, and ensure solutions are fit for purpose without requiring hands‑on model development as a primary responsibility.
  
  
**Delivery & Execution**
Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute work in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Manages team capacity, dependencies, and risks to ensure predictable delivery of high‑quality outcomes. Uses data and metrics to assess progress, identify issues early, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Communication & Collaboration**
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. Builds strong partnerships with product owners, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to align expectations, manage trade‑offs, and deliver value.
  
  
Software Development Life Cycle
  
  
Demonstrated knowledge of software and data science development life cycles, including experimentation, prototyping, production deployment, and ongoing operations. Understands the differences between research‑oriented work and production‑grade solutions and guides teams accordingly.
  
  

* Works within formal delivery and governance methodologies
* Understands phases, activities, dependencies, and key decision points across the life cycle
* Identifies common risks and quality considerations at each stage
* Interprets and guides technical documentation, design artifacts, and delivery plans

Artificial Intelligence
  
  
Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, GenAI and machine learning concepts, risks, and opportunities, with the ability to guide teams toward solutions that deliver business outcomes responsibly.
  
  

* Understands AI methodologies, capabilities, and limitations
* Guides teams in applying responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, robustness, and governance
* Keeps informed of emerging AI technologies and evaluates their applicability to business needs
* Supports the adoption of AI practices that balance innovation with risk management

Programming & Technical Literacy
  
  
Strong technical literacy across programming and data science tools sufficient to effectively review code, designs, and technical approaches.
  
  

* Able to assess code quality, maintainability, and architectural alignment
* Collaborates effectively with hands‑on engineers and data scientists
* Understands testing, version control, and deployment concepts
* Hands‑on coding is not a primary responsibility, but technical depth is sufficient to guide and challenge solutions

Technical Troubleshooting
  
  
Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical and operational issues across data, models, and production systems.
  
  

* Guides investigation and resolution of data, model, and system issues
* Reviews logs, metrics, and system behavior to support root cause analysis
* Partners with platform and operations teams to resolve production incidents
* Ensures issues are documented, learnings are captured, and preventative actions are implemented

Note
  
  
This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties, and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. It is expressly not intended to be a comprehensive list of “essential job functions” as that term is defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 16, 2026 - October 29, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

* Improve OEE, capacity utilisation, throughput, labour productivity, yields and equipment reliability while reducing conversion cost, wastage, rework and downtime.
* Deliver production plans aligned with sales forecast demand, customer service levels and inventory norms.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement frameworks to minimize operational bottlenecks and reduce cycle times.

title: Head - Plant Engineering
description:
**Job Purpose**
Responsible for the strategic and operational management of plant infrastructure, utilities, and equipment across the organization. The role focuses on maintenance, layout optimization, facility creation, energy efficiency, and sustainability initiatives. The role is key to supporting business continuity and long-term infrastructure planning aligned with operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities/ Accountabilities**
**Equipment & Maintenance Management**

* Effective management of Machineries and Equipment by way of proper scheduling, planning on preventive, predictive maintenance techniques, modernization of equipment, adopting TPM practices in order to improve the uptime of the equipment to meet the business objectives
* Monitor maintenance expenses and control the budget for maintenance

**Infrastructure management**

* Effective up-keeping of utility planning and executing layout changes in order to effectively utilize the facilities
* Responsible for planning, execution and establishment of infrastructure requirements/facilities creation in line with business requirements
* Planning of Capex and execution on facilities to Plant/business requirement/EHS/Statutory compliance

**Sustainability management**

* Organize, identify and initiate various energy resource conservation activities, conduct energy audits, propose cost-benefit analysis, promote renewable energy for a sustainable future
* Reduce carbon footprint by initiating reduction programs
* Responsible for Corporate Driven EHS Sustainability Targets and sustainability reporting

**People Development & Networking**

* Motivate the team for personal and professional development
* Network internally and externally

**Compliance & MIS**

* Collaborate with statutory and regulatory bodies in order to comply with legal requirements
* Ensure that the periodic reports for MIS are generated - weekly, monthly and inputs for the review meetings are provided on time every time

title: Assistant Vice President , Financial Accounting
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others**
.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Assistant Vice President , Financial Accounting.**
**Purpose of the role**
The role holder will be responsible for Managing complex accounting events such as manual journals, which are key to the ledger close, provide robust accounting and business insight into Trial Balance analysis, substantiation, exception management and book closure. Managing monthly and quarterly IFRS/FINREP/GSIB/Regulatory and MI Reporting and manual returns for legal entity. Extensive involvement with all stakeholders. Engagement in process improvement and automation initiatives.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Process Leader for one of the Financial Accounting work streams for the region and all legal entities within that. SME in the area of financial control & accounting and have an end to end knowledge in closure of books per IFRS. Extensive exposure in various aspects of Site Reporting (IFRS/FINREP/GSIB/Regulatory/ MI Reporting and Manual return) and have the ability to move to a hands-on approach.
* Experienced in analytical review. Coordinate with the regional finance teams for preparation of accounts, timely closure of GL, completion of Site Reporting. Operate within tight deadline for production and reporting activities; at the same time not to compromise on accuracy
* Establish and run a strong quality control framework for outputs and activities. Drive governance on exceptions. Seek inputs from various stakeholders. Lead new projects/assignments/process: Identify, Drive, Build & operate it as BAU and implement new technologies and drive process automation/ standardization.
* Connect with other departments for end to end and satisfactory service delivery. Deliver process improvement / efficiency. Partner with change management to support continuing process re-engineering initiatives.
* Drive performance to agreed service levels and manage In-Country teams’ expectations in a timely and professional manner. Establish and maintain effective relationship with business areas and identify areas of service improvements by implementing regular calls and feedback mechanism
* Operational capability must be maintained all year round given the frequency of reporting periods (monthly plus additional requirements quarterly, half-yearly and annually). Manage / Support In-Country relationship effectively.
* Maintain defined operations Risk framework. Adherence to Group policies, IFRS reporting requirements, audit, controls and compliance requirements. This also includes and is not limited to Declaration of secrecy, data protection act, health, safety and security, clear desk policy. Ensure BC plan is documented, agreed with In-Country team and tested for all the processes as agreed.
* Responsible for timely update and maintenance of RCAs, BIAs, PLAs and ensuring all other documents like the SOPs are in place and updated. Robust back up planning for uninterrupted service delivery.
* Effective communication with Team on decided Organization changes and goals. Achieve efficiency in operations and maintain work-life balance. Effectively drive change and achieve cross-training. Drive and maintain performance in team to required standards.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* CA/CPA/ACCA/MBA/ICWAI with strong Financial Control and Stakeholder Management skills and strong background of IFRS norms are preferred. Overall post qualification experience of not less than 8-10 years for CA, MBA: 9-11 yrs
* Prior experience in month end closure processes and Site Reporting is required
* Strong knowledge of month end closure & Reporting processes at Financial Institutions will be preferred
* Proven track record of role in controllership in BFSI sector and sound knowledge of financial products and businesses such as Commercial Banking and Global Banking etc.
* Experience in managing mid-size teams in specialized functions. Working knowledge of FTP/HUB/Fusion etc.
* Experience that demonstrates ability to deliver BAU and Change/ Transformation Projects
* Experience in policy interpretation and implementation. Experience of working with processes involving US GAAP / HIGAAP/ IFRS understanding
* Understanding of Global markets, products, securities etc.

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**
**www.hsbc.com/careers**
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

title: Assistant Facilities Manager
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Designation:** Assistant Facilities Manager
  
**Job Location:** Guindy or Pallikaranai, Chennai
  
  
**Educational Qualification:** Graduation Mandatory
  
**Experience Required:** 5-6 years Minimum
  
**Work Schedule:** 6 Days/week
  
  
**Specific Skills:** Non-technical soft services manager with strong skills in presentation development, data analysis, and Excel proficiency.
  
  
What's this job involves
  
  
POSITION GOALS
  
To provide administrative support to the Facilities Management team at Client, Hyderabad.
  
To ensure timely and accurate completion FM reports pertaining to Client, Hyderabad.
  
DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
**Be accessible for escalation of all FM related issues:**  
Oversee the Helpdesk work process
  
Provide management advice to Helpdesk operators for escalated issues
  
Ensure planning and execution of all preparation required for Conferences / meetings of the client as well as VIP visits scheduled during the shift
  
Oversee the Reception.
  
Oversee the Front Office function
  
Ensure visitors are promptly attended by the Front Office Executives (FOE)
  
Take rounds of the front office and lobby to ensure high standards of housekeeping and upkeep are maintained
  
Oversee the Housekeeping Services
  
Overall service delivery assessment of HK vendor.
  
Coordination meetings with vendor for resolution of service issues
  
Evaluate vendor performance
  
Ensure that vendor manpower reports at site as per agreed terms and conditions.
  
Undertake audit of the attendance and check their grooming.
  
Oversee Cafeteria Services
  
Ensure that the caterers are maintaining highest standards of hygiene in the services area
  
Ensure that the quality and quantity of the food supplies are meeting the requirements
  
When the food supplies run out, escalate the matter to the caterers’ management immediately and make swift alternate arrangements. In such a scenario communicate with the users and provide alternate solutions and appease them
  
Overall coordination with all service providing vendors.
  
Take rounds of the facility regularly to identify issues in Housekeeping, Maintenance, Cafeteria etc and initiate immediate rectification actions
  
Prepare weekly shift rosters for Helpdesk, Front Desk and Mailroom and communicate in advance to the staff and transport division
  
EMPLOYEE SPECIFICATIONS
  
Graduate in any discipline
  
5 – 6 years experience in facilities management
  
Tertiary qualifications in hotel management / building management and/or business desirable.
  
Excellent communication skills and ability to converse in English.
  
Proven ability to function effectively as part of a team
  
Proven ability to initiate and follow through with improvement initiatives
  
  
KEY PERFORMANCE MEASURES
  
Overall client satisfaction by achieving SLA targets
  
Timely resolution of helpdesk complaints
  
Effective team coordination of direct and vendor staff for efficient service delivery
  
  
**What we can do for you:**  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Content Production Manager
description:
**About the role**

As a Content Platform Subject Matter Expert, you will make an impact by providing deep specialist product knowledge across enterprise content technologies — including CMS, DXP, headless content, DAM, content supply chain, PIM and content migration — to support client consulting, solutioning, offering development and delivery assurance. You will be a valued member of the Cognizant Moment - Go To Market team and work collaboratively with the Enterprise Multi-Solution Architect, delivery teams and practitioners, and clients.

**In this role, you will**

* Maintain deep knowledge of your primary content platform — architecture, services, APIs, extensibility, deployment, security and operations — and translate editorial, publishing, asset and product-content needs into practical platform capabilities and implementation patterns.
* Define content models, taxonomy, metadata, workflow, governance and lifecycle patterns, and design multisite, multibrand, multilingual, authoring, publishing, search, SEO and accessibility approaches along with DAM, PIM, creative tooling and channel integrations.
* Lead platform-specific inventory, dependency, migration and modernisation assessments, defining extraction, transformation, loading, validation, reconciliation, redirect and cutover approaches with realistic estimates, assumptions and risks.
* Act as the assigned platform SME across consulting, solutioning, architecture and delivery advisory, partnering with the Enterprise Multi-Solution Architect while owning platform feasibility, patterns, estimates and implementation guidance, and contributing to RFIs, RFPs, proposals, demonstrations and proofs of concept.
* Create reusable reference architectures, playbooks, assessment frameworks and accelerators, guide delivery teams on complex configuration and migration decisions, and identify practical generative AI and agentic opportunities with appropriate security, privacy, governance and human oversight.

**Work model**

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore or Chennai. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

**What you must have to be considered**

* 10-15 years of overall experience in content management, digital experience or content operations.
* At least 5 years of deep experience in a nominated enterprise content platform or product family.
* Experience in enterprise implementation, migration or modernisation as an SME, Technical Architect or Technical Lead.
* Strong understanding of content architecture, APIs, integrations, governance, performance and security.
* Experience supporting client workshops, proposals, estimates, demonstrations and technical presentations, plus working knowledge of at least one adjacent or competing content platform.

**These will help you succeed**

* Hands-on specialisation in enterprise CMS/DXP platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Optimizely or Acquia/Drupal, or in headless and composable CMS such as Contentful, Contentstack or Sanity.
* Experience with Digital Asset Management platforms such as AEM Assets, Sitecore Content Hub, Aprimo or Bynder, including asset lifecycle, metadata, rights and renditions.
* Experience with content supply chain platforms such as Adobe Workfront, Workfront Fusion or GenStudio across planning, intake, creation, review, approval and activation.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted migration and classification tooling for inventory, mapping, transformation and quality assurance.
* Ability to connect product capabilities with editorial and business outcomes, mentor practitioners, and contribute reusable offerings without claiming ownership of the overall multi-solution architecture.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Finance Manager, Operations and Global Functions
description:
**Finance Manager, Operations and Global Functions**

**Do you enjoy using financial insight to shape decisions and improve business performance?**

  

**Do you enjoy partnering with senior stakeholders across global functions to turn financial insights into sound business decisions?**

**About our Team**

This role is part of the Elsevier Business Decision Support (BDS) team and reports to the Finance Director, Operations and Global Functions. The BDS team serves as a strategic and financial partner to business leadership, enabling better decision-making and driving improved financial performance by translating financial and operational data into forward-looking insights, constructive challenge and actionable recommendations.

  

**About the Role**

As our Finance Manager – Operations & Global Functions, you’ll be a trusted finance partner to senior leaders, helping them manage costs, make sound financial decisions, and shape and deliver their longer-term plans.

  

You’ll support Operations and Global Functions leadership across areas including HR, Strategy, Global Communications and Marketing. You’ll lead budgeting, forecasting and performance analysis for operating expenses and direct costs, turning financial information into clear recommendations and practical actions.

  

As our business moves from traditional workflows towards agentic AI-enabled ways of working, you’ll help leaders understand the financial impact of that change. You’ll model the opportunities, reflect them in forecasts, and monitor outcomes so the business can make informed decisions and adjust course when needed.

  

This hands-on role is suited to an experienced finance professional with strong business acumen, a solid understanding of operational cost drivers and direct-cost management, and the ability to independently partner with and influence senior stakeholders in an international environment.

  

**Responsibilities**

  

* **Act as a trusted finance partner** to senior leaders across Operations and Global Functions, developing a deep understanding of business priorities, operational processes and underlying cost drivers to support effective decision-making.

* **Take end-to-end ownership of financial planning and performance** for assigned areas, including budgeting, rolling forecasts and long-term planning, ensuring robust assumptions, reliable financial outlooks and clear accountability for risks and opportunities.

* **Translate financial and operational data into actionable insights** , explaining performance drivers, anticipating developments, identifying risks and opportunities, and proactively recommending actions to improve financial outcomes.

* **Provide independent financial challenge and decision support** , evaluating alternatives, developing business cases and scenarios, and influencing strategic and operational decisions through sound financial judgement.

* **Drive direct-cost transparency and productivity improvements** , developing a thorough understanding of cost structures, operational volumes, unit economics and efficiency drivers to identify, quantify and monitor opportunities for sustainable cost improvement.

* **Support business transformation and AI-enabled workflows** , modelling the financial impact of operational and technology changes, incorporating agreed initiatives into financial plans and monitoring the delivery of expected benefits.

* **Ensure high standards of financial integrity and control** , including accurate reporting, robust forecasting, appropriate accruals, effective cost governance and timely resolution of financial issues.

* **Proactively lead the financial agenda across assigned areas** , engaging stakeholders, challenging assumptions, communicating clear financial narratives and driving agreed actions through to completion.

  
  
  

**Requirements**

* A postgraduate qualification in Finance, Business, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Professional qualifications such as CA, CMA or MBA (Finance) are valued.

* At least five years of relevant experience in finance business partnering, FP&A, performance consulting or financial advisory, preferably within an international corporate environment, with a proven track record of independently supporting senior stakeholders and owning financial planning for a significant business scope.

* Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial performance analysis, management reporting and cost management, including direct costs.

* A proactive, self-driven approach, with demonstrated ability to take end-to-end ownership of complex financial responsibilities, anticipate issues, identify opportunities and deliver results independently.

* Proven ability to understand complex operational processes and cost structures, identify the underlying drivers of financial performance and translate business developments into actionable financial insights and recommendations.

* Experience in scenario planning, investment appraisal, business case development and financial modelling, ideally supporting business transformation or technology-driven initiatives.

* Strong commercial acumen, sound financial judgement and a solid understanding of accounting principles, financial governance and controls, with the confidence to constructively challenge and influence senior stakeholders.

* Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial planning, reporting and analytical tools. Familiarity with SAP, Oracle, Hyperion, Anaplan or Power BI is an advantage.

* Excellent communication, analytical and organisational skills, with fluency in written and spoken English and the ability to manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across functions, geographies and time zones.

  

**Work in a way that works for you**

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

* Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

  

**Working for you**

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.

* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.

* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.

* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.

* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance.

* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges.

* Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority.

* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.

* Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.

* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.

* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.

* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.

* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home -office - home (applies in Chennai)

  

**About the Business**

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

  

**We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click** **here** **to access benefits specific to your location.**

We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1-855-833-5120.

**Criminals may pose as recruiters asking for money or personal information. We never request money or banking details from job applicants. Learn more about spotting and avoiding scams** **here** **.**

Please read our Candidate Privacy Policy .

We are an equal opportunity employer: qualified applicants are considered for and treated during employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, protected veteran status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: WFM Manager, LMAQ
description:
**Description**
Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate’s route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Drive end-to-end workforce management for the entire LMAQ space, designing and delivering short- and long-term labor planning strategies across all lines of business
* Own forecasting, planning, and execution to ensure operational performance meets or exceeds targets

* Manage headcount planning across the space, ensuring key programs and business needs are driven without impacting SLA, sustaining operational performance with the least churn for managers
* Ability to partner with multiple teams and build strong stakeholder relationships to drive HC planning for the LMAQ space
* Manage the VCC vs. B&M mix across sites, ensuring compliance, driving seating planning across sites, and driving key operational metrics like cross-site reporting, etc.
* Build a data-driven culture by championing automated solutions to drive LMAQ HC planning at a regular cadence with minimal effort
* Own end-to-end delivery of multiple projects focused on performance optimization and cost efficiency
* Guide the design, development, and maintenance of metrics, reports, analyses, and dashboards that inform key business decisions
* Work through and influence WFM leads and analysts across each space without direct authority, aligning them to a common planning and execution standard
* Demonstrate a strong eye for detail, uncovering trends, going beyond the obvious, and identifying root causes
* Thrive in ambiguous environments and proactively take on new challenges
* Influence hiring quality by raising the bar on interviewing standards across the organization

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 7+ years of operational and/or retail management experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**
