title: Facility Manager
description:
**Company Description**

At Vroutes HR, we focus on creating coaction capabilities and empowering employers with the most precious asset-people. With a combination of innovative technology and personal touch, we have enabled marketing and advertising firms to achieve their vision. Founded in the year 2017 Vroutes HR have been striving hard to help agencies across India structure their human resources and achieve their short and long-term goals. We are lean and agile in adapting to the dynamic changes in modernized methods of HR functioning. From Staffing and Recruitment, Performance management, Training and Development, Employee Engagement, Compliance management, Payroll management, Grievances Handling, HR Strategy services and HR Audits we are a one stop solution for complete HR Solutions.

 **Job Description**

**1. Infrastructure and Property Maintenance**

* **Oversee the maintenance of all common areas, internal roads, pathways, drainage systems, streetlights, and community infrastructure.**
* **Ensure the proper functioning and upkeep of electrical systems, plumbing, water supply, pumps, DG sets, STP/WTP, and other utility installations, as applicable.**
* **Monitor the condition of buildings, amenities, equipment, and infrastructure to identify and resolve maintenance issues proactively.**
* **Plan and execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities.**
* **Coordinate repairs, renovations, and infrastructure improvement projects.**
* **Maintain maintenance schedules, equipment records, service logs, and technical documentation.**

**2. Facility and Common Area Management**

* **Ensure the upkeep of landscaped areas, gardens, parks, clubhouses, swimming pools, gymnasiums, and other community amenities, as applicable.**
* **Monitor housekeeping, waste management, pest control, sanitation, and overall cleanliness.**
* **Ensure common facilities are maintained to premium residential community standards.**
* **Conduct regular inspections and ensure timely closure of identified maintenance issues.**
* **Coordinate with security teams to ensure smooth day-to-day community operations and appropriate access control.**

**3. Manpower and Staff Management**

* **Manage and supervise housekeeping staff, technicians, electricians, plumbers, gardeners, security personnel, and other outsourced or in-house facility staff.**
* **Allocate duties, prepare duty rosters, monitor attendance, and ensure adequate manpower availability.**
* **Monitor staff performance, productivity, discipline, grooming, and service quality.**
* **Ensure staff follow established operating procedures, safety guidelines, and service standards.**
* **Address operational issues and coordinate training wherever required.**

**4. Vendor and Contractor Management**

* **Coordinate with external vendors, contractors, and service providers for maintenance, repairs, and facility services.**
* **Monitor vendor performance, service quality, timelines, and contractual commitments.**
* **Verify completed work and ensure adherence to agreed specifications.**
* **Maintain vendor records, service agreements, warranties, and annual maintenance contracts (AMCs).**
* **Identify opportunities to improve service quality and optimise maintenance costs.**

**5. Budgeting and Cost Control**

* **Prepare and monitor facility maintenance budgets and operational expenses.**
* **Track expenditure on repairs, utilities, consumables, manpower, and vendor services.**
* **Control unnecessary costs without compromising safety or service quality.**
* **Maintain records of purchase requests, invoices, quotations, and maintenance expenses.**
* **Recommend cost-effective solutions for recurring maintenance issues and infrastructure improvements.**

**6. Safety, Compliance and Emergency Management**

* **Ensure compliance with applicable safety requirements and relevant statutory obligations for facility operations.**
* **Monitor fire safety systems, emergency exits, firefighting equipment, and emergency response arrangements.**
* **Coordinate periodic inspections, equipment testing, and emergency preparedness drills.**
* **Ensure safe working practices for employees, contractors, and service providers.**
* **Respond to emergencies such as power failures, water supply disruptions, equipment breakdowns, flooding, and other facility-related incidents.**
* **Maintain incident reports and implement corrective and preventive actions.**

**7. Resident Coordination and Service Delivery**

* **Act as the primary point of contact for facility-related concerns raised by residents, the association, or community management.**
* **Ensure complaints and service requests are recorded, prioritised, and resolved within defined timelines.**
* **Communicate maintenance schedules, planned service disruptions, and important operational updates.**
* **Maintain a professional and service-oriented approach while dealing with residents.**
* **Work closely with the Resident Welfare Association (RWA), Homeowners Association, or community management committee, as applicable.**

**8. Reporting and Documentation**

* **Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly facility operations reports.**
* **Track maintenance requests, complaint closure rates, preventive maintenance completion, and recurring issues.**
* **Maintain records of assets, equipment, maintenance schedules, vendor contracts, and utility consumption.**
* **Provide regular updates to management on facility performance, expenses, risks, and improvement initiatives.**

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* **B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.**
* **5–8 years of relevant experience in facility management, property maintenance, residential communities, hotels, commercial buildings, or integrated facilities management.**
* **Experience managing technical infrastructure, utilities, maintenance activities, and service staff.**
* **Strong knowledge of preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, vendor coordination, and facility operations.**
* **Experience handling housekeeping, landscaping, security coordination, and other outsourced services.**
* **Good manpower management, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.**
* **Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to emergencies.**
* **Proficiency in MS Excel, email, reporting, and maintenance tracking systems.**

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* **Experience managing premium residential communities, gated villa projects, luxury apartments, or large residential townships.**
* **Practical knowledge of electrical, plumbing, civil maintenance, water treatment systems, sewage treatment plants, DG sets, and other building utilities.**
* **Experience managing multiple vendors and a sizeable facility workforce.**
* **Strong ownership, accountability, and a hands-on approach to resolving operational issues.**
* **Resident-focused mindset with the ability to maintain high service standards.**

 **Qualifications**

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Timely completion of preventive and corrective maintenance.**
* **Reduction in recurring breakdowns and infrastructure complaints.**
* **Resident satisfaction and timely resolution of service requests.**
* **Cleanliness and upkeep of common areas and amenities.**
* **Vendor performance and service quality.**
* **Maintenance cost control and budget adherence.**
* **Staff productivity, attendance, and discipline.**
* **Safety compliance and emergency response effectiveness.**

 **Additional Information**

**We are looking for an experienced and proactive Facility Manager to oversee the overall maintenance, infrastructure, facilities, and day-to-day operations of a premium gated villa community.**

**The individual will be responsible for maintaining the community's infrastructure, common areas, utilities, landscaping, security coordination, housekeeping, and other essential services. The role involves managing facility staff, contractors, and service providers while ensuring high standards of maintenance, safety, cleanliness, and resident satisfaction.**

**The ideal candidate should have an engineering background, strong technical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage manpower, budgets, vendors, and day-to-day facility operations efficiently.**

title: Assistant Plant Manager
description:
**Company Description:**
Bhavi Plast Pvt Ltd is a long-established manufacturer of corrosion-resistant equipment for process plants across India and abroad. The company designs, builds, and commissions wet scrubbing systems, dust collection systems, high-efficiency blowers, and emission control ducting under a single accountable contract. It also provides FRP and dual-laminate chemical storage tanks, reactors, pressure vessels, and process tanks engineered to international standards and tested in-house at its plant in Mankoli, Bhiwandi. Registered and vetted by major engineering consultants, Bhavi Plast’s equipment operates in plants across India and in more than ten countries. The team frequently customizes solutions based on client process data, offering sized proposals and performance curves for specialized duties.

**Role Description:**
We are looking for an Assistant Manager – Plant Operations to run the Mankoli plant day to day and take ownership of what leaves it. You will be accountable for production, quality, maintenance, inventory, dispatch, safety and manpower: delivering every order on time, to specification and within cost. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is comfortable on the shop floor, reads drawings with confidence, and can hold a team to a standard without needing

constant direction from management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Plan and execute daily and weekly production schedules, allocating manpower, machines and materials across multiple concurrent jobs

- Track progress against delivery commitments, flag delays early and recover schedules proactively

- Supervise fabrication and assembly as per approved drawings, specifications and codes

- Ensure in-process and final inspection at every stage, and coordinate customer and third-party inspections

- Lead and train supervisors, fabricators, fitters, welders and contract workers, with clear accountability and discipline

- Ensure preventive maintenance of machinery, and monitor machine utilisation and OEE to reduce downtime

- Oversee inventory, stores, packing and dispatch, with accurate records and correct documentation

- Enforce safety protocols, PPE use, 5S and housekeeping, and ensure compliance with ISO and statutory requirements

- Control plant costs (material usage, scrap, overtime, idle time) and identify and plug leakages

- Drive lean manufacturing and process improvements to raise productivity and cut lead times

- Coordinate with Design, Planning, Purchase, Sales, Projects and Accounts, and support installation and commissioning teams with materials and site queries

- Track and report key metrics (OEE, on-time delivery, rework and rejection rates, productivity) and prepare production MIS for management

**Qualifications:**

**Must-have**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical or Production Engineering
* 10–15 years of experience in engineering or manufacturing, with at least 3–5 years in a similar Assistant Manager / Plant Operations / Production Head role
* Strong knowledge of fabrication and assembly processes, and the ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
* Working familiarity with ERP systems and with ISO and health & safety standards
* Proven experience leading and managing shop-floor teams

**Preferred**

* Experience in fabrication of process equipment, such as tanks, vessels, ducting, scrubbers or similar custom-engineered products
* Exposure to project-based or make-to-order manufacturing, where every order differs
* Experience with lean tools, 5S and structured problem-solving
* Experience coordinating customer inspections and client site support

**Attributes we care about most:**

- High ownership: treats the plant's output, quality and safety as their personal responsibility

- Ability to work independently: doesn't need constant direction, and can be handed a problem and trusted to solve it end to end

- Strong leadership and discipline: earns respect on the shop floor and sets and holds a standard

- Decisive under pressure: takes timely decisions when deadlines tighten or priorities clash

- Proactive, not reactive: spots delays, quality risks and cost leaks before they become problems

- Clear communicator: able to coordinate with Design, Purchase, Sales and management, and explain plant constraints plainly

- Integrity and trustworthiness: handles materials, costs and people matters honestly in a closely run, family-owned business

- Hands-on and process-minded: comfortable on the floor and equally comfortable with plans, data and MIS.

**What We Oﬀer:**

-The opportunity to lead a growing plant making critical, custom-engineered equipment

-Direct visibility to the management and real authority over plant decisions

-Varied, technically meaningful work across industries, with a team that has built this business since 1977

-A stable, collaborative work culture, and scope to introduce better systems and practices

-The chance to contribute to cleaner air and safer industrial operations

**Work Schedule:**

Day shift: 9:15 AM to 6:30 PM

Monday to Saturday

Occasional extended hours during project deadlines

title: Operations Manager - Training & Development
description:
**T&D Operations Manager**

* **The Opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo isn’t just India’s largest tattoo brand - we’re building the world’s most admired tattoo company.

Our studio network and specialist tattoo school depend on reliable training operations to develop artists at scale.

We’re looking for an Operations Manager for Aliens Tattoo School who can run multiple course, batches, evaluations, student milestones, and facility needs into one dependable operating rhythm.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing order to moving parts, protecting the learner experience, and making performance visible.

You will work across Training and Development, Course Delivery, Course Development, mentors, School Sales, Admin and HR

If you take ownership, notice gaps before they become disruptions, and build processes people can actually follow, we’d love to meet you.

* **The Mandate**

Your mission is simple:

As T&D Operations Manager, you are entrusted with making every training day ready to run - with the right mentor, room, schedule, evaluation, student record, equipment, and stock in place.

You will run the batch calendar, monthly timetable, rosters, room plan and evaluations. You will own onboarding, operational records, certificates, concern tracking, feedback cycles, and Aliens Home referrals.

You will keep every learning space safe, clean, functional, and audit-ready; maintain stock; prevent shortages; control operating spend; and track repairs to closure.

You will build practical SOPs, current policies, disciplined trackers, and a monthly MIS covering course progress, attendance, student experience, and performance data.

* **What you’ll be doing**

You will publish the master calendar and monthly timetable, assign rooms and trained mentors, schedule evaluations, plan mentor studio hours and L&D Artist bookings, and ensure every class and shoot proceeds without an operations-led delay.

You will manage the student lifecycle from joining to completion: finish onboarding before day one, maintain records, flag fee status at defined milestones, issue certificates on time, offer Aliens Home to students who need accommodation, and record every choice.

You will log and own student concerns until closure, route teaching matters to Course Delivery, run feedback forms at fixed points, and report NPS, CSAT, attendance, progress, and dropout visibility. You will audit hygiene and facilities on schedule, maintain biomedical-waste records, track repairs, count stock, prevent session shortages, control operating spend, maintain the SOP and policy library, and publish a complete monthly T&D report with every variance explained.

* **What we’re looking for**

We are looking for a disciplined operator with experience in training, education, academy, studio, or multi-schedule operations. You should be comfortable coordinating several batches, people, rooms, evaluations, shoots, and deadlines at the same time without losing attention to detail.

You can build practical schedules and trackers, work confidently in Excel, manage stock and spend, write SOPs and policies in clear language, and turn raw operational data into useful monthly reports.

You remain calm with upset students or parents, communicate clearly across functions, follow issues through to closure, and escalate early when ownership sits elsewhere.

Most importantly, you act like an owner: you protect safety, learner experience, and operational continuity, and you do not wait for preventable problems to become emergencies.

* **What success looks like**

Success in this role is measured by reliable execution. You’ll know you’re succeeding when. Training operations - Classes run as scheduled, evaluations are completed within the agreed turnaround, mentor studio hours are delivered, and calendars and timetables are published on time.

Student lifecycle - Students are fully onboarded before day one, records stay current, certificates are issued within the set time, concerns close on time, student retention is on point, no dropouts, feedback cycles run consistently, and Aliens Home is offered and tracked for every eligible student.

Facilities and inventory - Every space is audited on rhythm, hygiene and facility audits pass first time, repairs close within the agreed timeline, biomedical-waste records remain current, no session is delayed by missing stock, and operating spend stays within budget.

Systems and reporting - The SOP library reaches full coverage, policies stay approved and current, and a live monthly MIS is published on time with every variance explained.

Safety - Zero hygiene-related safety incidents and no hygiene breach remains open beyond the same day.

title: Team Lead, ADM Ops
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.
  
  
As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the
**PFLT Data Operations Team Lead**
is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the team on complex Schedule of Investments (SOI) processing, special asset classes (e.g., crypto/token assets, real estate), and intricate fund accounting mechanics (e.g., PQ reconciliation, derived metric calculations, corporate actions).
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex extraction errors across pipeline stages and front-end verification checks.
* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

**Job Opportunity: Operations Manager**

**Position:** Operations Manager (Work from Office, Permanent)

**Location:** Pune

**Office Location:** Enlight Metals, 606, Clover Hills Plaza, NIBM Road, Pune 411048

**Reporting To:** Senior Leadership

**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday

**Experience:** 6+ years

**Directions:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/pNgNzn14iMGNpzYKA

**About Enlight Metals**

Enlight Metals Pvt. Ltd. is a fast-growing B2B metals aggregator transforming how businesses procure steel and metal products across India. We partner with leading manufacturers such as Tata Steel and JSW Steel to supply OEMs, manufacturers, infrastructure companies, and industrial customers.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Operations Manager to own the order-to-delivery cycle, from mill coordination and logistics to dispatch and inventory, and to lead the team that delivers every order on time, at the right quality and cost.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Order Fulfilment & Supply Chain**

* Coordinate order execution with mills, suppliers, and customers.

* Track order status, dispatch schedules, and delivery timelines.

* Resolve delays, shortages, and escalations quickly.

**2. Logistics & Warehousing**

* Manage transporters, freight rates, and vehicle planning.

* Oversee warehouse and stock operations with accurate inventory tracking.

* Reduce transit losses, damages, and detention costs.

**3. Quality, Compliance & Documentation**

* Verify material quality and test certificates; handle complaints and claims.

* Ensure GST, e-way bill, and invoicing compliance.

* Maintain accurate dispatch and delivery records.

**4. Process Improvement & Cost Control**

* Design and improve SOPs and drive ERP adoption.

* Identify savings in freight, handling, and inventory.

* Coordinate with sales, finance, and procurement teams.

**5. Team Leadership & Reporting**

* Lead, train, and set targets for the operations team.

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.

* Present KPIs and risks to senior leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Graduate in Engineering, Commerce, or Supply Chain; MBA preferred.

* 6+ years in operations, logistics, or supply chain, including team handling.

* Experience in steel, metals, manufacturing, or trading is preferred.

**Skills**

* ERP or order management systems (Tally, SAP, Zoho, or similar) and advanced Excel.

* Inventory and logistics planning; knowledge of GST and e-way bill.

* Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and communication skills.

* Leadership ability and a strong sense of ownership in a fast-paced office.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery rate

* Order turnaround time

* Freight cost per tonne

* Inventory accuracy and loss or damage rate

**Why Join Enlight Metals?**

* Be part of one of India's fastest-growing B2B metals companies.

* A high-growth, high-ownership culture at our Pune (NIBM) office.

* Build strong domain expertise in the metals and steel industry.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

* Provident Fund

description:
At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

==================

A Day in the Life
  
  
Our Global Diabetes Capability Center in Pune is expanding to serve more people living with diabetes globally. Our state-of-the-art facility is dedicated to transforming diabetes management through innovative solutions and Technologies that reduce the burden of living with diabetes.
  
  
This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. Medtronic has announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic, subject to applicable information and consultation requirements. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.  
  

#BetterDaysStartNow

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

  

**Facility & Infrastructure Management**

Oversee building safety, security, maintenance and emergency protocols with different service providers (including electrical, plumbing, HVAC, civil repairs, and general upkeep but limited to)

Coordinate vendor and contractor agreements for housekeeping, security, landscaping, and repairs

Handle space planning, asset tracking, and workplace hygiene/environmental standards

Monitor vendor performance and safety compliance guidelines are monitored and documented as per organization standard

Instrumenting day-to-day functions of canteen for staff and contractual accommodating cafeteria vendor for timely availability of food forr employees during the stipulated time

Strive for continuous improvement and consistency in deliverables.

  

**Innovation and Complexity:** Proposes modifications to functional operating policies and day-to-day processes.
  
Problems and issues faced are complex, difficult and undefined, and require detailed information gathering, analysis and investigation to understand the problem.

  

**Communication and Influence:** Communicates with internal and external customers and vendors regarding ongoing operations.
  
Uses information exchange, influence and active persuasion without direct exercise of command to gain cooperation of other parties.
  
May interact on issues that have externally shared objectives.

  

**Leadership and Talent Management:** Manages a team consisting of supervisors and / or experienced professionals in the Specialist career stream.
  
Leads, directs and reviews the work of a team who exercise latitude and independence in their assignments.
  
Authorizes hiring, firing, promotion and reward within own area.

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

Bachelor’s Degree is a minimum requirement for this role.

Minimum 10 -12 years of relevant experience

Proven experience in a GCC operations role, preferably in India, with experience working in highly matrixed organization.

Graduate from reputed college and Postgraduate in Business Administration (desirable)

High empathy and highly collaborative approach

Sound knowledge of GCC operations areas, regulations, and statutory requirements.

Familiarity with GCC best practices, policies, and procedures and nuances of developing local culture aligned with HQ ethics.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels of the organization.

Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

Attention to detail, confidentiality, and a commitment to accuracy.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.

description:
School Operations & Administration Manager

**Department:** School Administration & Operations  
**Reporting To:** School Management / Authorised Management Representative  
**Coordination With:** Principal & Head of the Institution

Role Purpose

To ensure the smooth, safe, efficient, and compliant functioning of the school by managing administrative operations, infrastructure, logistics, support services, and operational resources, with **direct reporting and accountability to the School Management**.

Roles and Responsibilities

* **School Administration:** Oversee daily administrative functions, office operations, records, correspondence, and documentation.
* **Infrastructure and Maintenance:** Monitor campus maintenance, classrooms, sanitation, electricity, water supply, repairs, and facility readiness.
* **Safety and Security:** Coordinate security personnel, visitor management, emergency preparedness, and applicable safety requirements.
* **Transport Management:** Supervise transport operations, vehicle documentation, routes, drivers, attendants, and applicable safety procedures.
* **Support Staff Management:** Monitor the deployment, attendance, and performance of housekeeping, security, maintenance, and other non-teaching personnel.
* **Procurement and Inventory:** Coordinate quotations, vendor management, purchases, stock registers, and asset records as per management-approved procedures.
* **Financial and Operational Control:** Maintain operational expenditure records, submit bills and supporting documents, monitor approved budgets, and obtain necessary financial authorisations.
* **Regulatory Documentation:** Track the validity and renewal of applicable operational certificates, licences, safety documents, and statutory records.
* **Human Resources Administration:** Coordinate attendance, leave records, joining formalities, and administrative documentation for non-teaching staff, as authorised.
* **Events and Examination Logistics:** Arrange infrastructure, equipment, transport, and other operational requirements for school events and examinations.
* **Reporting and Accountability:** Submit periodic reports on operations, expenditure, maintenance, staffing, safety, and pending matters directly to the School Management.
* **Coordination with the Principal:** Coordinate operational requirements affecting academic functioning and implement approved administrative decisions without interfering with the Principal's designated academic responsibilities.

Reporting and Authority

* The Manager shall **report directly to the School Management / Authorised Management Representative** and remain accountable for assigned operational responsibilities.
* All financial commitments, procurement, expenditure, and contractual decisions shall be subject to the prescribed approval and delegation of authority.
* Matters requiring academic decisions shall be referred to the Principal & Head of the Institution.
* Significant operational risks, safety concerns, compliance gaps, and pending approvals shall be escalated promptly to the Management.
* The Manager shall maintain transparent records and submit periodic operational updates as directed by the Management.

**Note:** This role is operational and administrative in nature. Statutory responsibilities shall remain with the persons or authorities designated under applicable laws and CBSE requirements.

title: VP, APAC Operations
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

**What You'll Do:**

CoreWeave's Data Center Operations organization runs the physical infrastructure behind one of the world's leading AI cloud platforms: the GPU clusters that frontier AI labs and enterprises use to train and serve their models. As CoreWeave expands into Asia-Pacific, we're building a regional operations organization from the ground up. It will own uptime, safety, and operational excellence across every CoreWeave data center in the region, and set the standard for how we run at scale outside North America and Europe.

**About the Role:**

The Vice President, Data Center Operations – APAC is the senior operations leader for CoreWeave's Asia-Pacific data center portfolio, reporting directly to the SVP of Data Center Operations. You will own day-to-day operations across [Singapore, Korea, and future APAC sites]. This is a hands-on role: you'll be present in the data centers with your teams, not directing work from a distance. You'll build the regional team, put global standards and processes in place, and hold colocation partners, contractors, and vendors accountable to CoreWeave's performance bar. You'll work closely with global Operations, Fleet Operations, Engineering, Construction, Networking, and Supply Chain, as well as with executive leadership.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own operational performance for all APAC data centers (uptime, MTTR, safety, and audit readiness) and make the region a reliable, scalable part of CoreWeave's global fleet
* Build and lead the APAC operations organization (Regional/Area Managers, Data Center Managers, and Technicians), including hiring plans, leadership bench, and on-call coverage
* Adapt global SOPs, KPIs, and tooling for APAC, so that standards are followed consistently on site across countries and are not just documented
* Manage colocation partners, contractors, and vendors directly: drive schedule and SLA performance, escalate firmly, and decide when to course-correct or exit
* Lead new-site readiness and turn-up in partnership with Construction and Deployment, taking capacity from handoff to production on time
* Navigate local labor, regulatory, safety, and compliance requirements across multiple APAC jurisdictions
* Lead the response to critical (SEV-1) incidents in the region and represent APAC operations in executive reviews and global operating cadences

**Who You Are:**

* 15+ years in data center operations or critical infrastructure, including 5+ years leading multi-site operations at Senior Director/VP scope
* Proven ownership of live, production data center operations in APAC (operating sites, not only construction or project delivery) across more than one country
* Experience at a hyperscaler, large cloud provider, or major colocation/data center operator running high-density or mission-critical environments
* Track record of building and scaling operations teams of [XX+] people across multiple sites, including hiring and developing managers
* Hands-on experience managing colocation, facilities, and contractor relationships against SLAs, including performance management and commercial escalation
* Working knowledge of APAC labor law, regulatory, and EHS requirements across multiple jurisdictions (e.g., Singapore, India, Korea, Japan, Australia)
* Based in or willing to relocate to [Singapore or India], with frequent travel across the APAC region

**Preferred:**

* Experience running GPU/HPC or AI infrastructure at high rack density, including liquid cooling
* Experience standing up a new regional operations organization or market entry for a cloud or data center operator
* Familiarity with the Korean and/or Japanese data center markets
* Exposure to global operations standardization: SOP frameworks, KPI programs, and ticketing/DCIM tooling

**Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.**

* You'd rather be on the data center floor with your team than run the region from a slide deck
* You bring structure to fast-moving environments and know when to move fast and when to slow down for rigor
* You're direct and steady with partners and vendors, and you hold the line on commitments without burning bridges
* You're energized by building something new in a region where CoreWeave is just getting started

**Why CoreWeave?**

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

* Be Curious at Your Core
* Act Like an Owner
* Empower Employees
* Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
* Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base pay and target total cash for this position range from INR 14,500,000.00 to INR 14,500,000.0. Pay is based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This position includes a discretionary bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

title: DSW Operations Manager
description:
DSW Operations Manager

Department of Student Welfare (DSW) | K. R. Mangalam University

**Job Purpose**

To manage the day-to-day administrative and operational activities of the Department of Student Welfare, ensuring efficient grievance coordination, documentation, online reputation management (ORM), event support, and communication with students, parents, faculty, and other university departments.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Student Grievance Handling

· Receive, record, categorize, and track student grievances and complaints.

· Coordinate with the concerned departments and university authorities for timely resolution.

· Maintain a grievance register, follow-up records, and status reports.

· Ensure confidentiality and professional handling of sensitive student matters.

· Escalate unresolved or urgent grievances to the Dean – Student Welfare.

2. Online Reputation Management (ORM)

· Monitor student-related feedback, reviews, and concerns across relevant online platforms and social media channels.

· Coordinate responses to student queries and complaints in consultation with the Dean and authorized university teams.

· Track recurring concerns and prepare periodic ORM reports.

· Coordinate with the Marketing, Admissions, IT, and other concerned departments for appropriate follow-up.

· Ensure that all public responses are accurate, professional, and aligned with university communication policies.

3. File and Documentation Management

· Maintain physical and digital files, registers, official correspondence, approvals, and administrative records.

· Organize student grievance records, meeting minutes, reports, circulars, and official communications.

· Maintain systematic documentation for audits, accreditation, and institutional reporting.

· Ensure timely retrieval, secure storage, and confidentiality of official records.

· Track pending approvals, action items, and deadlines.

4. Event Photography and Media Coordination

· Coordinate event photo shoots, videography, and media coverage for DSW activities.

· Prepare photography and videography schedules in coordination with the concerned teams.

· Coordinate with photographers, videographers, student volunteers, and university media teams.

· Ensure timely collection, proper naming, cataloguing, and archiving of event photographs and videos.

· Maintain media records for reports, social media, newsletters, and accreditation documentation.

5. Administrative and Operational Activities

· Manage official emails, meeting schedules, correspondence, and follow-ups.

· Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas and minutes, and track action points.

· Assist in preparing budgets, expenditure statements, purchase requests, and approval notes.

· Coordinate logistics, transport, venue bookings, permissions, and resource requirements for DSW events.

· Maintain staff attendance and task trackers, where assigned.

· Coordinate with HR, Finance, Procurement, Security, Housekeeping, Transport, IT, and other university departments.

· Support the Dean in preparing presentations, reports, notices, and official communications.

6. Reporting and Compliance

· Prepare monthly operational reports and maintain activity-wise documentation.

· Maintain evidence and records required for NAAC and other institutional reporting.

· Track compliance with approved procedures, timelines, and administrative instructions.

· Perform additional responsibilities assigned by the Dean – Student Welfare.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

· Graduate degree in any relevant discipline; postgraduate qualification preferred.

· Relevant experience in university administration, student affairs, operations, or office management preferred.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, email, and digital documentation.

· Good coordination, record-management, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.

· Ability to handle confidential information and multiple assignments.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

· Timely grievance registration, escalation, and follow-up.

· Accuracy and completeness of files and records.

· Timeliness of ORM monitoring and reporting.

· Availability and organization of event photographs and media assets.

· Timely submission of reports and completion of administrative tasks.

· Adherence to deadlines and quality of interdepartmental coordination.

Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced
**KYC Depository Participant (DP) professional**
with 9–11 years of relevant experience, primarily in Depository Participant operations. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in demat account opening and maintenance, CDSL/NSDL operations, KYC verification, regulatory compliance, and end-to-end DP processes.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for ensuring seamless DP operations, maintaining regulatory compliance, managing operational risks, and coordinating with depositories, exchanges, internal teams, and clients.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Depository Participant (DP) Operations — Primary Responsibility
* Manage end-to-end DP operations, including demat account opening, activation, modification, closure, and maintenance.
* Handle CDSL/NSDL-related activities, processes, portals, and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee dematerialisation, rematerialisation, off-market transfers, inter-depository transfers, and other securities-related transactions.
* Manage DIS processing, e-DIS, DDPI, and related authorisations, wherever applicable.
* Handle pledge creation, invocation, closure, and release, along with securities transfer and settlement-related activities.
* Ensure timely processing of client requests, transaction instructions, and service requests within prescribed turnaround times.
* Reconcile DP records and resolve discrepancies related to client holdings, transactions, and depository records.
* Coordinate with CDSL/NSDL, clearing corporations, exchanges, and other relevant stakeholders for operational matters.
* Maintain DP records, documentation, registers, and audit trails in accordance with applicable regulations.
* KYC Client Onboarding
* Oversee KYC verification and client onboarding in accordance with applicable SEBI, KRA, CKYC, and PMLA requirements.
* Ensure appropriate verification of PAN, identity, address, bank details, and other prescribed documents.
* Manage KYC modifications, rejections, discrepancies, remediation, and periodic updation wherever applicable.
* Ensure adherence to applicable in-person verification, IPV, and video-based verification requirements.
* Coordinate with compliance, risk, and client servicing teams to resolve onboarding and documentation issues.
* Monitor KYC exceptions and ensure timely closure of pending cases.
* Regulatory Compliance Audits
* Ensure adherence to applicable SEBI regulations, depository bylaws, operating instructions, and internal policies.
* Support internal audits, concurrent audits, DP audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports, compliance records, reconciliations, and audit documentation.
* Identify process gaps, operational risks, and control deficiencies and implement corrective measures.
* Track regulatory circulars and ensure timely implementation of relevant changes.
* Process Management Stakeholder Coordination
* Establish and improve SOPs, maker-checker controls, and operational workflows.
* Monitor productivity, turnaround times, pending cases, and error rates.
* Coordinate with technology, product, compliance, risk, and customer support teams to resolve operational issues.
* Support automation and process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and accuracy.
* Guide team members and ensure adherence to established processes and service standards.

**Required Qualifications Experience**

* Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline; relevant professional qualifications are an advantage.
* 9–11 years of overall relevant experience in stockbroking, capital markets, or financial services.
* Substantial hands-on experience in DP operations is mandatory and should form the major part of the candidate’s experience.
* Strong working knowledge of CDSL and/or NSDL processes and systems.
* Practical experience in demat account operations, securities transfers, pledging, account maintenance, and DP compliance.
* Sound understanding of KYC, KRA, CKYC, SEBI regulations, and applicable AML/PMLA requirements.
* Experience handling audits, reconciliations, operational controls, and regulatory documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Candidates from stockbroking firms, depository participants, securities firms, or capital market intermediaries.

* Experience managing DP processes in a high-volume environment.
* Exposure to process automation, operational risk management, and team supervision.
* NISM certifications relevant to depository operations are an advantage, where applicable.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong DP operational expertise
* Regulatory and compliance orientation
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Problem-solving and decision-making
* Process ownership and execution
* Team coordination and stakeholder management

**Success in this role will be measured by:**
operational accuracy, adherence to regulatory requirements, timely processing of DP requests, audit outcomes, reduction in exceptions, and overall process efficiency.

title: Senior Network Service Implementation (NSI) Manager
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior NSI Manager, you will drive international network migration projects that enhance scalability, optimize network performance, and deliver high operational standards with adept project management and cultural insight.
  
  

* Lead and manage the implementation and deployment of network migration projects to enhance optimization and scalability within the global enterprise network.
* Oversee multiple operations within the portfolio to ensure deployments are completed on time and meet quality standards.
* Perform technical and economic analyses to identify optimal solutions while ensuring compliance with engineering, business, environmental, and safety standards.
* Validate and verify documentation and compliance of studies conducted by external service providers.
* Coordinate stakeholder agreements and manage ordering processes to promote smooth operations.
* Conduct site visits and autonomously manage complex network operations, providing clear and detailed reporting.
* Implement cross-business and operational improvement plans to enhance deployment strategies continuously.
* Deploy network hardware such as routers, switches, and firewalls efficiently during greenfield and brownfield migration projects, ensuring operational readiness.
* Configure and test network equipment in staging environments prior to field shipment to ensure optimal performance and minimize deployment issues.
* Develop and implement comprehensive Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for high-risk network changes to minimize downtime and maintain service continuity.
* Supervise physical layer tasks including cable patching and labeling to uphold data center standards and facilitate maintenance.
* Conduct thorough post-deployment validation to verify adherence to design specifications and operational effectiveness.
* Produce detailed As-Built documentation and updated network diagrams to support seamless transition to network operations teams.

**About You**
You demonstrate hands-on proficiency with Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, and Arista platforms, ensuring comprehensive hardware deployment. Your strong knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and VLANs supports robust network configuration and operation. Skilled in scripting languages like Python and Bash along with automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform, you enable scalable deployment processes. Your experience with hybrid cloud connectivity involving AWS Direct Connect and Azure ExpressRoute is strong. You also maintain detail-oriented execution of technical procedures to ensure reliability. With over 8-10 years in network engineering and deployment-focused roles, along with CCNA or CompTIA Network+ certification (CCNP or JNCIP preferred), your methodical approach and communication skills enable alignment across stakeholders during complex network migrations.
  
  
**Your professional skills:**

* Demonstrates proficient hands-on expertise with network hardware platforms such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, and Arista to facilitate comprehensive deployments.
* Possesses a thorough understanding of network protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and VLANs, enabling stable network configuration and operation.
* Utilizes scripting languages like Python and Bash alongside automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform to promote scalable, efficient deployment processes.
* Applies practical know-how in establishing hybrid cloud interconnections like AWS Direct Connect and Azure ExpressRoute to improve network connectivity.
* Maintains strong attention to detail, rigorously performing technical procedures to minimize errors and ensure process reliability.

**Your soft skills:**

* Exhibits adaptability and resilience, maintaining composure while addressing unforeseen challenges during network deployment activities.
* Communicates complex technical information clearly to align all stakeholders during maintenance and migration phases.
* Employs excellent time management skills to ensure network deployment projects meet established schedules and deadlines.
* Approaches problem resolution through logical analysis and systematic isolation of faults, avoiding assumptions.
* Supports clients thoughtfully throughout network transitions, fostering trust and confidence during change processes.

Join Orange to bring your expertise to large-scale network projects in a collaborative environment that values precision, cultural awareness, and continuous improvement. As a Senior NSI Manager, you will shape the future of global network deployment by leading efficient initiatives that enhance connectivity and operational excellence.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

description:
**About us:**
Today, MKS is a global leader in the highly complex world of plating chemicals, equipment and services for printed circuit board (PCB), package substrate and semiconductor manufacturing, as well as decorative and functional surface finishing. Within the chemical sector, we have developed distinct capabilities in two core businesses: electronics and general metal finishing. Globally, over 8,000 customers rely on MKS’s leading technologies and service capabilities. Our people, our expertise being at the center of a knowledge industry, our true asset is our people. MKS is committed to providing an environment of original thinking, entrepreneurial spirit and teamwork, making it a great place to work. We place great emphasis on diversity and view it as a valuable asset. We pride ourselves on fostering a highly inclusive culture for our workforce which consists of skilled professionals from multiple disciplines. MKS is home to a global team of individuals from different cultures working towards a common goal – customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Specialties:**
Electronics, General Metal Finishing Division, Electronics Materials, and Semiconductor Technology
  
  
**Role:**
**Facility & Engineering Lead**
**Job Location: Manesar**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee daily operations and maintenance of the Development centre facility and warm shell office in Delhi NCR region, including engineering utilities (power distribution, water treatment, compressed air, steam systems) and electroplating lines (anodizing, plating baths, wastewater treatment).
* Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules, troubleshooting downtime, and coordinating repairs to minimize production disruptions.
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations in a chemical environment through audits, risk assessments, and training programs.
* Manage a team of technicians and contractors; conduct performance reviews, training, and resource allocation.
* Optimize energy usage, utility costs, and sustainability initiatives while maintaining high uptime for electroplating and chemical processing equipments.
* Collaborate with production, quality, and safety teams to support process improvements, capital projects, and emergency response planning.
* Monitor budgets, track KPIs (e.g., equipment reliability, maintenance costs), and generate reports for senior leadership.
* Respond to facility emergencies, including chemical spills, equipment failures, or utility outages, with a focus on zero-incident safety culture.

**Technical / Engineering skills (not limited to):**

* Electrical

+ Interpretation of various drawings and diagrams related to building and engineering equipment.
+ Working knowledge of LT Panel, SLD, control wiring, Panels, Circuit breakers, HT, VCB & other electrical various safety equipments.
+ Working knowledge of PLC, BMS, Access control & Fire detection /PA systems.

* HVAC

+ Understanding of operation & maintenance of water cooled & air-cooled chillers.
+ Functioning of condenser, cooling towers, AHU, TFA, air extraction system & scrubbers.
+ Good knowledge of air quality management in chemical hazard areas.
+ Good knowledge of HVAC load calculation and designing.

* Fire Fighting

+ Setting, adjustment & programming of fire alarm panel and PA system.
+ Working principle, functioning & maintenance of hydrant, sprinkler & jockey pumps with automation.
+ Good understanding of cause & effect of various material of fire (fire triangle).
+ Good experience of emergency / BCP management.

* Civil

+ Basic understanding of local rules & regulations.
+ Reading of basic layout drawings prepared by Architect / consultant & interpretation w.r.t. NBC regulations.
+ Preparation of small project BOQs & management of interior, civil work, clean room and MEP related work.

* Water Treatment plant / hazardous waste

+ Good understanding of WWTP, STP, RO, DI plant maintenance.
+ Knowledge of the occupational hazards in wastewater treatment plants and safety measures to be implemented.
+ Ability to operate, recognize needed repairs, maintain equipment used in the wastewater treatment process.
+ Good understanding of waste management and all regulatory requirements as per PCB norms.

* Chemical processes

+ Should understand chemical compatibility chart (resistance of materials when exposed to different substances).
+ Use of various piping materials for chemical transfer (PPR, PVDF, PVC, PP, SS, titanium etc).

**Qualifications / Professional Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, chemical, electrical, or industrial engineering.
* 13–15 years in facility and maintenance operations, preferably in chemical, specialty chemicals, or electroplating manufacturing.
* Proven experience managing site operations with teams of indirect/contractual staff.
* Strong understanding of chemical manufacturing processes, electroplating technology, and industrial utilities design/operation.
* Familiarity with CMMS, EHS management systems, and audit readiness (internal, regulatory, customer).
* Demonstrated ability to lead multi‑site teams, contractors, and vendors under demanding conditions.
* Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and stakeholder‑management skills (with plant heads, safety, environment, and corporate leadership).
* SAP usage proficiency.
* Expertise with relevant plant equipments and machinery (Utilities etc.).
* Documentation and MIS Reporting.
* MS office use proficiency and good presentation skills.

**Interpersonal qualities**

* Keen to learn and grow
* Problem solving mindset
* Good listening skills
* Creative, Structured and method-based work ethics
* Team Player – Manage Local as well as Global Teams
* Excellent Communication skills
* Maintain Confidentiality
* Sense of Ownership and Innovative mindset

title: Head - NPL
description:
**Job Description**
**JoJob Description / Area of Responsibility**

* Lead the end-to-end Operations workstream for the development and flawless launch of advanced, safety-critical automotive mechatronic systems across two focus factories. Integrate mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software disciplines; align worldwide stakeholders, customers and suppliers; and deliver industrialization, quality, cost, timing, capacity and ramp-up targets. Provide decisive, hands-on leadership in a highly dynamic environment and coach launch teams.
* Support quotations and business cases with operations feasibility, industrial concepts, footprint and capacity scenarios, investment estimates, launch timing and risk assessment for complex mechatronic products. Ensure assumptions cover both focus factories and the required revenue-growth roadmap.
* Define Operations targets for safety, quality, cost, timing, scope, capacity and launch maturity across both focus factories. Establish project governance, decision rights, integrated master plan, gate deliverables, cadence, documentation and escalation paths.
* Build and lead the global launch team; secure resources and ownership with line management. Drive early risk management, manufacturing concept selection, make-or-buy inputs and work-package definition.
* Align factory readiness and industrialization strategy with the growth path from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue. Lead operations delivery for the complete mechatronic system, integrating mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces.
* Translate product requirements into robust manufacturing, assembly, testing, traceability and end-of-line concepts. Drive DfM/DfA, design reviews, process validation, equipment implementation, supplier readiness and capacity installation.
* Staff, direct and coach the two-factory launch team; resolve cross-functional dependencies and resource conflicts. Ensure all deliverables meet customer, regulatory, safety, cost, quality and timing requirements. Control the integrated plan and recover deviations through clear owners, countermeasures and escalation.
* Manage capital expenditure, tooling, launch costs, labor, ramp-up cost and obsolete-material exposure against approvals. Lead APQP, FMEA, control-plan, capability, test-coverage, traceability, line-release, PPAP and safe-launch readiness.
* Coordinate equipment, process, component, logistics and software-release maturity across both factories. Run risk-based launch reviews and drive rapid problem solving to achieve a stable, flawless ramp-up.
* Maintain one transparent, fact-based status for both factories covering milestones, budget, quality, capacity, resources, risks and decisions. Report gate maturity and forecast to Project Management, Operations leadership, plant management and executive steering committees.
* Escalate product, process, supplier, customer or safety-critical issues early, with impact, containment, recovery plan and required decision. Track actions to closure and ensure disciplined change control.
* Capture lessons learned and standardize reusable launch methods, equipment concepts, controls and best practices across both factories. Drive continuous improvement in yield, cycle time, scrap, reliability, test coverage and launch efficiency. Support warranty, 0-km, field and supplier-quality containment and root-cause resolution. Optimize capacity and requalification throughout the product lifecycle.
* Represent Operations and both focus factories on project, customer, supplier and executive meetings worldwide. Build alignment among diverse stakeholders and communicate complex issues clearly, directly and early. Lead feasibility, change and problem-resolution discussions using timing, cost, quality, safety and risk evidence. Maintain a strong customer focus while protecting operational readiness and launch integrity.
* Own the transition from launch through stable serial production and formal handover at both factories. Monitor ramp-up performance, capacity, yield, quality, delivery and cost until agreed exit criteria are achieved.
* Coordinate product maintenance, engineering changes, non-conformance resolution and requalification. Lead capacity adaptations and phase-out preparation in line with business and customer requirements.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, electronics, mechatronics, manufacturing, industrial engineering or a related technical field. At least 15 plus years of progressive experience in automotive or another safety-critical, high-volume industry, including complex mechatronic product development, manufacturing industrialization and launch. Experience across multiple functions or factories is required.
  
  
Demonstrated successful delivery of at least three new-product launches, including a complex multi-site or safety-critical mechatronic program. Strong competence in APQP/PPAP, industrialization, launch planning, risk management, budget control, capacity planning, supplier readiness and structured problem solving.
  
  
At least 5 years as a Launch Manager, Operations Project Manager or comparable cross-functional leader. Proven ability to lead international matrix teams, steer two factories, make timely decisions, escalate effectively and deliver under high pressure.
  
  
Proven leadership of worldwide, multicultural stakeholders across functions, factories, customers and suppliers. Fluent business English is required; additional languages are advantageous. Strong intercultural sensitivity, executive communication and willingness to travel are expected.
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Global Customer, Business Unit and Operations Governance: Expert knowledge of matrix decision-making, escalation paths and stakeholder management across factories and functions. Ability to establish clear governance, accountability and communication in a worldwide project environment
* New Product Launch and Product Lifecycle Management: Expert application of NPL processes, gate reviews, industrialization planning, launch readiness and serial-life handover. Strong command of multi-site launch governance and operational deliverables
* Safety-Critical Quality in Launches: APQP, PPAP, safe launch, line release, control plans, process capability, test coverage and end-to-end traceability. FMEA-based risk prevention and awareness of functional-safety implications for manufacturing and validation
* Operations Program Control and Reporting: Integrated planning, milestone and gate control, resource steering, risk and opportunity management, change control and executive reporting. Rapid problem resolution, disciplined escalation and recovery planning across two factories.
* Manufacturing and Launch Financials: Business-case understanding and management of Capex, tooling, launch cost, labor, ramp-up cost, capacity and obsolete-material exposure. Ability to align industrial investment with growth from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue.
* Advanced Mechatronic Product and Manufacturing Knowledge: Strong system-level understanding of mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces. Manufacturing, assembly, testing, calibration, traceability, software-release and configuration-control concepts
* Customer and Supplier Management: Customer-specific milestones, audits, PPAP, capability and drawing requirements. Executive-level communication, negotiation, expectation management and recovery alignment with customers and suppliers
* Matrix Team Leadership: Lead, motivate and coach international cross-functional teams without relying solely on direct authority. Delegate outcomes, resolve conflict, manage performance input and create ownership across both focus factories
* Change Management and Complex Problem Resolution: Evaluate changes across system interfaces and quantify impact on safety, quality, timing, cost, capacity and industrial readiness. Drive fast, structured decisions and implementation while keeping worldwide stakeholders aligned.
* Front Loading and Industrial Strategy: Lead early feasibility, manufacturing concept, footprint, capacity, investment and timing assessments for large, complex programs. Challenge assumptions early and convert lessons learned into robust launch concepts

title: VP, APAC Operations
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
CoreWeave's Data Center Operations organization runs the physical infrastructure behind one of the world's leading AI cloud platforms: the GPU clusters that frontier AI labs and enterprises use to train and serve their models. As CoreWeave expands into Asia-Pacific, we're building a regional operations organization from the ground up. It will own uptime, safety, and operational excellence across every CoreWeave data center in the region, and set the standard for how we run at scale outside North America and Europe.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Vice President, Data Center Operations – APAC is the senior operations leader for CoreWeave's Asia-Pacific data center portfolio, reporting directly to the SVP of Data Center Operations. You will own day-to-day operations across [Singapore, Korea, and future APAC sites]. This is a hands-on role: you'll be present in the data centers with your teams, not directing work from a distance. You'll build the regional team, put global standards and processes in place, and hold colocation partners, contractors, and vendors accountable to CoreWeave's performance bar. You'll work closely with global Operations, Fleet Operations, Engineering, Construction, Networking, and Supply Chain, as well as with executive leadership.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own operational performance for all APAC data centers (uptime, MTTR, safety, and audit readiness) and make the region a reliable, scalable part of CoreWeave's global fleet
* Build and lead the APAC operations organization (Regional/Area Managers, Data Center Managers, and Technicians), including hiring plans, leadership bench, and on-call coverage
