title: Director of Global Security Operations
description:
MongoDB's Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Director of Global Security Operations to build and lead GSO's first dedicated team in India. This is a foundational leadership role: your first mandate is to stand up a 20-person team from scratch.
  
  
This team’s first mission will be extending US based teams in three different areas:
  
  

* Vulnerability management - AI driven detection, triage and workflow management of vulnerabilities from code to components to applications to infrastructure
* Launch readiness - shifting security analysis left to proactively address security needs as far upstream from product launch as possible
* Core enterprise security - projects focusing on improving protection against insider threats and and newly emerging AI Governance and Security needs

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
GSO secures MongoDB's products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Recruit, hire, and onboard a 20-person team including 3 managers - across vulnerability management, launch readiness, and core enterprise security
* Stand up the operating rhythms, tooling, and documentation the India team needs to work as a first-class part of GSO from day one
* Get new hires productively engaged quickly and working seamlessly with required stakeholders
* Actively manage matrix reporting, ensuring ambiguity doesn't slow the team down — resolve competing priorities between local and functional leadership before they become the team's problem
* Represent the India team's capacity, constraints, and growth needs back to GSO leadership
* Build the durable leadership bench and processes that let the India team operate as an accountable, outcome-owning part of GSO going forward
* Build and lead an inclusive, high-performing global team by setting clear goals and operating rhythms; coaching and developing talent through regular, candid feedback and career conversations; monitoring team health and engagement; recognizing strong performance and addressing performance concerns early and fairly; and communicating change early with clarity and context

**Requirements**

* 12+ years of experience in security operations, security engineering, or a related technical discipline, including at least 5 years in a people-leadership role
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Direct, hands-on experience in at least one of: vulnerability management, security automation or workflow tooling, or enterprise security operations
* A track record of hiring and ramping a technical team quickly while holding the line on quality and culture
* Experience operating successfully in a matrix structure — with the judgment to manage functional dotted-line relationships without losing ownership of your own team
* Comfort with a mandate that will evolve as the team matures — you're building this job as much as filling it
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills across geographies and time zones spanning the US, EMEA, and India

*Don't feel that you meet all of the requirements? We encourage you to apply anyway — studies show strong candidates sometimes rule themselves out prematurely. MongoDB has a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and high-performing environment, and we want to keep improving our ability to deliver for customers.*
Nice to Haves
  
  

* Background specifically in vulnerability management platforms, security orchestration/automation (SOAR) tooling, or enterprise security operations at scale
* Prior experience in a matrix organization with international, distributed reporting lines

Success in This Role Means
  
  

* The India team is fully staffed and operating to MongoDB's standards for quality, pace, and culture
* Ability to step into direct delivery level accountability vs. extending capabilities of other teams once the initial team build phase is complete
* The India GSO team has moved from a build-phase support function to owning clear, accountable delivery in vulnerability management, workflow automation, and enterprise security

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

Remedo, a healthcare-focused digital marketing agency serving dental and medical practices in the US and UK.

**Lead PPC Operations (Google Ads, Meta Ads and emerging ad platforms)**
to run our paid media function end to end. You will own day-to-day operations of the ads team, the health of 50+ client ad accounts, and the results we deliver. This is a player-coach role: you lead the team, stay close to the work, step in on accounts yourself to help solve complex problems, and are accountable for outcomes, not just activity.   coach and review the ads team, set priorities and standards, and own hiring, onboarding and performance reviews.

* **Own results:**
  be accountable for account performance against client goals (cost per lead, lead quality, ROAS, booked appointments); diagnose underperformance independently and drive the fix.
* **Step up with clients:**
  lead the ads discussion in strategy and review calls, explain results and decisions clearly, and own ads escalations.
* **Work across teams:**
  collaborate closely with account management, SEO, content, web and design on landing pages, tracking, handovers and client goals.
* **Platforms and measurement:**
  strategy and optimization in Google Ads and Meta Ads; sound tracking with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API.
* **Emerging channels and AI:**
  pilot Apple Search Ads and LLM ad formats, and use AI and automation to make the team faster and more accurate.
* **Healthcare compliance:**
  follow ad policies and data-privacy requirements for dental and medical clients in the US and UK.

**Requirements:**

* 4 to 6 years in paid media or performance marketing, ideally in an agency managing multiple client accounts (slightly less is fine for a fast learner with strong results).
* Experience leading or mentoring a team (2 to 3+ people), or clear readiness to step up.
* Strong hands-on command of Google Ads and Meta Ads, including lead generation, with a record of improving cost per lead and lead quality.
* Solid measurement skills: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Pixel / Conversions API, conversion tracking.
* Runs daily operations independently: spots problems early, sets priorities, closes issues. Hands-on by nature and happy to work directly in accounts and cover for teammates.
* Confident leading client conversations, presenting results and handling escalations; collaborates smoothly with other teams.

**Good to have:**
healthcare or local-service clients; Apple, Microsoft, LinkedIn or TikTok Ads and early LLM ads exposure; SOPs, dashboards (Looker Studio) or automation (scripts, n8n); Google and Meta certifications; US / UK time-zone experience.

**What success looks like:**

**30 days:**
know every account and its goals, audit tracking and account health, and agree an operating rhythm with the VP of Operations.

**60 days:**
daily health checks running reliably, reporting standardized, a clear owner and plan for every account, and the top 3 underperforming accounts on a recovery plan.

**90 days:**
consistent team output, no unnoticed budget or tracking issues, and ads escalations handled without leadership involvement.

description:

Job Summary

MedKarma Healthcare Solutions is seeking an experienced and results-driven
**Medical Coding Manager**
to lead and oversee medical coding operations across Cardiology, Urgent Care, Paediatrics, and Pathology/Laboratory. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in US healthcare coding guidelines, quality management, team leadership, and process optimization.

This role requires a hands-on leader who can drive coding accuracy, productivity, compliance, and operational excellence while developing a high-performing coding team.

Key Responsibilities

**Team Leadership & Operations**

* Manage and mentor medical coders and senior coders, ensuring optimal workload allocation and performance.
* Monitor productivity, coding accuracy, turnaround time (TAT), and overall team performance.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, quality audits, and feedback sessions.

**Medical Coding & Quality**

* Oversee coding operations across Cardiology, Urgent Care, Paediatrics, and Pathology/Laboratory.
* Ensure accurate application of CPT, HCPCS Level II, and ICD-10-CM coding guidelines.
* Maintain compliance with AMA, CMS, payer-specific policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Identify coding errors, denial trends, and quality gaps, and implement corrective action plans.

**Process Improvement & Reporting**

* Develop and improve coding workflows, SOPs, and quality control processes.
* Prepare and review MIS reports covering productivity, accuracy, TAT, and denial trends.
* Collaborate with RCM, compliance, and IT teams to enhance operational efficiency.

**Hiring & Training**

* Participate in recruitment, selection, and onboarding of medical coding professionals.
* Conduct training sessions on coding guidelines, specialty-specific requirements, and regulatory updates.
* Support continuous learning and professional development within the team.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* **Mandatory certification:**
  CPC, CCS, CCS-P, or an equivalent recognized medical coding certification.
* 8–10 years of hands-on medical coding experience, including at least 3–4 years in a team lead, supervisory, or managerial role.
* Strong knowledge of US healthcare coding guidelines, payer policies, and Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance requirements.
* Expertise in Cardiology, Urgent Care, Paediatrics, and Pathology/Laboratory coding.
* Proficiency in CPT, HCPCS Level II, and ICD-10-CM.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and reporting formulas.
* Familiarity with RCM workflows, claim lifecycle, denial management, and EHR/EMR systems.
* Excellent analytical, communication, problem-solving, and team management skills.

If you have the required medical coding expertise and leadership experience and are looking to take the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply. You can share your resume at ritika.goyal@medkarmarcm.com or himani.mathur@medkarmarcm.com

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**Electrical Manager**
to lead and oversee all electrical maintenance, utility operations, project execution, and reliability initiatives within the organization. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in electrical systems, power distribution, troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and team management. This role is responsible for ensuring uninterrupted plant operations, compliance with safety standards, and continuous improvement in electrical performance and energy efficiency.

Energy Management

* Monitor plant energy consumption and identify opportunities for energy savings.
* Implement energy-efficient technologies and practices to optimize operational costs.

Budget & Vendor Management

* Prepare and manage maintenance and project budgets.
* Control operating costs without compromising reliability or safety.

description: Job DescriptionThe Head of Department – Mining & Metals, Australian GCC is a senior business leadership role responsible for leading, growing and developing WSP’s GCC Mining & Metals organisation as an integrated delivery partner to the Australian business. Working with Australian and GCC leadership, the role will establish the leadership capability, operating systems, governance and culture required for a sustainable, scalable and high-performing organisation.The role is accountable for the performance and development of an organisation of approximately 70 professionals, with significant growth ambitions. The priority is to build strong leaders, clear accountabilities and embedded business and delivery systems so the organisation operates proactively and consistently without reliance on individual intervention.This is a business leadership and operating-model role requiring strong leadership presence, commercial judgement and credibility in an engineering or project-delivery environment. Australian Mining & Metals experience is strongly preferred, although candidates from comparable sectors or markets will be considered where they can establish credibility quickly.The Head of Department will strengthen integration through connected relationships at multiple levels and a culture of trust, transparency, constructive challenge and shared accountability. People will be expected to identify risks early, exercise judgement and retain ownership through to resolution, supporting predictable delivery, sustainable growth and career development across both regions.Scope of Work – Mining & MetalsThe GCC Mining & Metals team supports the Australian business across the full project lifecycle, including: Studies and early project phases Design and engineering delivery Project execution and delivery support Operations, sustaining capital and brownfield work The Head of Department is not expected to provide technical delivery, but is accountable for ensuring the leadership, capability and systems are in place to support high-quality outcomes.ResponsibilitiesLeadership, Governance & Operating Model Provide visible senior leadership with accountability for the organisation’s growth, performance, culture and development. Translate Australian Mining & Metals strategy and business plans into executable GCC priorities and operating requirements. Establish and continuously improve the systems, governance and operational disciplines required for consistent and sustainable performance. Empower decisions at the appropriate level and build accountability for matters through to resolution, reducing reactive intervention and upward escalation. Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery within agreed scope, schedule and requirements, aligned with Australian technical governance and client expectations. Embed fit-for-purpose planning, assurance, review, reporting and lessons-learned systems that improve delivery confidence and reduce rework. Ensure delivery risks, capability constraints and resource limitations are identified early, communicated transparently and addressed appropriately. Work with Australian leaders, technical authorities and project managers to clarify requirements, maintain effective interfaces and drive sustained improvement. Australian Interface, Integration & Collaboration Strengthen the “One Team – Two Locations” model through trusted relationships between Australian and GCC leaders, disciplines, project teams and support functions. Set clear expectations for communication, planning, decision-making and escalation, including early dialogue on scope, priorities, constraints and risk. Promote early GCC involvement in workforce and project planning to improve predictability, quality and integration. Build multi-level relationships, shared ownership and clear interfaces that reduce reliance on individual points of contact. Address structural, behavioural or cultural barriers to collaboration and represent the organisation in relevant leadership forums. People, Culture & Capability Create a safe, inclusive and high-performing environment that supports wellbeing, engagement, retention and sustainable growth. Build psychological safety, ownership and initiative so people ask questions, provide honest advice, challenge respectfully and bring considered recommendations. Build leadership depth through clear accountabilities, coaching, succession planning and practical development pathways. Lead workforce planning and recruitment against agreed growth, capability and business plans. Empower leaders to manage day-to-day people, performance and delivery matters within clear governance boundaries. Build cross-cultural leadership capability and meaningful career opportunities across Australian and GCC teams. Business Planning & Resource Stewardship Develop and deliver the GCC Mining & Metals business plan, workforce plan and budget in partnership with Australian leadership. Manage headcount, capability, deployment and utilisation to align capacity with demand while protecting quality, wellbeing and sustainable delivery. Provide transparent information on performance, capacity, financials and risk to support timely business decisions. Support project planning, resource commitments and proposals, ensuring commitments are achievable and commercially sound. Promote a value-based approach to GCC growth that improves client outcomes, competitiveness, profitability and reinvestment in people across both regions. Key Interfaces & StakeholdersAustralian Mining & Metals leadership, discipline leaders and project teams; GCC discipline and team leaders; other WSP regions, sectors and GCC leaders; and Talent, HR and Operations teams.QualificationsExperience, Skills & Profile Required Senior leadership experience in a complex professional services, engineering or project-delivery environment, including leading leaders and scaling teams. Proven ability to lead across regions and cultures and build credibility with Australian or comparable international teams. Strong leadership presence and stakeholder skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge constructively and drive behavioural change. Experience building leadership depth, accountability and succession rather than relying on direct control. Commercial acumen and understanding of workforce planning, utilisation, delivery economics and risk. High cultural and emotional intelligence, sound judgement and clear communication. Mining & Metals experience is strongly preferred but not mandatory where relevant sector leadership and credibility can be demonstrated. Qualifications A bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical leadership experience. Postgraduate leadership, management or business qualifications and professional accreditation are advantageous but not mandatory. Extensive senior leadership experience, judgement and credibility are more important than specific academic or technical qualifications. A capable leader-of-leaders structure is established, with clear accountability and decisions made at the appropriate level. Delivery performance, risks, capacity and resource constraints are predictable and transparent. Workforce growth and career opportunities align with business demand, capability requirements and agreed plans across both regions. Health, safety, wellbeing, quality and team sustainability are evident in leadership decisions and everyday practices. Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Farm Manager Aquaculture
description:
**Company Description**

Affy Parenterals is a certified pharmaceutical manufacturing company based in Baddi, Himachal Pradesh, India, with over 28 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. The company operates multiple manufacturing units along with printing and packaging units, producing over 8,000 pharmaceutical brands for more than 1,000 customers worldwide. Affy specialises in a wide range of pharmaceutical formulations, focusing on delivering quality products at affordable prices. Key product categories include oncology, injectables, soft and hard gelatin capsules, tablets, nutraceuticals, and diagnostic solutions. Going forward, Affy Group is expanding its horizon into the Aquaculture & Agriculture Industry, leveraging its extensive manufacturing expertise to drive innovation and diversification.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Farm Manager to oversee our advanced aquaculture operations in Ujina, Haryana. This is a full-time, on-site role, located in Ujina, Haryana (District-Nuh), which is pivotal in managing the end-to-end production of Pangasius, Tilapia, Sea Bass, Shrimp, Rohu, and Scampi using cutting-edge technology, specifically In-Pond Raceway Systems (IPRS) and Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS). The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep technical expertise in intensive fish farming, biological monitoring, and system maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Production Management: Oversee the complete lifecycle, from fingerling stocking and grading to harvesting and post-harvest logistics.
* System Oversight: Manage and optimise the daily operations of IPRS and RAS, ensuring peak efficiency of filtration, aeration, and water circulation components.
* Water Quality Monitoring: Conduct rigorous daily testing of water parameters (DO, pH, Ammonia, Nitrates, Temperature) and implement immediate corrective actions to maintain an optimal environment.
* Biosecurity & Health: Implement strict biosecurity protocols to prevent disease outbreaks. Diagnose fish health issues and manage feeding regimes to maximise Growth Rate (SGR) and minimise Food Conversion Ratio (FCR).
* Inventory & Data Logging: Maintain meticulous records of feed consumption, growth charts, mortality rates, and chemical usage. Manage procurement of farm inputs.
* Team Leadership: Supervise and train on-site farm labourers and technicians, ensuring a culture of safety and precision.
* Maintenance: Coordinate routine and emergency repairs for pumps, blowers, sensors, and backup power systems to ensure 24/7 operational continuity.

If you feel like you fit the role and are excited to take on this opportunity, please share your CV and a brief cover letter at - Email Address - anshika@affygroup.com, mentioning
*“Farm Manager - Aquaculture”*
in the subject line. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and will reach out to the shortlisted candidates.

Job Description:
  
  
UKG is seeking a people-focused and operationally strong Partner Operations Manager to build, lead, and develop a team in India that delivers reliable, scalable support across UKG’s global partner ecosystem. Working across UKG’s partner organizations, the manager will oversee support for multiple partner motions and programs, including technology, broker, services, GPO/PE, and other business programs as assigned.
  
  
The role partners closely with onshore Partner Operations leaders, partner-facing teams, Finance, Legal, IT, and other cross-functional stakeholders to manage intake, approvals, contracting, onboarding, lifecycle, reporting, billing, renewals, and offboarding activities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is an experienced people manager who can establish clear priorities, develop high-performing teams, maintain strong service and data-quality standards, and continuously improve processes. The individual will balance hands-on operational leadership with effective escalation management, cross-functional collaboration, and a strong commitment to partner and stakeholder experience.
  
  
Job Responsibilities include:
  

* Recruit, onboard, train, coach, and manage a Partner Operations team in India, establishing clear roles, performance expectations, development plans, and annual goals.
* Create an inclusive, accountable, and high-performing team culture grounded in UKG values, continuous learning, collaboration, and operational excellence.
* Manage daily operations, workload allocation, queue health, schedules, leave coverage, and month- and quarter-end readiness to consistently meet business requirements and service-level expectations.
* Own team performance through regular coaching, quality reviews, productivity and service metrics, timely feedback, recognition, and performance management.
* Oversee recurring operational requests and ensure accurate, timely records across designated systems and workflows.
* Ensure the team completes administrative, data-entry, validation, and documentation activities in accordance with established procedures, controls, and service-level commitments.
* Establish quality-control practices for reviewing submitted information, required approvals, completeness, and accuracy; ensure missing, inconsistent, or non-standard items are resolved or escalated promptly.
* Lead operational support for partner intake, qualification, approval, contracting, onboarding, lifecycle management, renewal, termination, and offboarding workflows.

* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of recurring files, reports, and data submissions for commissions, referral fees, program administration, forecasting, billing, and financial operations.
* Manage commercial program administration, including fee and billing files, payout preparation, vendor or program tracking, and follow-up on payment issues.
* Monitor assigned support queues, ensure timely responses to routine inquiries, and provide clear ownership and escalation paths for non-standard or high-risk issues.
* Serve as a trusted operational partner to onshore Partner Operations leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, communicating capacity, performance, dependencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Document and standardize processes, maintain operating procedures and training materials, and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale work.
* Provide operational leadership for technology, broker, services, GPO/PE, and other partner programs as assigned, adapting team capabilities as business needs evolve.

  
Qualifications:
  

* Twelve or more years of experience in partner operations, sales operations, commercial operations, business process support, finance operations, or a related field, including at least five years of people-leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success building, leading, coaching, and developing operational teams in a fast-paced, service-oriented environment.
* Experience managing service delivery, operational queues, workload planning, performance metrics, quality controls, escalations, and business continuity.
* Strong knowledge of partner, customer, or commercial lifecycle processes, such as intake, approval, contracting, onboarding, lead management, data governance, billing, commissions, renewals, and offboarding.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders across functions, levels, cultures, and geographic locations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify risk, resolve operational issues, and use data to improve performance.
* Experience with Salesforce and Microsoft applications; familiarity with ERP, workflow, ticketing, reporting, or partner-management systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate priorities, performance, risks, and recommendations clearly.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a consistent focus on data accuracy, process compliance, and stakeholder experience.
* Ability to lead through change, manage competing priorities, and maintain team engagement and service continuity during peak periods.
* Willingness to provide leadership coverage during month-end and quarter-end periods and to travel on a limited basis, as required.

title: Director of Global Security Operations
description:
MongoDB's Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Director of Global Security Operations to build and lead GSO's first dedicated team in India. This is a foundational leadership role: your first mandate is to stand up a 20-person team from scratch.

This team's first mission will be extending US based teams in three different areas:

* Vulnerability management - AI driven detection, triage and workflow management of vulnerabilities from code to components to applications to infrastructure
* Launch readiness - shifting security analysis left to proactively address security needs as far upstream from product launch as possible
* Core enterprise security - projects focusing on improving protection against insider threats and and newly emerging AI Governance and Security needs

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

### **Who We Are**

GSO secures MongoDB's products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.

### **Responsibilities**

* Recruit, hire, and onboard a 20-person team including 3 managers - across vulnerability management, launch readiness, and core enterprise security
* Stand up the operating rhythms, tooling, and documentation the India team needs to work as a first-class part of GSO from day one
* Get new hires productively engaged quickly and working seamlessly with required stakeholders
* Actively manage matrix reporting, ensuring ambiguity doesn't slow the team down — resolve competing priorities between local and functional leadership before they become the team's problem
* Represent the India team's capacity, constraints, and growth needs back to GSO leadership
* Build the durable leadership bench and processes that let the India team operate as an accountable, outcome-owning part of GSO going forward
* Build and lead an inclusive, high-performing global team by setting clear goals and operating rhythms; coaching and developing talent through regular, candid feedback and career conversations; monitoring team health and engagement; recognizing strong performance and addressing performance concerns early and fairly; and communicating change early with clarity and context

### **Requirements**

* 12+ years of experience in security operations, security engineering, or a related technical discipline, including at least 5 years in a people-leadership role
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Direct, hands-on experience in at least one of: vulnerability management, security automation or workflow tooling, or enterprise security operations
* A track record of hiring and ramping a technical team quickly while holding the line on quality and culture
* Experience operating successfully in a matrix structure — with the judgment to manage functional dotted-line relationships without losing ownership of your own team
* Comfort with a mandate that will evolve as the team matures — you're building this job as much as filling it
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills across geographies and time zones spanning the US, EMEA, and India

*Don't feel that you meet all of the requirements? We encourage you to apply anyway — studies show strong candidates sometimes rule themselves out prematurely. MongoDB has a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and high-performing environment, and we want to keep improving our ability to deliver for customers.*

### **Nice to Haves**

* Background specifically in vulnerability management platforms, security orchestration/automation (SOAR) tooling, or enterprise security operations at scale
* Prior experience in a matrix organization with international, distributed reporting lines

### **Success in This Role Means**

* The India team is fully staffed and operating to MongoDB's standards for quality, pace, and culture
* Ability to step into direct delivery level accountability vs. extending capabilities of other teams once the initial team build phase is complete
* The India GSO team has moved from a build-phase support function to owning clear, accountable delivery in vulnerability management, workflow automation, and enterprise security

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Senior Manager - Regional Logistics
description:
**About the Job:**
We are looking for a dynamic Regional Logistics Manager to lead secondary distribution operations within the assigned branch territory. The role is responsible for ensuring best-in-class service levels at optimum cost, while staying fully compliant on storage, transportation, sustainability, safety and security standards.
  
  
This is a high-impact role that combines strategic network design with hands-on execution, working closely with Sales, O2C, Finance, Factories, HO Logistics, 3PL partners, transporters and Carrying & Forwarding Agents (CFAs) to deliver a seamless end-to-end distribution experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Distribution & Transportation Management**

* Manage Cost of Distribution (COD) by optimizing inbound and outbound delivery (E2E) to control Total Delivered Cost (FDC / VDC / % COD).
* Drive Distribution Network Redesign, Logistics Excellence and related projects across delivery transportation and downstream warehouse operations.
* Prepare the Transport strategy along with T-Hub, onboard new carriers for downstream operations, and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Complete formalities and ensure recovery of accident/loss claims for primary and secondary movements.

**Warehouse & DC Operations**

* Lead DC improvement projects – manpower productivity, MHE utilization, DIDO/GIGO improvement, warehouse utilization – ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Prepare warehouse strategy and manage new infrastructure transitions in line with business volume progression (OPL/MBS).
* Ensure 100% cycle count and inventory accuracy along with adherence to internal & external compliance guidelines.

**Service Levels & Customer Fulfilment**

* Maintain COF / OTIF / ZATP, reduce CD OOS and secondary OTRs.
* Resolve CD complaints related to shortages/damages and drive corrective actions.
* Coordinate with the Sales team and O2C team to onboard new customers post CSP alignment and ensure full supply.

**Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure cool chain compliance in downstream storage and transportation (DC to Distributor).
* Drive batch traceability, reefer service and chilled service strategies.
* Adhere to the company charter on supply and distribution of Infant Milk Substitutes and Infant Foods.

**Transformation & Automation**

* Identify and deploy advanced process improvement tools in warehousing (WMS, Dock Management, RF Implementation).
* Implement digital solutions in transportation – Transporeon, In-Transit Visibility, Digital Hygiene Checklist, LCOP, ERC, OVT.
* Roll out all Distribution-related HO projects (LER, CLER, Trainings, LVS) at the unit level.

**Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage vendors and ensure formal execution of agreements with DC owners, CFAs and Carriers.
* Trigger transport events on a real-time basis and ensure timely issuance of detention certificates.
* Maintain strong P2P process compliance.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* MBA / PGDM from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institution (full-time).
* 2 – 5 years of relevant post-MBA experience in Logistics, Warehousing, Transportation or Distribution within FMCG / Consumer / Supply Chain-intensive industries.
* Mandatory experience in managing Warehousing Operations and Transportation Management.
* Strong experience in team management, stakeholder engagement, coordination with Sales and Order-to-Cash (O2C) teams, and end-to-end execution ownership.
* Exposure to transformation and automation projects in supply chain / logistics.
* Working knowledge of SAP, WMS, TMS and digital logistics tools (e.g., Transporeon, In-Transit Visibility).
* Understanding of the FMCG value chain, freight market trends, and transport costing (fixed vs. variable)
* Knowledge of the local language of the region is an added advantage.

title: Manager Purchase
description:
Position Summary
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Management & Strategic Sourcing
* Lead end-to-end category management and strategic procurement for capital equipment (Greenfield & Rebuild projects), MRO, and spare parts categories.
* Own the complete equipment build cycle: source individual parts, sub-assemblies, and heavy components from a global and domestic supplier base, coordinate inbound logistics, and support in-house assembly and trial runs.
* Prepare component-level budgets for new products, conduct comprehensive market and industry research to inform category strategies, and collaborate with business area stakeholders for project estimation and cost modelling.
* Establish and maintain framework agreements, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), price benchmarking tools, and should-cost models for diverse equipment and spare parts.
* Supplier Development, De-risking & Cost Optimization
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic suppliers; assess and enhance existing supplier capacities across Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QDC) parameters.
* Drive cost-saving initiatives through competitive tendering, strategic bundling, group purchasing volumes, and alternative supplier development (e.g., building robust local/national models to mitigate foreign supply chain dependencies).
* Perform sub-assembly level risk assessments before ordering, develop secondary/alternative sources to de-risks supply chains, and maintain production continuity.
* Act as the primary commercial point of contact for key partners, managing supplier performance evaluations and sharing insights transparently across internal engineering, production, and quality teams.
* Cross-functional Collaboration & Quality Compliance
* Partner closely with design, production, and quality assurance teams during assembly and trial phases to resolve part deviations, manage supplier claims, and ensure strict technical conformity.
* Ensure full compliance with corporate sourcing policies, internal approval workflows, ISO standards, and corporate procurement audits.
* Drive internal restructuring initiatives to optimize procurement performance, fostering clear accountability across specialized purchase, sourcing, and supply chain verticals.
* Digital Transformation & Systems Excellence
* Leverage advanced procurement tools—specifically SAP HANA (MM & SH modules) and JAGGAER (RFX, Auctions, SRM, Supplier Evaluation, and Spend Analytics)—to drive process transparency and data integrity.
* Manage vendor onboarding onto digital platforms, facilitating EDI-based data exchange, order confirmation, and digital offer submissions.
* Train cross-functional teams (Purchase, Quality, and Shipping) and external suppliers on digital procurement modules to enhance department-wide response efficiency and reporting accuracy.

title: Leder til Skovbørnehaven Alfely
description:
Vi er en lille, Steiner-inspireret skovbørnehave med 22 børn og 4 ansatte, som søger en ny, praksisnær leder. Du vil hovedsageligt deltage i det pædagogiske arbejde samt varetage ledelses- og administrative opgaver ca. 8-10 timer ugentligt.
  
  
Vores unikke skovbørnehave ligger naturskønt under træerne med Vestskoven som baghave og Albertslund Rideskole som nabo.
  
  
Her får du naturen som arbejdsplads og tid til kvalitet i det pædagogiske arbejde.
  
  
Bliv leder hos os
  
  
Vi søger et engageret, fleksibelt og kærligt menneske med lyst til at videreføre børnehavens livsnerve: natur og udeliv, rytme, sanselige oplevelser, efterligning, leg, fællesskaber, eventyr og årstidsfester.
  
  
**Hos Os Får Du**

* Nærvær: Du får tid til fordybelse i børnerelateret arbejde. Du indgår i børnehavens pædagogiske og praktiske hverdag.
* Natur: Du får en hverdag under åben himmel i vores skønne have og den omkringliggende vilde natur, hvor årstidernes skiften er en naturlig del af pædagogikken.
* Kultur: Du leder og udvikler børnehaven i samarbejde med personalet og bestyrelsen med afsæt i vores fælles værdier og traditioner.
* Administrativ støtte: Du samarbejder med Landsorganisationen Danske Daginstitutioner (LDD), som understøtter dine administrative og økonomiske opgaver.
* Faglig udvikling: Vi prioriterer din udvikling og tilbyder løbende relevante kurser gennem LDD. Efter ønske er der mulighed for mentorordning.

En børnehave med udeliv og eventyr
  
  
Vi er inspireret af Steiner-pædagogikken, hvor sang, eventyr og årstidsfester skaber en genkendelig og tryg rytme for børnene.
  
  
Vi passer haven, laver mad over bål, går på ture og opdagelse i skoven. Vi graver og bygger i sandkassen og mudderhullet. Vi sår og høster i køkkenhaven og leger i regn, blæst og sol.
  
  
**Vores Pædagogiske Tilgang Bygger På**

* Tryghed gennem gentagelser og faste rytmer
* Læring gennem efterligning og sanselige oplevelser
* Fokus på relationer, fællesskab og respekt for det enkelte barn
* Målrettet styrkelse af børnenes selvstændighed og selvhjulpenhed

Dine opgaver som leder
  
  

* Personaleledelse, personalemøder og skemaplanlægning
* Planlægning og evaluering af den pædagogiske indsats, bl.a. pædagogiske aktiviteter, ugeplaner og årshjul i samarbejde med personalet
* Administrative opgaver samt samarbejde med børnehavens bestyrelse
* Deltagelse i og medansvar for det praktiske pædagogiske arbejde

Hvem er du?
  
  

* Er uddannet pædagog eller har tilsvarende relevant baggrund
* Har gerne erfaring med personaleledelse
* Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket
* Er god til at samarbejde og kommunikere med personale, forældre, bestyrelse og andre instanser
* Er tydelig og anerkendende i din kommunikation
* Har høje pædagogiske ambitioner

Praktisk information
  
  

* Jobbet er på fuld tid med ansættelse den 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter.
* Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst mellem LDD og BUPL.
* Der indhentes børneattest og referencer i forbindelse med ansættelse.
* Børnehavens åbningstid er 7.15-17.00.
* Børnehaven er privat, og børnehavens øverste ledelse er bestyrelsen, der består af forældrevalgte repræsentanter.
* Børnehaven administreres af LDD, der ligeledes assisterer os med ansættelsen.

Vil du vide mere om jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte leder Lene André på tlf. 2877 1014.
  
  
Vil du se mere om vores dejlige institution, kan du se mere i videoen her og læse mere på vores hjemmeside www.alfely.dk.
  
  
**Ansøgningsfrist:**
9. november 2026.
  
  
Samtaler afholdes løbende.
  
  
**Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og modtage din ansøgning.**

title: Textile Operations Lead (Production, Merchandising & Quality)
description:
Job Overview

Anuprerna Artisan Alliance is seeking an experienced, proactive **Textile Production & Merchandising Manager** to lead end-to-end textile operations, quality assurance, and artisan cluster management.

In this pivotal operational role, you will bridge client requirements and on-ground production. You will be responsible for translating design and client orders into structured production plans, managing Time & Action (T&A) calendars, overseeing raw material procurement and dyeing/weaving processes, enforcing strict quality standards, and directly leading field supervisors and artisan teams.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical knowledge of yarns, natural fibers, weave structures, and finishing, paired with hands-on commercial merchandising acumen and the leadership ability to ensure on-time, defect-free delivery.

Key Responsibilities. Production Planning & Cluster Execution

* Develop, monitor, and execute comprehensive Time & Action (T&A) production calendars across all running orders to ensure 100% on-time delivery.
* Plan loom capacities, manage yarn consumption matrices, and allocate production runs across internal units, weaver clusters, and external dyeing facilities.
* Track work-in-progress (WIP) from raw yarn procurement, warping, and dyeing through weaving, washing, finishing, and packing.
* Proactively identify production bottlenecks, material shortages, or weather-dependent delays, implementing rapid corrective actions.

2. Textile Merchandising & Costing

* Coordinate order specifications, approvals, and buyer requirements from initial sampling through bulk dispatch.
* Prepare accurate Bill of Materials (BOM), cost breakdowns, fabric yields, and consumption estimates for custom developments and commercial collections.
* Manage sampling cycles, lab dips, strike-offs, and counter-samples, obtaining formal sign-offs before bulk production rollout.
* Serve as the technical link between internal management/sales and field execution teams.

3. Quality Assurance & Technical Control (QA/QC)

* Establish and implement standardized inspection protocols across raw materials (yarn count, strength, twist), in-line weaving, and final fabric finishing.
* Supervise physical testing parameters including GSM, dimensional stability (shrinkage), colorfastness, rub fastness, and weaving defect tolerances (utilizing 4-Point System or relevant international standards).
* Audit dyeing units (natural and azo-free certified processes) to ensure batch-to-batch shade consistency and lot integrity.
* Conduct root-cause analysis on defects and implement preventive measures to systematically drive down rejections.

4. Team Leadership & Artisan Management

* Direct and mentor on-site supervisors, quality checkers, logistics staff, and weaver cluster coordinators.
* Foster fair, professional, and productive relationships with artisan networks, weavers, and dyeing partners.
* Maintain clean production ERP records, inventory audits, and regular status reports for executive management.

Candidate Profile & Eligibility Criteria

* **Education:** Degree or Diploma in Textile Technology, Textile Engineering, Textile Design, or Apparel Production (e.g., GCETT, NIFT, or recognized textile institutes).
* **Experience:** 4 to 8+ years of hands-on experience in textile production, merchandising, or quality assurance within textile mills, handloom/powerloom clusters, export houses, or sustainable textile enterprises.
* **Technical Mastery:** In-depth knowledge of fiber classifications, yarn counts, weave constructions (plain, twill, dobby, jacquard), GSM analysis, dyeing mechanics, and post-loom finishing treatments.
* **Process Knowledge:** Familiarity with handloom, artisanal textile techniques, natural fibers (silk, linen, cotton), and eco-conscious or sustainable finishing standards is strongly preferred.
* **Operational Skills:** High proficiency in creating and managing T&A schedules, fabric costing, and inventory tracking using MS Excel / Google Sheets or textile ERP tools.
* **Languages & Leadership:** Strong cross-functional leadership skills. Ability to communicate effectively with artisans and local weavers in Bengali, along with professional working proficiency in English or Hindi for reporting.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Please mention your educational background in Textile Engineering / Textile Technology or related field.
* What practical experience do you have in textile production, weaving, dyeing, yarn handling, or fabric manufacturing? Please explain briefly.
* Do you have technical knowledge of yarn count, GSM, fabric structures, dyeing, weaving, or natural textile processes? Please mention the areas you are familiar with.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
1. Position Details

* Designation: Facility Manager
* Organization: PS Arham Apartment Owners’ Association
* Reporting to: President and Secretary
* Working Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
* Weekly Off: Wednesday
* Recess: 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM
* Work Location: PS ARHAM APARTMENT OWNERS’ ASSOCIATION, Biswa Bangla Sarani, New Town, Jatragachi, Kolkata – 700161

2. Job Purpose

To ensure the smooth, safe, efficient, and cost-effective operation of all common facilities and services of the residential complex, including security, housekeeping, gardening, swimming pool, clubhouse, lifts, DG sets, CCTV, electrical systems, water supply, and other common amenities.

The Facility Manager shall coordinate daily operations, supervise staff and service providers, address residents’ complaints, maintain records, monitor expenditure, and ensure timely reporting to the Executive Committee (EC).

3. Key Responsibilities

A. Facility Operations and Maintenance

* Supervise the functioning and maintenance of all common facilities, including:
* Security and housekeeping services.
* Gardening and swimming pool.
* Clubhouse, gymnasium and games room.
* Lifts, DG sets, CCTV and firefighting systems.
* Water pumps, underground reservoirs (UGT) and overhead tanks (OHT).
* Common-area lighting, electrical distribution, drainage and washrooms.
* Conduct daily inspections of the premises and identify defects, breakdowns, safety hazards, and maintenance requirements.
* Record all observations in the appropriate registers and promptly report critical issues to the EC.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and ensure timely repairs to minimize service interruptions.
* Monitor electricity and diesel consumption, water availability, and other common utility usage.

B. Staff Supervision and Administration

* Supervise security guards, housekeeping personnel, gardeners, pool staff and other deployed personnel.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, shift handovers, duty rosters and work performance.
* Ensure proper standards of cleanliness, discipline, safety and service delivery.
* Conduct regular briefings and motivate staff to improve efficiency and accountability.
* Report staff shortages, misconduct, absenteeism and recurring performance issues to the President and Secretary.
* Maintain attendance and duty records of the Facility Manager and other staff.

C. Security and Safety

* Ensure proper security shift handovers and maintenance of security registers.
* Verify the operational health of CCTV cameras and recording systems.
* Ensure that security staff follow approved procedures for visitor management and incident reporting.
* Maintain updated emergency contact numbers for doctors, electricians, plumbers and other essential services.
* Maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for lifts, DG sets, firefighting equipment, pump houses and electrical distribution systems.
* Coordinate periodic emergency drills, mock tests and safety training for staff and residents, with proper records.
* Report accidents, security breaches, equipment failures and other emergencies immediately to the EC.

D. Residents’ Complaints and Communication

* Monitor resident complaints and service requests received through MyGate, WhatsApp groups, email or other approved channels.
* Record, assign, follow up and close complaints within reasonable timelines.
* Escalate unresolved, recurring or critical complaints to the EC.
* Post daily updates on important maintenance activities, pending issues and completed work in the designated WhatsApp group.
* Maintain professional and courteous communication with residents, owners, tenants and service providers.
* Ensure that confidential information and residents’ personal data are handled appropriately.

E. Financial and Commercial Records

* Coordinate with MyGate for generation and circulation of Common Area Maintenance (CAM) bills on the first day of each month.
* Maintain updated records of CAM bills raised, payments received and outstanding dues, and report discrepancies to the EC.
* Obtain vendor invoices by the fifth day of the following month and submit them for verification and approval.
* Maintain records of vendor payments, petty cash, daily expenditure, vouchers and supporting bills.
* Maintain registers for diesel, chemicals, housekeeping materials, purchases, electricity bills and other operational expenses.
* Ensure proper documentation and settlement of petty cash within the prescribed timeline.
* Assist the EC with budgeting, cost control, expenditure tracking and monthly financial reporting.
* Make bank visits for authorized transactions as and when required.

*All purchases, payments and financial transactions shall be subject to the Association’s approved procedures and authorization limits.*

F. Vendor and AMC Management

* Maintain an updated list of vendors, service providers, emergency contacts and service agreements.
* Track AMC, warranty, licence and defect liability period (DLP) expiry dates for lifts, firefighting equipment, DG sets, batteries, air conditioners and other installations.
* Initiate timely follow-up for inspections, renewals, repairs and preventive maintenance.
* Monitor vendor attendance, service quality, completion of work and compliance with agreed scope.
* Coordinate with vendors for quotations, work orders, bills and completion reports, as directed by the EC.
* Report recurring equipment failures and poor vendor performance for corrective action.

G. Water Supply, Drainage and Housekeeping

* Ensure proper operation of pumps and timely filling of overhead tanks.
* Monitor water availability and maintain records of pump operation and related issues.
* Arrange periodic cleaning of UGTs and OHTs and maintain cleaning records.
* Coordinate periodic cleaning of drainage lines and report blockages or overflows.
* Follow up with NKDA or the relevant authority for cleaning of external drains and resolution of civic issues.
* Inspect common areas, staircases, corridors, parking areas, washrooms and service rooms to ensure cleanliness and hygiene.

H. Asset and Inventory Management

* Maintain an updated inventory of Association-owned assets, including gym equipment, games-room items, puja utensils, refrigerators, tools, keys and stationery.
* Maintain stock registers for housekeeping materials, chemicals, consumables and other supplies.
* Monitor consumption and prevent misuse, wastage, loss or unauthorized removal of common assets.
* Ensure safe custody of keys, documents and equipment.
* Report damaged, missing or obsolete assets to the EC and obtain approval before disposal or replacement.

I. Documentation and Statutory Coordination

* Maintain organized physical and electronic records of Association documents, bills, contracts, correspondence, approvals and maintenance records.
* Use Gmail, Microsoft Office and other approved software for routine administrative work.
* Circulate notices, communications and resolutions to owners through the official email account, as directed by the EC.
* Coordinate periodic updating of owner KYC records, targeted every six months, subject to the Association’s approved process.
* Assist the EC in correspondence and follow-up with banks, NKDA, WBSEDCL, local authorities, auditors, chartered accountants, PS Group and other service providers.
* Maintain tenant documentation and ensure records are securely stored and accessible only to authorized persons.

J. Reporting and Review

* Submit a daily operations report covering:
* Staff attendance and deployment.
* Complaints received, resolved and pending.
* Equipment breakdowns and safety issues.
* Maintenance activities completed and planned.
* Water, electricity, diesel and material-related issues.
* Vendor visits and work progress.
* Critical issues requiring EC intervention.
* Maintain a pending-work register with responsibility, target date, priority and current status.
* Prepare a monthly facility report for review at the BOM/EC meeting.
* Inform the President and Secretary immediately about emergencies, major breakdowns, significant expenditure requirements and serious complaints.
* Maintain transparent, accurate and up-to-date records for review and audit.

4. Authority and Limitations

* The Facility Manager shall work under the direction of the President and Secretary and follow decisions approved by the competent Association authority.
* Routine operational follow-up and staff supervision may be undertaken within the approved scope of duties.
* No unapproved expenditure, vendor commitment, contractual change or major repair shall be undertaken without the required authorization.
* The Facility Manager shall not independently alter security arrangements, staff employment terms or Association policies.
* Any matter beyond the delegated authority shall be escalated promptly to the President and Secretary.

5. Performance Evaluation

Performance shall be assessed periodically based on the following parameters:

* Effective functioning of common facilities and utilities.
* Timely resolution and closure of residents’ complaints.
* Cleanliness, safety and overall upkeep of the premises.
* Staff attendance, discipline and service quality.
* Timely preventive maintenance and AMC renewals.
* Accuracy and completeness of registers and financial records.
* Timely submission of daily and monthly reports.
* Control of operational costs and prevention of wastage.
* Responsiveness, punctuality, communication and accountability.

6. Professional Conduct

The Facility Manager shall:

* Maintain punctuality, personal hygiene and a neat appearance.
* Behave courteously and professionally with residents, owners, visitors, staff and vendors.
* Maintain confidentiality of Association records, financial information and residents’ personal data.
* Follow applicable health, safety and security procedures.
* Protect Association property and act in the best interests of the residential community.

7. Working Conditions

The normal working schedule shall be 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with a one-hour recess from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM and Wednesday as the weekly day off. Any change in the schedule shall require approval from the President or Secretary.

The Facility Manager shall remain contactable for genuine emergencies on the weekly day off, subject to the Association’s applicable compensatory-off arrangements. Any work on a holiday and the corresponding compensatory leave shall be recorded and approved.

Pay: ₹16,000.00 - ₹17,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time

title: Manager - Process Excellence & Cost Optimization
description:
**Job Purpose**
This role controls plant cost and material loss and improves workforce productivity. It does this through standard measurement systems (BOM, cost per sq ft, manpower matrices) and shop-floor automation such as production scanning, smart scheduling and live dashboards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cost and Financial Control**

* Track monthly plant cost per sq ft against budget, and analyse and explain variances.
* Reconcile BB and COV material consumption and wastage against BOM, keeping variance within 1%.
* Build and maintain a BOM-based tracking system for general consumables, with cost variance within 5%.
* Reconcile and approve job-worker bills within the agreed billing cycle, with no delays.

**Automation and Digital Tracking**

* Implement operator-wise and team-wise production scanning (barcode for COV, QR code for BB) to measure throughput and reduce manpower cost by 10% YoY.
* Drive smart production scheduling and order-kit allocation to improve direct-worker efficiency by 20%.
* Develop an AI / Power BI tracker for media-wise material inflow versus wastage, with full traceability and variance under 1%.
* Maintain daily plant and department dashboards comparing budget and actual cost trends.

**Waste Management and Manpower Productivity**

* Develop at least two alternate or backup buyers for each saleable scrap item or category, targeting a 15% impact on sale value.
* Optimise waste disposal, including balers for cardboard, plastic and fabric, to cut waste volume by 30%.
* Build a manpower performance measurement matrix for non-sq-ft production and non-production departments.
* Support the skill matrix and skill-based operator allocation, and train supervisors and operators in method and productivity improvement (10 people per department).

**General Duties**

* Conduct time and motion studies, set standard times, and balance lines.
* Prepare monthly MIS and variance reports for management.
* Coordinate with production, stores, finance, IT and vendors.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen and 5S initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering. An MBA or PGDIE is preferred.
* 8–12 years in manufacturing industrial engineering, costing or productivity, including at least 3 years leading projects or a team.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong in BOM and inventory reconciliation, cost analysis, time study and production scheduling.
* Skilled in advanced Excel and Power BI, with exposure to ERP/MES and barcode or QR systems. AI or analytics knowledge is a plus.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable presenting data to senior management.
* Able to work across departments and train shop-floor teams.

RightWalk Foundation is a public policy implementation and state-capacity building organisation. We exist to ensure that progressive public policies actually work for people at scale — not just on paper, but in real lives, over time. Our RIGHT model — Redesign, Institutionalize, Ground, Hone, Transition — converts policy intent into sustained government-owned outcomes. In addition, the scheme is one of the top three priority schemes of the Chief Minister’s office and is closely followed. This is a great opportunity to work in public policy implementation in Maharashtra and impact the lives of thousands of youths from vulnerable communities. description:
Job Description – Center Manager

**Company:** Apollo Clinic  
**Location:** Gandhinagar, Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu

Job Title

Center Manager – Apollo Clinic

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and responsible Center Manager to oversee the daily operations of Apollo Clinic, ensure quality patient care, manage staff performance, drive revenue growth, and maintain smooth coordination across all departments.

Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Clinic Operations**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of the clinic.
* Ensure smooth functioning of reception, nursing, pharmacy, laboratory, diagnostics, dental, and physiotherapy departments.
* Monitor patient flow, waiting time, appointment scheduling, and service quality.
* Ensure clinic cleanliness, safety, and maintenance standards.

**2. Staff Management**

* Supervise department in-charges and support staff.
* Allocate duties, monitor attendance, and ensure adequate staffing.
* Conduct regular staff meetings and performance reviews.
* Coordinate with HR regarding recruitment, training, and employee issues.

**3. Patient Experience**

* Ensure excellent patient service and satisfaction.
* Handle patient complaints and resolve issues promptly.
* Monitor patient feedback and implement improvement measures.
* Ensure professional communication and patient confidentiality.

**4. Revenue & Business Development**

* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly revenue.
* Work towards achieving clinic revenue and business targets.
* Coordinate with the sales and marketing team to increase patient footfall.
* Develop corporate tie-ups, referral networks, and healthcare partnerships.
* Monitor service-wise revenue and identify opportunities to improve business.

**5. Financial & Administrative Management**

* Monitor operational expenses and control costs.
* Coordinate with the finance and accounts team regarding billing, collections, and reports.
* Monitor pharmacy and consumable stock management with the respective department in-charge.
* Review daily cash collection, billing accuracy, and outstanding payments.

**6. Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare regulations and clinic policies.
* Monitor documentation, patient records, and operational checklists.
* Coordinate audits and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure medical equipment maintenance and timely reporting of issues.
* Support infection control, patient safety, and quality improvement initiatives.

**7. Reporting & Coordination**

* Report clinic performance, challenges, and achievements to management.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Coordinate with doctors and all department in-charges.
* Implement management decisions and monitor completion of assigned tasks.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of monthly revenue targets.
* Increase in patient footfall and repeat visits.
* Patient satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* Operational efficiency and reduced patient waiting time.
* Staff attendance, productivity, and performance.
* Billing accuracy and collection efficiency.
* Stock control and reduction of wastage.
* Compliance with clinic policies and quality standards.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

* Strong leadership, communication, team management, and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of healthcare operations, billing, financial reporting, and quality standards.

Job Purpose

To manage the overall operations of the Honda two-wheeler service department, ensure excellent customer satisfaction, achieve service revenue and profitability targets, maintain service quality, and lead the service team efficiently.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Service Operations**

* Manage daily workshop operations, including vehicle reception, job allocation, repairs, servicing, quality control and vehicle delivery.
* Ensure timely completion of service jobs and optimum workshop productivity.
* Monitor workshop capacity, technician efficiency, bay utilisation and vehicle turnaround time.
* Ensure compliance with Honda service standards, SOPs and warranty procedures.

* Control workshop expenses, manpower costs, consumables and operational wastage.

* Monitor customer complaints, repeat repairs, service quality issues and customer feedback.

* Improve customer retention, repeat service visits and customer satisfaction scores.

**D. Team Management**

* Lead and supervise Service Advisors, Workshop Supervisors, Technicians and other service personnel.
* Set individual and team targets and monitor performance.
* Conduct daily briefings, performance reviews and technical training.
* Ensure discipline, punctuality, productivity and accountability among team members.
* Identify training requirements and develop employees for higher responsibilities.

**E. Honda Standards and Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to Honda's service processes, warranty policies and technical standards.
* Monitor warranty claims, free-service and paid-service processes.
* Maintain workshop cleanliness, safety, tools, equipment and housekeeping standards.
* Ensure proper documentation, job card closure and billing accuracy.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly service revenue achievement.
* Labour revenue and spare parts sales achievement.
* Number of vehicles serviced per day and per month.
* Technician productivity and efficiency.
* Average repair order value.
* Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* Repeat repair rate and vehicle comeback percentage.
* Customer retention and periodic maintenance conversion.
* Workshop profitability and expense control.
* Warranty claim accuracy and timely job closure.

4. Qualification and Experience

* Diploma or Degree in Automobile Engineering or Mechanical Engineering preferred.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in automobile after-sales service, preferably in a two-wheeler dealership.
* Previous experience as a Service Manager or senior workshop leadership professional preferred.
* Experience with Honda two-wheeler service operations will be an advantage.
* Good knowledge of workshop management, customer handling, warranty procedures, service revenue and MIS reporting.

5. Required Skills

* Strong leadership and team management.
* Customer relationship and complaint-handling skills.
* Revenue generation and target achievement.
* Analytical skills and MIS reporting.
* Workshop planning and manpower utilisation.
* Problem-solving and decision-making.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
