title: WFM - UKG Pro/ Kronos - Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY- Global Delivery Services (GDS) – People Consulting (PC) – Work Force Management (WFM) – UKG WFM Boomi Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for
**Managers**
with expertise in
**Boomi Integration**
strategy within
**UKG Pro Workforce Management**
to join the GDS PC team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be a part of a leading global professional services organisation whilst being instrumental in the growth of the GDS PC team.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Develop UKG Pro WFM integration architecture, including end‑to‑end design with API‑led patterns, event‑driven frameworks using Boomi.
* Recommend best practices for implementing, managing, and governing integrations using the Boomi AtomSphere platform.
* Perform risk assessments, identify platform compatibility issues, and implement mitigation strategies.
* Manage code reviews to ensure compliance with quality, security, and platform standards.
* Translate complex technical requirements into clear deliverables, dependencies, and risk considerations.
* Participate in full lifecycle activities and ensure the integration aligns with business requirements.
* Serve as SME and advise the project delivery team during integration Build/Test activities.
* Ensure quality of delivery and all aspects of operational management.
* Manage engagement risks, project economics, escalations, and ensure effective planning and budgeting.
* Focus on delivering on client expectations while identifying opportunities to expand engagement value.
* Contribute to firm growth by delivering engagements, leading client sessions, offering subject‑matter expertise, supporting sales/business development, and shaping expansion opportunities.
* Manage and grow payroll consulting and WFM services capability; build relationships with global practices and achieve metrics around productivity, utilization, headcount growth, and penetration.
* Develop thought leadership, collateral, tools, methodologies, and frameworks to strengthen payroll consulting and WFM offerings.
* Act as counsellor and coach set goals, conduct performance reviews, and foster continuous learning and development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* High integrity and commitment to work in a new and challenging environment
* Ability to manage ambiguity and be proactive
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity
* High energy levels, agility and adaptability
* Open to travel nationally and internationally for client projects that are approved as per EY and country specific travel advisory guidelines.
* Demonstrates strong analytical capability and a structured approach to problem‑solving.

To qualify for the role, you must have
  
  

* 12 - 16 years of experience
* Minimum 8 – 10 years of experience with solid understanding of UKG Pro Workforce management solution processes.
* Experience of working in a consulting environment on global client projects in areas of time & attendance, work force management transformation and shared services advisory.
* Experience in team management; providing advice and guidance on client projects related with Workforce management processes and systems
* Boomi Professional Developer Certification/Badge.
* Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, XML, SFTP, WIM and SQL.
* Proficiency in Groovy scripting or JavaScript within Boomi is highly desired.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Demonstrated technical proficiencies in Work Force Management; take a practical/business driven approach to solving complex global payroll client challenges
* Led Work Force Management project work streams from planning through to implementation – managing project resources and budgets effectively
* Designed payroll delivery options (consolidation of multiple payrolls, vendor advisory, shared service centre development, use of technology to generate efficiencies), and payroll transition management
* Supported other regions in client pursuit activities in the payroll and WFM space by developing proposals and presentations
* Ability to review current processes to identify key metrics to evaluate operational performance compared to internal performance objectives and Payroll industry leading practices benchmarks
* Facilitate and support the client in movement of the payroll delivery to a 3rd party outsource provider - developing a strong governance model to drive the vendor performance and delivery of services
* Project management experience
* Experience of working with a Big 4 consulting firm

**What We Look For**

* Professionals who are independent, self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented and able to provide a high level of customer satisfaction through the delivery of world-class support services. Apart from day-to-day activities, the candidate is expected to be involved in strategic planning to grow the team.
* Technical experts with commercial acumen, relevant experiences and high degree of enthusiasm to adapt and learn in a fast-moving environment.
* Professionals who are willing to work in an environment of continual professional development, drive to take on new responsibilities and projects and work experiences with clients across geographies.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. .
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our R&D Engineering team, drive new product development and continuous improvement, and deliver innovative, cost-effective engineering solutions that meet customer needs and strengthen NOV’s technological advantage. Responsible for directing and coordinating the Engineering team to maintain and improve existing products while addressing the customers’ needs and maintaining NOVs technological advantage in the industry. Ensuring that this is achieved in a cost effective and efficient manner.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver engineering projects on time, on budget, and to quality expectations.
* Improve product reliability and reduce customer issues through sustaining engineering.
* Develop and retain a high-performing engineering team through coaching and succession planning.
* Drive cost reduction and continuous improvement initiatives that improve profitability.
* Partner with customers and cross-functional teams to ensure engineering solutions meet business and market needs.
* Direct department activities to design new products, modify existing designs, and improve production techniques.
* Utilize standard engineering calculations related to specific design or analytical projects.
* Manage and coordinate team activities including training, employee development, performance evaluation, hiring decisions, establishment of goals, and performance objectives.
* Manage budget and expenditures.
* Direct and see project through to completion with assistance of technical personnel.
* Develop accurate and complete documentation of data and project results in a timely manner.
* Interact with personnel in other departments and disciplines.
* Participate in action plans for new projects defined by supervisor.
* Consistently produce quality work and recommend areas where quality can be improved.
* Assist with generation and delivery of customer presentations.
* Attend field runs and visit service shops to provide basic technical support for products as needed.
* Partner with Manufacturing to improve manufacturability, reduce costs, and optimize product performance.

**Qualifications**

* A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical engineering or similar
* 12-15 years’ experience in Research and Development engineering role.
* Product Specific Design Training - Able to use design concepts, manufacturing knowledge and repair knowledge to trouble shoot product function issues.
* CAD - Create/manipulate complex models/parts/assemblies.
* FEA - Understand the theory behind FEA and be able to interpret results.
* CFD - Understand the theory behind CFD and be able to interpret results.
* IP Series Training – Understand how to do a patent search.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical personnel
* Ability to plan, organize and coordinate workflow
* Skills in verbal communications, problem solving and record keeping
* Valid B1 United States Visa is desired

Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.

We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
  
  
**Purposeful Innovation**
Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
  
  
**Service Above All**
This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

title: Area Manager - Cardiac Surgery
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Kerala and Mangalore. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.
  
  
The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
* Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
* Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
* Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
* Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
* Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
* Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
* Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
* Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
* Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
* Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers.

title: Finance Manager
description:
**About Helium**

After chasing brokers, navigating fake listings, and locking up lakhs in deposits, most renters

settle because the system leaves them no real choice. Helium is rebuilding rentals in India

from the ground up with a discovery platform of exclusive, gated homes that are actually

available and require just a one-month deposit. Under the hood, we run two fintech

products: a rent guarantee for homeowners and a credit-led deposit solution for tenants.

We are backed by founders and operators from Blinkit, CRED, Zomato, and Stanza Living.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a sharp, high-ownership Finance Manager to join our team in Bangalore.

You will work directly with the founder on finance strategy, planning, and fundraising, while

owning the systems that keep money moving accurately across Helium.

From building budgets and unit economics models to preparing investor reports and

fundraising decks, you will help shape the decisions that drive how Helium grows. This role is

perfect for someone who loves numbers, enjoys turning manual work into automated flows,

and wants to build a finance function from the ground up at a fast-growing company.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Finance Strategy: Work directly with the founder on finance strategy, capital allocation, and key business decisions.
* Budgeting & Planning: Prepare budgets for upcoming quarters and monitor actuals against budgets, flagging variances and their drivers.
* Unit Economics: Build and maintain unit economics and financial models across our rental and fintech products.
* Investor Reporting: Prepare and share regular investor updates and MIS reports on business and financial performance.
* Fundraising: Work on fundraising decks, financial projections, and data rooms, and support the founder through investor conversations.
* Payouts & Collections: Own monthly rental payouts to homeowners, ensuring payment files are accurate and released only after the necessary approvals, and drive follow-ups on pending payments.
* Statutory Compliance: Work with our CA consultant on statutory filings (GST, TDS and other compliances) and keep records audit-ready.
* Process Automation & Systems: Break finance workflows into simple processes, automate manual work, and build systems that scale with Helium.

**Requirements**

* BBA, BCom, or MBA (Finance preferred).
* 2–5 years of experience in finance, FP&A, strategy, investment banking, or a finance role at a startup.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, with hands-on experience in financial modelling, budgeting, and MIS.
* Strong grasp of unit economics and the ability to turn numbers into clear business insights.
* Comfort building crisp decks and reports for founders and investors.
* Ability to break complex processes into simpler, repeatable flows.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills across teams.
* A builder’s mindset: curious, proactive, and keen to automate manual work.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, unstructured startup environment.

**What You’ll Get**

* Direct work with the founder on strategy, fundraising, and investor relationships.
* The chance to build Helium’s finance function from the ground up.
* Real ownership from day one, with room to grow as Helium scales

title: Assistant Finance Controller - WFO
description:
**Role: Assistant Finance Controller**

**Location: HSR Layout, Bangalore**

**About BrightCHAMPS**

BrightCHAMPS is a holistic skill-building and learning platform on a mission to bridge the gap between traditional education and the real-world skills kids need to thrive, offering expert-designed courses in Coding, Financial Literacy, Math, Robotics, AI, and Communication. Founded in 2020 by Ravi Bhushan, the company has rapidly expanded to over 30 countries, delivering 200,000+ live classes every month, and is one of the fastest-growing EdTech companies in the world, teaching coding, robotics, financial literacy, and STEM skills to over a million children.BrightCHAMPS is backed by $63M in funding at a $650M valuation, with investors including Premji Invest, GSV Ventures, 021 Capital, Beenext, and Binny Bansal. The company operates across four core learning verticals — CodeCHAMPS (coding), RoboCHAMPS (robotics and artificial intelligence), FinCHAMPS (financial literacy), and LingoCHAMPS (communications) —

and has grown to a team of 700+ employees across five continents.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Finance Controller to join our Finance & Controllership team. This role is central to strengthening our financial reporting, statutory compliance, and internal control framework as we grow. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, auditors, and leadership to ensure accurate financial records, timely audit closures, and robust governance — while also contributing to cash flow management, budgeting, and business decision support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Reporting & Accounting**

● Support the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring they are

accurate, complete, and delivered within defined timelines

● Assist in the consolidation of group financials across multiple entities and geographies, ensuring

alignment with group accounting policies

● Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records by reviewing ledgers, journal entries, and

supporting documentation on an ongoing basis

● Perform periodic account reconciliations and variance analysis, investigating discrepancies and ensuring

corrective actions are taken in a timely manner

**Audit & Compliance**

● Coordinate with statutory, internal, and tax auditors by acting as the primary point of contact, facilitating

data requests, and resolving audit queries

● Ensure timely closure of audits and submission of required documentation, minimizing delays and audit

observations

● Monitor compliance with the Companies Act, Income Tax Act, GST, and other applicable regulatory

requirements, keeping track of regulatory changes and their impact on the business

● Maintain audit schedules, trackers, and supporting documentation in an organized manner to enable

smooth and efficient audit processes

**Taxation**

● Assist in the timely and accurate filing of GST returns, TDS returns, and Income Tax compliances in line

with statutory due dates

● Support tax audit processes and respond to tax queries and notices from authorities, coordinating with

consultants where required

**Internal Controls & Process Improvement**

● Strengthen internal controls and financial governance by identifying control gaps and implementing

corrective measures

● Monitor process adherence across finance operations and proactively highlight gaps, inefficiencies, or

risks to management

● Support the implementation of SOPs and automation initiatives (ERP/Zoho, etc.) to improve process

efficiency, accuracy, and scalability

**Treasury & Cash Management**

● Assist in cash flow planning and preparation to ensure adequate liquidity for business operations

● Track and optimize the utilization of funds, identifying opportunities to improve working capital

efficiency

● Support banking operations, payment approvals, and bank reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and timely

resolution of discrepancies

**Business Support & Planning**

● Support the budgeting and forecasting processes by providing accurate inputs, tracking actuals against

budgets, and flagging variances

● Provide analysis of P&L performance and support cost optimization initiatives to improve overall

profitability

● Assist in management reporting and business decision support by preparing insightful reports and

dashboards for leadership

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

● Qualified or Semi-qualified CA / CMA / MBA Finance / CA Inter

● 3–6 years of relevant experience in Finance/Controllership

● Strong understanding of accounting standards, compliance, and audit processes

● Hands-on experience with ERP systems (Zoho, SAP, Oracle, etc.)

● Good knowledge of GST, Income Tax, and Companies Act compliance

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

● High attention to detail and ownership mindset

**Preferred Skills**

● Experience in startup / high-growth environment

● Exposure to group consolidation & international reporting

● Understanding of automation tools and finance system integration

● Strong ownership and accountability

● Ability to handle multiple priorities under tight deadlines

● Collaborative approach with cross-functional teams

● Focus on confidentiality and internal controls

title: Engagement Manager
description:
**About the Company**

The Founders Finance is a Bangalore-based finance partner for founder-led businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets. The team runs Virtual CFO, Accounting and Taxation, Fundraising, Company Secretarial and Advisory functions for companies across consumer and D2C, food and beverage, fashion, SaaS and financial services, working to a disciplined monthly rhythm rather than year-end scrambles. Clients get their books closed early in the month, a clear read on their cash runway, and a compliance calendar where nothing slips through. It's a small, senior-heavy team by design, so founders work directly with people who understand both the numbers and the business behind them.

**About the Role**

As an Engagement Manager, you own the client relationship. You're the person founders trust to know their numbers, spot problems early and keep every deliverable on time. You'll run a portfolio of clients end to end, from monthly closings and compliance to the conversations that shape their financial decisions.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Own a portfolio of client engagements end to end, and act as the primary point of contact for founders and their teams

2. Deliver accounting, taxation, compliance and financial reporting services to clients on a disciplined monthly rhythm

3. Gather information and data from clients' finance managers, teams and other sources, and make sure it's complete, accurate and on time

4. Review books, reconciliations, MIS and P&Ls prepared by the team, and ensure quality before they reach the client

5. Present monthly performance, cash flow and key insights to founders, and advise on the actions that matter

6. Track compliance calendars (GST, TDS and other statutory deadlines) so nothing slips through

7. Guide and review the work of associates on your engagements, and help raise the quality bar across the team

8. Spot opportunities to expand services with existing clients, such as Virtual CFO, fundraising support and advisory

9. Manage timelines, deliverables and client expectations across multiple engagements at once

**Requirements**

1. CA Qualified (must)

2. 5+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or client-facing finance services

3. Strong working knowledge of Tally (ERP 9 / Prime)

4. Solid understanding of GST, TDS and tax compliance

5. Strong Excel skills and experience in MIS and financial reporting

6. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines, and to review the work of others

7. Excellent communication, with the confidence to work directly with founders and senior stakeholders

8. Strong ownership, judgment and attention to detail

**Good to Have**

1. Experience working with or inside startups (preferred)

2. Familiarity with other accounting software such as Zoho or QuickBooks

3. Exposure to FP&A, fundraising support or investor reporting

4. Exposure to D2C, e-commerce, F&B, SaaS or financial services clients

5. Experience in a CA firm, advisory firm or virtual CFO setup

**What You'll Gain**

1. Full ownership of client portfolios across high-growth businesses

3. Exposure across virtual CFO reporting, fundraising and compliance

4. A fast track to larger portfolios and leadership responsibilities

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position: Business Operations Associate

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Sarjapur Main Road, Bangalore (On-site / No remote work)

Commute Requirement: Candidates must reside near Sarjapur Main Road or adjacent areas (e.g., HSR Layout, Bellandur, Kasavanahalli, Kaikondrahalli, Carmelaram) to ensure a smooth daily commute.

Language Requirement: Mandatory fluency in Kannada, Hindi, and English.

Work Schedule: 6 days a week, 8 hours daily (48 hours/week)

Reports To: Founder / Owner

Industries Covered: Hospitality (Restaurant), Apparel, and Real Estate (Commercial Property)

JOB OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly dedicated, organized, and analytical Business Operations Associate to assist the Founder in managing a diverse business portfolio. This is a full-time, on-site, execution-focused role based at our Sarjapur Main Road office. You will act as the Founder's operational right hand—gathering data, compiling reports, and executing specific directives across our restaurant, apparel, and commercial real estate ventures. This position offers a massive opportunity for professional growth, providing great potential to learn the inner workings, data structures, and operational strategies of three completely different business types.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

\* Data & Information Management: Collect, organize, and analyze daily/weekly operational data, sales metrics, and financial reports from all three business sectors.

\* Billing & Invoicing: Oversee billing processes, issue invoices, track incoming payments, and ensure smooth financial documentation across all businesses.

\* Real Estate Asset Management: Look into and monitor the maintenance schedules of the commercial building to ensure structural upkeep, timely vendor servicing, and safety compliance.

\* Stakeholder Liaison: Proactively follow up with vendors and building tenants to address operational requests, coordinate maintenance visits, and track invoices.

\* Executive Execution: Act swiftly on direct instructions from the Founder to resolve operational bottlenecks or implement new processes on-site.

\* Administrative Support: Maintain highly organized digital records, manage general vendor documentation, and monitor apparel inventory data.

\* Internal Communication: Draft updates, follow up on action items with on-site team leads, and ensure the Founder’s directives are being implemented accurately.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

\* Education: Must be a Graduate (Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Administration, or a related discipline is preferred).

\* Languages: Full proficiency in Kannada, Hindi, and English is strictly mandatory to coordinate effectively across all stakeholders.

\* Location: Must be living within close proximity to Sarjapur Main Road, Bangalore, to facilitate easy travel for a 6-day work week.

\* Experience: Proven experience in business operations, billing/invoicing, or a strong administrative role.

\* Interpersonal Skills: Prior experience dealing with customer service, tenant relations, or vendor management is highly preferred.

\* Technical Skills: High proficiency in spreadsheet software (Excel/Google Sheets) and data organization tools.

\* Attributes: A strong desire to learn and adapt smoothly between different industries, an exceptional attention to detail, a process-oriented mindset, and the ability to execute instructions precisely.

\* Workplace Readiness: Comfort working in a fast-paced, fully on-site environment on Sarjapur Main Road and visiting local property/business locations as needed.

WHAT WE OFFER

\* A unique, fast-paced environment with a high learning curve.

\* Direct mentorship from the Founder.

\* Hands-on exposure to the restaurant, apparel, and commercial real estate industries.

**Interested candidates please share your CV at Rohin.razdan@gmail.com or apply on Linkedln**

title: Specialist - Commercial Standards Claims & Contract
description: Job DescriptionSpecialist — Commercial Standards, Claims & Contracts is a Business Analyst and SME on the Customer Operations Transformation programme. The outcome is a clear, governed set of commercial policies — credit, claims, pricing and trade terms — and customer agreements that are standard, compliant and correctly executed in the systems; fewer and cleaner customer claims; lower invalid deductions and trade-spend leakage; and <1 Day Resolution wherever the process allows: fewer claims arising in the first place, and faster, controlled settlement for those that remain. Everything this role does serves that outcome.The scope spans Commercial Standards, Claims and Contracts end to end — formulation and governance of credit, claims, pricing and trade-terms policies, policy exceptions and delegation of authority, the customer agreement and contract lifecycle (drafting, approval, activation, amendment and renewal), pricing, rebate, discount and promotion setup, accruals, claims intake, validation and settlement, proof of performance, and the controls that link agreed terms to what is invoiced and paid. The role designs across this scope as one process rather than as separate contract, promotion and claims solutions. It works with market Commercial, Revenue Growth Management, Sales Finance, Credit, Legal, Internal Control, Customer Service and Collections teams, GBO, D&T, the SAP and Control Tower (Claims and Deduction platform) teams and third-party vendors.The role combines 5 capabilities in one person. As an SME, they formulate, document the global commercial policies — credit policy (credit limits, payment terms, risk categories, blocks and releases), claims policy (eligibility, evidence, time limits, approval and write-off thresholds), and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount and rebate guardrails, price-change control) — and the standards and controls that make them work in practice. As a business analyst, they interrogate contract, trade-terms, accrual, claims and deduction data, document current and target process, and write requirements to standard. As a subject matter expert, they bring the functional depth to act as design authority for the fragment and to challenge solutions that would not work in the markets. As a sprint or project owner, they take a scope fragment through design, test and deployment on a two to four week value drop cadence. As a process and technology expert, they translate commercial policy, contract terms and controls into working design on SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, Control Tower claims and deduction capability, and the contract and trade promotion management toolset.The defining discipline of this role is designing claims out at source, not processing them faster. A quicker claim approval is a smaller prize than a contract term clear enough never to be disputed; a faster settlement is a smaller prize than a promotion set up correctly in the system so the customer never needs to claim. The postholder is expected to use the data to find where in the commercial process claims are created — an ambiguous contract clause, a non-standard trade term, a late or incorrect pricing or promotion setup, an accrual gap, a weak approval control — and design the fix upstream into commercial policy, standards, contract templates, deal approval and master data, as well as into the claims and settlement design.Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role. A claim usually starts life as a commercial negotiation; a contract term becomes a pricing condition, an accrual, an invoice and, if anything is misaligned, a deduction in Collections. The postholder is expected to know what happens on either side of their own process — from deal negotiation through to cash and the P&L — and to design accordingly.This is a transformation design and delivery role, not an operational one. The postholder does not negotiate customer deals, draft or approve individual contracts, validate or settle individual claims, or manage customer relationships; that stays with market Commercial, Legal, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done — including the commercial policies, standards, contract templates, reason codes, analytics and controls that let run teams find and remove causes in BAU. The role formulates and recommends policy; final approval sits with the relevant policy owners and governance forums.The role works independently within an agreed frame set by the workstream lead, gathers its own data, forms its own view and brings recommendations rather than questions. Where a Senior Specialist is assigned on the same fragment, it works under their design direction. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS.Analyse commercial terms, contracts and claims performance and baseline the problem — 25%. Document current-state credit, claims and pricing policies, commercial standards, contract lifecycle and claims processes across markets and identify variation from the global standard. Build the process, trade-terms and claim-type taxonomy and interrogate the data directly at portfolio level — customer agreements and terms, pricing and promotion conditions, accruals versus actuals, claims volume, value, ageing and rejection rates, invalid deductions, write-offs and trade-spend leakage — to baseline the problem per market and size the opportunity. Perform gap analysis between current process, commercial policy, contract terms, platform capability, controls and the target operating model, separating structural design issues from operational backlog. Support business-rule validation, master-data requirements and policy analysis. Aim for validated current-state documentation and a defensible baseline that will stand up to audit.Formulate commercial policies and standards, and design claims out at source — 25%. Support future-state design aligned to the global standard, always designing for the cause rather than the symptom. Formulate, document and maintain the global commercial policies the design depends on — credit policy (credit limits and risk categorisation, payment terms, credit blocks and release authority), claims policy (claim eligibility, evidence and proof-of-performance requirements, submission time limits, validation, approval and write-off thresholds) and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount, rebate and promotion guardrails, price-change control and margin protection) — with a clear policy-exception and delegation-of-authority framework, and take them through the governance forums for approval. Translate policy into the standards that operationalise it: standard trade-terms structures, contract and agreement templates, clause libraries, deal approval and delegation-of-authority rules, and the minimum data a contract must carry to be executed correctly in the systems. Use the baseline to show where claims are created — contract ambiguity, non-standard terms, pricing and promotion setup, accruals, proof of performance, master data — and design the fix upstream. Design the interventions: standard contract-to-condition setup, automated accruals and settlement, validated claim intake, reason-code frameworks and claims workflow. Prepare business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, business rules and user stories. Facilitate design workshops and document outcomes and decisions. Assess process, policy, financial and control impacts, and define how policy compliance will be monitored.Deliver the outcome: standard contracts, fewer claims and <1 Day Resolution — 20%. Design for, and evidence, policy adoption and compliance across markets, an increase in contracts on standard terms and templates, fewer policy exceptions, a reduction in claims volume, aged claims, invalid deductions and trade-spend leakage, and movement toward <1 Day Resolution for appropriate claims and queries. Shape the build-out of SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, Control Tower claims and deduction functionality, and contract and trade promotion management tooling as the primary levers on the outcome. Define the measures with the business owner, monitor post-go-live performance against the baseline, and recommend and, where owned, implement continuous improvements to the design. This is the accountability every other accountability serves.Own testing, deployment and adoption through the value drops — 20%. Translate requirements into working design on SAP, Control Tower and the contract and trade promotion management toolset with D&T, system integrators and vendors. Define and review test scenarios, support SIT and UAT, and manage defect resolution with business users. Break the work into fragments that can be delivered on the value drop cadence, and own the backlog, dependencies and risks for the fragment. Support deployment, hypercare and business readiness, and hand over up-to-date commercial standards, contract templates, process documentation, SOPs, controls and training materials to the run teams. Aim for SIT and UAT completed with minimal post-go-live defects and a clean handover into run.Manage delivery discipline and enable across the programme — 10%. Track requirements, risks, assumptions, dependencies and decisions throughout the lifecycle, and escalate early and precisely when the frame is wrong. Act as a trusted partner to market Commercial, Revenue Growth Management, Sales Finance, Credit, Legal, Internal Control, Customer Service, GBO, D&T and vendors, and coach business users through testing, deployment and adoption. Enable the adjacent workstreams — Order-to-Invoice, Collections, Claims & Receivables, Customer Service and Supply — by surfacing cross-boundary impact before it becomes a deployment defect, and by handing design-level root causes to the workstream that owns them. Commercial Standards, Claims & Contracts domain depth and business analysis, on a broad Customer Operations base. Real SME depth in commercial policy and customer contracts — credit policy and credit risk, claims policy, pricing governance, trade-terms structures, rebates, discounts and promotions, contract lifecycle management, accruals, and claims validation and settlement — sufficient to act as design authority and to write policy that is clear, enforceable and auditable, combined with strong business-analysis craft: process mapping, requirements gathering, gap analysis, functional-specification writing, user stories and workshop facilitation. Understands how claims and deductions are created across the commercial and Order to Cash process, and how contract wording, deal approval, pricing and promotion setup, master data and accruals drive them. Built on a general understanding of Customer Operations end-to-end (Order to Cash, Commercial and Supply) and of how markets actually work, including upstream and downstream impact. Knows Consumer Products industry standards and the realities of Beer, Wine & Spirits — distributor and wholesaler concentration, complex customer agreements, promotional and trade-spend claims, and route-to-market and regulatory constraints on trade terms. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards. Data, technology and delivery discipline. Comfortable interrogating contract, trade-terms, accrual, claims and deduction data directly, and translating requirements into working design on SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, the Control Tower claims and deduction platform, and the supporting contract and trade promotion management toolset. Understands the platform, the data model, the business rules, workflow and approval logic, and the operating model — retained, GBO and BPO — beneath the process. Strong on test planning and defect management (SIT / UAT), business readiness and hypercare, and on risk, issue and dependency management. Data-driven by instinct — baselines the problem, quantifies the opportunity and lets the evidence settle the argument. Able to prioritise across concurrent workstreams and deadlines. Design-for-prevention rigour, stakeholder influence and adaptability. Relentless about cause over symptom in design — not satisfied with automating a workaround when the claim could be designed out through a clearer standard, contract or setup. Strong stakeholder management and influencing across a global and local matrix, including senior Commercial, Finance and Legal stakeholders and policy governance forums, and consultative by default: frames the problem before prescribing and drives stakeholders toward aligned design decisions. Clear communicator, and able to manage conflict to a resolution rather than let it stall a decision. Comfortable being redeployed: arrives in an unfamiliar market or process, orients fast, and adds value quickly. Resilient, collaborative, and a visible role model for Diageo’s values.QualificationsBachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Business, Commercial, Law, Operations, IT or a related discipline.Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards. Business-analysis, Agile / Scrum or Lean Six Sigma credentials are an advantage; familiarity with SAP pricing, condition contracts or settlement management, Control Tower or similar claims and deduction platforms, or contract lifecycle or trade promotion management tools is a plus.Experience — EssentialOverall. 10+ years spanning transformation, business analysis and consultative experience, with a strong core of business analysis and SME design work in large-scale process transformation.Subject matter expertise. Deep functional understanding of credit, claims and pricing policy, commercial terms, customer contracts and agreements, trade promotions and claims within a Commercial and Order-to-Cash environment — someone who knows how claims and deductions are created by contract terms and commercial setup, and how standards and process should be designed to prevent them, not only the tooling. Operational exposure is useful context; the requirement is designing the process, not running it.Transformation. Experience in business process transformation, including current-state assessment and future-state operating model design, across the full lifecycle from design through testing, deployment and post-go-live stabilisation. Evidence of reducing claims, deductions, trade-spend leakage, cycle time or manual effort against a defensible baseline.Consultative. A track record of acting as a trusted business partner — framing the real problem, facilitating design decisions, aligning global and local stakeholders — and being measured on whether the business changed, not only on whether the deliverable shipped.Technology. Experience translating business requirements into functional specifications and solution design with D&T, system integrators and vendors, including test planning and defect management (SIT / UAT). SAP pricing, condition contracts or settlement management, Control Tower, or comparable contract, trade promotion or claims platform exposure is an advantage.Industry. FMCG or Consumer Products experience is essential. Beer, Wine & Spirits experience is strongly preferred.General understanding of Customer Operations end to end — OTC, Commercial and Supply — and of how markets actually operate, including upstream and downstream impact.Experience — DesirableExperience formulating and governing commercial policy — credit, claims and pricing governance — and the standards beneath it: trade-terms frameworks, contract templates, clause libraries and deal approval policies — across multiple markets.Exposure to contract lifecycle management, trade promotion management, or claims and settlement automation, including AI-led claim validation and matching.Experience designing reason-code frameworks and claims analytics that let run teams identify and remove the causes of claims and deductions.Experience defining what must be global standard versus what requires market localisation.Experience working in a pooled, on-demand or competency-based delivery model across multiple workstreams.Prior experience of a GBO or shared services transition or operating model consolidation.About UsWith over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. * Excellent thoughtfulness, communication, interpersonal and teaming skills
* Experience in Equity Research, Investment Banking and Corporate Finance
* Experience in financial modelling, including experience building models from scratch in MS Excel and related software preferred

* Exposure to databases such as Capital IQ, Bloomberg etc
* Experience in analytics tools and techniques like Python, R, VBA, PowerBI etc

* Project management skills

* An opportunity to be a part of a market-prominent, multi-disciplinary team of 1400+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. title: Portfolio Value Realisation Manager
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Portfolio Value Realisation Manager ensures that the investments DPTF makes deliver measurable business value. The role operates the value framework. It defines how benefits are identified, baselined, measured and reported, ensures every funded initiative has a named benefit owner and a measurement schedule, and tracks realised outcomes against what was committed at the point of funding.
  
  
Benefit ownership sits with platform and product domain leadership. This role defines the method, secures the inputs, reports the position, and coaches and challenges benefit owners against the value they committed to. It works closely with the Investment & Portfolio Manager so that measurable outcomes are defined before funding, with the Technology Performance Manager so that value and performance are read together, and with Finance so that reported value reconciles with the financial picture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Operate the DPTF value framework, defining how benefits are identified, baselined, measured and reported across the portfolio.
* Ensure every funded initiative has a benefit baseline, a named benefit owner in the domain, a measurement schedule and an agreed tracking method before funding is released.
* Define the value KPIs and benefit OKRs against which investments and programmes are assessed, distinct from the delivery and service metrics owned by Technology Performance Management.
* Measure and report realized business outcomes against committed benefits, capturing emergent value as well as variance to the original business case, and recommend the holding or release of funding tranches at stage-gates on the basis of realized value.
* Track benefit delivery through and beyond initiative closure, so that value continues to be measured once delivery has finished.
* Coach and challenge benefit owners in the platform and product domains against the value they committed to, holding them to it through evidence and transparency rather than direct authority.
* Partner with the Investment & Portfolio Manager so that measurable outcomes and benefit profiles are defined at business case stage, not added once delivery is under way.
* Provide value-based insight into portfolio prioritisation and re-prioritisation decisions, including where committed benefits are not being realised.
* Work with Finance and Business Operations to reconcile claimed benefit against the financial position, so that value reporting withstands scrutiny.
* Set the value measurement standards that federated Domain Portfolio Managers apply, so benefit data is consistent and comparable across domains.
* Build value management capability across DPTF through guidance, templates and coaching, so that benefit ownership becomes embedded in the domains over time.
* Use AI and analytics to accelerate benefit measurement, variance analysis and value reporting.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15+ Years of exp, typically 6-8 years in value or benefits management, portfolio management, investment planning, or business analysis roles within technology or digital functions.
* Experience defining benefit baselines, measurement schedules and tracking methods across a portfolio of investments.
* Demonstrated experience measuring and reporting realised outcomes against committed benefits, including where results fall short.
* Experience defining KPIs and OKRs linked to business value rather than delivery activity.
* Experience working with Finance to reconcile claimed benefit against the financial position.
* Experience building capability in others through guidance, templates and coaching for benefit owners.
* Familiarity with portfolio tooling and with AI-enabled analytics applied to benefit measurement and reporting.

**Skills/Background**

* Strong analytical and financial literacy, able to interpret benefit, cost and value data and test whether claimed value is real.
* Excellent communication skills, able to report an uncomfortable value position clearly and without apportioning blame.
* Ability to coach and challenge senior stakeholders constructively and without formal authority.
* Well organised, able to run recurring measurement cycles across a large portfolio.
* Comfort operating where practice is immature and the method is still being established.

**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Benefits Management, Business Analysis, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Investment Planning, Portfolio Management, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

title: Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager
description:
**About Centric Software**
Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.
  
  
Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.
  
  
**Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a
**Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager**
to join our Accounting team at a fast-growing global software company. This role will play a critical role in ensuring accurate and compliant revenue recognition while helping scale the revenue accounting function through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
  
  
The Senior Revenue Accountant will own key aspects of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, serve as a technical accounting resource for complex customer arrangements under
**ASC 606 and IFRS 15**
, and partner closely with Sales, Legal, Revenue Operations and other stakeholders throughout the quote-to-cash lifecycle.
  
  
This is both an operational and advisory role. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting judgment with a practical business mindset, is comfortable evaluating complex and non-standard deal structures, and proactively identifies opportunities to use technology, data, automation, and AI to improve the quality, speed, and scalability of revenue accounting processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Revenue Accounting & Technical Expertise**

* Own key components of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, ensuring accurate and timely revenue recognition, accounting, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Evaluate executed and proposed customer contracts under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including complex and non-standard arrangements.
* Perform technical accounting assessments involving standalone selling price (SSP), multiple performance obligations, contract modifications, variable consideration, material rights, early renewals, future purchase options, SLA credits, swaps, termination provisions, and other complex contract terms.
* Prepare clear, well-supported technical accounting analyses and memos documenting significant judgments and conclusions.
* Maintain contract review procedures and documentation to support consistent application of company revenue recognition policies.
* Stay current on relevant U.S. GAAP, IFRS, FASB, SEC, and financial reporting developments and assess their impact on company policies and practices.

**Revenue Close & Financial Reporting**

* Prepare and/or review revenue-related journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
* Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations and fluctuation analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, unbilled accounts receivable, and other revenue-related accounts.
* Investigate unusual trends, discrepancies, and accounting issues and drive timely resolution.
* Develop and monitor relevant revenue accounting KPIs to improve visibility into process performance, data quality, and close execution.
* Support management reporting, financial statement preparation, and ad hoc revenue analyses as required.

**Systems, Automation & AI**

* Manage and review revenue accounting activities within NetSuite ARM or similar revenue recognition systems, including sales order approval, revenue arrangements, allocation and schedule adjustments, order activation, and revenue schedule maintenance.
* Proactively identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive work across the revenue accounting and quote-to-cash lifecycle.
* Design, prototype, implement, or help deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, and automated workflows that improve efficiency, scalability, analytical capability, and control.
* Apply a clean-sheet mindset to existing processes, challenging legacy workflows and identifying opportunities to simplify or redesign them using generative AI, advanced automation.
* Leverage automation to enhance areas such as contract review, reconciliations, fluctuation analysis, large-dataset analysis, audit support, and management reporting.

**Cross-Functional Business Partnership**

* Partner proactively with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, FP&A, Product, Engineering, and IT to evaluate the accounting implications of proposed transactions.
* Provide accounting guidance before deal execution to help the business structure arrangements in a manner that supports commercial objectives while maintaining accounting compliance.
* Advise on the revenue implications of new products, pricing models, go-to-market initiatives, and changes to commercial practices.
* Translate complex accounting conclusions into clear, actionable guidance for non-accounting stakeholders.
* Identify and resolve contract, system, or process discrepancies and escalate significant matters to revenue accounting leadership as appropriate.
* Consider global implications of accounting conclusions and process changes and support consistent policies and practices across regions.

**Controls, Audit & Process Excellence**

* Maintain high-quality, audit-ready documentation supporting revenue accounting judgments, reconciliations, and controls.
* Own or support key revenue-related internal controls and update control procedures as systems, business processes, products, and policies evolve.
* Perform risk assessments associated with revenue process and system changes and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors during interim and annual audits, including preparation and ownership of PBC schedules and responses to audit inquiries.
* Lead or participate in high-impact revenue accounting projects and process improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CPA or equivalent preferred.
* Approximately 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful experience in revenue accounting; Big Four or other public accounting experience is preferred.
* Strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and ASC 606, including demonstrated experience evaluating complex customer contracts and revenue recognition judgments.
* Experience with SaaS, software, subscription, or other recurring revenue business models, including multi-element or multiple-performance-obligation arrangements.
* Experience with ERP, billing, and revenue recognition systems; experience with NetSuite and NetSuite ARM is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to own revenue close activities and deliver accurate results under tight monthly and quarterly reporting deadlines.
* Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical accounting matters effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and cross-functional initiatives with limited supervision.

**What Success Looks Like**
The successful candidate will:
  
  
Bring strong technical judgment to complex revenue recognition matters.
  
  

* Execute a high-quality, timely, and increasingly automated revenue close.
* Become a trusted advisor to commercial and finance stakeholders on complex transactions and new business models.
* Reduce manual work and improve scalability through thoughtful use of systems, automation, data, and AI.
* Strengthen revenue accounting documentation, controls, and audit readiness as the company grows.
* Take ownership, move with urgency, operate effectively through ambiguity, and continuously raise the standard for the revenue accounting function.

*Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.*

title: Senior Revenue Accountant
description:
**About The Job**
As a Senior Revenue Accountant at LaunchDarkly, you will play a critical role in ensuring that revenue is recognized accurately and in accordance with US GAAP and ASC 606, while leaning heavily into AI-driven automation to enhance process efficiency and scalability. You will own revenue-related tasks for month end close procedures and partner closely with cross functional teams (like Sales, Deal Desk, Legal) to review customer contracts and non-standard terms. You will also assist with external audits, preparing ad hoc analyses, and be a key point of contact for all revenue recognition activities. * Perform ASC 606 contract reviews for new and existing customer arrangements and document appropriate revenue recognition conclusions

* Maintain and reconcile revenue schedules across revenue, accounts receivable, deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, and customer credits
* Develop and maintain revenue accounting workbooks, rollforwards, and supporting documentation that provide clear audit trails from customer contracts and usage data through the general ledger
* Partner with Sales, Legal, Deal Desk, and Finance on new products, pricing models, contract structures, and commercial terms to identify potential accounting implications
* Support the accounting assessment and operationalization of new products and SKUs, including determining appropriate revenue recognition treatment, sales tax treatment, and ensuring required accounting data is captured

* Identify opportunities to improve and automate revenue accounting processes, controls, reconciliations, and reporting

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
* 8+ years of relevant accounting experience, including meaningful experience with SaaS revenue recognition

* Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and ASC 606 and experience evaluating customer contracts and revenue arrangements.

title: Analyst - Commercial Pharma Analytics
description:
Job Title: Analyst - Commercial Pharma Analytics
  
  
GCL:C3
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn complex healthcare data into decisions that accelerate brand growth and improve patient outcomes? As an Analyst in Pharmaceutical Commercial Analytics based in Chennai, you will serve as a proactive internal consultant to a specific brand team, crafting and delivering commercial analytics. These analytics help drive strategic and operational excellence. Your work will enable data-driven decisions grounded in rigorous analysis and the best available information, directly influencing how we engage customers, allocate resources, and measure impact.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Medical, Market Access, Sales, Forecasting, and other partners to build forward-looking and actionable solutions across customer segmentation and targeting, HCP and patient opportunity identification, test-and-learn experiments, market simulation, and patient flow modelling. Imagine seeing your insights shape go-to-market strategies within weeks, and your capabilities embedded across the enterprise—how will you leave your mark?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Commercial Decision Support: Provide rigorous analytics to guide brand strategy and resourcing decisions, focusing on customer-facing model leadership and measurable business impact.
* Segmentation and Targeting: Build and implement HCP and patient grouping and selection approaches; identify high-value opportunities to improve coverage, conversion, and growth.
* Predictive and Prescriptive Analytics: Build, test, and operationalize models using syndicated and custom, primary and secondary data (including IQVIA) to inform decisions and actions.
* Experimentation and Simulation: Lead smart business experiments (test and learn), market analysis simulations, and patient movement modelling to de-risk decisions and accelerate learning.
* Data Access and Integration: Access and integrate large, transactional datasets via platforms and tools such as DataBricks, PySpark, Python, R, and SQL; ensure quality and reproducibility.
* Insight Communication: Summarize and present findings through clear narratives, visualizations, and concise recommendations that influence senior collaborators and drive action.
* Capability Building: Identify, prioritize, and lead the development, deployment, and embedding of new analytic capabilities; instill a culture of continuous improvement.
* Partnership and Influence: Build trusted relationships with cross-functional partners; translate technical solutions into business value and shared outcomes.
* External Scanning: Monitor the external analytics landscape within and beyond pharma; evaluate and adapt leading methods and technologies for practical use inside the organization.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* A quantitative Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience from an accredited college or university is required. It must be in Engineering, Operations Research, Management Science, Economics, Statistics, Applied Math, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred (Master’s, MBA or PhD).
* 3+ years of experience in application of advanced methods and statistical procedures on large and disparate datasets.
* 3+ years of recent experience and proficiency with PySpark, Python, R, SQL.
* Working knowledge of data visualization – PowerBI, MicroStrategy, Tableau, Qlikview, D3js or similar tools.
* Working knowledge on platforms like DataBricks.
* Experience with IQVIA data sets.
* Experience in MS Office products - Excel and PowerPoint skills required.
* Expertise in managing and analyzing a range of large, transactional databases is required.
* Statistical analysis and modelling background is advantageous
* ML a plus
* Ability to derive, summarize and communicate insights from analyses.
* Organization and time management skills.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with a significant number of business leaders and cross-functional business partners.
* Strong communication and influencing skills with demonstrated ability to develop and effectively present succinct, compelling reviews of independently developed analyses infused with insight and business implications/actions to be considered.
* Strategic and critical thinking with the ability to engage, build and maintain credibility with Commercial Leadership Team.
* Knowledge of AZ brand and Science (Oncology in particular).
* Experience using Big Data, is a plus. Exposure to SPARK is desirable.
* Should have Excellent Analytical, Problem-Solving ability. Should be able to grasp new concepts quickly

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold ideas fueled by the power to encourage life-changing medicines. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Here, you will connect cutting-edge analytics with a clear purpose—transforming the lives of patients with unmet needs. **Specialist, Fixed Assets**
**Role Description Summary**
The Fixed Assets Specialist is responsible for managing the end-to-end accounting lifecycle of fixed assets, including capitalization, transfers, disposals, depreciation, and reconciliation activities in compliance with accounting standards (IFRS/GAAP), company policy, and internal controls (including SOX). This role will support ongoing integration into S/4HANA, onboarding of new companies, audit compliance, and fixed asset reporting. The individual must have strong accounting acumen, a proactive compliance mindset, and a data-focused approach to ensure timely and accurate asset management across entities.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas**

* Maintain and manage the Fixed Asset Register, ensuring accurate recording of acquisitions, capitalizations, retirements, transfers, and adjustments.
* Execute monthly depreciation runs and ensure alignment with accounting standards and useful life policies.
* Perform fixed asset reconciliations (FA subledger vs GL), investigate variances, and drive timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Support fixed asset physical verification exercises and tagging in collaboration with business units.
* Ensure timely closure of Construction in Progress (CIP) and proper classification of assets as per capitalization policy.
* Review and validate asset additions against Capex approvals and ensure policy compliance before posting to the ledger.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation for all asset-related activities and support both internal and external audit requirements.
* Monitor and report on SOX and internal control compliance through dashboards, identifying risks and taking corrective actions.
* Support fixed asset process design and data migration during S/4HANA integrations and onboarding of new entities.
* Collaborate with the business, project teams, and accounting to ensure timely closure of open items and smooth period-end processing.
* Manage GR/IR clearing and reconciliations, ensuring timely follow-ups with relevant teams for resolution
* Manage end-to-end lease accounting activities in compliance with IFRS 16
* Leases including initial recognition, right-of-use (ROU), asset amortization, interests, lease liabilities, and modifications.
* Prepare monthly lease accounting entries, including depreciation of ROU assets and interest accretion on lease liabilities.

COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Detail Orientation & Accuracy: Maintains meticulous asset records and ensures high precision in all postings and reconciliations.
* Accounting & Compliance Focus: Strong grasp of fixed asset accounting principles, with an ability to enforce policies and controls.
* Time & Process Discipline: Delivers tasks under tight timelines, especially during month-end and year-end periods.
* Analytical & Reporting Abilities: Skilled in reviewing data, identifying gaps, and producing compliance or asset performance dashboards.
* Collaboration & Issue Resolution: Coordinates with stakeholders (e.g., project teams, controllers) to close exceptions proactively.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance; CA Inter or equivalent preferred.
* ERP Knowledge: Experience in S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) module is essential.
* Accounting Standards: Familiarity with IFRS/GAAP for asset capitalization, impairment, depreciation, lease liability, ROU and interest.
* Technical Tools: Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with automation tools, scripts, or dashboarding is an added advantage.
* Work Experience: 8–10 years of relevant experience in Fixed Asset Accounting, preferably within a shared services or corporate environment with audit exposure.
