title: Principal Treasury Analyst
description: Job DescriptionWe are currently exploring potential candidates for an upcoming role at McDermott. While this position is not yet open for active recruitment, we want to connect with talented individuals who may be interested in future projects with us. If you are passionate about building energy's future and want to be considered when this role becomes available, we encourage you to submit your details.Job OverviewThe Principal Treasury Analyst – FX & Hedging is responsible for supporting the Company's global foreign exchange risk management program, executing and administering hedging strategies, monitoring currency exposures, and ensuring compliance with treasury policies and accounting requirements. The role partners closely with business units, accounting, FP&A, tax, and regional finance teams to identify, quantify, manage, and report foreign exchange risks. The position plays a critical role in protecting the organization from adverse currency movements through the use of financial derivatives and natural hedging strategies while supporting cash flow forecasting, hedge accounting, and treasury technology initiatives.ResponsibilitiesKey Tasks and ResponsibilitiesManage and monitor global foreign exchange exposures, including transactional, translational, and forecasted currency risks across business units and regions. Execute and administer FX hedging strategies using approved derivative instruments such as forwards, swaps, options, and NDFs in accordance with Treasury Policy. Partner with FP&A, accounting, tax, and regional finance teams to identify exposures, improve forecast accuracy, and support risk mitigation strategies. Perform quantitative analysis and scenario modeling to evaluate the potential financial impact of currency market movements on earnings, cash flow, and balance sheet exposures. Support hedge accounting compliance by preparing documentation, assisting with effectiveness testing, and coordinating closely with accounting teams under ASC 815 or IFRS 9 requirements. Monitor financial markets, economic trends, and geopolitical developments to assess potential impacts on foreign exchange risks and recommend appropriate actions. Prepare treasury risk reports, dashboards, and management presentations covering FX exposures, hedge performance, market conditions, and key risk metrics. title: Cost & Quotation Specialist
description:
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a Supplier Cost & Quotation Specialist within SCM to support Sales and project teams with daily quotation activities, cost validation, and early-stage sourcing strategy alignment with suppliers.
  
  
This role plays a critical part in pre-sales engagement ensuring cost accuracy, data integrity, and supplier strategy alignment during the quotation phase. The position plays a critical role in connecting Sales, Engineering, Category Management, and Supply Chain, enabling competitive, realistic, and executable offers.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Support sales quotations by validating supplier costs, material master data, and market benchmarks to ensure competitive and accurate pricing.
* Review and challenge cost assumptions, identify risks/gaps, and ensure alignment between quoted, system, and execution costs.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Sales, Category Managers, and Supply Chain to clarify technical requirements and sourcing strategies.
* Manage cost data governance by ensuring Material Master accuracy, completeness, and alignment with current supplier pricing and lead times.
* Drive early sourcing engagement with Category Managers to leverage agreements, mitigate risks, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Act as the key interface between Sales, Engineering, Category Management, and Supply Chain throughout the quotation process.
* Provide market intelligence on pricing trends, supplier capabilities, risks, and key cost drivers within the energy industry.
* Monitor quotation performance through dashboards, pipeline tracking, win/loss analysis, RFQ cycle times, and supplier responsiveness.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quotation accuracy, process efficiency, cost transparency, and digitalization.
* Track and improve key KPIs, including cost accuracy, cost savings, quotation quality, on-time submissions, data accuracy, win rates, margin performance, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (preferred), Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in project procurement, quotation/bid support, cost analysis, supply chain, or commercial functions.
* Strong knowledge of the energy industry, including high-voltage equipment, transformers, and electrical components/systems.
* Expertise in cost structures and technical-commercial evaluation, with the ability to assess quotation feasibility and profitability.
* Hands-on experience with SAP (Material Master, Costing) or similar ERP systems for cost validation and data management.
* Advanced analytical and reporting skills, particularly in Excel, Power BI, and data-driven decision-making.
* Strong commercial acumen, attention to detail, and ability to challenge data, assumptions, and cost discrepancies.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, act as a trusted advisor to Sales, and bridge technical, commercial, and operational perspectives.

**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
The BSM IFAR team works with the broader Treasury and LOB Finance team to support LOB and Finance partners through analytics and reporting to communicate the story of the Company’s financial results to stakeholders. This team is responsible for coordinating, consolidating, analyzing, and reporting balance sheet forecast results under various scenarios including baseline and stress. This role also plays a critical role in forecasting net interest income (NII), Treasury non-interest income, and to explain the driver of our forecasts such as change in the market yields, the LOB business strategy by line of business, legal entity, and product.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Balance Sheet and Management (BSM) is a division within the CFO group responsible for providing executive management with accurate and timely forecasts of the balance sheet and net interest income (NII). Another critical function is the measurement and analysis of Interest Rate Risk (IRR) using various methods. This information provides the framework that allows the company to position its balance sheet consistent with its risk appetite and expectations for changes in interest rates.
  
  
BSM maintains close partnerships with various groups across the enterprise, providing key input to critical processes and strategic decisions. These partnerships focus on the following: (1) balance sheet composition and interest rate risk strategy, (2) strategic planning for the company’s three-year outlook with Corporate Planning and Finance, (3) setting the right strategy to accurately measure the profitability of assets and liabilities to ensure efficient usage of the balance sheet, (4) stress testing the balance sheet under adverse economic scenarios with the Global Stress Testing team and, (5) producing the balance sheet and NII forecast and supporting liquidity calculations in coordination with Global Liquidity Management
  
  
This job is responsible for managing balance sheets, balancing risk and stabilizing returns. Key responsibilities include determining and executing on stakeholder business requirements, leveraging discretionary assets, liabilities, and modern balance sheet instruments. Job expectations include pursuing operational excellence, recommending process improvements, decreasing operational risks, and providing analytics such as, Net Interest Income (NII) and yields.

title: Record to Report accountant
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
  
  
**About The Role**
Job Summary
  
  
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.
  
  
The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues
* Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations
* Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records
* Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes
* Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations
* Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements
* Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider
* Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger
* Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)
* Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates
* Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role
* Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA
* Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

**Education And Experience**

* University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field
* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting
* CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

**Critical success factors**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment
* Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

**Technical & Language Skills**

* Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software
* Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills
* Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus
* Proficiency in English

**Interfaces with**

* Accounting teams
* Reporting & Analytics team
* Local Accounting Managers
* Country Finance Heads
* RTR GPO
* External stakeholders (i.e. auditors, tax authorities etc.)

What we offer you
  
  
Medical insurance for self and family
  
  
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days
  
  
Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.
  
  
We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

**Company:**

One XL Info LLP(India and UAE)

Accountant

Full-Time

Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM

2+  Years

**Location:**

Thergaon, Pune, Maharashtra

₹ 20,000 - ₹ 25,000 per month

**About Us**

1XL is a Dubai-based company focused on empowering individuals and organisations through growth, innovation, and success. We inspire individuals and organisations to reach their full potential through tailored, market-proven solutions.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accountant to manage accounting operations for our UAE group entities remotely and our India entity. The role involves maintaining books of accounts in Tally Prime, handling bank reconciliations, supporting taxation and payroll compliance, preparing financial reports, and coordinating with the Dubai team, auditors, and other stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. UAE Group Entities**

* Record purchases, sales, receipts, payments, and journal entries in Tally Prime with proper supporting documentation.
* Prepare monthly bank reconciliations and resolve unmatched transactions.
* Maintain tenant rent, post-dated cheque (PDC), and vendor payment trackers.
* Prepare VAT working schedules, including input and output VAT registers, for review by the Dubai team.
* Support month-end closing activities, including accruals, prepayments, depreciation, and inter-company reconciliations.
* Prepare audit and Corporate Tax schedules as required.

**2. India Entity**

* Maintain books of accounts in Tally Prime and ensure accurate recording of financial transactions.
* Handle TDS calculations, quarterly returns, and issuance of TDS certificates.
* Support GST compliance, monthly payroll processing, PF, and Professional Tax.
* Track foreign inward remittances, Foreign Inward Remittance Certificates (FIRCs), and export-of-service invoicing.
* Coordinate with statutory auditors and assist with ROC/LLP annual filings.
* Prepare monthly bank balance, cash flow, expense, and other financial reports for management.

**3. Reporting and Coordination**

* Maintain accurate accounting records, ledgers, and financial trackers.
* Ensure timely completion of reconciliations, reports, and compliance activities.
* Coordinate with the Dubai finance team and other stakeholders for accounting information and clarifications.
* Maintain proper documentation and support audit requirements.

**Key Skills Required**

* **Qualification:**

  B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter or equivalent.
* **Experience:**

  Minimum 2+ years of practical accounting experience.
* Hands-on experience with Tally Prime and good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and SUMIFS.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, payroll, PF, and Professional Tax.
* Knowledge of UAE VAT and Corporate Tax will be an added advantage; training will be provided where required.
* Good written English communication skills for daily coordination with the Dubai team.
* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and time management.
* Pune-based candidates or candidates willing to relocate to Pune.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Monthly bank reconciliations completed by the 5th working day.
* Timely statutory filings with minimal errors and no avoidable late fees.
* Accurate accounting records and financial schedules submitted to Dubai within agreed deadlines.
* No unexplained or unreconciled suspense balances at month-end.

**Selection Process**

1. **Technical Interview:**

   Video call to assess accounting knowledge and relevant experience.
2. **Practical Accounting Test:**

   Approximately 60 minutes, covering accounting entries, Tally Prime, Excel, and reconciliations.
3. **Final Discussion and Offer:**

   Discussion regarding role expectations, salary, and joining availability.

The separation reflects strong confidence in the Mobility team and positions the new company as an employer of choice in the automotive and commercial vehicle industry. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the spinoff closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.
  
  
The Finance Business Partner – EIIC (Mobility business) provides end‑to‑end financial support to MobilityBusiness group and program portfolios executed at the Eaton India Innovation Center (EIIC). title: FPA VMC Analyst
description:
**About AkzoNobel**
Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.
  
  
For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
  
  
© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
**Role –**
The VMC FP&A Analyst reports to the BU FP&A VMC Team Lead and works closely with the BU Head, BU FP&A, R2R, Costing Analyst, IBP, ISC and Commercial Navigators / Controller, creating an impact by providing high value adding analysis on variable manufacturing cost (VMC) of the respective BU at various levels (BU, Performance Cell, Region, Country, Legal Entity, Site, Customer-Material to the ISC and Commercial association.
  
  
**VMC CoE End to End Scope:**
The VMC CoE Analyst collaborates with BU finance leadership to provide a detailed overview of VMC development, using advanced data platforms like CFIN, CRYSTAL, Power BI, Alteryx, and SAP BI. They identify cost variance drivers, conduct root cause analysis, and work with other pillars to implement corrective actions. The Analyst also supports future cost planning for critical pricing decisions.
  
  
As a reliable business partner, the Analyst identifies and flags process and system related issues, ensuring adherence to accounting standards and AkzoNobel’s P&L guidance (PLENT). They contribute to key projects and continuously improve processes through CI initiatives.
  
  
Candidates should be open to learning new skills and flexible in exploring new ways of working. AkzoNobel promotes a dynamic work culture with a focus on technology adoption to stay ahead of the curve. Analysts are expected to prioritize skill development to keep pace with market and competitor advancements, such as AI and Automation.
  
  
**Key Activities**

* Planning (QRF + Budget):
* Budget Preparation: Prepare budget templates, gather inputs, and load FLM data; run validation checks and resolve data issues.
* Rolling Forecast: Update drivers and post approved manual adjustments; ensure documentation and version control.
* Forecast Translation: Upload and reconcile forecast data in HFM; resolve validation errors under guidance.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Collect inputs from Demand, Data Science, Costing, and Procurement FP&A; track submissions to closure.
* Cost Trend Packs: Generate cost-trend reports vs PY/BUD/QRF; prepare variance tables and initial commentary.
* VMC Bridge Build: Consolidate inputs for PVM bridge and co-ordinate with HRT; validate mappings and ensure consistency with prior versions.
* Strategic Business Support:
* Variance Packs: Prepare MEC variance packs and waterfall charts; summarize drivers for review.
* A06 Preparation: Populate A06 templates; compare to prior periods and fix mapping issues.
* KPI Dashboard: Refresh KPI dashboards (VMC, VMC/L); run data-quality checks and highlight outliers.
* PVM Observations: Draft observations from PVM results for VMC Story telling.
* IBP Support: Compile IBP materials, update slides, record minutes and action owners
* Inventory Revaluation: Calculate RMPI-based forecast impact; maintain workings and assumptions repository.
* Data & Process Integrity (System hygiene, process hygiene):
* Data Hygiene Monitoring: Run exception/integrity reports; flag anomalies (e.g., not-in-use materials) to owners.
* RCA Support: Provide data extracts and trend summaries for RCAs; track action status.
* Gap Ticketing: Raise system/process gap tickets and follow up to resolution.
* Process Improvements:
* Product Cost Checks: Validate BOM/routing and cost splits; flag anomalies to costing.
* CI & Automation: Build macros/Power Query/Power BI measures; document steps and handover notes.
* System Reconciliations: Execute reconciliation scripts across HFM/CFIN/Crystal/SAP; log and categorize issues.
* Digital Tool Usage: Adopt approved AI/digital tools; provide structured feedback.
* Data Standards: Apply naming conventions and data definitions consistently.
* Project Support:
* Project Documentation: Maintain project trackers, timelines, and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependency) logs for assigned initiatives.
* Data Provisioning: Extract, cleanse, and provision datasets for project charters and ad hoc analyses.

**Education**

* Proven work experience “5 to 7 years” in a strategic financial analysis role is essential.
* Qualified chartered or cost accountant or similar equivalent professional competency.
* Experience in large scale manufacturing industry/GBS/GCC. Leveraging deep industry knowledge to enhance financial analysis, cost management, and strategic planning.
* Focus on stakeholder management (e.g. BU Head of Finance, Head of FP&A, Reg Proc Director, Comm, ISC Navigators, Acc Controller, R2R, etc.) engaging to drive actions that support strategic objectives.
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting, optimize data processes, and provide strategic insights to support high-level decision-making (VMC FP&A team is collectively analyzing Variable Manufacturing Cost of around 6 billion €, BU wise ranging from 0.3 billion € to 1 billion €).
* In-depth knowledge of process order settlement and material ledger runs, familiarity with Inter Company (ICD) transactions, proficiency in managing material master attributes, strong analytical skills for financial reviews, and effective communication skills for managing price variations and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Possess in-depth knowledge of Financial & Cost accounting, Product costing, Transfer pricing, IFRS, Financial Statements, and System accounting flow, with a dynamic and innovative approach to problem-solving.
* Must have experience in a multinational company, demonstrating a proven track record of success. Ability to think outside the box and drive strategic financial initiatives.
* Support in managing external financial reporting & ensuring compliance. Responsibilities include preparing VMC Price Volume Mix reporting and Analysis “A06”.
* Proven experience in managing complex organizational setups. Responsibilities include overseeing intricate financial structures, ensuring seamless integration of financial systems, and optimizing processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

title: Lead Analyst Procurement
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
:

The Lead Analyst Procurement supports category strategy and sourcing activities across the allocated categories. The role contributes market insight, commercial analysis, and structured supplier support to ensure services are sourced and managed in a way that delivers measurable value, operational efficiency, and long-term performance – not only for the assigned categories. Applying category management best practices, the role supports spend analysis, supply market intelligence, industry benchmarking of pricing and service delivery models, supplier segmentation, and the development of sourcing strategies that balance cost efficiency with service quality and innovation. Working closely with the internal stakeholders, the role translates operational priorities into sourcing approaches and supplier solutions. Operating within a global procurement framework, the role supports consistent application of category strategy, sourcing governance, and supplier management practices, while leveraging digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to improve spend visibility and process efficiency. ESG and supplier diversity considerations are applied as part of broader sourcing decisions, in line with company policy.

**Major Responsibilities:**

1. Conduct spend data analysis and generate actionable insights, identifying cost drivers, spending patterns, supplier concentration, and opportunities for savings and improved contract coverage
2. Support the development and execution of category strategies incorporating spend analysis, supply market intelligence, and industry benchmarking of pricing, supplier practices, and service delivery models to inform sourcing direction and stakeholder recommendations
3. Analyze market trends, to identify solutions that meet business needs across the categories in scope
4. Contribute to measurable value creation through sourcing initiatives and supplier engagement that deliver cost savings, improved cash flow, stronger supplier performance, effective risk mitigation, and supplier-led innovation
5. Identify opportunities to optimize supplier footprint, service delivery models, and commercial structures
6. Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and ensure procurement activities support operational priorities
7. Support competitive sourcing processes including RFI and RFP, supplier negotiations, and contract award in line with company procurement policies and governance requirements
8. Assist in supplier performance monitoring through clear service expectations, performance reviews, and issue resolution to ensure reliable service delivery
9. Support contract management and supplier governance to ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms, service levels, and risk requirements, including data privacy considerations and appropriate regard for ESG and supplier diversity
10. Contribute to process simplification and supply base rationalization to reduce complexity, improve service consistency, and strengthen commercial leverage
11. Monitor category spend, supplier concentration, and contract coverage, leveraging digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to identify opportunities for cost control, efficiency, and risk mitigation

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Value delivered across the categories in scope including cost savings, cash improvement, service quality, and risk mitigation, benchmarked against industry standards
* Quality and actionability of spend data analysis, market intelligence, and industry benchmarking delivered to support category strategy and sourcing decisions
* Delivery of sourcing initiatives and contracts
* Supplier performance against agreed service levels including quality, reliability, responsiveness, and issue resolution
* Compliance with Procurement policy, contracting standards, and applicable regulations including data privacy and basic ESG requirements
* Continuity and reliability of critical services
* Timely execution of sourcing processes including RFI, RFP, negotiations, and contract implementation
* Supply base effectiveness including appropriate supplier coverage, service consistency, and managed risk exposure
* Effective use of digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to improve spend visibility and process efficiency
* Growing personal capability, engagement, and effectiveness within the Procurement team

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field
* Working knowledge of data analytics tools such as Excel or Power BI as well as AI tools
* Working knowledge of procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba is a plus
* Foundational knowledge or coursework in project management is a plus

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5 years in procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management, including exposure to service-based categories, within global or multi-regional organizations
* Hands-on experience with spend data analysis and procurement analytics, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for category strategy and stakeholder recommendations
* Demonstrated experience supporting category strategies and sourcing initiatives that delivered measurable cost savings, cash flow improvement, stronger supplier performance, effective risk mitigation, and supplier-driven solutions
* Experience conducting market benchmarking, supply market intelligence, and spend analysis to inform sourcing direction and category strategy
* Commercial acumen and developing negotiation skills, with the ability to support competitive sourcing processes and evaluate commercial proposals, payment structures, and supplier agreements
* Financial analysis skills including Total Cost of Ownership modeling and basic cash flow concepts applied to supplier agreements
* Experience supporting supplier management and service contracts in global organizations, including performance tracking and SLA governance
* Good understanding of procurement systems and digital tools supporting sourcing, contracting, and spend management, including SAP Ariba or equivalent platforms, with the ability to leverage data to drive visibility and process improvement
* Basic awareness of data privacy requirements and ESG principles

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning

title: Manager, Controllership - HVACR & Controls EUR
description:
Manager, Controllership - Financial Shared Services
  
  
Johnson Controls is looking for a finance leader to oversee a key function within our financial shared services organization in a business center. This role supports accurate accounting operations, strong controls, and timely financial information that helps the business make sound decisions.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
You will lead a specific accounting function with responsibility for daily, weekly, and monthly activities, team coordination, and the quality of financial output. The role is suited to an experienced accounting professional who can balance operational execution, control discipline, and people leadership in a shared services environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Plan and manage the day-to-day, weekly, and monthly accounting activities for the assigned function.
* Establish and maintain accounting systems, procedures, and controls that support accurate financial information.
* Review reconciliations, journal entries, and related accounting outputs to help ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members responsible for the function.
* Partner with internal finance stakeholders and the broader business center to support service delivery and issue resolution.
* Monitor workflow, priorities, and deadlines to keep accounting activities on track.
* Support audit, compliance, and control requirements as part of the shared services operating model.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and standardization across the function.

How You Will Do It
  
  

* Own the function with accountability for accuracy, timeliness, and follow-through.
* Stay close to the work by understanding daily execution, resolving obstacles quickly, and supporting your team where needed.
* Use clear controls and disciplined reviews to protect the integrity of financial information.
* Look for practical ways to improve processes, reduce rework, and strengthen consistency.
* Work as one team by building trust with finance partners, sharing knowledge, and coaching for performance.

**Qualifications**

* University degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* At least 8 years of progressive experience in accounting, controllership, or financial shared services.
* Experience leading or managing a team in a finance or accounting environment.
* Strong knowledge of accounting processes, reconciliations, journal entries, controls, and close activities.
* Ability to establish accounting systems and processes that support accurate and reliable reporting.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in a shared services, business center, or similar high-volume finance environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and deadlines.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience driving process improvement or standardization initiatives in finance operations.
* Background supporting internal or external audits.
* Experience in a global or multi-site accounting environment.

Why Join Us
  
  
This is an opportunity to lead an important finance function where your work directly supports accuracy, control, and service quality. At Johnson Controls, you will work with a collaborative team environment and have the chance to help strengthen shared services processes while developing the people around you.
  
  
If you are ready to lead with accountability and help improve the finance function, we encourage you to apply.

title: Team Lead, ADM Ops
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.
  
  
As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the
**PFLT Data Operations Team Lead**
is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the team on complex Schedule of Investments (SOI) processing, special asset classes (e.g., crypto/token assets, real estate), and intricate fund accounting mechanics (e.g., PQ reconciliation, derived metric calculations, corporate actions).
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex extraction errors across pipeline stages and front-end verification checks.
* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

description:
**Job Description**
The Business Consultant will be part of the Honeywell AutonomyX Center of Excellence (CoE) based in Pune, India, and will play an active role in developing and executing business consulting activities for Middle East, Turkey, and Central Asia (META) region opportunities, with flexibility to engage other regions depending on workload. This role will combine selective front-office ownership of qualified customer opportunities with back-office business development, analysis, proposal, and value-storyline execution in partnership with the Middle East business consulting team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Business development and selective opportunity leadership for META digital transformation programs for operating companies:
* Co-lead opportunity development for Honeywell AutonomyX and related transformation programs across META, working closely with the Middle East business consulting lead and regional sales teams, including

+ Research customer operating models, business priorities, performance improvement levers, and digital/autonomy transformation opportunities
+ Translate customer challenges into structured consulting problem statements linked to Honeywell and AutonomyX solutions
+ Own preparation of executive engagement materials, value hypotheses, customer narratives, and account-specific storylines for selected pursuits
+ Lead or actively participate in selected customer-facing discussions and workshops, including preparation, facilitation, documentation, and follow-up from Pune or on site when required
+ Own customer-ready material including value propositions, executive summaries, business cases, case studies, and sales enablement content for assigned opportunities
+ Lead preparation and follow-through for selected regional demonstrations, conferences, campaigns, and strategic pursuits

* Drive go-to-market planning inputs, account prioritization, white-space analysis, customer segmentation for Honeywell AutonomyX and Process Automation
* Consulting workshops, studies and execution ownership
* Lead or co-lead scoping of customer diagnostic exercises, workshops, value assessments, and consulting studies for selected META opportunities
* Develop consulting proposals, workshop agendas, data request lists, workplans, interview guides, and analysis frameworks with appropriate regional input
* Coordinate and drive inputs from technical, sales, and solution teams to produce structured consulting deliverables
* Own the development of diagnostic reports, gap analyses, business cases, value roadmaps, maturity assessments, and adoption plans for assigned workstreams
* Drive follow-up actions, maintain opportunity documentation, and lead handover from consulting discovery into sales execution where assigned
* CoE capability building and organizational enablement
* Build and continuously improve repeatable AutonomyX consulting assets, templates, value frameworks, and proposal content within the Pune CoE
* Lead selected internal enablement activities for value-based selling and consulting-led opportunity development across META
* Share best practices, case studies, and reusable methods with regional sales, consulting, and solution teams

**Qualifications**
**Skills and qualifications**

* Prior consulting experience with a leading consulting firm at Associate level or equivalent, including strategy, operations, transformation, digital, or value-creation work. Alternatively MBA from a leading business school
* Prior experience in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, refining, petrochemicals, or other process industries preferred
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical engineering discipline preferred; Chemical Engineering is desirable, although other relevant engineering disciplines will be considered
* Preferred experience in running or contributing to operational transformation programs, performance improvement initiatives, digital transformation programs, or operating model improvement efforts
* Demonstrated ability to lead defined consulting workstreams, customer workshops, or opportunity development activities with senior stakeholder exposure
* Strong written communication and executive-presentation preparation skills, with ability to create clear customer-facing narratives and C-suite-ready materials
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to structure ambiguous business problems, identify customer value levers, and translate analysis into actionable recommendations
* Strong quantitative skills, including business case development, financial modelling, scenario planning, benchmarking, and value analysis
* Ability to work effectively from Pune with META stakeholders across time zones, balancing independent ownership, remote collaboration, and selected customer-facing engagement
* Ability to travel to Middle East selectively for high-value customer workshops, internal alignment sessions, and strategic pursuits as required

**Value proposition of role**

* Opportunity to help shape the AutonomyX CoE in Pune while taking ownership of selected strategic growth opportunities in the META region
* Blend of customer-facing consulting leadership and high-impact strategy, proposal, analysis, and execution ownership
* High visibility to regional business consulting, sales, and leadership teams through direct contribution to priority transformation pursuits
* Exposure to globally leading operating companies in the Middle East that are at the forefront of technology transformation, autonomy, and next-generation industrial operations
* Strong platform to develop expertise in autonomy, digital transformation, industrial operations, and value-based selling
* Role offers a broad problem-solving, business case, and opportunity-leadership remit across multiple industries and customer situations
* Selective travel intensity compared with pure front-office consulting, while retaining meaningful ownership of strategic customer engagements

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Consultant - LBA
description:
The Consultant LBA for Wolters Kluwer will be responsible for performing Legal Bill Analysis (LBA) in the Legal Bill Analysis Center of Excellence (“LBACOE”).
  
  
The Consultant LBA will be responsible for the prompt, accurate and efficient auditing of electronically submitted legal fee and expense invoices submitted by law firms and vendors of our clients. The candidate will be responsible for making adjustments to invoice line-item entries, where those line item entries violate provisions of the relevant billing guidelines, and documenting the justification for such adjustments.
  
  
The Consultant LBA will provide guidance to business unit partners regarding issues or opportunities within the LBA process.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Efficiently and accurately review legal invoice entries.
* Receive legal bill assignments from the Operations Support Specialist and/or work the intake queue for self-assignments.
* Verify compliance with legal billing guidelines by law firms and vendors submitting invoices.
* Verify the accuracy of the UTBMS task codes (Fee, Activity and Expense codes) applied to invoice line items.
* Document reasons for any adjustments made to invoice line items, identifying the billing guideline violated and the rationale for the amount adjusted.
* Forward the audited legal bill through the review chain as required.
* Communicate and calibrate with Legal Invoice Analyst and Quality Assurance Analyst team members. Provide feedback to management on additional calibration opportunities.
* Demonstrated superior ability to review, analyze and evaluate legal fee and cost/expense invoice entries and to exercise discretion and sound judgment when making audit and adjustment decisions.
* Advanced understanding of legal terminology and claims legal situations required.
* When directed by management, support QA Analysts in addressing requests for reconsideration of adjusted amounts submitted by law firms.
* When directed by management, support QA Analysts in conducting the quality assurance review of invoices audited by Legal Invoice Analyst I & II peers, while utilizing SME knowledge in specialized legal practice areas.
* Conduct periodic audit and data analysis to support management in collecting performance metrics for internal use and use with clients and law firms.
* Analyze and condense clients’ legal service agreements to produce effective operational tools, meeting and in some cases exceeding customer expectations.
* When directed by management, assist with the creation and updating of various team and department wide standard operating procedures.
* Participate in the training and mentoring of new Legal Invoice Analysts via informal and formal mentorship and training initiatives, both for new client roll outs and for back-filling vacancies on existing client teams.
* Liaise with and provide periodic feedback to CIOX Artificial Intelligence Decision Science team on functionality and improvement of machine learning end-user experience and accuracy.
* Self-motivated with an ability to work independently and with very limited supervision after training.
* Excellent computer skills with the ability to learn the electronic legal bill submission and auditing software.
* Sound command of the English language-- grammar, syntax and style -- including an understanding of the conventions of punctuation and capitalization.
* Excellent spelling and proofreading skills.
* Effective communication skills - ability to obtain information from others and deliver information to others orally and in written form.
* Organizational skills, including the ability to organize work in an orderly fashion conducive to the prompt, efficient review of an appropriate number of legal invoices in a given day or time period.
* Familiarity with common business math and possess appropriate business telephone skills.
* Ability to carry out detailed written or verbal instructions; ability to respond to requests effectively and efficiently.

**Job Qualifications**
**Education**
Minimum: Paralegal Certification or equivalent work experience. Bachelor’s Degree in legal related discipline and/or equivalent work experience either in-house or with a third-party legal invoice auditing company strongly preferred. Advanced degree a plus.
  
  
Experience, Knowledge and Tools
  
  
Minimum Experience: 3 - 5 years of experience in a legal services or legal bill auditing environment, including:
  
  

* Extensive experience with legal billing processes.
* Firm understanding of the federal and/or state rules of civil procedure.
* Prior legal bill review experience required.
* Experience with one or more practice areas in a legal billing or legal services setting, including but not limited to; insurance, civil litigation, intellectual property, corporate, and banking.

**Required Competencies:**

* Communications: Strong arbitration and organizational skills are critical to being successful in this role. Strong communications skills and the ability to organize and motivate team members in a matrix environment are essential.
* Team Work: Must work collaboratively with people within FCOE and throughout the entire WK organization, while providing constructive feedback to LBACOE leadership.
* Problem Solving: Capable of independent thinking and rendering sound decisions. Astute at identifying and engaging the necessary resources to help in decision making. Takes quick actions to identify and resolve the cause of any problem. Proactive in nature.
* Leadership: Exhibits individual control over day to day responsibilities as well as the ability to work collaboratively with other BUs to produce results.
* Planning and Organizing: Must be able to implement plans with the purpose of achieving short and long term goals. Must be able to prioritize in order to accomplish these goals in a given time period.
* Technology: Has the ability to partner with experts in the technology field to identify technology gaps and requirements necessary to develop position and impactful solutions.
* Learning: Ability to acquire new or modify existing knowledge to support a changing market place and workforce. Can demonstrate a capability to learn by study, experience, or instruction.
* Initiative and Enterprise: Is self-directed and has the ability to translate ideas into action and get things done.
* Critical Thinking: Able to firmly understand the nuances of language and think critically about the meaning behind cryptic language and legal jargon.

**Tools:**

* Microsoft Office Suite ( Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

title: Senior Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Analyst, Financial Planning & AnalysisSenior Analyst, Revenue Assurance, Financial Planning and Analysis  
  
About Mastercard?  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  
The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function manages all aspects of management reporting encompassing budgeting and forecasting, strategic and customer planning. This includes the management and execution of the corporate reporting and planning requirements.  
Business Finance Centre provides FP&A expertise to the organization by compiling and analysing metrics, identifying trends and problems, communicating information to relevant groups, and recommending actions to improve financial performance.  
  
Revenue Assurance (RA) is a function within Finance responsible for strengthening revenue controls, identifying billing opportunities, and minimizing revenue leakage across QMR (Quarterly Mastercard Reported), global billing processes, and billing reviews of revenue streams across core and services.  
The role focuses on ensuring billing accuracy, driving revenue recovery, and partnering with cross-functional teams to enhance revenue integrity and controls.  
  
This position will report to Director, Revenue Assurance, and is responsible for driving data analytics excellence for Global Corporate Revenue assurance team.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities  

* Lead and own revenue assurance review projects to identify billing leakages and ensure billing completeness and accuracy.
* Working with billing on understanding rules, determining if there are any billing issues, working through the back billing, and working through system fixes
* Perform in-depth analysis of data systems and process flows to identify and resolve root causes of revenue leakage. Conduct rigorous data analysis from Mastercard databases to identify, research, and resolve revenue leakage; synthesize findings into actional insights and recommendations
* Understand and validate billing logic by recreating billing from core systems and comparing it with actual billed amounts.
* To work with the pricing teams to see any gaps in pricing or understanding the intent of pricing to determine if we are billing on what we intended to bill on.
* Support risk-based prioritization plans for revenue stream reviews based on materiality, business inputs, and new initiatives
* Perform financial analysis to estimate revenue impact at customer and country levels and support recovery decisions.
* Collaborate with Finance, Product, and GBSC teams to improve billing accuracy, implement fixes, and execute back-billing.
* Communicate identified revenue leakage opportunities, recovery actions/waivers to Regional Finance team and senior stakeholders.
* Act as an active member for all billing related matters and ensure alignment with corporate Revenue Assurance strategies.
* Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders such as Finance, Product, GBSC, etc., to develop analytical toolkit that drives efficiency on issue detection for key initiatives and focuses across corporate and regions
* Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders such as Finance, Product, GBSC, etc., to develop analytical toolkit that drives efficiency on issue detection for key initiatives and focuses across corporate and regions

  
All about you:  

* CA/MBA (Finance preferred); CPA/CFA certification is an added advantage.

Strong proficiency in database management, Microsoft Office applications, and data analytics.
  

* Demonstrated success in Revenue Assurance, with the ability to thrive in project-based roles requiring self-initiative and self-motivation.
* Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to simplify and articulate complex issues effectively.
* Knowledge on tools like Alteryx, Tableau , Hyperion etc.
* Structured, proactive problem-solver with a strong focus on process improvement and execution.
* High degree of ownership, business acumen, and entrepreneurial mindset.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across teams and all management levels.
* Proven ability to manage time-sensitive matters, ensuring timely follow-up and closure.
* Capable of handling multiple priorities simultaneously while working effectively with cross-functional partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior QS & Billing Expert
description:
Job Description (JD) – Senior QS & Billing Expert – Railway Project
  
  
**Position:**
Senior QS & Billing Expert
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ Years
  
  
**Qualification:**
Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) from a recognized university.
  
  
**Location:**
Railway Project Site
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Senior QS & Billing Expert will be responsible for quantity surveying, measurement, billing, cost monitoring, contract administration, and commercial management of railway civil infrastructure works, ensuring accurate billing and compliance with contract conditions, specifications, and project requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Review and verify contractor measurements, RA bills, final bills, and supporting documents.
* Prepare and check detailed quantities, BOQs, rate analysis, and cost estimates for civil and railway infrastructure works.
* Monitor quantities executed at site and reconcile them with approved drawings, BOQ, and contract provisions.
* Conduct joint measurements with contractors and site teams and maintain accurate measurement records.
* Review variation claims, extra items, deviation statements, and rate analysis for additional works.
* Monitor project costs, quantities, and expenditure against the approved budget and contract value.
* Assist in contract administration, including interpretation of BOQ, specifications, payment terms, and contractual provisions.
* Review contractor submissions related to claims, extensions of time, escalation, and other commercial matters.
* Coordinate with engineering, planning, construction, and project management teams for timely resolution of billing and quantity-related issues.
* Maintain records of measurements, bills, variations, quantities, and commercial correspondence.
* Prepare monthly commercial reports, cost statements, quantity reconciliation, and billing status reports.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, contract conditions, Indian Railways/RDSO requirements, and applicable standards.
* Support the Project Manager in commercial and contractual matters related to railway civil works.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Quantity Surveying, billing, measurement, BOQ, rate analysis, and cost control.
* Good understanding of civil construction contracts and contract administration.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, AutoCAD, and quantity/billing software.
* Ability to independently verify contractor bills and assess quantities at site.
* Strong analytical, numerical, documentation, and reporting skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills with contractors and project stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary project environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in Quantity Surveying, Billing, Cost Control, or Commercial Management.
* Experience in railway/metro infrastructure projects will be preferred.
* Experience in civil works such as railway formation, earthwork, bridges, culverts, stations, drainage, and other infrastructure works.
* Experience in EPC/Item Rate/Construction Contracts, contractor billing, variations, claims, and final account settlement.
* Knowledge of Indian Railways, RDSO, Metro Rail standards, SOR/DSR, and railway contract procedures will be an advantage.

Key Deliverables
  
  

* Accurate and timely verification of contractor bills and measurements.
* Effective monitoring and reconciliation of quantities and project costs.
* Proper assessment and documentation of variations, claims, and additional works.
* Timely commercial and billing reports for project management.
* Compliance with contractual, technical, and financial requirements.
* Effective support to project management in QS, billing, and contract administration matters.

title: Manager Purchase
description:
Position Summary
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Management & Strategic Sourcing
* Lead end-to-end category management and strategic procurement for capital equipment (Greenfield & Rebuild projects), MRO, and spare parts categories.
* Own the complete equipment build cycle: source individual parts, sub-assemblies, and heavy components from a global and domestic supplier base, coordinate inbound logistics, and support in-house assembly and trial runs.
* Prepare component-level budgets for new products, conduct comprehensive market and industry research to inform category strategies, and collaborate with business area stakeholders for project estimation and cost modelling.
* Establish and maintain framework agreements, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), price benchmarking tools, and should-cost models for diverse equipment and spare parts.
* Supplier Development, De-risking & Cost Optimization
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic suppliers; assess and enhance existing supplier capacities across Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QDC) parameters.
* Drive cost-saving initiatives through competitive tendering, strategic bundling, group purchasing volumes, and alternative supplier development (e.g., building robust local/national models to mitigate foreign supply chain dependencies).
* Perform sub-assembly level risk assessments before ordering, develop secondary/alternative sources to de-risks supply chains, and maintain production continuity.
* Act as the primary commercial point of contact for key partners, managing supplier performance evaluations and sharing insights transparently across internal engineering, production, and quality teams.
* Cross-functional Collaboration & Quality Compliance
* Partner closely with design, production, and quality assurance teams during assembly and trial phases to resolve part deviations, manage supplier claims, and ensure strict technical conformity.
* Ensure full compliance with corporate sourcing policies, internal approval workflows, ISO standards, and corporate procurement audits.
* Drive internal restructuring initiatives to optimize procurement performance, fostering clear accountability across specialized purchase, sourcing, and supply chain verticals.
* Digital Transformation & Systems Excellence
* Leverage advanced procurement tools—specifically SAP HANA (MM & SH modules) and JAGGAER (RFX, Auctions, SRM, Supplier Evaluation, and Spend Analytics)—to drive process transparency and data integrity.
* Manage vendor onboarding onto digital platforms, facilitating EDI-based data exchange, order confirmation, and digital offer submissions.
* Train cross-functional teams (Purchase, Quality, and Shipping) and external suppliers on digital procurement modules to enhance department-wide response efficiency and reporting accuracy.

description:

The Indirect Tax Associate will handle GST compliance for clients of S P V S & Co., Chartered Accountants across different industries. * Good written and spoken communication in English and Tamil.
* Attention to detail and the ability to meet due dates across several clients.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and interpretation skills for complex tax issues.
* Ability to communicate clearly with clients and team members and to present technical information effectively.
* Attention to detail, high ethical standards, and the ability to manage multiple engagements and deadlines.
